title: DIBench: Benchmarking Decision Integrity of GUI-based Mobile Agents Under Deceptive Injections
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: As GUI-based mobile agents rapidly progress, rigorous safety evaluation of their autonomous decision-making in realistic app interfaces becomes increasingly critical. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on execution-level anomalies using task success or hijack rates, but fail to capture the in-task goal deviation risk in multi-candidate selection tasks, where the decision may be steered toward an attacker-specified target, even in violation of instruction-implied constraints (e.g., cheapest/highest-rated), without any overt execution anomalies. We present DIBench, a decision integrity benchmark for measuring this risk in mobile agents. DIBench covers 7 commercial and 3 simulated apps with 5 task types. Under a threat model restricted to non-privileged UI content, we construct 8 deceptive injection probe instantiations that can steer critical selections without overt anomalies. The benchmark includes 1,000 clean and 36,672 injected instances, with a unified protocol and integrity metrics for comparison. Experiments spanning 4 agent frameworks and 7 base models show that completion-based evaluation can overestimate agent trustworthiness and miss decision-integrity risks: deceptive injections steer selections and shift early action policies, inflating completion rates and creating a misleading illusion of safety. Common defenses, including detection, image preprocessing, and prompt reminders, yield inconsistent integrity gains. Overall, DIBench provides a unified, reproducible benchmark to quantify the risk of in-task goal deviation in mobile agents and enable comparable evaluations of safety defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIBench，一个面向移动智能体的决策完整性基准，用于量化多候选选择任务中被欺骗性注入引导而偏离指令目标的风险，弥补现有基准只关注执行级异常、忽略任务内目标偏离的不足。
AI.motivation: 随着基于 GUI 的移动智能体快速发展，对其在真实应用界面中自主决策的安全性评估愈发关键。现有基准主要关注执行级异常（如任务成功率或劫持率），无法捕捉多候选选择任务中的任务内目标偏离风险：即决策被引导至攻击者指定目标，甚至违反指令隐含约束（如最便宜/评分最高），却不出现明显的执行异常。
AI.method: 作者构建 DIBench 基准，覆盖 7 个商业应用和 3 个模拟应用、5 种任务类型。在仅限非特权 UI 内容的威胁模型下，构造 8 种欺骗性注入探针实例，可在不产生明显异常的情况下引导关键选择。基准包含 1,000 个干净实例和 36,672 个注入实例，并提供统一协议与完整性指标用于比较。
AI.result: 在 4 个智能体框架和 7 个基础模型上的实验表明：基于完成度的评估会高估智能体的可信度并漏掉决策完整性风险。欺骗性注入会引导选择、改变早期动作策略、抬高完成率，制造具有误导性的安全假象。常见防御手段（检测、图像预处理、提示提醒）带来的完整性收益并不一致。
AI.conclusion: DIBench 提供了统一、可复现的基准，用于量化移动智能体中任务内目标偏离风险，并支持对安全防御进行可比评估。

title: APEX: Active Protection at Execution Boundaries for LLM Agents
summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) hides adversarial instructions in content that large language model (LLM) agents read at runtime. As agents compose heterogeneous capability units, including Tools, MCP servers, and Skills, the carriers of injection multiply, and defenses built to recognize attack patterns fall behind them. We instead shift defense from covering attack patterns to one stable point: whatever the carrier and however the injection propagates, harm materializes only at the \emph{execution boundary}, where the agent turns internal state into an external action or released output. Safety there turns on two conditions, both settled by the trusted task rather than by the run: whether the proposed effect is authorized, and whether the runtime information reaching it is endorsed by that task. We present APEX, an active defense that enforces both at this boundary from a single authorization contract compiled before untrusted execution: \emph{evidence-gated prevention} admits an effect only when the contract justifies it, while \emph{deception-based exposure} makes unendorsed use reveal itself before the effect commits. Protection therefore follows from what the task permits rather than from how an attack is built, and applies uniformly across capability units without attack-specific policies or taint tracking. Against 13 baselines, APEX attains 0\% attack success on five of six benchmarks and 0.56\% on the sixth, holds 0\% under adaptive attacks on all three capability-unit types, and remains effective across defender backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengXR930/APEX_official/tree/official.

AI.tldr: 提出APEX主动防御框架，将间接提示注入防御从"覆盖攻击模式"转向"执行边界"授权控制，通过预编译授权合约实现证据门控预防与欺骗式暴露，在多基准上达到近乎0%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在运行时读取的内容中可能隐藏对抗性指令（间接提示注入IPI）。随着智能体整合异构能力单元（Tools、MCP服务器、Skills），注入载体不断增多，而基于识别攻击模式的防御措施难以跟上攻击手段的变化，因此需要一种不依赖攻击模式的稳定防御点。
AI.method: APEX将防御焦点转移到执行边界——智能体把内部状态转化为外部动作或输出释放之处。安全取决于两个由可信任务（而非运行时）决定的条件：提议的效果是否被授权，以及到达该处的运行时信息是否被任务认可。基于在执行不可信内容前编译的单一授权合约，APEX在执行边界同时强制执行这两点：证据门控预防（仅当合约认可时才允许效果）与欺骗式暴露（使未被认可的使用在效果提交前自我暴露）。
AI.result: 在13个基线对比下，APEX在六个基准中的五个实现0%攻击成功率，第六个仅0.56%；在三种能力单元类型上面对自适应攻击时保持0%攻击成功率，并在不同防御者主干网络上依然有效。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: APEX表明，防护能力可源于任务所允许的范围而非攻击的构建方式，无需针对特定攻击的策略或污点追踪，即可统一适用于各类能力单元，实现稳健且通用的间接提示注入防御。

title: TARE: Weigh a Never-Poisoned Twin Before Reading Backdoor-Defense Costs
summary: Backdoor-defense leaderboards print a clean-accuracy drop and read it as removal cost. Measured on the poisoned victim alone, the drop cannot separate removal from what the defense does to any model, and inherits the victim's start, which for three of BackdoorBench's sixteen attacks is a configuration file: WaNet, BPP and Input-Aware ship a MultiStepLR that never fires, so their victims never anneal and are the least accurate in 30/31 public CIFAR cells at $\leq$5%. On PreAct-ResNet18, fine-tuning-family defenses return a low start to their own level, so there the published cost is negative, the benchmark's rating clips the "gain" to zero, and 2 of 48 citing defense papers we read rest a no-cost claim on those cells; TSBD and CGD, re-run with their code, "gain" on a never-poisoned model too. A $2\times2$ editing only that scheduler line isolates the cause, its swapped arms self-registered before they ran: the sign of the fine-tuning family's clean-model cost reverses both ways while its published gain on the annealed victim only shrinks toward zero, 44/44 seeds following the schedule, replicated on BPP, FT-SAM, CIFAR-100 and VGG19-BN and induced in a second toolkit. TARE runs the same defense on a never-poisoned twin of the same recipe, schedule and seed (on BackdoorBench, $\leq$10 poisoned images, admitted only below 5% attack success); what the twin loses is the tare. On the BadNets grid seven of eight defenses charge the twin (Neural Cleanse only where its detector fires), +0.13 (fine-tuning) to +5.70 points (I-BAU); the eighth, ABL, destroys it. Within an attack the start cancels from rankings, so the tare re-orders nothing there; what poisoning adds beyond it is printed under two estimators and not corrected, its removal share unidentified. We ship the three-key patch, a signed tare column (7 attacks $\times$ 8 defenses) and TARE-Z, a twin-free estimator for seed-stable defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文指出后门防御排行榜以干净准确率下降衡量"移除代价"存在根本缺陷：对三个攻击（WaNet、BPP、Input-Aware），其配置文件中MultiStepLR从未触发，导致受害模型从不退火、初始准确率极低；在PreAct-ResNet18上微调族防御因此表现为"负代价"。作者通过仅修改调度器一行的2×2实验隔离成因，并提出TARE（以从未投毒的孪生模型衡量防御对任意模型的固有损伤）及无孪生的TARE-Z估计器。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御榜单把干净准确率下降直接读作"移除代价"，但该指标仅在投毒受害模型上测量，既无法区分是真正移除了后门还是防御本身对任何模型的普遍损伤，又继承了受害模型的起点。在BackdoorBench的16种攻击中有3种（WaNet、BPP、Input-Aware）配置文件中MultiStepLR从不触发，受害模型从不退火、在31个公开CIFAR格子中的30个里准确率≤5%，是准确率最低的一批，导致微调族防御的"代价"被误读（甚至为负，被榜单裁剪为0），部分引用论文据此得出"零代价"结论。
AI.method: 1) 指出并定位调度器缺陷：仅对MultiStepLR这一行做2×2编辑实验隔离因果，交换两组臂并预注册；2) 在BPP、FT-SAM、CIFAR-100、VGG19-BN上复现，44/44个种子遵循该调度，并在第二个工具包中诱导出同样现象；3) 提出TARE：对同一配方、调度和种子的从未投毒孪生模型运行相同防御，孪生模型损失即为"tare"；4) 在BadNets网格上对8种防御测量孪生损伤；5) 提出TARE-Z，一种无需孪生模型、适用于种子稳定防御的估计器。
AI.result: 仅改调度器一行的实验显示：微调族的干净模型代价符号双向反转，而其在对已退火受害模型上的"公布增益"只趋近于零。TARE测量下，BadNets网格8种防御中有7种对孪生模型造成损失（Neural Cleanse例外，仅在其检测器触发处），从+0.13（微调）到+5.70个百分点（I-BAU）；第八种ABL直接摧毁孪生模型。在单一攻击内部，起点从排名中抵消，TARE不改变排序。最终交付三键补丁、带符号的tare列（7攻击×8防御）和TARE-Z估计器。
AI.conclusion: 现有榜单的"移除代价"混淆了防御的固有损伤与后门移除效果，且在部分配置下因调度器缺陷而被系统性扭曲；应以TARE（孪生模型损伤）作为更诚实的度量基准，并采用提供的补丁与TARE-Z估计器进行修正。

title: Which Image Property Carries the Jailbreak? A Controlled Dissection of Image-to-Text Jailbreaks
summary: Image-to-text jailbreaks place harmful intent in text, image content, or the relationship between them. We examine image-side factors across four published attack families on a 313-prompt StrongREJECT slice, using five multimodal models and an additional appendix evaluation of InternVL3.5-8B. The harmful instruction is held constant across conditions; the baseline matrix uses one draw per prompt, and paired ablations use three draws with an automated rubric judge. A bare harmful query, with or without a benign unrelated image, produces little attack success on most victims, while attack images substantially increase it. First, per-tile entropy and JPEG size do not reliably distinguish attack tiles from size-matched benign distractors, limiting density-only screening. Second, earlier tile-count ladders were confounded by payload visibility. A corrected region-count test found no detectable effect, so the role of tile-count structure remains unresolved. Third, on Qwen3-VL-8B, the E4 manipulation that removes query-specific relatedness lowers ASR by about 0.12. This supports a bounded attribution to the relatedness manipulation, although image-text congruence remains unmeasured. A within-category control reproduces the direction on overlapping stimuli. Five tests survive the global statistical correction, but only E4 supports attribution to one measured descriptor; the within-category result is a robustness check, not a separate attribution. These conclusions remain conditional on the rubric judge.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验图像侧因素在图像-文本越狱攻击中的作用，发现普通有害查询（即使配上无关图像）大多无法成功，而攻击图像能显著提升成功率；但密度类指标、图块数量结构等未被可靠证实，仅"图文相关性操纵"在一个模型上获得有限归因支持。
AI.motivation: 图像-文本越狱可将有害意图置于文本、图像内容或二者的关系中，但既有工作对"图像侧"到底哪些因素真正驱动攻击成功缺乏受控、可复现的归因。作者希望在固定有害指令、配对消融的条件下，厘清攻击图像中究竟是哪些可测量特征在起作用，以及哪些此前的结论是混杂导致的假象。
AI.method: 在 313 条 StrongREJECT 切片上，跨四类已发表攻击家族、五种多模态模型（附录另评 InternVL3.5-8B）考察图像侧因素。有害指令在各条件间保持不变；基线矩阵每条提示一次采样，配对消融采用三次采样并由自动评分量表评判。具体检验包括：逐图块熵与 JPEG 体积对比尺寸匹配的良性干扰项、修正后的区域计数（图块数量）测试、移除查询相关性的 E4 操纵、以及类内对照与全局统计校正。
AI.result: 1) 裸有害查询无论是否附良性无关图像，在多数受害模型上攻击成功率都很低；攻击图像则显著提升成功率。2) 逐图块熵与 JPEG 大小无法可靠区分攻击图块与尺寸匹配的良性干扰项，限制了仅凭密度的筛查。3) 早前的图块数量阶梯被"载荷可见性"混杂；修正后的区域计数测试未检出可检测效应，图块数量结构的作用仍悬而未决。4) 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，移除查询特定相关性的 E4 操纵使 ASR 下降约 0.12。5) 类内对照在重叠刺激上复现了方向。6) 五项检验通过全局统计校正，但仅 E4 支持对某一测量描述符的归因。
AI.conclusion: 攻击图像的效力主要来自图像内容本身而非"有图"这一事实；密度类与图块数量类解释均未获稳健支持，图块结构的作用仍不确定。较有说服力的发现是对"图文相关性"操纵的有限（有界）归因，但图文一致性本身未被测量，故归因并非完整。类内结果只是稳健性检验而非独立归因。所有结论均以自动量表评判为前提，属条件性结论。

title: SAFESHIELD: A Decision-Organization Framework for Deployment-Time Safety of Small Language Models
comment: Accepted to the Application Track of IEEE TPS 2026. 12 pages
summary: Deployment-time safety of language models is commonly implemented through runtime guardrails such as input moderation, routing, retrieval verification, and output filtering. Existing deployment frameworks provide increasingly capable mechanisms for these functions, but offer limited guidance on how the safety decisions they produce should be explicitly organized, coordinated, and audited. We formulate deployment-time safety as a decision-organization problem with two elements: responsibility-oriented decomposition of safety decisions and explicit coordination among them. We instantiate this formulation in SAFESHIELD, a deployment-time safety system for small language models that organizes four recurring decision responsibilities (admission, routing, evidence, and release) and records committed decisions in auditable Decision Traces. We evaluate SAFESHIELD through mechanism-level experiments, aggregate stage ablations, controlled coordination ablations, and a deployment-oriented stress suite. Mechanism-level results show that the instantiated safeguards provide the capabilities required by the decision process, while aggregate ablations show substantial degradation in end-to-end safety as the surrounding safety organization is removed. More importantly, dedicated coordination ablations preserve the participating safeguard mechanisms while selectively severing their dependencies: removing admission gating substantially increases false release, and withholding upstream evidence from the release decision reduces release accuracy from 96.0% to 69.5%. These results provide system-level evidence that deployment-time safety depends not only on the capability of individual guardrails, but also on how their decisions are organized and coordinated.

AI.tldr: 论文将部署时安全性表述为"决策组织"问题，并提出SAFESHIELD系统，通过可审计的决策轨迹组织四类安全决策，实验证明安全不仅取决于单个防护机制的能力，还取决于决策如何被组织与协调。
AI.motivation: 现有部署框架虽提供了越来越强的运行时防护机制（输入审核、路由、检索验证、输出过滤），但对这些安全决策应如何被显式组织、协调与审计缺乏指导。
AI.method: 将部署时安全建模为决策组织问题，包含两要素：面向责任的决策分解与决策间的显式协调。在SAFESHIELD系统中实例化，面向小语言模型组织四类决策职责（准入、路由、证据、发布），并将已提交决策记录为可审计的决策轨迹。评估采用机制级实验、阶段消融、受控协调消融及部署导向压力测试。
AI.result: 机制级结果表明所实例化的防护具备决策过程所需能力；聚合消融显示移除安全组织会导致端到端安全显著退化；协调消融保持各防护机制不变而选择性切断依赖：移除准入门控显著增加误发布，隐藏上游证据使发布决策准确率从96.0%降至69.5%。
AI.conclusion: 部署时安全不仅依赖单个防护机制的能力，更依赖其决策如何被组织与协调，提供了系统层面的证据。

title: Disentangling Models from Personas in Heterogeneous LLM Simulations
comment: Presented as a Spotlight Paper at the Second Workshop on Social Simulation with LLMS, Third Conference on Language Modeling, 2026
summary: Multi-agent simulations with large language models (LLMs) often operate networks of agents with a single base model. This overlooks the inter-model effects which may dominate engagement dynamics in real-world deployments. To show this, we simulate a heterogeneous social network powered by several different base models and show that the amount of engagement an agent receives depends more on its base model than on its assigned persona. The attraction or repulsion effects of a base model strengthen dramatically when more models are added in the mix, suggesting that networks dynamics may converge to base model effects at scale. To help explain this effect, we conduct a series of content-mediating analyses, showing the predictability of base models across contexts as well as the relationship between a model's lexical patterns and an engagement-maximizing style. In light of recent developments in mass multi-agent interaction, this work underscores the relevance of heterogeneous compositions in driving the outcomes of those networks

AI.tldr: 该论文通过构建由多个不同基座模型驱动的异质社交网络模拟，发现智能体获得的互动量更多取决于其基座模型而非被赋予的人设，且随模型种类增加，基座模型的吸引或排斥效应显著增强，暗示网络动态在规模化时可能收敛于基座模型效应。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体模拟通常使用单一基座模型构建智能体网络，忽略了真实部署中不同模型之间的交互效应，而这些跨模型效应可能主导互动动态。作者希望揭示异质模型组成对网络结果的关键影响。
AI.method: 构建由多个不同基座模型驱动的异质社交网络模拟；比较智能体的基座模型与其被赋予人设对互动量的影响；逐步增加模型种类以观察吸引/排斥效应的变化；并开展一系列内容中介分析，考察基座模型跨情境的可预测性以及模型词汇模式与互动最大化风格之间的关系。
AI.result: 智能体获得的互动量更多取决于其基座模型而非被赋予的人设；当混合中加入更多模型时，基座模型的吸引或排斥效应显著增强；内容中介分析显示基座模型在不同情境下具有可预测性，且模型的词汇模式与互动最大化风格存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 在规模化多智能体互动背景下，异质模型组成是驱动网络结果的关键因素，网络动态可能随规模收敛于基座模型效应。该研究强调在智能体网络模拟中考虑异质组成的重要性。

title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GameGo框架，将简短游戏种子系统性转化为基于行业实践的产品需求文档，配合动态压缩策略保留核心玩法约束，并构建了含55,060条开发轨迹的数据集GameGoData与124个查询的基准GameGoBench，训练出的GameGoCoder在游戏开发任务上超越同类基线并逼近前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 浏览器端游戏生成是LLM前端执行能力的重要前沿，但现有工作多依赖复杂的多轮工作流或仅关注静态评估基准；直接从稀疏用户查询生成复杂游戏会导致假设不充分、机制不完整、玩法割裂和视觉美学受限。本文旨在实现由编码智能体驱动的端到端真实游戏合成。
AI.method: 提出GameGo可扩展框架，系统性地将简短游戏种子转化为符合行业游戏开发实践的产品需求文档；采用任务特定的动态压缩策略，在最大化信息密度的同时保持指令遵循，从而在不限制设计探索的前提下保留核心玩法约束。基于该流程构建了覆盖2D、2.5D、3D游戏的55,060条开发轨迹数据集GameGoData，以及包含124个多样化游戏查询的基准GameGoBench，并在其上训练GameGoCoder模型。
AI.result: GameGoCoder在多项游戏开发基准上优于同等基线，性能可与前沿模型相媲美。所有代码、数据集和模型将公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过将简短游戏种子转化为完整需求文档并结合动态压缩，GameGo为编码智能体的端到端游戏生成提供了可扩展方案，并配套开放数据、基准与模型，推动该方向研究。

title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
summary: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"零样本可视化"(ZSV)任务：用户用自然语言指定概念，将文档映射到相应概念轴上以进行可视化；作者建立基准，比较嵌入相似度、直接语义判断与条件似然估计三类打分方法。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型用于文本语料的视觉探索具有应用价值，但构建实用的ZSV系统并不简单，需在特征函数、高效实现权衡以及影响可视化质量的前后处理决策上做出选择，目前缺乏系统性的评估基准与设计指南。
AI.method: 建立ZSV基准，对比跨越嵌入相似度、直接语义判断、条件似然估计的方法；在多个数据集和用例上，从语义忠实性、分数保真度和计算成本三方面评估不同打分方法与设计选择，并将该方法应用于无标注语料以考察真实探索场景中的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于下一词概率的打分在所评估方法中提供最佳的实际权衡。应用于无标注语料时，还揭示出若干设计考量：分级轴与二元相关性过滤的结合使用，以及离题文档中存在的组合式情感偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，作者为构建端到端ZSV基线提供了实用指南。

title: Medical Image Alignment Assessment as a Test of Generalist Visual Reasoning in Frontier Multimodal Models
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly positioned as general purpose visual reasoners as part of the quest for artificial general intelligence. A key test of this generality is whether they can perform novel visual judgments that humans can make reliably from visual evidence and task instructions, without task-specific parameter optimisation. We investigate this question through the task of medical image alignment assessment, where the goal is to establish whether there is anatomical correspondence between two images. Human visual assessment of image alignment is still the gold standard and most common approach; however, it requires trained operators and is impractical to scale for large datasets. We evaluate recent generations of MLLMs on two exemplar medical image alignment tasks, varying both prompting strategies and image-presentation methods. We compare against a locally fine-tuned MLLM and a task-specific CNN to examine the trade-off between frontier general purpose models and smaller models that require specific task optimisation but can be used locally. We show that are reaching an inflection point, where frontier MLLMs can now perform effective visual assessment of medical image alignment. Models released only a few months ago generalise poorly and, in some settings, perform barely above chance, whereas GPT-6 achieves over 85% across almost all scenarios tested. Fine-tuned local models can match or exceed frontier-model performance on the tasks on which they are trained, but transfer substantially less effectively to unseen settings. These findings identify medical image alignment as a useful test bed for generalist visual reasoning and suggest that frontier multimodal models are beginning to acquire capabilities that could support a common quality-control mechanism across heterogeneous medical-imaging pipelines.

AI.tldr: 前沿多模态大模型（MLLM）在医学图像配准评估任务上出现能力拐点：GPT-6 在几乎所有测试场景中准确率超过85%，而仅数月前发布的模型在部分场景仅略高于随机水平；本地微调模型在已训练任务上可匹敌甚至超越前沿模型，但跨场景迁移能力明显不足。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于检验前沿MLLM是否具备"通用视觉推理器"的泛化能力，即无需任务特定参数优化、仅凭视觉证据与任务指令即可完成新颖的视觉判断。医学图像配准评估是理想测试场：它依赖人类专家判断、难以规模化，且需要跨异构影像流程的通用质控手段。
AI.method: 研究选取两个代表性医学图像配准任务，对近几代MLLM进行评估，并系统变化提示策略（prompting）与图像呈现方式（image presentation）。同时与本地微调MLLM和任务专用CNN进行对比，以考察前沿通用模型与需任务优化但可本地部署的小模型之间的权衡。
AI.result: 结果显示能力拐点已经出现：前沿MLLM能有效完成医学图像配准的视觉评估。仅数月前发布的模型泛化性差，部分设置下仅略高于随机水平；而GPT-6在几乎所有测试场景中准确率超过85%。本地微调模型在其训练任务上可匹配或超过前沿模型，但迁移到未见场景时效果显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 医学图像配准评估可作为通用视觉推理的有效测试基准。前沿多模态模型正开始获得支撑跨异构医学影像流程统一质控机制的能力，但通用性与任务专用优化之间仍存在权衡。

title: Towards a Unified Misuse Monitoring Benchmark
summary: LLM agents increasingly act in multi-actor environments, exposing them to misuse from multiple sources: decomposition attacks, where a harmful request is split into innocuous sub-requests, and prompt injection attacks, where a compromised tool delivers a malicious instruction. Existing evaluations treat these threats separately and ask whether a trajectory is harmful, rather than when it becomes harmful. We propose monitoring the agent's responses, where its actions are externalised, and ask whether the first point where monitors identify harm lands within a harm window (from the agent's first harmful commitment to goal execution). We develop a unified formalism for trace-level misuse monitoring and use it to construct a benchmark of ~6,200 conversation transcripts between a user, an LLM agent, and the external environment, spanning both threats in a shared schema, with a labelled harm window, corresponding benign controls, and matched instances of refusals to these requests. Across 17 monitor configurations, we find that our proposed action-framed monitors perform well on both threats under classical metrics (AUC: 0.95 and 0.99 respectively), while content-framed monitors collapse on injection attacks (AUC: 0.52). We also show that classical position-blind metrics paint an optimistic picture of monitor performance, since all monitors localise decomposition attacks poorly under the interval metric, which measures the ability to localise harm. Broadly, we illustrate the need for a unified study of misuse monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一的“轨迹级”滥用监控形式化框架，构建覆盖分解攻击与提示注入攻击的约6200条对话基准，并提出以“危害窗口”定位为核心的评估方式，发现动作框架监控器在两威胁上表现良好，而内容框架监控器在注入攻击上失效，且传统位置盲指标高估了监控性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地在多主体环境中行动，面临多来源滥用威胁：分解攻击（将有害请求拆分为无害子请求）与提示注入攻击（被污染的工具传递恶意指令）。现有评估将两类威胁分开处理，且只问“轨迹是否有害”，而非“何时开始有害”，无法反映监控器能否及时定位危害。
AI.method: 提出统一的轨迹级滥用监控形式化方法；基于该框架构建约6200条对话记录基准，涉及用户、LLM智能体与外部环境，在同一schema下同时覆盖两类威胁，并标注危害窗口（从智能体首次有害承诺到目标执行），配有良性对照与对应的拒绝实例；评估17种监控配置，区分动作框架与内容框架监控器，并采用经典指标与衡量定位能力的区间指标。
AI.result: 动作框架监控器在两类威胁上均表现良好（AUC分别为0.95与0.99）；内容框架监控器在注入攻击上崩溃（AUC 0.52）；传统位置盲指标给出乐观图景，所有监控器在区间指标下对分解攻击的定位能力均较弱。
AI.conclusion: 需要对滥用监控进行统一研究，并重视监控器对危害发生位置的定位能力，而非仅关注轨迹级危害判别。

title: Catching Developers in the Flow: Low-Latency Agentic Program Repair at Google Scale
comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary:
Manual repair of program failures is time-consuming and disruptive for software developers, particularly during the pre-submit phase where test failures occur within continuous integration systems. While Automated Program Repair has seen significant advancement through Large Language Models, existing state-of-the-art techniques primarily focus on post-submit workflows, operating offline without the low-latency requirements necessary to assist developers in real-time within their flow before they switch context.
  In this paper, we introduce FlowAgent, an AI agent deployed at Google to automatically repair test failures in the pre-submit outer-loop workflow inside continuous integration systems. Integrated into Google's internal developer tools, Critique and Cider,FlowAgent utilizes a ReAct-style generate-and-validate loop, as well as rigorous pre-execution and post-execution abstention filters to ensure high-quality suggestions under strict latency constraints.
  Based on our case studies, FlowAgent is highly effective. First, a manual evaluation conducted on 195 real-world test failures demonstrated 67.18% accuracy in suggesting correct fixes. Following its Google-wide deployment, FlowAgent suggested fixes on 295,508changes, of which developers previewed 65,069 and applied 28,554. Developer feedback from interviews indicate that the agent is useful in suggesting correct fixes, integration of autonomous repair agents into industrial software engineering workflows is received well, while interesting challenges and opportunities still remain.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 FlowAgent，一个部署于 Google 持续集成流程中、用于在提交前自动修复测试失败的 AI 智能体，在严格延迟约束下取得了 67.18% 的修复准确率并已在 Google 大规模落地应用。
AI.motivation: 手动修复程序故障耗时且打断开发者工作流，尤其在持续集成系统的提交前阶段，测试失败会中断开发者的实时心流，导致上下文切换成本高昂。现有基于大语言模型的自动程序修复技术多聚焦于提交后离线场景，无法满足提交前实时辅助所需的低延迟要求，因此缺少能够在开发者流程中即时提供修复建议的方案。
AI.method: 本文提出 FlowAgent，部署于 Google，用于在持续集成系统的提交前外循环工作流中自动修复测试失败。该智能体集成到 Google 内部开发者工具 Critique 与 Cider 中，采用 ReAct 风格的“生成—验证”循环，并配合严格的执行前与执行后弃权过滤器，以在严格延迟约束下保证建议的高质量。
AI.result: 基于案例研究，FlowAgent 效果显著。对 195 个真实测试失败的人工评估显示，其给出正确修复建议的准确率达 67.18%。在 Google 全公司范围部署后，FlowAgent 在 295,508 个变更上给出了修复建议，其中开发者预览了 65,069 个并实际应用了 28,554 个。访谈中的开发者反馈表明，该智能体在建议正确修复方面很有用，将自主修复智能体集成到工业软件工程工作流中受到良好接受。
AI.conclusion: FlowAgent 证明了在工业级持续集成提交前场景中，结合 ReAct 生成—验证循环与弃权过滤器的 AI 智能体能够在低延迟约束下提供高质量的自动修复建议，并具备大规模实际落地价值。同时，将自主修复智能体融入工业软件工程流程仍存在有趣挑战与机遇，值得进一步探索。

title: Joint Workflow and Prompt Optimization for User Behavior Simulation
comment: under review for ACM Transactions on Information Systems Journal, 34 pages, 2 figures
summary: User behavior simulation is the computational modeling of user interactions within information systems through the use of simulated agents in place of live users. It supports system testing and evaluation, decision-making and forecasting, and user experience design. Existing simulators rely on hand-crafted rules or domain expertise that transfers poorly across tasks. SWORD (Simulation-driven Workflow and Prompt Optimization with Role-based Design) is introduced as a framework that jointly optimizes multi-agent workflow topology and natural-language prompts. It is guided solely by a scalar task metric, without domain initialization or task-specific engineering. The experimental results demonstrate that SWORD achieves statistically significant gains over prompt-only, workflow-only, and staged-optimization baselines under a controlled, identical-backbone comparison. Against the strongest published domain-specific baseline, SWORD further improves accuracy while using a smaller backbone model, substantially less training data, and a very reasonable API cost (\$4--\$6 for each dataset). Beyond predictive performance, SWORD autonomously discovers domain-relevant signals, review-sentiment mapping rules and epidemiological decay priors, purely from scalar error feedback, establishing textual gradients as a mechanism for unsupervised feature-importance discovery in user behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SWORD框架，联合优化多智能体工作流拓扑与自然语言提示，仅依赖标量任务指标驱动，无需领域初始化或任务特定工程，在用户行为模拟任务上显著优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 用户行为模拟对系统测试、决策预测和用户体验设计很重要，但现有模拟器依赖手工规则或领域专家知识，跨任务迁移能力差。
AI.method: SWORD（Simulation-driven Workflow and Prompt Optimization with Role-based Design）框架，联合优化多智能体工作流拓扑和自然语言提示，仅由标量任务指标引导，无需领域初始化或任务特定工程。
AI.result: 在受控、相同骨干模型对比下，SWORD相对仅提示优化、仅工作流优化及分阶段优化基线取得统计显著提升；相比最强已发表领域专用基线，使用更小骨干模型、更少训练数据和极低API成本（每数据集4–6美元）仍提高准确率。此外SWORD仅从标量误差反馈中自主发现领域相关信号、评论情绪映射规则和流行病学衰减先验。
AI.conclusion: SWORD证明文本梯度可作为用户行为建模中无监督特征重要性发现的机制，实现低成本、跨任务的多智能体模拟优化。

title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
summary:
Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

AI.tldr: Text2Dashboard 是一个将自然语言分析请求转化为可检查仪表盘的原型系统，通过确定性软件控制执行、并评估其在真实任务与故障场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言分析请求转化为仪表盘时，需要兼顾模型灵活性与执行可控性、可审计性与故障恢复能力，本文提出并验证该思路。
AI.method: 结合受模式约束的模型决策与类型化工具、持久状态和确定性Hooks，实现实体解析、元数据发现、只读SQL、仪表盘组装及静态检查、动态预检与浏览器检查。
AI.result: 冻结任务上严格成功为6/8，元数据选择4/4通过，SQL任务均满足语义标准但仅2/4满足精确输出列契约；仪表盘任务通过4/4单面板、一个双面板及一个已有仪表盘改进；十个故障场景均达标且无未授权外部副作用；模型推理占运行时间超97%。
AI.conclusion: 结果具有小型、特定场景局限，尚不足以证明生产可用性、通用Text-to-SQL准确性或相较手工构建的效率优势。

title: Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable
summary: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.

AI.tldr: 论文将语言模型激活空间中的因果影响拆解为容量、响应性和对齐三个因素，发现因果有效性需三者同时较高且具有上下文依赖性，并提出因果探针以提升引导效果。
AI.motivation: 定位语言模型激活空间中的潜在结构对理解和控制模型行为至关重要，但不同结构在因果影响上差异显著，因此需要探究"什么使一个结构具有可操作性（可因果干预）"。
AI.method: 将因果影响建模为容量（输出对沿该结构移动的敏感性）、响应性（概念在当前上下文中可被激发的程度）和对齐（结构与该概念上下文特定表示的一致程度）三个因子的乘积；在4个语言模型家族、50个概念上进行实证验证；并据此将线性探针的训练限制在因果有效方向构成的低维子空间，提出因果探针。
AI.result: 因果有效性要求三个因子都高：容量和响应性低分别使因果效果下降84%和95%，而对齐低甚至会逆转效果、抑制概念表达。因果性是上下文依赖而非结构内在属性，因果有效方向构成随上下文变化的低维子空间。因果探针在跨模型引导上实现17%–118%的提升，同时概念检测仅下降3%。
AI.conclusion: 因果影响可分解为可解释且相互独立的三个约束因子，且因果性随上下文变化；利用这一低维因果子空间训练探针，可在几乎不损失检测性能的前提下大幅提升模型引导的效果。

title: RADC: Risk-Aware Dual Caching for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Cache-based test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language models is often hindered by background bias in global representations and unreliable entropy-based cache admission under representation variations. To address these limitations, we propose RADC, which enhances prototype learning through reliable dual caching. RADC introduces a Semantic Foreground Cache that aggregates category-consistent spatial evidence from CLIP representations, yielding foreground prototypes that complement the global cache while mitigating background interference. To reliably manage both caches, Gaussian Risk Admission models multi-view representations as diagonal Gaussian distributions and jointly considers class separation and feature uncertainty to prioritize reliable cache candidates. RADC integrates zero-shot logits with complementary global- and foreground-cache predictions for robust inference. Extensive experiments on cross-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 RADC，通过语义前景缓存与高斯风险准入，提升视觉-语言模型基于缓存的测试时适应性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于缓存的视觉-语言模型测试时适应存在两个问题：全局表示中的背景偏差，以及表示变化下基于熵的缓存准入不可靠。
AI.method: RADC 通过可靠的双缓存增强原型学习：1）语义前景缓存，从 CLIP 表示中聚合类别一致的空间证据，生成前景原型以补充全局缓存并缓解背景干扰；2）高斯风险准入，将多视角表示建模为对角高斯分布，联合考虑类别分离度与特征不确定性来筛选可靠缓存候选；3）融合零样本 logits 与全局、前景缓存预测进行推理。
AI.result: 在跨域和分布外基准上的大量实验表明，方法持续达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: RADC 通过双缓存机制与可靠性准入策略，有效缓解背景偏差与缓存不可靠问题，实现稳健且领先的测试时适应。

title: Jailbreaking Open-Weight LLMs via Random Embedding Perturbations
summary: While open-weight models have enjoyed steady progress in capabilities and wide adoption across multiple domains, their safety remains an important concern. One key feature is the ability to refuse or deflect harmful, malicious, or insensitive prompts. In this paper, we expose safety vulnerabilities across six common open-weight LLMs of various sizes that consistently lead to harmful or unsafe responses on the JailbreakBench benchmark dataset. Our proposed attack, Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV), is a simple and fast "jailbreaking" technique that is cheaper than prior approaches, which typically require gradient computations, per-prompt optimizations, or altering internal weights of the models. PEV just adds independent Gaussian noise in the embedding vector representations of the prompt, with no need for further manipulations. To generate unsafe responses, we repeatedly sample additive noise from this distribution. In our experiments, we observe that the average compute cost to get the first successful attack is up to an order of magnitude less than previous attacks. The first successful jailbreak on a new prompt typically arrives within one minute on every tested model, and PEV generates unsafe responses across all models for all prompts in JailbreakBench. No other tested method achieves such results, despite them taking longer to run. More broadly, we believe that understanding the behavior of LLMs under perturbations in the embedding vectors is an important research direction: while perturbations constitute a major security risk, they can also serve as a valuable tool for exploring the dynamical behavior of such models.

AI.tldr: 提出 PEV 方法：仅在提示词嵌入向量上加高斯噪声即可高效越狱六种主流开放权重 LLM，成本比现有攻击低一个数量级，且对所有测试模型与 JailbreakBench 全部提示均成功。
AI.motivation: 开放权重模型能力与采用度不断提升，但其拒绝有害/恶意提示的安全能力仍存隐患；现有越狱方法通常需要梯度计算、逐提示优化或修改模型内部权重，代价高、速度慢，因此需要一种更简单、更快、更廉价的攻击方式以暴露安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出 Perturbed Embedding Vector（PEV）：在提示词的嵌入向量表示上直接加入独立高斯噪声，无需梯度、无需逐提示优化、无需改动模型权重，通过反复从该分布采样加性噪声来触发不安全回复。
AI.result: 在六个不同规模的常见开放权重 LLM 上于 JailbreakBench 数据集上均持续产生有害或不安全回复；获得首次成功攻击的平均计算成本比此前方法低至多一个数量级；每个新提示的首次成功越狱通常在1分钟内完成；PEV 在所有模型、所有提示上均成功，其他测试方法即使运行更久也未能达到该效果。
AI.conclusion: PEV 表明开放权重 LLM 在嵌入空间扰动下存在显著安全风险，且该扰动既是重大安全隐患，也可作为探索模型动态行为的有价值工具，理解嵌入向量扰动下的模型行为是重要研究方向。

title: A Validated Dataset and Benchmark for Coherent Multi-Diagram SysML Models
summary: Systems engineers use several diagrams to describe the structure and behavior of systems. Engineers create these diagrams together to make sure that they use the same elements and remain consistent with one another. Large language models can generate diagrams as text or code, which makes it possible to create system diagrams automatically. However, their ability to generate coherent sets of diagrams is not well understood, and existing datasets and benchmarks do not directly measure this ability at scale. We introduce SEMAADB (Systems Engineering Modeling Assistant with AI Dataset and Benchmark), a dataset of 3,000 engineering contexts and 15,000 diagrams. Each context contains five connected SysML views: Requirement, Block Definition, Activity, State Machine, and Sequence. Here, a view is a diagram that presents one aspect of a system. We checked the diagram sets for consistency and valid rendering. A set of 100 contexts is also human-verified and forms the benchmark test set. We evaluate three language models on two tasks. In diagram repair, the strongest model repairs 64.3% of semantic errors . In cross-diagram update the best propagation F1 is 80.7% when a model applies one change across related diagrams. The results show that syntax repair is nearly solved, but semantic repair and consistency across diagrams are still challenging tasks for models. SEMAADB therefore provides both a large diagram resource and a set of benchmarks for measuring coherent multi-diagram SysML generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SEMAADB，一个包含3000个工程上下文和15000个SysML图的系统工程项目数据集与基准，用于评估大语言模型生成连贯多图系统的能力。
AI.motivation: 系统工程师需联合创建多种图以确保元素一致，而大语言模型虽能生成图的文本或代码，但其生成连贯图集的能力尚不明确，现有数据集和基准无法大规模直接衡量这一能力。
AI.method: 构建SEMAADB数据集，包含3000个工程上下文和15000个图，每个上下文含五种相互关联的SysML视图（需求、模块定义、活动、状态机、序列）。检查图集的一致性与有效渲染，并将100个上下文进行人工验证构成基准测试集。在图上修复和跨图更新两项任务上评估三个语言模型。
AI.result: 在图修复任务中，最强模型修复了64.3%的语义错误；在跨图更新任务中，最佳传播F1为80.7%。结果表明语法修复已接近解决，但语义修复和跨图一致性仍是挑战。
AI.conclusion: SEMAADB既提供了大规模图资源，也提供了一套用于衡量连贯多图SysML生成的基准。

title: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual Semantic-Social World Models
summary: Fully decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), also referred to as independent learning, requires each agent to learn and act using only its local information and experience, without a centralized critic or inter-agent communication. Such a stringent information structure renders the conventional reward signal ambiguous. A poor return may result from an ineffective ego action, an incompatible teammate response, or an effective opponent response, yet scalar rewards alone do not reveal which explanation is responsible. We argue that agents can learn more effectively by prospectively comparing the consequences of candidate actions rather than diagnosing failures only from realized returns. We introduce CASTLE (Counterfactual Action-conditioned Semantic Tokens for Local Execution in Decentralized MARL), an offline-training, online-in-context guidance framework with two complementary world models. A Local Dynamics World Model, offline pre-trained over agents' local trajectories, summarizes the agent's local trajectory dynamics and partial observability, while a Semantic-Social World Model predicts compact short-horizon task and social consequences for each candidate ego action. The latter is trained from counterfactual simulator rollouts that expose plausible teammate and opponent responses to alternative actions taken from the same logged rollout state. During online learning and execution, both world models remain frozen and are queried by agents using only locally available information. Their prediction logits provide in-context guidance to an independent PPO policy. Across 30 matched seeds on Tag, Spread, and Adversary in the benchmark multi-particle environments, our proposed CASTLE achieves the highest mean final score among the evaluated methods, exceeding the strongest baseline on each task by 10.67, 6.46, and 0.33 normalized points, respectively.

AI.tldr: CASTLE是一个离线训练、在线上下文引导的框架，利用两个世界模型为完全去中心化MARL中的独立PPO策略提供反事实动作条件的预测引导，在多粒子环境中取得最高平均最终分数。
AI.motivation: 完全去中心化MARL（独立学习）要求智能体仅用本地信息和经验学习、行动，没有集中式critic或智能体间通信。这种严格的信息结构使传统奖励信号含义模糊：低回报可能源于无效的自身动作、不配合的队友反应或有效的对手反应，而标量奖励无法揭示原因。作者认为，与其仅从已实现的回报中诊断失败，智能体可以通过前瞻性地比较候选动作的后果来更有效地学习。
AI.method: 提出CASTLE（用于去中心化MARL本地执行的反事实动作条件语义Token），含两个互补世界模型：1）局部动态世界模型，在智能体本地轨迹上离线预训练，总结本地轨迹动态与部分可观测性；2）语义-社会世界模型，预测每个候选自身动作的紧凑短时程任务与社会后果，其训练数据来自反事实模拟器rollout，即在同一记录状态下暴露队友和对手对备选动作的可能反应。在线学习与执行时，两个世界模型保持冻结，智能体仅用本地可得信息查询；其预测logits为独立PPO策略提供上下文引导。
AI.result: 在基准多粒子环境的Tag、Spread和Adversary三个任务上，跨30个匹配随机种子，CASTLE在所评估方法中取得最高平均最终分数，分别超过最强基线10.67、6.46和0.33归一化分。
AI.conclusion: 通过前瞻性地比较候选动作的后果（而非仅从已实现回报诊断失败），并利用冻结的局部动态与语义-社会世界模型为独立策略提供本地可得的上下文引导，CASTLE在完全去中心化MARL中优于现有方法，验证了反事实动作条件预测引导的有效性。

title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
summary:
Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance.
  We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

AI.tldr: FluidPD 提出一种 SLO 感知的原地弹性机制，通过 FluidToken 和 FluidRole 应对 LLM 服务中 prefill/decode 比例失衡问题，在 Azure trace 上将 SLO 达成率较静态 SGLang 提升最多 94.6 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 真实负载中 prefill-to-decode 需求比例会同时出现短时突发和持续漂移，而现有固定 P/D worker 配比加路由的系统无法应对这种变化，容易在其它地方有空闲容量时仍违反延迟 SLO；现有自动扩缩容反应慢、需要备用 GPU，且不能解决短时间尺度的阶段失衡。
AI.method: FluidPD 是一个 P/D 解耦服务系统，提供 SLO 感知的原地弹性。包含两个互补机制：1）FluidToken 在 decode 侧有空闲时把有界部分 prefill 计算卸载到 decode worker，处理瞬时失衡；2）FluidRole 通过原地重新分配运行中的 worker 在 prefill 和 decode 角色间切换，处理持续失衡，避免模型重载和引擎重启。两者都由轻量级压力指标引导，可在 SLO 违反发生前暴露 prefill 和 decode 侧资源压力。
AI.result: 在生产 Azure trace 工作负载上，FluidPD 相比静态 SGLang 将整体 SLO 达成率提升最多 94.6 个百分点，且无需额外配置 worker。
AI.conclusion: SLO 感知的原地 P/D 弹性可以显著提升服务质量，特别适合动态变化的 LLM 服务负载场景。

title: Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementation of RAPTOR, NavTree is the strongest matched-cost hierarchical retriever in our evaluated grid and ties the strongest flat baseline. On long-document multi-hop QA, it is the only hierarchical method that significantly beats BM25 on a class-vs-class basis, corroborated by a reader-free retrieval-recall check. A matched-reader replication of the published abstractive RAPTOR variant, given strong cluster summaries, still loses to NavTree at every multi-chunk budget, at zero indexing cost. The ranking carries across stronger and open-weight readers, a stronger encoder, and a full factorial that isolates leaves-only emission as the structural lever.

AI.tldr: NavTree 用确定性平衡分段树作为纯导航骨架，无需索引期LLM调用，仅向阅读器输出叶子块，在长文档QA中达到匹配成本下最强层次检索效果，并优于RAPTOR式摘要树。
AI.motivation: 长文档检索中，扁平top-k检索易聚集于单一区域而遗漏互补证据。RAPTOR式摘要树通过递归聚类和LLM摘要来缓解，但作者认为其收益可能主要来自“导航”而非摘要内容本身，因此希望分离并验证这一机制。
AI.method: 提出 NavTree：在块上构建确定性平衡分段树，索引期零LLM调用；以树作为导航支架，从根开始进行词典与稠密混合的前沿游走，并以top检索叶子为锚点，最终只输出叶子块给阅读器。与扁平检索器、RAPTOR的抽取式重实现进行匹配成本评估，并做匹配阅读器复现、更强/开放权重阅读器、更强编码器及因子实验。
AI.result: 在评估网格中，NavTree是匹配成本下最强层次检索器，并与最强扁平基线持平；在长文档多跳QA上，它是唯一在类对类基础上显著超过BM25的层次方法，检索召回检验也支持该结论。在强聚类摘要下，复现的RAPTOR抽象式变体在每个多块预算下仍不如NavTree，且NavTree索引成本为零。结论在更强阅读器与编码器下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 摘要树在长文档QA中的主要收益来自导航结构而非摘要内容；仅输出叶子块是关键结构杠杆。NavTree以零索引LLM成本实现更强层次检索，挑战了依赖LLM摘要树的必要性。

title: UniPro: Unified Multi-Mode Medical Image Segmentation from 2D Images to 3D Volumes via Propagation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains fragmented along two axes: segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality. Existing methods are typically developed separately for semantic, in-context, and interactive segmentation, and are further specialized to either native 2D images or 3D volumetric data. In clinical practice, however, segmentation workflows take many forms: a case may be initialized by semantic prediction, reference-guided segmentation, or user interaction. Regardless of how it begins, fine-grained refinement is naturally performed on 2D views; for volumetric scans, such 2D edits must propagate coherently to the rest of the volume. We present UniPro, a unified model that bridges segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality, using propagation to extend 2D segmentation to 3D volumes. Our key insight is that volumetric propagation and in-context segmentation share the same reference-conditioned prediction mechanism, differing only in whether the reference image-mask pairs come from other cases or from previously segmented neighboring slices. Building on this view, UniPro supports semantic, in-context, interactive, and propagation-based segmentation within a single slice-based framework, using class priors, reference exemplars, user clicks, and neighboring-slice predictions as mode-specific conditioning inputs. To improve propagation reliability, UniPro further incorporates bidirectional and 3D supervision to regularize slice-wise propagation beyond per-slice losses. Extensive experiments across diverse modalities and anatomies show that UniPro achieves strong performance across all segmentation settings, enabling annotation-efficient 3D segmentation from sparse 2D initialization and reducing slice-by-slice correction effort.

AI.tldr: UniPro是一个统一的分割模型，通过传播机制将2D分割扩展到3D体积，在单一框架内支持语义、上下文、交互和传播四种分割范式。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法沿两个维度割裂：分割范式（语义、上下文、交互）和数据维度（2D、3D）各自独立开发。但临床工作流中这些形式常混合出现：可由语义预测、参考引导或用户交互初始化，且精细修正天然在2D视图上进行，而3D扫描需将2D编辑一致地传播到整个体积。因此需要一个能桥接范式与维度的统一模型。
AI.method: 核心洞见是体积传播与上下文分割共享同一参考条件预测机制，区别仅在于参考图像-掩码对来自其他病例还是已分割的相邻切片。基于此，UniPro在单一基于切片的框架内，以类别先验、参考样例、用户点击、相邻切片预测作为模式特定的条件输入，支持四类分割。为提升传播可靠性，引入双向和3D监督，在逐切片损失之外对切片间传播进行正则化。
AI.result: 在多种模态和解剖结构上的大量实验表明，UniPro在所有分割设置下均取得强劲性能，可从稀疏2D初始化实现标注高效的3D分割，并减少逐切片修正的工作量。
AI.conclusion: UniPro通过传播统一了分割范式与数据维度，验证了体积传播与上下文分割机制共享的洞察，为标注高效的3D医学图像分割提供了统一且有效的解决方案。

title: Efficient Auditing of Adversarial AI Agent Behavior from Agent Traces
summary: AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) can perform complex tasks but may harm the systems they operate in, either intentionally or unintentionally. Existing agent monitoring approaches rely on rule-based guardrails or LLM-based trace auditing. However, rule-based guardrails can be bypassed through obfuscation and may miss harmful actions beyond their predefined rules, whereas applying an LLM to audit every action is costly. We present a two-stage agent trace auditing framework. The first stage uses single-event and trace-sequence rules to select pending actions for inspection; the second uses an LLM audit agent to examine each selected action in the context of the agent's preceding trace before execution. We jointly refine the gate rules and audit instructions using training data, allowing the framework to adapt to complex agent behaviors rather than relying solely on predefined rules. On the public benchmark OpenAgentSafety, our framework reduces the average number of LLM audits from 8.15 to 2.33 per run and token usage from 47.8k to 14.6k, with a detection rate of 72.8\% compared with 81.5\% when every action is audited. In two simulated multi-agent case studies, the framework flags all malicious traces while reducing audit token usage by more than 80\%.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段智能体轨迹审计框架：先用规则筛选待检动作，再用LLM审计，在降低审计成本的同时保持较高检测率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可能有意或无意地损害其运行系统，现有监控方法存在不足：基于规则的护栏易被混淆绕过且只能覆盖预定义规则，而对每个动作都用LLM审计成本过高。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用单事件规则和轨迹序列规则筛选待检查动作；第二阶段在执行前，用LLM审计智能体结合前置轨迹对每个被选动作进行审查。并利用训练数据联合优化门控规则与审计指令，使其适应复杂智能体行为。
AI.result: 在OpenAgentSafety基准上，将每轮平均LLM审计次数从8.15降至2.33，token用量从47.8k降至14.6k，检测率为72.8%（全量审计为81.5%）。在两个模拟多智能体案例中，框架标记出所有恶意轨迹，同时将审计token用量降低80%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过规则预筛选与LLM审计结合并联合优化，可在显著降低审计成本的同时实现较高的有害行为检测能力，适用于复杂及多智能体场景。

title: CogAdapt: Cognition-informed Sparse Adaptation of Code LLMs
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of generating code. However, achieving stronger code-generation performance still often relies on costly model adaptation, i.e., fine-tuning pretrained model parameters. Prior studies have shown correspondence between human code processing and neural models' attention or internal computation. Human-aligned learning approaches use cognitive signals to guide training, but typically adapt a large portion of the model, leaving training costs largely unchanged. Human cognitive signals may indicate not only what the model must learn from, but also where adaptation is most useful. We investigate whether human responses during code reading correspond to code-model behavior and can guide selective adaptation without sacrificing performance.
  We present CogAdapt, a cognition-informed framework for task-dependent sparse adaptation of code models. CogAdapt first learns transferable program-level and token-level priors from human Electroencephalography (EEG) and attention data, then combines these priors with the frozen model's response to each coding task to determine how much adaptation to allocate and which transformer blocks should receive updates. During fine-tuning, only the selected blocks are updated, while no new human recordings are required for inference. Across Qwen and GLM, we find consistent correspondence between human reading behavior and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) computation. CogAdapt achieves the best pass@1 across both LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench, including gains of 10.86 and 6.29 percentage points over matched regular fine-tuning on LiveCodeBench, while reducing gradient-eligible adaptation parameters by 86.21-87.21%. These results suggest that human comprehension signals can provide useful guidance for making code-model adaptation both more selective and more effective.

AI.tldr: 提出 CogAdapt 框架，利用人类脑电与眼动信号指导代码模型的任务相关稀疏微调，仅更新部分 Transformer 块，在降低可训练参数的同时提升代码生成性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 代码生成能力提升常依赖代价高昂的全参数微调；现有"人类对齐"方法虽用认知信号引导训练，但仍需调整大量参数，训练成本未实质下降。作者猜想人类认知信号不仅能指示"学什么"，还能指示"在哪里调整最有效"，从而实现选择性适配。
AI.method: CogAdapt 先从人类 EEG 与注意力数据中学习可迁移的程序级和 token 级先验，再结合冻结模型对每个编程任务的响应，决定分配多少适配量以及哪些 Transformer 块需要更新；微调时只更新被选中的块，推理阶段无需新的脑电记录。在 Qwen 和 GLM 上验证，并观察到人类阅读行为与 MoE 计算之间存在一致对应。
AI.result: 在 LiveCodeBench 和 BigCodeBench 上均取得最佳 pass@1；在 LiveCodeBench 上相比同等常规微调提升 10.86 和 6.29 个百分点，同时将可参与梯度的适配参数减少 86.21–87.21%。
AI.conclusion: 人类理解信号可为代码模型适配提供有效指导，使其同时更具选择性与更高效，表明认知信号可用于稀疏适配的位置与强度决策。

title: Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via System One-Guided Computational Division of Labor
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have become a promising paradigm for complex information-seeking and reasoning tasks by enabling collaborative problem solving among specialized agents. However, existing MAS frameworks tightly couple task reasoning with coordination operations, including task selection, role assignment, message routing, and context management. As interactions grow, using powerful LLMs for these bounded control decisions introduces substantial token overhead and latency, limiting the scalability of agentic Web services. In this paper, we investigate whether coordination can be decoupled from expensive reasoning without compromising collaborative performance. We propose S1-MAS, a token-efficient multi-agent framework based on System One-guided computational division of labor. S1-MAS assigns bounded coordination decisions to lightweight System One models while reserving open-ended reasoning for capable LLM workers. Specifically, a lightweight controller selects inspection conditions, chooses subsequent tasks, and determines termination, while a compact reader retrieves condition-relevant evidence from authorized sources to support these decisions. Through a decision-evidence loop, selected tasks dynamically determine worker roles and source access, enabling adaptive collaboration without task-specific training. Extensive experiments on seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate that S1-MAS achieves superior accuracy while substantially reducing the inference cost. Across individual comparisons with AgentVerse, DyLAN, and SelfOrg on seven benchmarks, S1-MAS reduces GPT-4o token consumption by 44.9%-97.2% and measured end-to-end latency by 37.8%-93.0%. These results highlight its potential for scalable and cost-effective agentic Web applications.

AI.tldr: 提出S1-MAS框架，将多智能体系统中的协调决策与复杂推理解耦，用轻量System One模型处理受限协调任务，在七个基准上实现更高准确率，同时大幅降低token消耗和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统将任务推理与协调操作（任务选择、角色分配、消息路由、上下文管理）紧密耦合。随着交互增长，用强大LLM处理这些受限的控制决策带来大量token开销和延迟，限制了智能体Web服务的可扩展性。论文旨在探究能否在不损害协作性能的前提下，将协调与昂贵的推理解耦。
AI.method: 提出S1-MAS，基于System One引导的计算分工。将受限的协调决策交给轻量System One模型，把开放式推理保留给能力强的LLM worker。具体地，轻量控制器选择检查条件、选择后续任务并决定终止；紧凑的reader从授权来源检索与条件相关的证据以支持这些决策。通过决策-证据循环，所选任务动态决定worker角色和来源访问，无需任务特定训练即可实现自适应协作。
AI.result: 在七个不同基准上，S1-MAS实现了更优的准确率，同时大幅降低推理成本。在与AgentVerse、DyLAN和SelfOrg的对比中，S1-MAS将GPT-4o的token消耗降低44.9%-97.2%，实测端到端延迟降低37.8%-93.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将协调与推理解耦可显著提升多智能体系统的token效率与响应速度而不牺牲协作性能，表明S1-MAS在可扩展、成本高效的智能体Web应用方面具有潜力。

title: Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning
summary: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"锚点散度"（Anchor Divergences），通过对比学习、指数族与信息几何的相互作用，在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何，实现高效且有效的语境化检索相似度。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似度提供单一固定几何，但语义相似性本质依赖上下文：两幅图像可能因同一物体、相似风格或同一临床发现而相似。因此需要一种能在固定表示上灵活指定语境相关语义几何的方法。
AI.method: 利用对比学习、指数族分布与信息几何三者的相互作用，建立"锚点分布"与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的一一对应关系；据此定义Anchor Divergences，用于在固定表示上指定特定上下文的语义几何——建模锚点分布即等同于建模几何本身。
AI.result: 检索实验表明，锚点散度是一种有效且高效的方式，能够指定上下文相关的语义相似度。
AI.conclusion: 对比表示天然包含一族几何结构，可通过锚点分布对其进行特化，从而在固定表示上实现语境自适应的语义相似度度量。

title: Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms
summary: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文将拒绝行为的激活引导拆解到组件级别，发现拒绝信号集中在稀疏的注意力和MLP组件子集（28-48%）以及约50%的残差流维度中，表明拒绝行为并非弥散编码，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成。
AI.motivation: 激活引导能操控大语言模型行为，但其内部机制基础尚不清楚。作者希望探究拒绝行为引导在模型内部究竟是弥散分布还是集中于特定稀疏机制。
AI.method: 在四个开放权重模型上，将拒绝引导分解为组件级别的干预，识别能够复现完整行为效果的稀疏注意力与MLP组件子集，并进一步分析这些组件内的残差流维度。
AI.result: 拒绝方向集中在占上游组件28-48%的稀疏机制中，保留88-101%的引导效果；在这些机制内部，有效引导进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留组件机制基线的85-98%，与特权基结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性在两个层面起作用：被引导的组件以及组件内承载信号的维度。拒绝行为不是弥散编码，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装，为理解拒绝行为的表征与引导提供了机制性基础。

title: Beyond the Linear Representation Hypothesis: Non-Linear Activation Steering in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which assumes that high-level concepts are encoded as linear directions in activation space. Yet a natural visual concept does not necessarily require a linear visual transition: between sunny and stormy lies an intermediate weather state such as a sky with a few white clouds, not simply a weaker storm; between a caterpillar and a butterfly, the progression is not a caterpillar with continuously growing wings. This raises the question of whether such true intermediate states are also represented nonlinearly by the model. Indeed, when we prompt text-to-image models directly for intermediate attributes, their activations rarely fall along the straight direction connecting the endpoints. Therefore, we propose KANSteer, which models concept traversal as a curve passing through its intermediate states. Seeking a representation that is both simple and interpretable, we propose to use Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), which provide a one-dimensional coordinate whose learned functions define the trajectory. This allows the steering direction to vary along the concept while preserving an interpretable representation. Across several concepts and text-to-image diffusion transformers, we find that their activation trajectories substantially deviate from straight lines, and that KANSteer provide a closer fit and smoother traversal of intermediate attributes than linear steering.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑线性表示假设（LRH）在视觉概念上的适用性，提出用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）建模概念过渡的曲线轨迹（KANSteer），在多个文本到图像扩散Transformer上验证了激活轨迹显著偏离直线，且KANSteer比线性引导更好地拟合和平滑穿越中间属性。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性常依赖线性表示假设（LRH），即高层概念在激活空间中编码为线性方向。但自然视觉概念并不必然对应线性视觉过渡：晴与暴风雨之间存在"少量白云"这类中间天气状态，而非单纯更弱的暴雨；毛毛虫与蝴蝶之间也不是翅膀持续生长的毛毛虫。因此引出问题：这类真正的中间状态是否也被模型非线性地表示。
AI.method: 直接向文本到图像模型提示中间属性时，其激活很少落在连接两端点的直线方向上。为此提出KANSteer，将概念穿越建模为穿过中间状态的曲线。为兼顾简单性与可解释性，采用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），提供一个一维坐标，其学习到的函数定义该轨迹，使引导方向可沿概念变化，同时保留可解释表示。
AI.result: 在多个概念和多种文本到图像扩散Transformer上，发现其激活轨迹显著偏离直线；KANSteer比线性引导能更贴近地拟合并更平滑地穿越中间属性。
AI.conclusion: 模型对视觉概念的表示并非线性，而是呈曲线结构；用KAN建模可提供简单且可解释的非线性引导表示，优于线性引导方法。

title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic. Existing agent-memory systems (e.g., MemGPT, Zep, A-MEM) gate retrieval by content, ownership, and role, not derivation, missing a cached insight that embeds a forbidden column. We introduce the Analytical Memory Unit (AMU), a memory schema that attaches a full derivation (lineage) graph to every cached result, gated by a retrieval policy that serves a hit only when the requester is authorised for every column touched. Provided lineage recording is complete, we prove by construction that the policy blocks retrieval of results derived from a sensitive column outside the requester's permissions, at O(n) worst case -- a conditional design guarantee, not an empirical claim, that excludes derived features encoding sensitive information without naming their source. Eliminating measured leakage required 75-90% recorded lineage completeness, so we treat 90% as a conservative deployment target. Across six experiments, lineage-gated retrieval removes the 18.8-25.5% cross-department leakage naive content-gated memory suffers, keeping 81.5-82.6% of memory reuse at 13.8 microsecond worst-case overhead. A real-agent proof-of-concept with LLM-generated SQL is consistent with the guarantee: zero leaks over 9 round-trips, two conflicts caught automatically -- though a feasibility demonstration, not evidence of production viability. This offers a practical governance layer for shared agent memory, complementing source-layer access control and supporting EU AI Act compliance.

AI.tldr: 提出分析记忆单元（AMU），为每个缓存结果附加完整推导（血缘）图，并以检索策略门控：仅当请求者对涉及的所有列均有权限时才返回命中，从而遏制共享记忆中的派生泄露与同名KPI冲突。
AI.motivation: 企业AI代理共享记忆库存在两个未被解决的问题：一是敏感数据可通过请求者本无法推导的合法计算结果泄露；二是不同部门可能以相互冲突的逻辑静默计算同名KPI。现有系统（MemGPT、Zep、A-MEM）仅按内容、归属和角色门控检索，而非按推导路径，无法拦截嵌入禁用列的缓存洞察。
AI.method: AMU为每个缓存结果附加完整的推导（血缘）图，并配合检索策略：仅当请求者对所有被触及的列都获得授权时才提供命中。在血缘记录完整的前提下，以构造法证明该策略能阻止检索源自请求者权限外敏感列的结果，最坏复杂度O(n)。
AI.result: 泄漏消除需要75-90%的血缘记录完整度，故将90%作为保守部署目标。六项实验中，血缘门控检索消除了朴素内容门控记忆所遭受的18.8-25.5%跨部门泄漏，同时保留81.5-82.6%的记忆复用率，最坏情况开销为13.8微秒。基于LLM生成SQL的真实代理概念验证与保证一致：9轮往返零泄漏，自动捕获两处冲突。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为共享代理记忆提供了实用的治理层，补充源头层访问控制并支持合规要求。需注意：O(n)结论是条件性设计保证而非经验主张，不涵盖未指明来源却编码敏感信息的派生特征；概念验证属可行性演示，尚不构成生产可用性证据。

title: The EPIC Framework for Spec-Driven Development
summary: One practitioner we interviewed said their team writes "must" instead of "should" when instructing a coding agent, because the agent may treat "should" as optional. Small wording choices matter because agents often fill gaps in their instructions with their own assumptions. Spec-driven development (SDD) asks developers to write a specification, plan, and tasks before the agent writes code. SDD frameworks provide templates for these artifacts, but the templates do not help developers judge whether they have written enough or clearly enough. We studied what good SDD specifications contain. We scored the artifacts of 114 open-source SDD repositories against ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 and derived practices from the highest-scoring ones. The resulting framework, EPIC, has 40 practices in 10 quality dimensions that guide developers in making expectations and decisions explicit in specifications, plans, and tasks for coding agents. The majority of SDD practitioners (N=15) endorsed every practice. Repositories in the top third of specification quality spent 11.8% of their commits on bug fixes, compared with 20.4% in the bottom third, and had a median of 4x as many contributors. Developers can use EPIC to find and fill the gaps in a specification before the agent does.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究规范驱动开发（SDD）中"好规范"应包含什么，基于ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148对114个开源SDD仓库的产物进行评分，提炼出EPIC框架（10个质量维度、40条实践），并发现规范质量较高的仓库缺陷修复提交占比更低、贡献者更多。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体会用自身假设填补指令中的空白，因此措辞（如"must"与"should"）和规范的完整性至关重要。SDD要求开发者先写规范、计划和任务，但其框架只提供模板，无法帮助开发者判断自己写的内容是否充分、清晰。论文旨在明确优质SDD规范应包含哪些要素。
AI.method: 访谈SDD实践者以获取初步洞见；依据ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148标准，对114个开源SDD仓库的开发产物进行评分；从得分最高的仓库中提炼实践，形成EPIC框架，包含10个质量维度和40条实践，用于引导开发者将期望与决策显式化；并通过15位实践者的反馈进行验证。
AI.result: EPIC的40条实践获得多数SDD实践者（N=15）的认可。规范质量排名前三分之一的仓库，其缺陷修复提交占比为11.8%，而排名后三分之一的仓库为20.4%；前者的贡献者数量中位数是后者的4倍。
AI.conclusion: 开发者可借助EPIC在智能体之前发现并填补规范中的空白，从而提升规范质量，并与更低的缺陷修复负担和更高的贡献者参与度相关联。

title: Visual Orchestration Tax in Agentic VLM Pipelines: Auditing and Certifying Visual Evidence Reuse
summary: Agentic VLM pipelines increasingly pass the same static visual evidence through multiple specialist agents and tools. This design creates an orchestration-level redundancy mode: semantically unchanged images are repeatedly reconstructed as image-conditioned requests at the VLM API boundary. We call this phenomenon visual orchestration tax and develop a measurement-to-certification framework for visual evidence reuse in agentic VLM pipelines. The audit side defines $\mathrm{M1}_{\mathrm{trace}}$ to count raw visual-evidence touches and M2 to measure structural touch redundancy, with query-level distributions, bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired quality tests. Across SeeingEye and MAMMQA on chart, document, general-VQA, and multi-modal-QA tasks, audits reveal 66.8-75.6% visual-evidence touch redundancy, and every audited query exceeds the predefined gate. The certification side introduces SharedVisCache, a contract-aware evidence reuse hook keyed by image content, preprocessing fingerprint, and encoder assumptions. On SeeingEye, contract validation certifies 75.0-75.5% repeated touches as reusable while preserving 350/350 output strings and $Δ\mathrm{M5}{=}0$. At the physical layer, certified hits reduce $F_{\mathrm{vision}}$ from 800 to 200 in ChartQA-200 trace replay and from 200 to 50 inside live SeeingEye translator-stage physical integration, preserving 800/800 replay strings and 200/200 integrated call outputs. The results position visual reuse as a measurable, behavior-preserving property of agent orchestration and define an agent-layer contract that makes backend prefix or token reuse semantically interpretable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"视觉编排税"概念，并构建了从测量到认证的框架，用于智能体VLM流水线中的视觉证据复用。
AI.motivation: 智能体VLM流水线中，同一静态视觉证据被多个专家智能体和工具重复传递，导致在VLM API边界反复重建语义上未变的图像请求，形成编排层面的冗余。
AI.method: 审计侧定义M1_trace统计原始视觉证据触碰次数，M2测量结构性触碰冗余，并采用查询级分布、bootstrap置信区间和配对质量检验；认证侧提出SharedVisCache，一种以图像内容、预处理指纹和编码器假设为键的契约感知证据复用钩子。
AI.result: 在SeeingEye和MAMMQA等任务上审计显示66.8-75.6%的视觉证据触碰冗余；认证可判定75.0-75.5%的重复触碰可复用，保持350/350输出字符串；物理层认证命中使F_vision从800降至200（ChartQA-200）和从200降至50（SeeingEye集成），分别保持800/800和200/200输出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉复用是智能体编排中可测量且保持行为不变的性质，并定义了使后端前缀或token复用具有语义可解释性的智能体层契约。

title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
summary: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadOnc-Agent，一个将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段、提供 26 个可调用函数的智能体式 AI 框架，通过大语言模型控制器实现跨阶段、跨模块的会话式任务编排，验证了多阶段放疗工作流协调的技术可行性。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI 在放疗中的应用多为孤立的单任务能力，分散于不同临床阶段、软件环境和数据模态中，与放疗从治疗决策到随访的纵向连续流程相割裂，缺乏统一协调机制。
AI.method: 将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，构建提供 26 个可调用函数的会话式框架；由大语言模型控制器把临床意图映射为模式约束的调用，保留患者与工作流上下文，并将请求路由至专用服务。评估采用 2,600 条单函数请求（7,800 次重复执行）、200 个预设合成跨阶段场景（600 次执行）以及来自 60 份去标识化病历的 120 个真实工作流实例（360 次干净执行），并进行了消融对比。
AI.result: 单函数执行中意图函数选择正确率 98.79%；脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率 96.50%；真实患者工作流完成率 96.67%。消融实验中，去除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率从 96.50% 降至 84.00%；关闭模式与身份校验后，在后端调度错配率由 0% 升至 95.28%（重放/测试评估）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 编排架构在协调异构放疗能力与信息、支撑纵向工作流方面具备技术可行性；但研究未验证临床正确性、临床实用性或前瞻性获益，仍需进一步临床研究。

title: Stabilizing language models under continual learning via condition-anchored distillation
summary: Continual adaptation of language models can change their output distribution on prompts learned earlier, while retaining every old prompt-answer pair may be undesirable or impossible. We study condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD): retain a small set of old prompts, use a frozen previous model to reconstruct completions and generation states, and match its predictive distributions while learning the next task. The formulation separates three roles that ordinary replay conflates: conditions select the behavior to protect, teacher generations locate relevant states, and soft targets specify how predictions may change. For autoregressive language generation, teacher-rollout distillation admits an exact chain-rule decomposition of sequence divergence. For masked-diffusion language modeling, our implementation directly controls local denoising drift on teacher-generated completions. In continual adaptation of a 219M masked diffusion language model, CAGD reduces four-task final held-out loss from 2.927 to 1.114 in one task order and from 2.168 to 0.891 in exact reverse. The same soft targets lower final average loss by 0.055 over hard replay when teacher-generated support is held identical. The direction persists on fresh facts and natural instructions across SMDM and Qwen3. On GSM8K, Qwen adaptation preserves answer-format compliance, but exact-match retention is seed-mixed at 0.6B and worsens at 1.7B. These results support condition-anchored functional preservation as a common design principle across the tested language-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"条件锚定生成式蒸馏"（CAGD）：保留少量旧提示，用冻结的旧模型重建补全与生成状态，并在学习新任务时匹配其预测分布，从而在持续适应中保护旧行为。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的持续适应会改变其在早期提示上的输出分布，而完整保留所有旧提示-答案对往往不现实或不可取，因此需要一种更高效的功能保持方法。
AI.method: CAGD 将普通回放混淆的三种角色分离：条件选择要保护的行为，教师生成定位相关状态，软目标规定预测可如何变化。对自回归生成，教师 rollout 蒸馏给出序列散度的精确链式分解；对掩码扩散语言建模，实现直接控制教师生成补全上的局部去噪漂移。
AI.result: 在 219M 掩码扩散模型的持续适应中，CAGD 将四任务最终留出损失从 2.927 降至 1.114（一种任务顺序）以及从 2.168 降至 0.891（完全逆序）。在教师生成支持相同时，软目标比硬回放降低最终平均损失 0.055。该趋势在新事实和自然指令上跨 SMDM 与 Qwen3 持续存在。在 GSM8K 上，Qwen 适应保持答案格式合规，但精确匹配保留在 0.6B 呈种子混合、在 1.7B 变差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将条件锚定功能保持作为跨所测试语言生成目标的通用设计原则。

title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
summary: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

AI.tldr: 提出 DistScene 框架，通过联合建模环境与物体实现单图组合式3D场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将场景主要表示为物体的集合，缺乏对环境的显式建模，导致物体放置缺少几何上下文。
AI.method: 包含三部分：Scene-Frame Generation（在共享坐标框架中联合生成环境与物体组件，共同学习几何与相对位置）、Object-Centric Refinement（在局部框架中结合场景上下文细化每个物体）、Object-to-Scene Distillation（通过自动组合与渲染的合成场景，将预训练物体生成先验迁移到场景生成）。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准上，相比基线方法提升了场景级空间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将环境作为显式场景组件建模并结合物体先验蒸馏，可有效提升单图3D场景生成的空间连贯性。

title: A Resilient Runtime-Verification Fabric for Security Monitoring of Critical Edge-IoT Infrastructure
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Critical Information Infrastructures Security (CRITIS 2026)
summary: Protecting critical infrastructure increasingly depends on continuously verifying large IoT fleets against formal security specifications at runtime. Yet the runtime-verification (RV) pipelines proposed for this task are typically single-host prototypes whose monitors read a shared log file, with no resilience to the failures such deployments incur: a crash or overload silently drops events, clock skew corrupts the ordering metric monitors require, a time-triggered "node has gone silent" property cannot fire when the network itself falls silent, and one slow consumer stalls the pipeline. Each failure is silent: the monitor keeps emitting verdicts over a corrupted view. We present RV-Fabric, a resilient delivery layer that carries the hierarchy over two brokers (MQTT for device ingest, a durable stream broker for backend delivery) and re-establishes five continuity guarantees: durable delivery under crashes, a trusted event order, progress under total silence, consumer isolation and flow control under bounded overload, each an invariant conditioned on broker durability. Above the transport, RV-Fabric makes evidence completeness part of runtime-verification semantics: every verdict carries a status (sound, degraded, incomplete or unavailable) derived from delivery gaps, retention pressure and liveness, so an incomplete stream cannot yield an unqualified all-clear. Under controlled fault injection on a containerised testbed, measured against a fault-free oracle using the real MonPoly engine, the shared-log baseline misses six of seven injected incidents, reporting each as an unqualified all-clear, whereas RV-Fabric preserves all seven; removing a delivery mechanism reintroduces silent loss, removing isolation costs only timeliness. Two published critical-infrastructure datasets, water-SCADA and IoT/IIoT, replay end-to-end.

AI.tldr: 提出 RV-Fabric：面向大规模 IoT 编队的弹性运行时验证交付层，通过双代理（MQTT 摄取 + 持久流代理后端投递）重建五项连续性保证，并把证据完整性纳入 RV 语义（verdict 状态分级），从而避免"静默全清"。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施的运行时验证需持续对大规模 IoT 编队做形式化安全规范校验，但现有 RV 流水线多为单机原型，监视器读取共享日志文件，缺乏容错能力：崩溃或过载会静默丢事件、时钟偏斜破坏顺序指标、网络静默时"节点失联"属性无法触发、单个慢消费者阻塞整条流水线。更严重的是，所有失败都是静默的——监视器仍在被污染的视图上输出判定。
AI.method: RV-Fabric 是一个弹性交付层：跨两个代理承载监控层级（MQTT 负责设备摄取，持久流代理负责后端投递），重建五项连续性保证——崩溃下的持久投递、可信事件顺序、完全静默下的进展、消费者隔离、有界过载下的流控，每项均为以代理持久性为条件的不变量。在传输层之上，把证据完整性纳入运行时验证语义：每个判定携带状态（sound / degraded / incomplete / unavailable），由投递缺口、保留压力和活性推导得出，使不完整流无法产生无条件的"全清"结论。在容器化测试台上用真实 MonPoly 引擎做受控故障注入，并以无故障 oracle 为基准对照。
AI.result: 共享日志基线在七个注入事故中漏报六个，均报告为无条件全清；RV-Fabric 则全部保留七个。移除任一投递机制会重新引入静默丢失，移除隔离仅以时效性为代价。两个已发布的关键基础设施数据集（水-SCADA 与 IoT/IIoT）可端到端回放。
AI.conclusion: RV-Fabric 通过双代理持久交付与证据完整性语义，解决了现有 RV 流水线的静默失败问题：在广泛故障注入下保持全部事故可见，防止有缺陷监控输出误导性的安全结论，并在真实数据集上验证了端到端可行性。

title: CheckerBench: Can Long-Horizon Agents Synthesize Static-Analysis Checkers?
summary: Static-analysis checker synthesis requires agents to interpret a defect specification, inspect a repository, implement analyzer-specific logic, and refine the checker through repeated compilation and analysis feedback. Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on tasks such as patch generation or vulnerability detection and rarely assess whether an agent can develop a working checker in a repository from start to finish. We introduce CheckerBench, an executable benchmark of 300 tasks derived from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems. Each task includes vulnerable and fixed revisions, a pinned analysis environment, and a checker scaffold. We further introduce CheckerLab, a common evaluation framework that independently rebuilds submitted checkers and measures vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use. Across 21 model-harness configurations and three independent repeats per configuration, mean Pass@1 is 32.30%, while the best reaches 45.33%. These results show that reliable, reusable checker development remains challenging for current coding agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 CheckerBench 基准（300 任务，源自 297 个 CVE）与 CheckerLab 评测框架，评估智能体端到端开发静态分析检查器的能力，最佳 Pass@1 仅 45.33%。
AI.motivation: 静态分析检查器合成需要智能体完成规格解读、仓库检视、分析器逻辑实现并通过反复编译与反馈迭代优化，但现有编码智能体基准多聚焦补丁生成或漏洞检测，较少评估智能体能否从零到端完成可用检查器开发。因此需要一套可执行的基准来检验这一能力。
AI.method: 构建 CheckerBench：包含 300 个任务，来自 167 个仓库、297 个 CVE、85 个 CWE 及五种语言生态；每个任务提供漏洞版本与修复版本、固定分析环境和检查器脚手架。并提出 CheckerLab 统一评测框架，独立重建提交的检查器，度量漏洞-修复诊断对比、补丁定位、误报和工具使用情况。评测覆盖 21 种模型-框架配置，每种配置重复三次。
AI.result: 21 种模型-框架配置、每配置三次独立重复下，平均 Pass@1 为 32.30%，最佳配置达到 45.33%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可靠且可复用的检查器开发对当前编码智能体而言仍具挑战性。

title: Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers
summary: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route.
