Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉Transformer如何在直接指称证据有限时对抽象概念（如"愤怒"）进行视觉接地，提出并验证了一种"转喻式接地"机制。
AI.motivation: 抽象概念（如愤怒）缺乏直接的视觉指称，训练数据中直接证据有限，视觉模型如何将视觉信号与抽象语义连接起来仍不清楚，因此需要探究抽象概念在视觉编码器中的接地机制。
AI.method: 在CLIP和DINO视觉编码器上应用Transcoders，恢复可关联到具体概念语义标签的中间特征，并追踪其在抽象概念识别电路中的贡献；使用精心构建的图标数据集进行分析，并通过因果干预进行验证。
AI.result: 发现了结构化的转喻电路：感知原语在早期层占主导，类物体锚点先于抽象目标出现；包含渲染文字的图像则招募了一条不同的"感知—文本"路径。因果干预进一步证实转喻中间特征在抽象概念接地中具有功能作用。
AI.conclusion: 视觉Transformer通过具体的、可解释的锚点概念以转喻方式对抽象概念进行接地，转喻中间特征在功能上参与其中，为理解抽象语义的视觉接地提供了机制性解释。

title: EMODE: Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts for Emotion-Aware Speech Language Modeling
summary: Large speech language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in unified cross-modal understanding and generation, yet paralinguistic cues, especially emotion, remain difficult to preserve. Existing systems typically rely on entangled acoustic representations, which allow the underlying language model to depend excessively on recovered lexical content instead of grounding its behavior in acoustic-prosodic evidence. We address this limitation with EMODE, an emotion-aware speech language model built around \textbf{Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts (DPSE)}. DPSE decomposes continuous speech features into semantic and paralinguistic pathways, routes them dynamically, and fuses them before integration into the language model. To turn this structural decomposition into functional specialization, EMODE is trained with a three-stage curriculum consisting of semantic warm-up, paralinguistic activation, and joint refinement, guided by Orthogonal Expert Guidance (OEG), Semantic-to-Acoustic Alignment (SAA), and Gating Diversity Regularization (GDR). Experiments on SER test, empathetic response evaluation, and the newly constructed bilingual MEPA benchmark show that EMODE improves the balance between lexical fidelity and emotional sensitivity, strengthens affect-grounded response generation, and exposes the value of explicit para-semantic factorization for robust cross-corpus emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EMODE情感感知语音语言模型，通过动态副语义专家（DPSE）分解与路由语音特征，结合三阶段课程训练，提升情感与语义的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语音语言模型在统一跨模态理解与生成上表现良好，但副语言线索（尤其是情感）难以保留。现有系统依赖纠缠的声学表征，导致语言模型过度依赖恢复的词汇内容，而非基于声学韵律证据，因此需要显式的副语言与语义分解。
AI.method: 提出EMODE，核心为动态副语义专家（DPSE）：将连续语音特征分解为语义路径与副语言路径，动态路由并在融合后集成到语言模型。采用三阶段课程训练——语义预热、副语言激活、联合精炼，并辅以正交专家引导（OEG）、语义到声学对齐（SAA）和门控多样性正则化（GDR）。
AI.result: 在情感识别（SER）测试、共情回应评估以及新建双语MEPA基准上，EMODE改善了词汇保真度与情感敏感性的平衡，增强了基于情感的回应急生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了显式副语义因子分解对鲁棒跨语料情感理解的价值，表明该结构分解与训练策略能有效提升情感感知语音语言模型的表现。

title: BoT-Feedback: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Biomechanical Evidence for Explainable Human Action Feedback
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning, yet they remain fundamentally limited in Human Action Feedback Generation. Existing methods infer coaching feedback directly from visual observations, producing generic advice, limited interpretability, and physically implausible hallucinations. In contrast, expert human coaches diagnose performance through explicit biomechanical reasoning over joint kinematics, posture, and body dynamics. We introduce BoT-Feedback, a framework that grounds MLLM reasoning in structured biomechanical evidence. Our key contribution is Biomechanics of Thought (BoT), a four-stage reasoning framework that progressively identifies the action, localises the critical body regions, analyses quantitative biomechanical differences between expert and student performances, and synthesises interpretable coaching feedback. To support this reasoning process, we develop a plug-and-play Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP) that converts videos into structured biomechanical descriptors and an alignment strategy that temporally matches expert and student motions. We further introduce BiomAF, a benchmark containing paired teacher-student videos, 3D skeletons, biomechanical attributes, and expert-coaching annotations. Experiments across twelve open- and closed-source MLLMs demonstrate that grounding reasoning in biomechanical evidence consistently improves feedback quality, interpretability, and robustness while substantially reducing biomechanical hallucinations. BoT-Feedback improves the average expert evaluation score from 2.07 to 2.95 (+40%), enabling compact open-source MLLMs to approach the performance of substantially larger proprietary systems for explainable action feedback generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BoT-Feedback 框架，通过将多模态大语言模型的推理建立在结构化生物力学证据之上，实现可解释的人类动作反馈生成，并发布 BiomAF 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型直接从视觉观察推断教练反馈，导致建议笼统、可解释性差，并产生物理上不合理的幻觉。而专家教练通过关节运动学、姿态和身体动力学进行显式生物力学推理来诊断动作表现。因此需要将模型推理锚定在结构化生物力学证据上。
AI.method: 核心贡献是 Biomechanics of Thought（BoT）四阶段推理框架：识别动作、定位关键身体区域、分析专家与学员之间的定量生物力学差异、合成可解释的教练反馈。配套开发即插即用的 Biomechanical Data Parser（BDP）将视频转为结构化生物力学描述符，并提出对齐策略在时间上匹配专家与学员动作。同时构建 BiomAF 基准，包含配对师生视频、3D 骨架、生物力学属性和专家教练标注。
AI.result: 在十二个开源与闭源多模态大模型上的实验表明，将推理建立在生物力学证据之上可持续提升反馈质量、可解释性和鲁棒性，同时大幅减少生物力学幻觉。BoT-Feedback 将专家评估平均分从 2.07 提升至 2.95（+40%），使紧凑的开源模型在可解释动作反馈生成上接近更大规模专有系统的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以生物力学证据为推理基础能有效提升动作反馈生成的质量与可信度，BoT-Feedback 为可解释的运动指导反馈提供了可行路径，并缩小了小型开源模型与大型专有系统之间的差距。

title: Polar: LLM-Powered Synthesis of Real-World Cyber Evidence for Prioritization and Mitigation
summary: Cyber threat analysis increasingly depends on evidence distributed across vendor advisories, vulnerability databases, and threat intelligence sources. Turning these fragmented observations into timely decisions requires models to connect technical severity with evolving exploitation evidence and available defensive actions. We present POLAR, an LLM-powered framework for synthesizing real-world cyber evidence into threat-centric assessments for prioritization and mitigation. POLAR first disentangles overlapping incidents and grounds each threat in source-linked evidence. For prioritization, it infers severity metrics from cyber evidence and combines the resulting assessment with temporally ordered exploitation signals to estimate near-term exploitation likelihood. For mitigation, it links the synthesized threat data to authoritative remediation knowledge and organizes applicable actions according to threat urgency and operational constraints. We evaluate POLAR on real-world vulnerability evidence collected from public resources and compare it with multiple baselines. Across heterogeneous incidents and zero-day settings, POLAR improves threat ranking and mitigation retrieval while producing evidence-linked intermediate assessments that support analyst inspection. The results establish evidence synthesis as a practical foundation for LLM-based cyber decision support across related security tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 POLAR，一个由 LLM 驱动的框架，将分散的网络威胁证据合成为以威胁为中心的评估，用于优先级排序与缓解。POLAR 先区分重叠事件并将威胁锚定到来源关联证据；再通过推断严重性指标并结合时间序列的利用信号估计近期利用可能性；最后将威胁数据链接到权威修复知识，按紧迫性和操作约束组织缓解措施。在真实漏洞证据上，POLAR 优于多个基线，提升了威胁排序与缓解检索效果。
AI.motivation: 网络威胁分析依赖分散在厂商公告、漏洞数据库和威胁情报源中的证据。将这些碎片化观察转化为及时决策，需要模型能将技术严重性与不断演变的利用证据及可用防御行动关联起来，现有方法难以整合这些异构信息。
AI.method: POLAR 框架包含三部分：(1) 事件消歧与证据锚定：区分重叠事件，将每个威胁关联到来源可追溯的证据；(2) 优先级排序：从网络证据推断严重性指标，并结合时间有序的利用信号估计近期利用可能性；(3) 缓解：将合成威胁数据链接到权威修复知识，依据威胁紧迫性与操作约束组织适用的行动。
AI.result: 在从公共资源收集的真实漏洞证据上，与多个基线比较，POLAR 在异构事件和零日场景下均改善了威胁排序和缓解检索，并生成可支持分析师审查的证据关联中间评估。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，证据合成可作为基于 LLM 的网络决策支持在相关安全任务中的实用基础。

title: When Old Facts Return: Re-Reads, Reverts, and the Limits of Temporal Memory
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain retained aggregate evidence, derived scenario and annotation exports, reference code, and an offline verifier
summary: A memory system can retire an obsolete value and later restore it merely because the same old statement appears again. A re-read of an old source and a genuine revert can produce the same observed sequence of values while requiring opposite current answers. We study this ambiguity on 130 extractor-selected atomic transitions derived from software fixes. In the ordinary transition condition, identity-based temporal memory reaches 98.5% model-judged accuracy with zero observed errors under a literal stale-value proxy. Appending a verbatim re-read of the old statement reduces accuracy to 10.8% and raises the stale-value rate to 88.5%. A guard that refuses to reactivate a previously retired value restores accuracy to 97.7% and reduces that rate to 0.8% in this constructed re-read condition. The guard cannot also recognize a legitimate revert without additional change provenance. Two supporting studies examine exposing retired history to the answer model and supplying current source for changed behavior. An exploratory extraction study over 707 software fixes provides scope context, not a universal coverage estimate. The design implication is to distinguish an observation of a value from evidence that the value changed. Selected inputs, aggregate-only answer records, related-family judges and a post-failure guard evaluation limit the conclusions to the retained experiments.

AI.tldr: 记忆系统会因旧语句重新出现而恢复已失效的值，导致"重读"与"真正回退"产生相同的观察序列但需要相反的当前答案；研究通过守卫机制区分二者。
AI.motivation: 身份式时间记忆在处理"旧值重新出现"时存在根本歧义：重读旧源代码和真正的代码回退会产生相同的观测值序列，但所需的当前答案完全相反，这一歧义会影响模型判断的准确性。
AI.method: 从软件修复中提取130个原子转换，设置普通转换条件与追加逐字重读旧语句的条件进行对比；引入"拒绝重新激活已失效值"的守卫；并开展两项支持性研究（向答案模型暴露已失效历史、为变化行为提供当前源代码），另在707个软件修复上做探索性提取。
AI.result: 普通条件下准确率98.5%、陈旧值率0；追加重读后准确率降至10.8%、陈旧值率升至88.5%；守卫将准确率恢复到97.7%、陈旧值率降至0.8%，但无法在缺乏变更溯源时识别合法回退。
AI.conclusion: 设计上应区分"对某值的观测"与"该值发生变化的证据"；结论受限于选择输入、仅聚合答案记录、同族评判等实验条件，不构成普适覆盖估计。

title: When to Remember, When to Abstain: Category-Conditioned Retention for Reliable Agent Memory
comment: 4 pages, 1 Figure, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Social Agent Workshop (https://openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc%2F2026%2FWorkshop%2FSocialAgent#tab-your-consoles)
summary: Persistent agent memory is only as reliable as its retention decision: an assertion weakly supported by its source can be stored and later reused as established fact. We study whether the retention decision should be governed by a confidence bar conditioned on the semantic category of the assertion rather than by a single global threshold, retaining well-evidenced categories liberally while abstaining more aggressively where inference is unreliable. We evaluate this in a deployed cold-start memory pipeline on 100 synthetic personas. The empirical evaluation is motivated by a sharp reliability asymmetry: across 4{,}715 candidate assertions, only 77.9\% of value and belief assertions are supported by their source, versus 96.2\% for all other categories. A global confidence threshold cannot separate these: it either admits unsupported value claims or discards well-evidenced ones. Conditioning the threshold on category resolves the tradeoff. In repeated held-out evaluation, a stricter bar on values alone reduces unsupported retentions from 6.2\% to 4.0\% (an ${\approx}36\%$ relative reduction, modest but consistent across folds) and, as corroborating evidence, preserves an estimated 13 percentage points more coverage (95\% CI 9.8--16.0) than a global threshold at comparable retention. Our results suggest that reliable retention depends on the type of assertion, not on confidence alone, and that a category-conditioned threshold can act as a simple, effective form of selective prediction at the write boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体长期记忆的保留决策，提出按断言语义类别设置差异化置信度阈值，而非单一全局阈值，以在写入阶段实现选择性预测。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆的可靠性取决于保留决策：证据薄弱的断言一旦被存储，之后会被当作既定事实复用。作者观察到可靠性存在明显的类别不对称——在4,715条候选断言中，仅77.9%的价值与信念类断言得到来源支持，而其他类别为96.2%。单一全局阈值无法区分二者：要么纳入无支持的价值主张，要么丢弃证据充分的断言。
AI.method: 在已部署的冷启动记忆流水线上对100个合成人格进行评估，将保留阈值按断言的语义类别条件化：对证据充分的类别宽松保留，对推断不可靠的类别更积极地弃权。采用重复的留出集评估与多折交叉验证。
AI.result: 仅对价值类施加更严格的标准，可将无支持的保留从6.2%降至4.0%（约36%的相对下降，幅度不大但跨折一致）；同时作为佐证，在相当保留量下比全局阈值多保留约13个百分点的覆盖（95% CI 9.8–16.0）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的记忆保留取决于断言类型而非仅置信度，按类别条件化的阈值可作为写入边界上一种简单有效的选择性预测形式。

title: Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA框架，通过将交互轨迹逐步抽象为情景描述、可复用流程和带适用条件的原则，构建执行-抽象反馈闭环，使LLM智能体无需微调即可持续进化，在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在交互环境中能力强，但难以从经验中持续进化。微调依赖参数访问且计算成本高，对大规模、闭源模型不适用；外部记忆方法虽无需改参数，但现有工作侧重经验表示与组织，知识仍与具体任务和情境强耦合，泛化性差。核心挑战是如何将具体交互转化为抽象、可复用的知识，以指导超越个体经验的新决策。
AI.method: SAGA框架将交互轨迹渐进转化为三个层次：情景描述、可复用流程、以及带显式适用条件的原则，同时保持与执行证据的链接。检索到的原则被实例化为任务特定指导，并通过纠正性反馈与重采样来精炼候选动作，从而形成执行—抽象的反馈闭环，使累积知识指导未来交互，新经验持续更新分层记忆。
AI.result: 在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上的实验显示任务性能提升；消融研究突出了情境实例化和动作调节在利用原则级知识中的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过经验落地式抽象，将具体交互转化为可迁移的原则级知识，并通过反馈闭环持续演进智能体行为，为无需修改模型参数的经验学习提供了有效路径。

title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
summary: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在不使用任何人工证据标注的情况下，仅凭判定结果（verdict）训练小型语言模型，能恢复多少证据（证据片段）。在ContractNLI上，标签训练达到0.896准确率和0.564跨度F1；拒绝采样从0.747/0.493提升到0.797/0.556。结果表明准确率与证据一致性仅弱相关，不能作为可审查引用的良好指标，但两种方法都能在无人标注证据的情况下改善证据质量。
AI.motivation: 在许多审查流程中，仅保留了最终判定，背后的支撑段落未被标注，因为证据标注成本远高于记录决策。作者希望探究：仅凭判定结果进行后训练的小型语言模型，能在多大程度上恢复这些证据，从而降低人工标注证据的需求。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI数据集上，将人工证据跨度保留至评估阶段。比较两种方法：(1) 仅用裸判定进行标签训练（label-only training）；(2) 拒绝采样（rejection sampling），即仅当生成轨迹的判定与记录一致时才保留该轨迹，再依据自动源接地（source-grounding）分数挑选。全程不使用任何人工证据标签。
AI.result: 标签训练达到准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样从训练前的0.747/0.493提升到0.797/0.556。逐字引用率在标签训练下从0.597升至0.729，在拒绝采样下升至0.701。在六个系统中，判定准确率与证据跨度一致性仅弱相关，且对系统的排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 判定准确率不能作为证据引用可审查性的良好指引，因为匹配判定与匹配证据跨度是两回事。单一语料上的单一随机种子无法断定哪种方法更优，但标签训练和拒绝采样都能在无人标注证据的情况下改善证据质量。

title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
summary: Melt-pool monitoring is central to qualifying metal additive manufacturing (AM), yet no public event-camera benchmark exists for this domain. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond timing instead of reading full frames, giving the temporal resolution AM transients demand at a fraction of the data rate. We present SynAM-E (Synthetic AM Events), the first public multi-source simulated event-camera benchmark for metal-AM melt-pool monitoring: 85 physics-calibrated event shards from 15 sources across 8 institutions, with public baselines and fixed cross-machine evaluation splits. On a single-machine case study, event-spatial monitoring matches dense-frame accuracy (0.874 versus 0.863 macro-F1), and the absolute intensity that events discard adds only +0.006 under fusion. On the NIST Additive Manufacturing Metrology Testbed (AMMT) build, a near-sensor event-rate counter recovers a raw-frame-confirmed 528.7 Hz intensity oscillation at ~380 times less sensor readout than the frame stream requires. A compact 93 k-parameter spiking model runs at 15 times lower modeled inference energy for a 0.073 macro-F1 cost. Every cross-source task includes a built-in trust test against camera identity shortcuts: process-type classification passes while material classification remains confounded by camera band, a corpus-structural limitation the release documents and the trust test exposes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个公开的多源仿真事件相机基准 SynAM-E，用于金属增材制造熔池监测，包含85个物理校准事件数据分片，并验证了事件相机在精度、数据率与能效方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造（AM）的熔池监测对质量认证至关重要，但该领域缺乏公开的事件相机基准。事件相机以微秒级时间分辨率记录逐像素亮度变化，能以更低数据率满足AM瞬态监测需求，然而此前没有公开基准可供比较。
AI.method: 构建 SynAM-E（Synthetic AM Events）基准：来自8个机构、15个来源的85个物理校准事件数据分片，提供公开基线和固定的跨机器评估划分。在单机案例中比较事件空间监测与密集帧监测，并进行融合实验；在NIST AMMT构建上使用近传感器事件率计数器；同时训练一个93k参数的脉冲神经网络模型；每个跨源任务内置针对相机身份捷径的信任测试。
AI.result: 单机案例中事件空间监测与密集帧精度相当（0.874 vs 0.863 macro-F1），事件丢弃的绝对强度在融合下仅贡献+0.006。在NIST AMMT构建上，近传感器事件率计数器以约380倍更低的传感器读出量恢复了原始帧确认的528.7 Hz强度振荡。93k参数脉冲模型以15倍更低的建模推理能耗运行，macro-F1仅损失0.073。信任测试中过程类型分类通过，而材料分类仍受相机波段混淆。
AI.conclusion: SynAM-E 填补了金属AM事件相机基准的空白，证明事件相机可在保持精度的同时大幅降低数据率与能耗。同时，信任测试揭示材料分类存在相机波段混杂的语料结构局限，该局限已在发布中记录并由信任测试暴露。

title: From Sandbox to Enforcement: Confidence-Qualified Threat Intelligence for Critical Infrastructure
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Critical Information Infrastructures Security (CRITIS 2026)
summary: Security operations centres and national incident-response teams defending critical infrastructure collect abundant threat data yet struggle to turn it into actionable intelligence. A malware sandbox produces detailed behavioural evidence, but as a large, unranked report whose confidence is unstated. We present CG-CTI, an operational pipeline that converts live sandbox output (CAPEv2) into STIX 2.1, correlates it in a knowledge graph with other critical-infrastructure sensors, and attaches to every intelligence object an explicit confidence status derived from provenance, cross-source corroboration, and observation durability. This status gates automated action: only corroborated intelligence is eligible for automated enforcement, while lower-confidence objects are routed to analyst review or kept as context. A grounded language-model stage then narrates the confidence-qualified evidence, where each statement either cites a supporting object or is marked unsupported, so fabricated references are removed before analyst review. We implement CG-CTI within the CYBERGUARD project, whose consortium includes Romania's national cyber-security directorate, and evaluate it against the live sandbox on a labelled malware corpus, measuring conversion validity, indicator yield, technique coverage, corroboration, enforcement eligibility, latency, and summary grounding. CG-CTI turns fragmented sandbox output into corroborated, confidence-ranked, and auditable intelligence for critical-infrastructure defence.

AI.tldr: CG-CTI 将沙箱原始输出转为 STIX 2.1，并在知识图谱中关联多源传感器数据，为每个情报对象附加显式置信状态，用于门控自动化处置，同时用接地语言模型生成可溯源叙述。
AI.motivation: 安全运营中心与国家事件响应团队掌握大量威胁数据，却难以转化为可行动情报；沙箱报告虽含详细行为证据，但体量大、无排序、置信度不明。
AI.method: 构建 CG-CTI 流水线：把 CAPEv2 实时输出转换为 STIX 2.1；在知识图谱中与其他关键基础设施传感器数据做关联；基于来源可信度、跨源印证和观测持久性为每个情报对象附加显式置信状态；该状态门控自动化动作（仅被印证情报可自动执行）；再用接地语言模型对置信限定证据进行叙述，每条陈述须引用支持对象，否则标记为无支撑并去除虚构引用。在 CYBERGUARD 项目中实现，联盟含罗马尼亚国家网络安全机构。
AI.result: 在带标签恶意软件语料上与实况沙箱对比评估，测量转换有效性、指标产出、技术覆盖、印证程度、可执行资格、时延与摘要接地性。
AI.conclusion: CG-CTI 能把碎片化沙箱输出转化为经印证、按置信度排序、可审计的情报，支撑关键基础设施防御。

title: Acquiring and Verifying Repository Norms for Coding Agents
summary: Changes produced by coding agents can pass functional tests while leaving repository contribution requirements unmet. Following repository-specific norms requires identifying guidance dispersed across repository sources and interpreting its conditions and exceptions. Retrieval and documentation approaches supply general context, but agents must still determine which norms apply. We introduce RepoNorm to acquire explicit and implicit repository norms independently of coding tasks. It checks norm content and applicability using repository evidence, consults Git history when needed, and delivers norm packages to existing coding agents. Our evaluation uses three coding models and 121 tasks from RepoNormBench. Against the baseline with no additional generated guidance (Raw), relative improvements are 7.42-10.77% for Overall Norm Compliance Rate (NCR), 31.64-45.44% for Contribution NCR, and 11.34-17.69% for Prompt-omitted NCR. All three coding models also obtain higher values on these NCR measures with RepoNorm than with CodeWiki documentation. Functional success rates show observed gains of 5.79-9.09 percentage points over Raw; the paired comparisons do not reach the significance threshold. Sampled precision is 86% with RepoNorm's default configuration.

AI.tldr: RepoNorm 通过仓库证据获取显式与隐式仓库规范，并打包交付给现有编程智能体，从而提升代码贡献的规范符合率。
AI.motivation: 编程智能体生成的改动虽能通过功能测试，但往往不满足仓库的贡献要求。仓库特定规范分散在多个来源中，且附带条件与例外，检索与文档方法只能提供通用上下文，智能体仍需自行判断哪些规范适用。
AI.method: 提出 RepoNorm，独立于具体编程任务获取显式与隐式仓库规范；利用仓库证据检查规范内容与适用性，必要时查阅 Git 历史，并将规范包交付给现有编程智能体。评估使用三种编程模型与 RepoNormBench 的 121 个任务。
AI.result: 相比无额外生成指导的基线（Raw），整体规范符合率（NCR）相对提升 7.42-10.77%，贡献 NCR 提升 31.64-45.44%，提示词遗漏 NCR 提升 11.34-17.69%。三个模型在 RepoNorm 下的三项 NCR 均高于 CodeWiki 文档。功能成功率较 Raw 提升 5.79-9.09 个百分点，但配对比较未达显著性阈值；默认配置下抽样精确率为 86%。
AI.conclusion: RepoNorm 能有效提升编程智能体对仓库规范的遵循程度，尤其在贡献规范方面增益显著，优于通用文档方案；功能成功率有正向趋势但统计显著性不足。

title: The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 26 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". Code: https://github.com/ziwang11112/right-memory-wrong-context
summary: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure. We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.

AI.tldr: 提出检索可采纳性验证框架，将记忆-查询对分为可采纳、不可采纳、未决三类，并在匹配必需证据召回率条件下比较检索路径，追踪记忆ID的提示暴露与答案披露。基于RHELM与MemOps的3,767条查询重分析显示：域外过滤不降低排名，Top-20锚点召回由0.432升至0.533，80%召回可行性由0.237升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%；在1,523组配对案例中，命名空间路由带来0.053–0.068的判定准确率增益（观察性）。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆检索评估仅看召回率与最终答案准确率，无法揭示检索到的信息是否“当前请求不可采纳”：可能属于其他主体、违反策略或处于不兼容的生命周期状态。路径可能因缺失必需证据而看似安全，而正确答案也可能源于不可采纳的提示暴露。
AI.method: 构建检索可采纳性验证框架：为每个记忆-查询对赋予可采纳/不可采纳/未决三种状态；在匹配必需证据召回率的条件下比较各检索路径，并为未决情形给出边界；通过追踪记忆ID的提示暴露，将其与目标级披露相链接；在独立、非合并的样本上分阶段评估。
AI.result: RHELM与MemOps冻结排名的Top-20事后重分析涵盖3,767条查询：发布锚点均位于可信查询命名空间内，域内分数不变，域外过滤不会降低其排名；Top-20锚点召回从0.432提升至0.533，80%召回可行性从0.237提升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%。冻结的72例开发诊断中，发布元数据参考保留必需证据，而两个纯文本验证器在1%必需锚点误拒上限下均未检出违规。1,523组配对案例中，命名空间路由与判定准确率增益0.053–0.068相关（三个读者，观察性）。16个受控暴露场景中，仅一个读者的95%置信区间排除零（相关不可采纳字面披露 +0.156，95% CI [0.031, 0.312]）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对候选支持、可采纳性、提示暴露与答案披露进行分离验证，而非依赖召回率或最终答案准确率来间接判断检索安全。

title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
summary: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

AI.tldr: AegisFlow 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体自愈框架，通过 Watchdog 与 Repair 智能体及并行影子补丁机制，将数据管道的检测与修复闭环，大幅降低 MTTR 并提升补丁成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统数据管道脆弱，常因上游模式漂移、API 契约变更或网页 DOM 修改而失败。现有可观测性工具仅向人工工程师告警，导致 MTTR 高、运维疲劳，检测与解决之间存在断层。
AI.method: 提出 AegisFlow 框架：使用 Watchdog 智能体采集运行时遥测数据，Repair 智能体基于大语言模型自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；采用非侵入式执行模型"并行影子补丁"，基于 MAPE-K 循环在数字孪生环境中生成与验证补丁；框架与部署无关，可作为插件接入现有管道编排系统。
AI.result: 在五类常见故障场景中评估：MTTR 从平均每补丁 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟，改善 98.1%；补丁成功率 92%。其中 JSON 模式变更成功率 96%、标点漂移 98%，Shadow DOM 场景最低为 85%。可释放约 98% 的数据工程值班时间用于创新。
AI.conclusion: AegisFlow 通过智能体闭环实现数据管道的自动检测与自愈，显著降低 MTTR 与运维负担，且具备部署无关性，能以插件方式低开销集成到现有管道编排系统中。

title: WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

AI.tldr: WavePrune通过将RoPE每个通道限制在首个旋转周期内，消除位置混叠带来的注意力干扰，提升长文本性能并带来推理加速。
AI.motivation: RoPE通过按通道特定频率旋转查询和键向量来编码位置，使注意力logits对位置的共同平移不变。但其旋转是周期性的，导致相隔一个完整旋转周期的相对位置难以区分，即位置混叠问题。
AI.method: 提出WavePrune，将每个通道限制在其首个旋转周期内。由于该限制相当于滑动窗口，它诱导出细粒度稀疏性，作者据此设计了硬件对齐的CUDA kernel加以利用。
AI.result: 在五个测试模型中的四个上无需额外调优即提升HELMET分数（如Qwen3-8B从35.7提升到40.0）；从头预训练时，在超出训练长度外推时验证损失更低；相比FlashAttention-2在32K上下文下实现1.15倍prefill和1.24倍decoding加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，RoPE的周期性结构虽被广泛认为至关重要，但在首个旋转周期之外基本上是冗余的。

title: Visual-Invariance-Augmented Feature Optimal Alignment for Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transferable adversarial examples, especially in black-box settings where only open-source surrogate models are accessible. Existing targeted transfer attacks mainly align adversarial and target samples using global image-level features, such as encoder [CLS] embeddings. However, such coarse alignment insufficiently exploits patch-level visual structures, limiting transferability across heterogeneous closed-source MLLMs. We propose IAU-FOA, a visual-invariance-augmented feature optimal alignment attack with adaptive unbalanced transport, to improve targeted transferability against closed-source MLLMs. IAU-FOA aligns adversarial and target samples at both global and local levels: a cosine-based objective narrows their global semantic gap, while patch tokens are clustered into compact local patterns and matched through optimal transport for fine-grained feature alignment. Balanced optimal transport enforces fixed marginal masses even for local clusters without reliable counterparts, potentially introducing misleading alignment gradients. We therefore introduce confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport to relax these constraints for weakly matched clusters, aiming to reduce unreliable local alignment and improve adversarial transferability. We further study the effect of input transformations and propose visual-invariance augmentation, which applies bidirectional pixel-intensity rescaling and per-channel white-balance adjustment to simulate exposure, contrast, illumination, and color-temperature variations. This strategy encourages adversarial perturbations to generalize across different visual encoders. Extensive experiments on open-source and closed-source MLLMs show that IAU-FOA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transferable attack methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA.

AI.tldr: 提出 IAU-FOA 攻击方法，通过全局与局部特征最优对齐及视觉不变性增强，提升对闭源多模态大模型的定向迁移性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型对可迁移对抗样本仍脆弱，尤其黑盒场景仅有开源代理模型。现有定向迁移攻击只用全局图像级特征（如 [CLS] 嵌入）做粗对齐，未充分利用 patch 级视觉结构，导致跨异构闭源 MLLM 迁移性受限。
AI.method: IAU-FOA 在全局与局部两个层面同时对齐：用余弦目标缩小全局语义差距；将 patch token 聚类为紧凑局部模式并用最优传输做细粒度匹配。针对无有效对应簇的平衡传输约束会引入误导梯度，提出置信度自适应非平衡传输，对弱匹配簇放宽约束。另研究输入变换并提出视觉不变性增强，通过双向像素强度缩放与逐通道白平衡模拟曝光、对比度、光照和色温变化。
AI.result: 在开源和闭源多模态大模型上的大量实验表明，IAU-FOA 持续优于当前最先进的可迁移攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 全局-局部联合对齐结合置信度自适应非平衡传输与视觉不变性增强，可有效提升对闭源 MLLM 的定向迁移攻击性能。

title: Evaluating Behavioral Context for Interpretable IAM Policy Risk Scoring in Cloud Environments
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Peer-reviewed and accepted at IEEE Conference ID# 71863; to appear in the IEEE Xplore proceedings
summary: IAM policy analysis typically emphasizes the authorization capabilities encoded in a policy, but security analyst review priority may also depend on the behavioral and environmental context surrounding a policy event. This paper evaluates whether contextual information provides measurable incremental value for interpretable IAM policy risk prioritization beyond policy and effective-authorization information. AWS is used as the experimental cloud provider because its IAM and audit-telemetry ecosystem enables controlled evaluation using AWS IAM Context Bench, a benchmark containing 534 real AWS experimental observations across policy, environment, and behavioral scenarios, including matched cases where policy and environment remain fixed while behavioral context changes. Three Explainable Boosting Machine models are evaluated under the same leakage-controlled grouped cross-validation protocol: a policy-centric baseline, a policy-plus-environment model, and a full-context model incorporating CloudTrail telemetry. The full-context model substantially reduces analyst-priority prediction error relative to the policy-centric baseline and closely tracks the reference priority ordering. In matched same-policy context pairs, the policy-centric model remains invariant, whereas the full-context model separates benign and suspicious behavioral conditions with high directional accuracy. The results also show improved concentration of high-priority cases at the top of simulated analyst review queues. These findings indicate that behavioral and environmental context can provide useful incremental information for analyst-oriented IAM risk prioritization while preserving an interpretable additive model structure. The formulation is applicable beyond AWS conceptually, although cross-provider validation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文评估行为与环境上下文信息能否在策略与有效授权信息之外，为可解释的IAM策略风险优先级排序带来可度量的增量价值，基于AWS IAM Context Bench基准与三种EBM模型验证。
AI.motivation: 传统IAM策略分析主要关注策略中编码的授权能力，但分析人员审查优先级可能还取决于策略事件周围的行为与环境上下文；因此需检验上下文信息是否具有可度量的增量价值。
AI.method: 以AWS为实验云平台，构建AWS IAM Context Bench基准，包含534个真实AWS实验观测，覆盖策略、环境与行为场景，并含策略与环境固定而行为上下文变化的匹配案例。在相同的泄漏受控分组交叉验证协议下，评估三种可解释提升机模型：策略中心基线、策略+环境模型、纳入CloudTrail遥测的全上下文模型。
AI.result: 全上下文模型相比策略中心基线显著降低分析人员优先级预测误差，并紧密贴合参考优先级排序；在策略相同的匹配案例中，策略中心模型保持不变，而全上下文模型能以高方向准确率区分良性与会话可疑行为条件；同时在模拟审查队列中提高了高优先级案例的集中度。
AI.conclusion: 行为与环境上下文可为面向分析人员的IAM风险优先级排序提供有用的增量信息，同时保持可解释的加性模型结构；该建模思路在概念上可推广至AWS以外的云平台，但跨云厂商验证仍属未来工作。

title: ES-Trace: Auditing Ethical-Sourcing Disclosure of Code Generation Models Beyond Model Cards
summary: Code generation models have been increasingly used in software development, but their development raises ethical-sourcing concerns involving intellectual property, privacy, fairness, labour practices, and environmental impact. Although prior work has defined ethical-sourcing criteria for code generation, it remains unclear how much evidence existing models disclose and where that evidence can be found. We introduce ES-Trace, a framework for ethical-sourcing disclosure audits that traces disclosed evidence beyond model cards using the Model Documentation Traceability Graph (MDTG), which represents relationships among models, versions, and documentation artifacts. We apply ES-Trace to 26 models from 10 publishers across 77 documents and 20 ES-CodeGen aspects. Model-card-only auditing yields a mean score of 1.77/5, while resolving the declared references increases it to 2.82/5, with most of the increase arising from documents that the publisher declares in structured metadata. The key findings of our study include: (1) social and labour-related aspects remain poorly documented, even when expanding the audit to the full documentation scope, (2) resolving documentation references substantially increases observed disclosure, raising the mean score from 1.77/5 to 2.82/5, (3) model-card-only audits can mischaracterize release-level disclosure changes, and (4) documentation mismatches can associate evidence with the wrong model or version, highlighting the need for explicit model--version binding and consistency across documentation artifacts. Our study calls for reference-aware ethical-sourcing disclosure audits, explicit model--version binding and consistency across documentation artifacts, and stronger documentation of currently underreported social and labour-related aspects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ES-Trace 框架，通过模型文档溯源图（MDTG）追踪模型卡之外的伦理溯源证据，对 26 个模型、77 份文档、20 个伦理维度进行审计，发现仅审计模型卡会低估披露水平，需进行引用感知的披露审计。
AI.motivation: 代码生成模型在软件开发中应用日益广泛，但其开发涉及知识产权、隐私、公平性、劳动实践和环境影响的伦理溯源问题。已有研究虽定义了伦理溯源标准，但尚不清楚现有模型披露了多少证据、以及这些证据位于何处，因此需要一种能够跨文档追踪证据的审计方法。
AI.method: 提出 ES-Trace 框架用于伦理溯源披露审计，其核心是模型文档溯源图（MDTG），用于表示模型、版本与文档制品之间的关系，从而将披露证据的追踪范围从模型卡扩展到模型卡所声明的引用文档。将该框架应用于 10 家发布方的 26 个模型，覆盖 77 份文档和 20 个伦理维度（ES-CodeGen aspects）。
AI.result: 仅审计模型卡时平均得分为 1.77/5，解析所声明的引用后提升至 2.82/5，其中大部分提升来自发布方在结构化元数据中声明的文档。主要发现包括：（1）社会与劳动相关维度即使在扩大审计范围后仍记录不足；（2）解析文档引用显著提高观察到的披露水平（1.77/5 提升至 2.82/5）；（3）仅审计模型卡可能错误刻画发布级别的披露变化；（4）文档不匹配可能将证据关联到错误的模型或版本。
AI.conclusion: 研究呼吁采用引用感知的伦理溯源披露审计，强调需要显式的模型—版本绑定与文档制品间的一致性，并加强对当前记录不足的社会与劳动相关维度的文档化。

title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
summary: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.

AI.tldr: 要让关于AI智能体的声明可被核查，必须先固定政策、范围、可验证记录及记录来源与判定规则，并满足独立性覆盖、参数级授权绑定、超出完整性的完备性三项条件。
AI.motivation: 组织常对AI智能体做出各类声明（如每次外发邮件均经人工批准、所有动作均被记录、评估证明可安全部署），但EU AI Act第12条只要求高风险系统支持自动记录事件，并未说明哪些记录能够支撑哪项声明，导致声明难以被真正核查。作者希望把"可审计性"从单个动作扩展到声明层面。
AI.method: 借鉴鉴证业务（assurance engagement）的前提条件，提出"可审计声明"的定义：政策、范围、可settle该声明的记录、记录撰写者以及判定规则须在任何裁决之前被固定，且记录可获取。这将既有Auditable Agents框架中的Policy Checkability维度从单一动作推广到声明。针对智能体额外提出三项条件：独立记录覆盖、授权绑定到每个动作的参数、以及超越完整性的完备性。在显式模型下证明：在假设成立处，缺少任一条件则支持（support）不可能成立。用声明-核查表将方法应用于六类常见声明，并锚定NIST、IETF、OWASP现行草案；以一个工作案例贯穿五种证据状态。
AI.result: 给出可审计声明的形式化界定与三项智能体专属条件，并在显式模型下证明三者对"支持"的必要性；形成适用于六类常见声明的核查表，与NIST、IETF、OWASP草案对齐；通过一个贯穿五种证据状态的案例演示方法落地。
AI.conclusion: 面向运营方、采购方、审计方与标准制定者提供实践要点与操作步骤，使AI智能体声明在裁决前即具备可核查结构，从而弥补EU AI Act第12条未指明记录标准所留下的空白。

title: EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search
summary: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

AI.tldr: EPOCH 是一种证据治理架构，通过任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立重放，使 AI 研究智能体的发现过程更可信，在 AlgoTune、Math14、AgentHPO 等基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 研究智能体虽能搜索程序、数学构造与证明，但通常只优化评估器反馈，未对反馈的解读、质疑与复用进行治理，导致脆弱候选被误判为发现，基准提升、有限证书与定理级主张被混淆。因此需要引入证据治理机制来提升发现的可信度。
AI.method: 提出 EPOCH 证据治理架构，实现证据治理的发现循环：结合显式任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立重放，使每个候选方案都依据其所支持主张的强度与范围接受评估。
AI.result: 在 AlgoTune 上取得最优综合表现，平均归一化得分 0.65 显著超过最强基线 0.53；在内部 Math14 套件上取得最高平均分 0.57；在官方测试重放下表现出良好的留出行为；在 AgentHPO 描述性综合指标上领先。在十个发现问题上，EPOCH 取得具体进展，包括改进的可执行构造、优化算法、反例与有证明支持的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，证据治理是迈向可信 AI 研究智能体的必要步骤，使其不仅能产生更强的解，也能产出更可信的科学发现。

title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
summary: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

AI.tldr: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开放模型，为随机试验文章的结局方向问题输出概率，按预先注册的四项标准全部通过，并以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。
AI.motivation: 为循证医学中"干预相对对照组是否显著增加、减少或未显著改变某结局"的判定提供可复用、可校准、许可清白的自动化模型，并在发布前用预注册标准约束模型质量与可复现性。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为底座，加低秩适配器与决策头；输入为截断至 6,144 token 的试验文章；仅在 2,657 篇训练文章中许可允许复用的 1,431 篇上针对 Evidence Inference 2.0 微调。四项评判标准在生成该版本测试预测前已注册于 Open Science Framework，其中一项在 EI 公开标签的测试集上判定。做了消融：仅用"干净"文章训练、无文章、仅标题，以及交换干预与对照。
AI.result: 测试集（333 篇文章、1,218 个提示）上：期望校准误差 0.0168（上限 0.05）；对数损失比先验低 0.8603（95% 区间 0.8104–0.9078），比读同样输入的 Gemma 4 31B-it 低 0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；macro-F1 为 0.9248（对照 0.8668）；四项标准全部通过。仅用干净文章训练使准确率下降 0.0123（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）。无文章时 macro-F1 降至 0.4384；仅给标题提升 0.0939（0.0655–0.1234），可能由标题中给出试验结果或试验记忆解释；交换干预与对照使 0.6652 的方向答案反转。按发布形态运行时文件与所评估预测在预设限度内一致。
AI.conclusion: Fiorillo v0.5 在预先注册的四项标准下全部达标，校准良好且显著优于先验与同输入的大模型基线；但其性能高度依赖文章信息（尤其标题中可能的结果线索），且对干预/对照的顺序敏感，说明部分"解答"可能来自记忆或表面线索而非严格推理。模型以 Apache 2.0 发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722），训练数据许可筛选未造成明显性能代价。

title: Hierarchy-GBP: Accelerating Factor Graph Inference via Abstraction and Recovery
summary: Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) is a distributed inference algorithm that passes messages in graphical models, making it attractive for scalable spatial intelligence. However, we find GBP most effective locally: it rapidly smooths message errors that vary sharply between neighbor variables, but corrects global errors across distant graph regions incrementally through long-range message propagations. We propose Hierarchy-GBP (H-GBP), an iterative, two-stage framework that accelerates GBP by first solving these global errors with a coarse graph approximation (abstraction) and projecting the results back to the original graph (recovery), then refining the remaining local errors with GBP. We prove H-GBP convergence to the optimum by deriving the combined matrix operator of our abstraction and recovery steps and analyzing its spectral radius. Experiments on linear sparse graphs show that H-GBP converges fundamentally faster than standard GBP. Moreover, we validate H-GBP on two important spatial problems: Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) and Bundle Adjustment (BA). H-GBP markedly accelerates large-scale PGO and achieves state-of-the-art runtime across all tested BA scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H-GBP，一种两阶段迭代框架，先通过粗图近似求解全局误差并投影回原图，再用 GBP 精化局部误差，从而显著加速大规模图推断。
AI.motivation: GBP 适合分布式推断与可扩展空间智能，但其主要擅长局部快速平滑消息误差，对跨远距离图区域的全局误差只能通过长程消息传播逐步修正，导致收敛慢。
AI.method: 提出 Hierarchy-GBP（H-GBP）两阶段迭代框架：第一阶段用粗图近似（abstraction）求解全局误差，并将结果投影回原图（recovery）；第二阶段用标准 GBP 精化剩余局部误差。同时推导 abstraction 与 recovery 的组合矩阵算子，并通过谱半径分析证明收敛到最优解。
AI.result: 在线性稀疏图上，H-GBP 收敛速度从根本上快于标准 GBP。在 Pose Graph Optimization（PGO）和 Bundle Adjustment（BA）两个空间问题上验证：H-GBP 明显加速大规模 PGO，并在所有测试规模的 BA 上达到 state-of-the-art 运行时间。
AI.conclusion: H-GBP 通过层次化全局-局部误差分解有效克服了 GBP 的远距离收敛瓶颈，并为大规模空间推断提供了更快且理论可证的迭代算法。

title: Simple Extremely Lossy Functions from Small-Exponent Hashing
summary:
Extremely Lossy Functions (ELFs) are a standard model primitive that captures many useful properties of random oracles (Zhandry, Crypto 2016). While there are many variations of ELFs with additional properties, every construction (excluding obfuscation) has followed essentially the same template of bootstrapping from a sequence of ELFs secure only against fixed-size adversaries, and every construction was based on only the exponential hardness of DDH (or $k$-Lin), an assumption that is only reasonable over elliptic curves.
  We introduce and construct Extremely Lossy Trapdoor Hashing (ELTDH), a stronger notion that implies all known variations of ELFs. Our construction achieves ELTDH in one go, without bootstrapping from schemes secure for only fixed-size adversaries, which makes it simpler and more efficient than existing ELFs. We assume exponential security of the small-exponent discrete logarithm, together with polynomial security of decisional composite residuosity (DCR). Exponential security is only required in the size of the secret exponent, not the size of the group, so the assumption plausibly holds for multiplication modulo $N^2$ (and for many other cryptographic groups), despite the subexponential-time discrete logarithm attacks from index calculus. Our results diversify the assumptions underlying ELFs, while also giving a simpler construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并构造了极强有损陷门哈希（ELTDH），它蕴含所有已知的极强有损函数（ELF）变体，并给出更简单高效的构造。
AI.motivation: 现有ELF构造几乎都依赖"从仅对固定规模敌手安全的ELF序列自举"这一模板，且仅基于DDH（或k-Lin）的指数级硬度假设，这类假设通常只在椭圆曲线上合理，假设基础较为单一且构造复杂。
AI.method: 引入更强的原语ELTDH，一步到位构造，无需从固定规模敌手安全的方案自举；假设小指数离散对数的指数级安全性（仅需在秘密指数规模上，而非群规模上）以及决定性复合剩余（DCR）的多项式安全性。
AI.result: 构造出比现有ELF更简单高效的ELTDH，其假设在模N²乘法群（以及其他许多密码群）上看似成立，尽管存在基于指数演算的亚指数时间离散对数攻击；同时使ELF所依赖的假设更加多样化。
AI.conclusion: ELTDH蕴含所有已知ELF变体，其构造更简单高效，并在多样化ELF底层假设的同时提供了更简洁的方案。

title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
summary: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{Dev-Primitives} (\emph{Development Primitives}), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose \textbf{HERMES}, a Harness Engineering framework for software engineeRing via Modular Executable Dev-PrimitiveS, which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4\% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2\% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Dev-Primitives与HERMES框架，将仓库构件转化为带常驻LLM的可执行抽象，解决长周期软件工程任务中的上下文爆炸与语义漂移问题，在四个基准上平均超越基线12.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有具备终端访问能力的大语言模型智能体在长周期工作流中表现脆弱：程序状态分散于源码、配置、测试、依赖与运行时行为中，需反复重构，导致交互历史过长、上下文爆炸与语义漂移；大型仓库还使任务相关组件的识别更加困难。
AI.method: 提出Dev-Primitives（开发原语），将仓库构件与常驻LLM配对，使构件获得基于自身实现与依赖的智能体原生接口，支持自然语言推理、组件间通信与局部自我修改；在此基础上构建HERMES框架，通过依赖感知的动态激活机制与将执行证据映射回待修正组件的缺陷诊断机制，在仓库规模上实例化这些原语。
AI.result: 在四个软件工程基准上的实验表明，HERMES平均超越匹配的基线框架12.4%；在搭配强激活与诊断模型时，即使使用Qwen3-8B作为Dev-Primitives，在全部四个基准上仍与同构的GPT-5.6 Sol配置相差不超过4.5%，同时在Terminal-Bench 4.0上降低推理成本26.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明框架（harness）设计对软件工程智能体至关重要，模块化可执行抽象与依赖感知激活、缺陷诊断机制能有效缓解长周期任务中的上下文与语义问题，并在性能与成本间取得更好平衡。

title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM多智能体系统（MAS）的防御归纳为五项原则，并实现为DEFER框架，通过确定性检查级联加四评委小组的混合机制，在四个领域将攻击成功率从约30%降至约3%。
AI.motivation: 当前针对LLM多智能体系统的防御通常被孤立评估，一次只针对一种攻击类型，导致成本高昂且难以审计的结果，缺乏统一、系统的防御组织方式。
AI.method: 将防御组织为五项原则，并实现为DEFER（确定性优先执行与残余判断）：包含28项检查的级联，先尽可能阻断，其余交由四名评委组成的评审小组判断。
AI.result: 在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%；78%被阻断的攻击由确定性检查处理；在安全运营领域仅四分之一提案到达评委环节。同时存在弱点，如风险评分审批门错误批准了大多数攻击提案但很少批准合法提案。
AI.conclusion: 规则性检查可为违反明确策略的攻击提供安全保障，而评委机制则处理那些仅伪装意图的攻击；但两者均存在不足，准确评估威胁仍是挑战。

title: When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value
summary: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分层诊断协议，检验交通预测精度提升能否转化为信号控制收益，发现受时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动力学一致性与目标对齐四重约束，预测改进往往无法带来运营提升。
AI.motivation: 交通预测精度提升常被默认能改善信号控制决策，但二者之间存在转化鸿沟。作者希望系统诊断预测增益在何种环节、因何原因无法转化为闭环控制收益，并提供可操作的诊断流程。
AI.method: 基于中国宣城29天重构需求数据（其中7天为测试日）开展分层诊断：评估点预测、保形区间、依赖感知情景与匹配的闭环控制器；进行接口审计以识别决策时刻信息泄漏与可用动作数；修正时间接口后，将因果预测与5秒事件"预言机"在穷举联合动作搜索下对比，并设置合成阳性对照。
AI.result: 入口级与流向级预测相较历史均值分别降低MAE 4.03%与3.92%；名义90%保形区间的边际覆盖率为90.72%，但在事后高需求子集上仅75.66%。接口审计发现决策时刻信息泄漏，且9个受控交叉口中仅2个提供多个有效动作。合成阳性对照显示未来信息可将内部推演成本降低61.5%；但在冻结测试日，因果预测与事件预言机相对匹配的无未来推演方案使排队车·秒分别增加6.09%与3.39%，预言机使溢出暴露降低3.78%，配对日自助法区间跨零。
AI.conclusion: 预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动力学一致性与目标对齐四项条件，预测精度提升并不必然带来控制收益。所提出的诊断协议可实际用于定位预测改进无法转化为运营效益的环节。

title: Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain
summary: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知识蒸馏与量化的联合应用，用于法英生物医学翻译，在低资源条件下实现模型压缩同时保持翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练Transformer模型性能优异，但部署成本高。知识蒸馏与量化虽可压缩模型，但在专业领域、低资源条件下分别面临平行数据稀缺和精度下降的限制。作者希望探索二者联合是否能在生物医学翻译中兼顾效率与质量。
AI.method: 针对法英生物医学翻译任务，联合使用知识蒸馏与量化，并设计、比较多种微调策略，将压缩后的学生模型适配到该领域。
AI.result: 协同蒸馏并量化的学生模型相比原始基线：模型体积减少69%，推理速度提升98.21%，CO2排放减少98.46%，且翻译质量未下降。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术可产出高效、高性能的模型，适合资源受限条件下的翻译服务提供商使用。

title: State-Aware Interaction MIL for Rare Joint Molecular Phenotype Prediction in Colorectal Cancer and Lung Adenocarcinoma
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Joint molecular phenotype prediction is complicated by small joint-positive populations and overlapping histological features across alternative molecular states. Existing computational pathology approaches typically predict biomarkers independently or formulate the joint-positive phenotype as a binary endpoint. Independent prediction does not model interactions between biomarker-specific histological representations, whereas binary joint prediction collapses the double-negative and two single-positive configurations into a single negative class. We propose State-Aware Interaction MIL, a weakly supervised method that preserves biomarker-specific histological representations, models their interaction, and supervises the complete four-state molecular configuration. We evaluate the proposed approach for joint BRAF+/MSI+ prediction in colorectal cancer and EGFR+/TP53+ prediction in lung adenocarcinoma using frozen UNI2-h and CONCH pathology foundation-model representations. With UNI2-h, State-Aware Interaction MIL achieved an average precision of 0.5566 in colorectal cancer (joint-positive prevalence 6.8%) compared with 0.5161 for NaiveMTL, and 0.2784 in lung adenocarcinoma (joint-positive prevalence 8.6%) compared with 0.2525 for IndependentPair. With CONCH, State-Aware achieved an average precision of 0.4410 compared with 0.3932 for DirectJoint in colorectal cancer and 0.1659 compared with 0.1226 for DirectJoint in lung adenocarcinoma. These results indicate that pathology foundation-model representations contain predictive information for rare joint molecular phenotypes and that preserving biomarker-specific representations within a structured molecular-state formulation can improve prediction of these phenotypes from histopathology.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 State-Aware Interaction MIL，一种弱监督方法，用于联合分子表型预测，保留各生物标志物的组织学表征、建模其交互，并对完整四状态分子配置进行监督，在结直肠癌 BRAF+/MSI+ 与肺腺癌 EGFR+/TP53+ 预测中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 联合分子表型预测面临两个困难：联合阳性样本稀少，以及不同分子状态之间组织学特征重叠。现有计算方法要么独立预测各生物标志物（无法建模生物标志物特异性表征之间的交互），要么将联合阳性作为二分类端点（将双阴性与两种单阳性配置合并为单一阴性类），均损失了信息。
AI.method: 提出 State-Aware Interaction MIL，一种弱监督方法：保留生物标志物特异性的组织学表征，建模这些表征之间的交互，并对完整四状态分子配置进行监督。使用冻结的 UNI2-h 和 CONCH 病理基础模型表征进行评估。
AI.result: 使用 UNI2-h 时，结直肠癌平均精度 0.5566（联合阳性患病率 6.8%），优于 NaiveMTL 的 0.5161；肺腺癌 0.2784（患病率 8.6%），优于 IndependentPair 的 0.2525。使用 CONCH 时，结直肠癌 0.4410，优于 DirectJoint 的 0.3932；肺腺癌 0.1659，优于 DirectJoint 的 0.1226。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型表征包含对罕见联合分子表型的预测信息，且在结构化分子状态表述中保留生物标志物特异性表征，可提升从组织病理学图像对这些表型的预测能力。

title: NetAgent: Multi-Task Agentic Network Traffic Analysis Made Practical
summary:
Network traffic analysis is central to network security, spanning tasks from intrusion detection to encrypted traffic classification. Existing approaches either train task-specific models that generalize poorly or rely on costly traffic foundation models that still struggle under distribution shift. We present NetAgent, the first agentic framework for multi-task traffic analysis. Through a carefully designed agent loop, NetAgent supports complex task understanding, on-the-fly decomposition and orchestration, dynamic replanning, and long-horizon analysis, without task-specific training. It introduces five key designs: (1) knowledge-augmented workflow planning that maps attack knowledge to traffic features to bridge the semantic gap; (2) a comprehensive tool action space with 150+ verified tools extracted from 50+ published systems; (3) a unified code execution space for flexible action composition; (4) a three-tier memory for long-term knowledge consolidation; and (5) sandboxing and runtime repair for reliable execution.
  Across 9 major benchmarks, NetAgent outperforms all baselines (23 single-task and 5 multi-task) on nearly all tasks and generalizes substantially better to unseen traffic distribution (90.04% F1 vs. 2.74% and 3.04% for the best single-task and multi-task baselines) and under realistic background shift (4.85-point F1 drop vs. 74.88-point and 74.80-point drop for the best single-task and multi-task baselines). These results reveal that existing methods owe much of their reported success to overfitting dataset-specific patterns and degrade sharply in realistic network environments, while NetAgent's agentic design remains accurate, generalizable, and robust.

AI.tldr: NetAgent 是首个面向多任务流量分析的智能体框架，无需任务特定训练，在 9 大基准上几乎全面超越 23 个单任务与 5 个多任务基线，并在分布漂移下展现出远超基线的泛化性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 网络流量分析涵盖入侵检测到加密流量分类等多种任务。现有方法一分为二：任务专用模型泛化能力差；流量基础模型成本高，且在分布漂移下依然表现不佳。因此需要一个无需任务特定训练、可支持复杂多任务分析的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出 NetAgent 智能体框架，通过精心设计的智能体循环支持复杂任务理解、即时分解与编排、动态重规划以及长时程分析。包含五项关键设计：(1) 知识增强的工作流规划，将攻击知识映射到流量特征以弥合语义鸿沟；(2) 从 50+ 已发表系统中提取 150+ 经验证工具构成的工具动作空间；(3) 统一代码执行空间以灵活组合动作；(4) 三层记忆实现长期知识固化；(5) 沙箱与运行时修复保障可靠执行。
AI.result: 在 9 大基准上，NetAgent 在几乎所有任务上优于全部基线（23 个单任务、5 个多任务）。对未见流量分布的泛化显著更好：F1 达 90.04%，而最佳单任务与多任务基线仅 2.74% 和 3.04%；在真实背景漂移下 F1 仅下降 4.85 个点，而基线分别下降 74.88 和 74.80 个点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明现有方法的高性能很大程度上源于对数据集特定模式的过拟合，在真实网络环境中急剧退化；而 NetAgent 的智能体式设计在准确率、泛化性与鲁棒性上均保持优势。

title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Dense and Mixture-of-Experts Models for Automated Program Repair
summary: Automated Program Repair (APR) with language models is usually evaluated by whether a generated patch passes the test suite, which can hide differences in maintainability, security, and computational cost. We propose a Weighted Quality Index (QI), inspired by the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality model, that combines functional correctness, maintainability, security, and generation efficiency under configurable weighting schemes. We evaluate three dense Qwen2.5-Coder models (3B, 7B, 14B) and the 16B-parameter DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model (2.4B active parameters) on 40 QuixBugs and 90 Defects4J bugs, all run locally on identical hardware to control for infrastructure effects. Model rankings change with the weighting scheme, showing that single-metric evaluation can hide trade-offs. The MoE model shows almost no statistically significant difference in correctness from the 7B and 14B dense models (McNemar's exact test) while using 3-6 times fewer active parameters, whereas correctness increases significantly across the three dense scales. These results suggest that active parameter count can be a more informative lens than total parameter count for sparse code models.

AI.tldr: 提出加权质量指数QI（基于ISO/IEC 25010），综合正确性、可维护性、安全性与生成效率评估APR模型；在QuixBugs与Defects4J上比较三种Qwen2.5-Coder稠密模型与DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite MoE，发现排名随权重变化，MoE以更少激活参数达到与7B/14B稠密模型相当的正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的自动程序修复通常只用"补丁是否通过测试套件"来评估，这种单一指标会掩盖可维护性、安全性和计算成本方面的差异，容易误导模型选择与部署决策。
AI.method: 提出受ISO/IEC 25010软件质量模型启发的加权质量指数QI，将功能正确性、可维护性、安全性和生成效率在可配置权重方案下组合；在同一硬件上本地运行三种稠密Qwen2.5-Coder模型（3B/7B/14B）与16B参数、2.4B激活参数的DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite MoE模型，在40个QuixBugs和90个Defects4J缺陷上进行评测，并用McNemar精确检验做统计比较。
AI.result: 模型排名随权重方案改变，说明单指标评估会掩盖权衡关系；MoE模型在正确性上与7B、14B稠密模型几乎无统计显著差异，但激活参数少3-6倍；而三个稠密模型随规模增大正确性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 对稀疏代码模型而言，激活参数量可能比总参数量更具信息量，APR评估应采用多维度加权质量指标而非单一测试通过率。

title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
summary: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EIO-Agents 开放规范，包含语义层 EIO（评估智能本体）与记录系统 PER（可移植评估记录），为 AI 智能体评估建立共享的语义标准，使评估从分数、轨迹、评判输出转变为可独立核查的可问责工件。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正进入高风险生产环境，但缺乏共享的语义标准来解释评估含义。分数、轨迹、评判输出与多评判者结论常被用于支持就绪与发布决策，却未说明证据支持何种主张、证据能确立什么、主张如何导向决策。
AI.method: 提出 EIO-Agents 开放规范，建立在两个层次上。语义层为评估智能本体（EIO），提供类型化证据、版本化行为谓词、证据契约、主张、见证规则、证明状态、复发，以及面向度量、发现、控制与 PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK 决策的可计算推导。系统记录层为可移植评估记录（PER），提供某次评估的规范、内容寻址表示，保留"证据到决策"链条，可重新推导、解释与验证。
AI.result: EIO 补足了缺失的语义契约，PER 将由此产生的评估保留为可移植、可验证的系统记录。分数用于总结、评审团用于解释、轨迹用于记录，但均不定义证据含义或其可证明内容。
AI.conclusion: 随着 AI 智能体承担更大运行责任，评估必须超越分数与结论的集合，成为含义、证据、局限与决策均可被独立核查的可问责工件。

title: Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks
summary: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

AI.tldr: 论文通过冻结协议分离速度误差、联合路径上界覆盖率、路径选择与实现损失，发现联合覆盖率的提升并不改善路由效用，反而增加迟到率与平均出行时间，离线结果不能证明在线或因果收益。
AI.motivation: 旨在厘清"更准确的交通预测"或"更高的不确定性覆盖率"是否能真正改善路线决策，因为二者关系此前并不明确。
AI.method: 采用冻结评估协议，将速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖率、路径选择与实现损失相分离；使用北京与成都处理后的道路速度数据，构建离线代理任务，每城含150个起讫点对、3条候选路径、14个测试日；比较原始90分位路径时间上界与最小上界路径选择下联合校准上界。
AI.result: 联合覆盖率在北京M1由83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1由75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2由74.01%升至90.64%；但C2分别使迟到率上升0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均出行时间增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。另在成都预测器对比中，速度平均绝对误差下降14.91%伴随C0下迟到率下降1.4571个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不能作为下游路由效用的替代指标；离线结果无法确立在线或因果层面的收益。

title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
comment: Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于有限状态机的全自动轻量级数据合成框架，用于小语言模型的多轮工具调用微调，仅需单次LLM调用即可生成完整示例。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型部署成本低、可运行于私有基础设施，但基础模型在多轮工具调用上表现不佳，且微调所需的分API数据稀缺。现有合成方法需要模拟运行环境和大量LLM调用，成本过高，难以支撑大规模微调。
AI.method: 将每个API建模为有限状态机，用抽象状态表示系统，决定各工具何时可被调用，从而生成状态合法的工具序列，并通过单次LLM调用将序列转化为完整训练示例。不追求多样性，而是对轮数、工具序列和任务复杂度设定目标分布。
AI.result: 通过在生成轨迹上微调小语言模型来评估数据质量。基于FSM的生成相比未变异基线显著提升下游准确率，与现有工作相比达到70.7%的完整准确率（对比63.4%和53.7%），且token消耗减少3.6–6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于有限状态机的轻量级合成框架能高效生成高质量多轮工具调用训练数据，在提升小模型下游准确率的同时大幅降低生成成本。

title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old-new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL. Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old-new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL.

AI.tldr: 论文研究基类样本也很稀缺的广义FSCIL（G-FSCIL）场景，提出利用潜在扩散模型生成并筛选可信合成数据进行稳定的增量学习框架。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法假设基类数据充足，但在基类与增量数据都稀缺时会出现初始表示弱、语义漂移和边界不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 先用冻结的潜在扩散模型构建类特定合成候选池，重用条件嵌入按需生成；再学习知识筛选策略，选取语义一致且视觉多样的样本，并将其蒸馏为可迁移的选择策略在基类阶段复用；最后设计边界稳定的增量适配，包括合成信息驱动的原型初始化和双向边界校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法持续优于现有FSCIL基线，遗忘更少，新旧类平衡更好。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建与筛选可信合成知识并稳定新旧类边界，可在基类稀缺的现实FSCIL设定下实现更稳定的增量学习。

title: Deep Defence on Wheels: A Dual Intrusion Detection System Architecture for Comprehensive In-Vehicle Network Security
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables, ACM Transactions on Embedded Computing Systems
summary: Increasing connectivity to the outside world and the lack of inbuilt security mechanisms have made legacy intra-vehicular networks vulnerable to cyberattacks. Initial research focused on maximising detection accuracy for known and unknown attacks, often using large, full-precision machine learning models. However, embedding IDSs into vehicular electronic systems also requires low detection latency, energy efficiency and minimal electronic control unit (ECU) resource overhead to process about 2,000 CAN frames/s. Lightweight models must balance accuracy with these deployment constraints. We propose a dual IDS framework comprising supervised and unsupervised learning-based solutions, each optimised for real-time, resource-constrained automotive platforms. A quantised LSTM-based IDS (QLSTM-IDS) achieves over 99.9% detection accuracy for DoS/Flooding, Fuzzing and Spoofing/Malfunction attacks using a single model architecture evaluated on two widely used datasets. The model is trained using the Brevitas quantisation-aware training library, transformed into a dataflow accelerator with custom blocks compatible with AMD's FINN toolchain, and synthesised using Vitis HLS. Complementing this, an 8-bit quantised convolutional autoencoder-based IDS (QCAE-IDS), quantised using AMD's Vitis-AI toolchain, detects previously unseen anomalies that alter CAN-ID sequence patterns with over 99% accuracy. An integration architecture enables both models to operate on a single FPGA, bridging the network interface IP and processing system to minimise software overhead. QLSTM-IDS achieves 0.25 ms inference latency and 0.8 mJ energy consumption per message, while QCAE-IDS achieves 0.42 ms and 1.1 mJ per block. Both solutions are deployed and evaluated on the ZCU104 SoC (XCZU7EV FPGA), demonstrating a flexible hardware/software co-design for real-time detection of known and unknown attacks on high-speed CAN buses.

AI.tldr: 提出双IDS框架：量化LSTM（QLSTM-IDS）检测已知攻击，8位量化卷积自编码器（QCAE-IDS）检测未知异常，均部署于FPGA实现实时低功耗车载CAN总线入侵检测。
AI.motivation: 车载CAN总线因外部连通性增加且缺乏内置安全机制而易受网络攻击。早期研究多追求高检测精度而使用大型全精度模型，但嵌入车载电子系统需满足低延迟、低能耗、低ECU资源开销（处理约2000帧/秒）等部署约束，因此需在精度与部署限制间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出由监督与非监督学习组成的双IDS框架，均针对实时资源受限车载平台优化。QLSTM-IDS用Brevitas量化感知训练库训练，转化为兼容AMD FINN工具链的数据流加速器，并用Vitis HLS综合；QCAE-IDS为8位量化卷积自编码器，使用AMD Vitis-AI量化。设计集成架构使两模型共用一个FPGA，桥接网络接口IP与处理系统以减少软件开销。
AI.result: QLSTM-IDS在DoS/Flooding、Fuzzing及Spoofing/Malfunction攻击上检测精度超99.9%，在ZCU104（XCZU7EV FPGA）上推理延迟0.25 ms、每条消息能耗0.8 mJ；QCAE-IDS检测改变CAN-ID序列模式的未知异常精度超99%，延迟0.42 ms、每块能耗1.1 mJ。
AI.conclusion: 两种方案均在ZCU104 SoC上部署评估，展示了面向高速CAN总线已知与未知攻击实时检测的灵活软硬件协同设计方案。

title: Newer and Bigger, but Safer? A Longitudinal Study of the Functionality-Security Gap in LLM-Generated Code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used to generate code. Although their functional plausibility keeps improving, the generated code often contains security vulnerabilities. The functionality-security gap captures code that passes functional tests but fails security tests. A recent longitudinal study of three model families concluded that LLMs become smarter but not safer, with the only considered open-weight family stagnating. Whether this holds for other (open-weight) families and particularly for compact models remains open. We present a longitudinal study of the gap across 32 LLMs from seven model families (five open-weight), covering three successive releases per family in flagship and compact variants. Using CWEval with 119 tasks in five programming languages and 31 CWEs, we compare trajectories across families, model sizes, and languages. Newer models do become safer in absolute terms, although no family closes the gap. Unlike prior work, we find that openness does not separate the families: every considered open-weight family narrows the gap significantly, while Gemini 3.1 Pro keeps a gap as wide as the one reported for Llama. Compact models usually produce less secure code than their flagship counterparts, with notable exceptions (e.g., Gemini 3.7 Flash). At the CWE level, we confirm persistent weaknesses such as log injection (CWE-117) and HTTP response splitting (CWE-113) and regressions in the newest proprietary models on memory and integer weaknesses, and show that the same CWE carries very different risk across languages. From these results, we derive implications for LLM vendors, researchers, and developers. In particular, developers should assume neither that upgrades improve security nor that proprietary models are more secure; they should rerun security checks after each model change and provide secure APIs in the model's context.

AI.tldr: 本文对7个模型家族（含5个开源）的32个LLM进行纵向研究，用CWEval在5种语言、31类CWE上评测其"功能-安全差距"，发现新模型绝对安全性提升、无人消除差距、开源模型同样显著缩小差距、紧凑模型通常更不安全但存在例外。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的代码功能可行但常含安全漏洞，"功能-安全差距"长期存在。此前一项针对三个模型家族的纵向研究认为LLM"变聪明但没变安全"，且唯一考察的开源家族停滞；这一结论是否适用于其他开源家族、尤其是紧凑模型，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对7个模型家族（5个开源）的32个LLM开展纵向研究，每个家族覆盖连续三个版本，并区分旗舰版与紧凑版。使用CWEval基准，包含5种编程语言、119个任务、31类CWE，跨家族、模型规模与语言比较差距变化轨迹。
AI.result: 新模型绝对安全性提升，但没有家族消除差距；与既有研究不同，开放性不构成分界——所有考察的开源家族均显著缩小差距，而某闭源模型家族的差距仍与此前报告的Llama一样宽。紧凑模型通常比旗舰版更不安全，但有明显例外。CWE层面存在持续弱点（如CWE-117日志注入、CWE-113 HTTP响应拆分），最新闭源模型在内存与整数类弱点上出现回退，且同一CWE在不同语言中风险差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 开发者不应假设升级会提升安全性，也不应假设闭源模型更安全；每次更换模型后都应重跑安全检查，并应在模型上下文中提供安全API。研究结果对LLM厂商、研究者与开发者均有启示。

title: Do I Need the Cloud? Uncertainty-Aware Step-Level Handoff for Small Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive as local agent controllers because they reduce remote inference, latency, and deployment footprint, yet structured tool errors can cause an agent step to fail. Existing routers typically select a model once per query. However, agents expose sequential decision points whose difficulty dynamically changes based on intermediate observations. We propose STEPGATE, an uncertainty-aware handoff framework that scores each local SLM action and selectively escalates challenging steps to a stronger model. On a 52-task held-out single-step BFCL-derived test split, the Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B pair attains 82.7% task success with 30.8% escalation, versus 67.3% local-only and 75.4% random escalation (which uses 33.8% escalation).
