In a separate multi-turn evaluation, STEPGATE achieves 69.0% trajectory success and 84.0% action success using only 30.0% cloud actions, compared with 48.0%/70.5% local-only, 60.0%/78.2% random escalation, and 57.0%/77.1% query-level routing (strong-only achieves 82.0% trajectory success at 100% cloud actions). These results suggest that step-level escalation recovers a large share of the performance gap to the stronger Qwen2.5-7B backend at a matched cloud-action rate while transmitting fewer tokens remotely. However, our evaluation is limited to one model family, a single stronger backend, and scripted tasks. Furthermore, the test sets are small, multi-turn comparisons rely on paired intervals and statistical tests, and our risk tiers serve as research annotations rather than formal safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出 STEPGATE：一种不确定性感知的分步交接框架，对本地 SLM 的每一步动作打分，仅把困难步骤升级到更强模型，从而在较低云端调用率下大幅缩小与强模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型适合作为本地智能体控制器，可降低远程推理、延迟与部署开销，但结构化工具调用错误会导致单步失败。现有路由方法通常只在每个查询上选择一次模型，而智能体的顺序决策点难度会随中间观测动态变化，因此需要按步骤进行动态交接。
AI.method: STEPGATE 对本地 SLM 的每个动作进行不确定性感知评分，并选择性地将高难度步骤升级到更强的后端模型。评估采用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 组合，在 52 个任务的 BFCL 派生单步测试集上测试，并与本地-only、随机升级、查询级路由及强模型-only 进行对比；另做多轮轨迹评估。
AI.result: 单步测试：STEPGATE 达 82.7% 任务成功率、升级率 30.8%，优于本地-only 67.3% 与随机升级 75.4%（升级率 33.8%）。多轮评估：轨迹成功率 69.0%、动作成功率 84.0%，仅用 30.0% 云端动作，优于本地-only 48.0%/70.5%、随机升级 60.0%/78.2%、查询级路由 57.0%/77.1%（强模型-only 需 100% 云端动作才达 82.0% 轨迹成功率）。
AI.conclusion: 分步升级能在匹配的云端动作率下恢复大部分与更强 Qwen2.5-7B 后端的性能差距，且远程传输的 token 更少。但评估仅限单一模型家族、单一强后端和脚本化任务，测试集较小，多轮对比依赖配对区间与统计检验，风险分层仅为研究性标注而非正式安全保证。

title: Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents
summary: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: TopoPlanner提出拓扑一致规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形，作为拓扑感知上下文用于LLM工具规划，在四类工具规划基准上优于提示型和图增强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体规划器擅长顺序或DAG结构，但在验证-纠正循环、分支汇聚合并、可复用中间状态等真实工具编排场景中表现不佳，需要一种能处理复杂子任务依赖的规划方法。
AI.method: 将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形；通过余层一致（cosheaf-consistent）的细胞检索获取请求相关的闭子复形；在检索到的拓扑上进行多维结构推理；将细胞表示接口到规划LLM以生成工具序列。
AI.result: 在四个工具规划基准上、针对拓扑引导的循环、合并及循环-合并工作流，相比基于提示和图增强的基线，在不同本地LLM骨干上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 引入细胞复形与余层检索的拓扑感知上下文，能有效增强LLM智能体对循环、合并等复杂工作流模式的规划能力，且对多种骨干模型具有普适性。

title: JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: When an LLM judge scores an output, its score distribution retains uncertainty and disagreement information that is lost after scalar compression. We introduce JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that assigns example-specific weights to cached judge score distributions and fuses them before computing a final score. A protocol study shows that score-range choice is unstable across judge--dataset settings and that soft scoring usually outperforms hard decoding. On the original 10-cell benchmark, JudgeMoE improves mean Spearman over uniform log pooling by $+0.079$. Applying the same configuration to six additional cells yields a $+0.0393$ mean gain over the strongest local single judge across 16 cells, with positive differences in 12/16 cells and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.0091$. Validation-based analyses further show that the preferred aggregation method depends on the task and judge pool.

AI.tldr: JudgeMoE是一种轻量级聚合器，为每个样本分配特定权重以融合缓存的评委分数分布，在多个基准测试中提升了评分与排序性能。
AI.motivation: LLM评委打分后，标量压缩会丢失分数分布中的不确定性和分歧信息，需要一种能保留并利用这些信息的聚合方法。
AI.method: 提出JudgeMoE轻量级聚合器，对缓存的评委分数分布进行示例特定加权并在计算最终分数前融合；同时开展协议研究，考察分数范围选择与软/硬评分解码。
AI.result: 在原始10单元基准上，JudgeMoE相比均匀对数池化提升平均Spearman +0.079；在16个单元上相比最强本地单评委平均提升+0.0393，12/16单元为正，单侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=0.0091。
AI.conclusion: 分数范围选择在不同评委-数据集设置下不稳定，软评分通常优于硬解码；优选聚合方法依赖任务与评委池，JudgeMoE在总体表现上更优。

title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
comment: This is submitted to IEEE Journal
summary: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: DTFormer 提出三模态（RGB-D-文本）语义分割框架，通过文本引导语义对齐模块注入语言先验，提升 RGB-D 分割的语义判别力。
AI.motivation: 主流 RGB-D 语义分割模型主要依赖像素级监督学习特征，缺乏直接的高层语义约束，语义判别能力受限。作者希望探究外部知识（如语言先验）能否为主流模型注入更强的语义判别力。
AI.method: 提出 DTFormer 三模态（RGB-D-文本）分割框架，核心是文本引导语义对齐模块（TSAM）：先将文本线索编码为一组语义原型，再在编码器和解码器的多个层级显式对齐多模态 RGB-D 特征与这些原型。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DTFormer 在保持简单高效的同时取得一致性的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义对齐是提升 RGB-D 语义分割的有效且实用的途径。代码将在录用后发布。

title: Understanding and Enhancing Backdoor Persistency in LLM Agent Post-Training
summary: Developers can build LLM agents by adapting third-party models through benign post-training. We study a supply-chain threat in which an attacker supplies a model with a backdoor: hidden behavior that produces malicious outputs when a particular input pattern appears. Focusing on software-engineering agents, we ask whether such backdoors survive the developer's supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and subsequent task-level reinforcement learning (RL). We observe that benign SFT substantially reduces attack success, but subsequent RL often preserves the residual behavior and sometimes even increases attack success. Our analysis of backdoor erosion during SFT identifies two factors that may favor survival: initial backdoor strength and gradient compatibility with benign training. These factors motivate PersistBD, which refines an already-backdoored model before release to improve its persistency through the benign post-training process. On Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, PersistBD raises attack success from 20% to 74% after SFT and from 20% to 76% after SFT-RL, while maintaining comparable benign task performance. Together, our results show that backdoors can remain active through benign post-training and that adversaries can deliberately increase their persistence. This highlights a supply-chain risk for AI developers and motivates stronger techniques for detecting and mitigating inherited backdoors when adapting third-party models into agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/uiuc-kang-lab/PersistBD.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了软件工程LLM智能体供应链中的后门威胁，发现良性SFT会削弱后门但后续RL常保留残余行为。作者提出PersistBD，通过优化已植入后门的模型提升其持久性，在Qwen2.5-Coder-7B上将攻击成功率从20%提升至74%（SFT后）和76%（SFT-RL后）。
AI.motivation: 开发者常通过良性后训练适配第三方模型来构建LLM智能体，这引入供应链风险：攻击者可能提供带后门的模型。论文关注此类后门能否在开发者的监督微调（SFT）及后续任务级强化学习（RL）中存活。
AI.method: 通过分析SFT过程中后门侵蚀，识别出两个有利于存活的因素：初始后门强度和与良性训练的梯度兼容性。基于此提出PersistBD，在模型发布前对已植入后门的模型进行精炼，增强其通过良性后训练流程的持久性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Coder-7B上，PersistBD使攻击成功率在SFT后从20%提升至74%，在SFT-RL后从20%提升至76%，同时保持可比的良性任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 后门可以在良性后训练中保持活跃，且对手能有意识地提高其持久性。这揭示了AI开发者面临的供应链风险，呼吁更强的检测与缓解技术来应对继承自第三方模型的后门。

title: Learning from Failures: A Failure-Driven Prompt Refinement for LLM-Based Vulnerability Analysis
comment: Accepted at CSoNet 2026. 15 pages, 6 figures/tables combined
summary: Large Language Models have emerged as promising tools for software vulnerability analysis, but their effectiveness depends heavily on prompt design. Existing research primarily compares prompting strategies using aggregate performance metrics, providing limited insight into why models fail or how prompts can be improved systematically. We propose Failure-Driven Prompt Refinement (FDPR), a methodology that analyzes recurring model failures to guide evidence-based prompt refinement. Using the Damn Vulnerable Java Application (DVJA), we identify recurring failure modes, including false positives, false negatives, unsupported reasoning, and CWE misclassification, and translate them into targeted prompt refinements. We then evaluate the resulting prompt on the Juliet Test Suite and perform cross-model validation to assess generalizability. The results show that failure-driven refinement improves the reliability of LLM-based vulnerability analysis while yielding reusable prompt design principles. More broadly, this work demonstrates that recurring model failures provide a principled foundation for prompt engineering, enabling the systematic development of more reliable LLM-based vulnerability analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 提出失败驱动提示精炼（FDPR）方法，通过分析LLM在漏洞分析中的重复性失败来系统性改进提示设计，从而提升漏洞分析可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在软件漏洞分析中很有前景，但其效果高度依赖提示设计。现有研究多以聚合性能指标比较提示策略，难以揭示模型为何失败，也难以为提示的系统性改进提供依据。因此需要一个基于失败分析、可证据化指导提示精炼的方法。
AI.method: 提出失败驱动提示精炼（FDPR）方法：以DVJA（Damn Vulnerable Java Application）为对象，识别重复性失败模式，包括假阳性、假阴性、无依据推理和CWE错误分类，并将这些失败模式转化为有针对性的提示精炼。随后在Juliet测试套件上评估精炼后的提示，并进行跨模型验证以检验泛化性。
AI.result: 失败驱动的精炼提升了基于LLM的漏洞分析的可靠性，并产出了可复用的提示设计原则；跨模型验证表明结果具有一定泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 重复出现的模型失败为提示工程提供了有原则的基础，可支撑LLM漏洞分析系统的系统性开发，使其更可靠、更可解释。

title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

AI.tldr: 提出MOTIVE多视角自验证框架，通过可靠性分数指导接受或重思决策，提升多模态推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型易生成看似合理但错误的答案，现有自验证方法依赖单一验证标准或固定提示，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。作者先系统分析验证器能力与提示设计对验证性能的影响：更强的验证器提供更可靠判断，但验证性能对提示选择高度敏感，没有单一提示在所有任务中占优。
AI.method: MOTIVE（Multi-View Self-Verification with Reliability-Guided Selective Rethinking）从互补的验证视角评估每个候选答案，并通过基于正确性的多视角验证学习获得与正确性对齐的可靠性分数。推理时该分数控制"接受或重思"决策：可靠答案直接返回，不确定答案触发历史引导的重思。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准和VLM骨干上，MOTIVE持续优于强自验证与自纠正基线。可靠验证改善了接受或重思决策，减少了不必要的推理轮次。
AI.conclusion: MOTIVE实现了更可靠、更高效的自验证，无需外部评判器。

title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Website: https://berkearda.github.io/croissantminer/
summary: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向Croissant社区标准元数据端到端抽取的基准，含602篇论文，发现单次完整上下文抽取优于四种智能体架构，长文本RAI字段表现最差。
AI.motivation: Croissant已成为机器可读数据集元数据标准，但填充其字段仍高度依赖人工且需仔细阅读数据集文档，缺乏系统性的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建包含602篇论文的基准（102篇人工校验金标准+500篇LLM生成银标准），覆盖Croissant完整模式的核心与RAI字段；在双层评估框架（规则打分+经人工审计选出的LLM评判）下评测前沿模型、开放权重模型及智能体架构等抽取系统。
AI.result: 单次抽取持续优于所评测的四种智能体架构，各骨干模型下分解式变体准确率均低于单次全上下文抽取；最大差距出现在长文本RAI字段上，因这些字段需综合解读分散于全文的信息而非从单一位置复制，现有系统远未可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究公开了基准、评估代码、评判审计、在线演示及面向新系统的排行榜，为该方向的标准化评测与后续研究提供基础。

title: Anchor and Adapt: Asymmetric Prompt Adaptation for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: In few-shot industrial anomaly detection, the few normal target images provide no direct defect supervision, making anomaly prompts difficult to learn from these samples alone. Some vision-language methods therefore use manually specified descriptions to supply explicit anomaly semantics. However, constructing these descriptions requires product-specific effort, and their effectiveness depends on prompt selection. We propose Anchor and Adapt, a two-stage prompt learning framework that separates the acquisition of anomaly semantics from adaptation to target normal appearance. Stage I learns transferable normal and abnormal anchors from annotated auxiliary data. Stage II keeps these anchors fixed and adapts an additional normal branch using the few target normal samples. The inherited and adapted normal branches jointly characterize target normality, with text-anchor regularization encouraging consistency with the generic normal prior and separation from the abnormal anchors. This design retains learned anomaly knowledge while reducing dependence on category-specific anomaly templates, without requiring synthetic anomaly generation. Cross-dataset experiments between MVTec-AD and VisA under 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings demonstrate competitive detection and localization performance. Controlled ablations assess the roles of transferred anchors, asymmetric adaptation, dual-normal representations, and anchor regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Anchor and Adapt"两阶段提示学习框架，将异常语义获取与目标正常外观适应解耦，在少样本工业异常检测中取得有竞争力的检测与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中，少量正常目标图像缺乏直接缺陷监督，难以单独学习异常提示。部分视觉-语言方法依赖人工指定描述来提供显式异常语义，但描述构建需针对具体产品，且效果依赖提示选择。
AI.method: 两阶段提示学习框架。Stage I 从带标注的辅助数据中学习可迁移的正常与异常锚点；Stage II 固定这些锚点，利用少量目标正常样本适应额外的正常分支。继承与适应的正常分支共同刻画目标正常性，并通过文本锚点正则鼓励与通用正常先验一致、与异常锚点分离。该方法无需合成异常生成。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD与VisA之间的跨数据集实验，1/2/4-shot设置下检测与定位性能具竞争力。消融实验评估了迁移锚点、非对称适应、双正常表示和锚点正则的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留已学异常知识的同时，减少了对手工类别特定异常模板的依赖，无需合成异常生成，为少样本工业异常检测提供有效方案。

title: BVI: Lightweight, Data-Centric Blockchain-Based Verification of Identity Claims
summary: A person who answers an unexpected call claiming to come from a bank has no way to check the claim. Australian text messaging has labelled a message as unverified when the sender identifier is not registered since 1 July 2026, but a voice call still arrives with nothing behind it, and voice cloning has removed the last cue recipients relied on. We present BVI, which answers one question for the recipient: did the calling party prove it holds a credential a registered organisation issued for this call? BVI keeps the organisational record, its authorised channels and its revocation state on a public ledger in a directly queryable form, and puts all decision logic in the handset, which performs eleven checks, pays no transaction fee and holds no full-chain state. We define ten attack classes plus the case in which revocation cannot be resolved, compare them in a 10-by-4 coverage matrix spanning BBCA, the content digest, the detector and composed BVI, and run 27 automated scenario tests against isolated Hardhat fixture states of the BVI contract; all 27 pass. For media substitution and synthetic speech, the contract tests validate commitment and gating properties rather than claiming detector accuracy. The mandatory per-session anchor costs about 91.5k gas and is invariant in call duration and hop count; each participating intermediary additionally contributes one optional attestation write. In a 20,000-session-per-cell path simulation, at one quarter carrier participation BVI detects 20.6 per cent of randomly located in-path rewrites versus 0.1 per cent for the every-hop comparison, while identity and content evidence remain available even when path evidence is indeterminate. We also quantify the throughput ceiling of the anchoring design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 BVI（Banked Voice Identity）系统，用于让接听者验证来电方是否持有注册机构为该通话签发的凭证，以应对澳大利亚自2026年7月1日起对未注册发送者标记"未验证"后仍存在的语音来电不可验证问题，以及语音克隆消除最后线索的挑战。
AI.motivation: 接听意外来电的人无法核实其声称来自银行的身份。自2026年7月1日起澳大利亚短信已对未注册发送者标记"未验证"，但语音来电仍无任何背景信息，且语音克隆消除了接收者原本依赖的最后线索，因此需要一种可验证的语音通话身份机制。
AI.method: BVI 将组织记录、其授权渠道与撤销状态以可直接查询的形式保存在公共账本上，所有决策逻辑放在手机端执行十一项检查，无需支付交易费也不持有全链状态。作者定义了十类攻击外加撤销无法解决的情形，构建覆盖 BBCA、内容摘要、检测器和组合 BVI 的 10×4 覆盖矩阵，并针对 BVI 合约的隔离 Hardhat 夹具状态运行 27 项自动化场景测试。
AI.result: 27 项测试全部通过。对于媒体替换和合成语音，合约测试验证的是承诺与门控属性而非检测器准确率。每会话强制锚定成本约 91.5k gas，且不随通话时长与跳数变化；每个参与中间节点额外贡献一次可选证明写入。在每小区 20,000 会话的路径模拟中，当四分之一运营商参与时，BVI 对随机定位的路径内重写检测率为 20.6%，而逐跳比较仅为 0.1%；即使路径证据不确定，身份与内容证据仍可用。论文还量化了锚定设计的吞吐量上限。
AI.conclusion: BVI 通过链上可查询的组织凭证与撤销状态结合手机端决策，为语音来电接收者提供"呼叫方是否持有为该通话签发的凭证"的验证答案，在攻击覆盖、Gas 成本恒定性和路径重写检测上表现优于逐跳比较方案，并明确了检测能力的边界与吞吐量上限。

title: RAPO-Sol: Retrieval-Augmented Preference Optimization for Repository-Level Solidity Code Generation
summary: Smart contracts written in Solidity manage assets, permissions, and irreversible state changes, making code generation both useful and security-critical. Repository-level Solidity generation is challenging because models must synthesize complete contracts or libraries while preserving consistency across state variables, modifiers, events, inheritance, external calls, and access-control logic. We present RAPO-Sol, a two-stage training framework for repository-level Solidity code generation. First, Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (RAFT) augments each training input with similar Solidity examples, helping the model learn recurring contract-level patterns while remaining retrieval-free at inference time. Second, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) trains the model to prefer reference contracts over close but semantically flawed alternatives. We construct rejected samples using Solidity Semantic-Anchor Perturbation (SAP), which perturbs validation statements, visibility modifiers, data-location keywords, context variables, payment operations, and low-level calls. Experiments on SolidityBench with CodeLlama-7B-Instruct, DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct show that RAFT consistently improves over supervised fine-tuning, while SAP-based DPO provides further gains in BLEU and SolidityScore. The full RAFT+DPO pipeline achieves the best performance across all three models, demonstrating complementary benefits from retrieval during training and Solidity-aware preference optimization without adding retrieval cost at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAPO-Sol 两阶段训练框架，用于仓库级 Solidity 代码生成：先通过 RAFT 引入检索增强微调，再用基于 SAP 扰动的 DPO 优化偏好，在不增加推理检索成本的情况下提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: Solidity 智能合约管理资产、权限与不可逆状态变更，代码生成既实用又对安全至关重要。仓库级生成要求模型在状态变量、修饰符、事件、继承、外部调用和访问控制逻辑上保持一致，难度较大。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架 RAPO-Sol：（1）RAFT 为每个训练输入附加相似 Solidity 示例，帮助学习合约级模式，推理时无需检索；（2）DPO 让模型偏好参考合约而非语义有缺陷的近似样本，拒绝样本由 Solidarity Semantic-Anchor Perturbation（SAP）构造，扰动验证语句、可见性修饰符、数据位置关键字、上下文变量、支付操作和低级调用。
AI.result: 在 SolidityBench 上，使用 CodeLlama-7B-Instruct、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 三个模型，RAFT 稳定优于监督微调，SAP-based DPO 进一步提升 BLEU 和 SolidityScore，完整 RAFT+DPO 流程在三模型上均取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 训练阶段的检索增强与 Solidity 感知的偏好优化具有互补作用，可在不增加推理检索成本的前提下显著提升仓库级 Solidity 代码生成效果。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自参照社会偏好"方法,使智能体无需观察同伴的奖励信号即可学习合作行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习中的社会偏好方法通常要求智能体观察同伴的奖励,但现实交互中智能体往往只能观察他人的行为与结果,无法获取其私有奖励信号,这一差距限制了方法的适用性。
AI.method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励的模型,并将其应用于其他智能体观察到的状态转移,以自身视角评估他人结果,将这些"自参照评估"注入标准社会偏好中。研究两种整合方式:(1)修改学习奖励;(2)用于加权策略更新。
AI.result: 在Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境环境(分别需要自愿参与、公共物品贡献与资源节制)中,智能体在未观察他人奖励的情况下均学到合作行为,包括独立学习失败的情形,且常比可获得真实奖励的智能体实现更公平的联合收益分配。有效整合点取决于社会偏好类型:不公平厌恶在"奖励+价值前瞻"下效果最佳,而纯粹利他偏好更适合策略更新加权。在部分可观测条件下,策略更新方法仍能维持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取其他智能体的奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件;社会偏好可以建立在基于观察行为的、自参照的他人结果评估之上。

title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSRFT（监督式安全角色微调）框架，将安全对齐重新表述为对预定义"安全角色"的内化，在多个Base与Instruct模型上比标准SFT获得更稳健、更可泛化的安全对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）存在三方面局限：需要大量针对特定攻击的监督数据与算力；易形成"浅层安全对齐"；以及对良性问题过度拒答。作者希望找到一种不依赖显式拒答模式、成本更低且更鲁棒的对齐范式。
AI.method: 提出SSRFT框架，把安全对齐转化为对预定义安全角色的内化。具体做法是构建SRQA（安全角色问答）数据集，数据来源包括心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示词以及一段安全角色描述；随后合成角色一致的回复，对其加以验证，并扩展到多样化场景，使模型习得安全导向的价值观与原则，而非死记硬背式的拒绝模板。
AI.result: 在多种Base和Instruct模型上的实验表明：SSRFT的安全对齐比标准SFT更稳健、泛化性更强；对预填充（prefilling）攻击的鲁棒性显著提升；对未见越狱领域的泛化更好；同时在良性查询上减少了过度拒答，并保持了模型的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明"安全角色内化"是一种可替代以拒答为中心的安全对齐方案的有效路径。

title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
comment: Published at COLM 2026. Project page: https://iii.baulab.info
summary: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

AI.tldr: 该研究在受控设定下识别出忠实自我报告的机制特征：持续微调隐含决策任务可使模型自发涌现准确的自我报告，且忠实自我报告伴随偏好表征前移，可通过归因相似度与不忠实模型区分。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型关于自身的陈述既具重要性，又越来越难以仅凭行为验证；如何区分似真的虚构性报告与真正的内省，是核心问题。
AI.method: 使用低秩适配器训练模型按潜在线性偏好函数为虚构角色做决策；通过权重消融与冻结层实验考察表征层次变化，并用归因补丁分析决策任务与自我报告任务间的归因相似度。
AI.result: 持续微调隐含决策任务可在无显式自我报告监督下涌现准确自我报告；忠实自我报告伴随偏好表征向更早层迁移；忠实模型在决策与自我报告任务间表现出显著更高的归因相似度，可作为机制特征。
AI.conclusion: 至少在受限设定下，可通过考察网络结构本身而非报告内容，区分忠实与不忠实的自我报告计算模式。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
summary: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: WiSPER是一个两阶段框架，通过姿态感知预测预训练与条件残差流细化，实现基于WiFi CSI的多人物3D姿态估计，整体MPJPE降至63.72 mm。
AI.motivation: 基于WiFi CSI的多人物3D姿态估计存在难点：不同人的反射信号相互重叠，难以直接识别个体关节；现有掩码嵌入目标虽能捕捉无线关系但缺乏显式姿态监督，而结构化解码器又容易保留坐标误差。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架WiSPER：第一阶段为姿态感知掩码嵌入学习（PAMEL），在同一CSI上下文上耦合掩码隐变量预测与辅助姿态集监督，引导编码器从部分观测中定位关节；第二阶段为Transformer残差流细化（ReFT），生成一组姿态候选以适配可变人数，并基于粗坐标与逐关节解码器特征通过条件流对每个候选进行细化。训练使用成对CSI与姿态标注，推理仅需CSI。
AI.result: 在PiW3D数据集上，WiSPER整体平均逐关节位置误差为63.72 mm，相较WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%；两人和三人实验分别降低MPJPE 42.1%和38.1%；姿态监督预训练配置误差低于仅用CSI的JEPA；启用训练后的残差细化器在各配置下进一步降低整体MPJPE 13.8%–15.6%。
AI.conclusion: 姿态监督预训练与条件残差流细化的结合能有效提升WiFi CSI多人物3D姿态估计精度，且推理阶段无需姿态标注。

title: Safeguarding LLMs via Model-Agnostic Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge
summary: LLMs have advanced rapidly, raising growing concerns about their safety. Recent work has proposed approaches to detect and defend against attacks including defenses at decoding stage that leverage models' hidden states. However, existing decoding-stage defenses suffer from two limitations. First, they introduce a trade-off between safety and over-refusal, where strengthening safety degrades the model's helpfulness on benign queries. Second, many of these methods rely on internal hidden states and are thus restricted to specific architectures, incurring substantial overhead and limited generalization across models. To address these limitations, we introduce LADE (Latent Safety Signals for Defense), which leverages latent safety signals extracted by contrasting harmful and benign queries from dark knowledge (i.e., information carried by the output probability distribution beyond its argmax) in the first-token output probability distribution. Our key insight is that, beyond surface-level refusal tokens, the dark knowledge in the first-token distribution contains latent safety signals, defined as tokens whose probabilities differ sharply between harmful and benign queries. We show that these signals consistently align across LLMs, forming a model-agnostic direction that emerges from safety alignment. LADE consists of three components: (1) Extracting Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge, which selects top-k safety-discriminative tokens from the first-token probability distribution; (2) Tokenizer Mapping, which maps these tokens across different tokenizers to enable model-agnostic application; and (3) kNN-based Discrimination, which classifies queries via a k-Nearest Neighbors search over the mapped tokens. Across diverse LLMs and benchmarks, LADE is robust against a wide range of jailbreak attacks and lowers attack success rates while maintaining a competitive safety-utility trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出LADE方法，利用首token输出概率分布中的"暗知识"提取潜在安全信号，构建模型无关的防御方向，在保持安全-效用平衡的同时抵御多种越狱攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有解码阶段的LLM防御存在两大局限：1）安全性与过度拒答之间存在权衡，强化安全会损害对良性查询的有用性；2）许多方法依赖内部隐藏状态，仅适用于特定架构，开销大且跨模型泛化能力差。
AI.method: LADE从首token输出概率分布的"暗知识"（超出argmax的信息）中，通过对比有害与良性查询提取潜在安全信号（概率差异大的token）。包含三部分：1）从暗知识中提取潜在安全信号，选出top-k安全判别token；2）Tokenizer Mapping，跨分词器映射token实现模型无关；3）基于kNN的判别，通过k近邻搜索对查询分类。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和基准测试中，LADE对广泛的越狱攻击具有鲁棒性，降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了有竞争力的安全-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: LADE证明了暗知识中的潜在安全信号在不同LLM间一致对齐，形成源自安全对齐的模型无关方向，为解码阶段防御提供了兼顾安全性与有用性的新思路。

title: A Case Study in Assuring AI-Written Software
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Meta-Agents Workshop
summary: Software-engineering agents can enable people without formal software training to build systems they could not otherwise implement and simultaneously can produce more code than even experts can meaningfully inspect. In both cases, exhaustive code review is not reliable as the sole basis for human control. We report a case study of a production healthcare platform built through coding agents and governed by an operator without formal software-engineering training. Over time, its workflow grew into a human-led meta-agent system where one agent wrote code, other agents supervised and reviewed it, and project rules carried lessons forward. The operator found that tests, monitors and reviewing agents used to supervise the system were fallible. Some monitors measured proxies rather than outcomes, some audits failed silently, missing checks disappeared from reported results and one automated repair caused operational disruption. In this case, human control depended on keeping the intended outcome, the evidence used to judge it, the agents' permissions and the final human decision were all tied to the same underlying objective.

AI.tldr: 本案例研究记录了一个由无正式软件工程训练的操作者借助编码智能体构建并治理的生产级医疗平台。随着时间推移，其工作流演变为由人类主导的元智能体系统：一个智能体写代码，其他智能体监督与审查，项目规则承载经验教训。操作者发现测试、监控与审查智能体均可能失效，因此人类控制的关键在于把预期结果、判断证据、智能体权限与最终人类决策统一到同一底层目标上。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体既让无正规软件训练的人能够构建原本无法实现的系统，也会产生超出专家可有效审查量的代码。在这两种情况下，详尽的代码审查都不足以作为人类控制的唯一基础。因此作者希望探究：当智能体生成与监督成为常态时，人类如何保持对系统的有效控制。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，考察一个由编码智能体构建、由无正式软件工程训练的操作者治理的生产级医疗平台。该平台逐步发展为由人类主导的元智能体系统：一个智能体负责编写代码，其他智能体负责监督与审查，项目规则用于传递经验教训。研究通过观察该系统中测试、监控与审查智能体的实际表现及其失效模式来分析人类控制机制。
AI.result: 操作者发现用于监督系统的测试、监控与审查智能体均存在可错性：部分监控测量的是代理指标而非实际结果；部分审计静默失败；缺失的检查从报告结果中消失；一次自动修复还导致了运营中断。这些失效表明智能体监督本身并不能可靠地保证控制。
AI.conclusion: 在智能体主导的软件开发与监督场景中，人类控制不能依赖详尽代码审查或智能体自监督。有效控制取决于将预期结果、判断结果所用的证据、智能体的权限以及最终人类决策全部绑定到同一底层目标上，形成一致的控制闭环。

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出PIP方法，通过联合视角VAE与伙伴状态信念网络解决具身零样本协作中伙伴间歇性不可见导致的表征模糊和隐藏状态不确定问题，在多个基准与人类评估中取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 具身场景下的零样本协作要求智能体在伙伴间歇性离开视野时仍能行动。现有方法面临两大挑战：伙伴表征模糊，以及对伙伴隐藏状态的不确定性。
AI.method: PIP包含两个组件：1）Joint-view VAE，将训练时两个智能体局部观测的并集蒸馏为更丰富的证据，形成仅凭本地观测即可获得的伙伴表征；2）Partner-state Belief网络，从自我智能体的交互历史中推断伙伴的隐藏位置与行为倾向。
AI.result: 在Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO及Melting Pot环境中评估，并在Burrito-PO中进行人类评估。PIP在三个基准中均取得最高的平均性能；人类评估与诊断分析支持其与未见伙伴的协作能力，以及在伙伴遮挡条件下两个组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PIP能有效应对伙伴遮挡下的零样本协作，兼顾伙伴表征学习与隐藏状态推断，性能优于对比方法，且组件贡献得到验证。

title: Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking
summary: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

AI.tldr: 该论文对离线AI语音优先系统进行了端到端基准评测，覆盖Jetson Orin NX与Raspberry Pi 5两种硬件层级、三种2-5B指令微调模型和四种量化格式，结论是Q4_K_M量化在体积与质量间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 面向非洲语言社区，语音是主要交互方式且网络连接不可靠或缺失，因此需要完全离线、低功耗、低成本且可社区获取的语音优先AI系统。论文旨在为这一技术栈提供首次端到端基准评测，验证其在实际硬件上的部署可行性。
AI.method: 工作流交付三个部分：模块化语音优先离线架构、低成本硬件参考物料清单、以及针对2-5B参数指令微调语言模型的可复现量化与基准测试流程。评测在两种硬件层级上进行：NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX（TierB）与Raspberry Pi 5（TierA）。对三种指令微调模型在四种量化格式下评估部署指标（解码吞吐、对话延迟、内存、功耗）与多语言质量（MasakhaNEWS主题分类准确率，覆盖英语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语和约鲁巴语；以及各语言困惑度漂移）。语音识别则在两种硬件层级上使用Ethio-ASR对阿姆哈拉语和奥罗莫语进行评估。
AI.result: Q4_K_M量化在两种硬件层级上均代表最佳体积-质量权衡。在TierB上，gemma-4-E2B-it在Q4_K_M下达到28.8 tokens/s解码吞吐与89.2%主题分类准确率；在TierA上，三种模型均可在16GB内存预算内运行。
AI.conclusion: 该离线AI模块技术栈可在低成本硬件上支持多语言语音优先AI的实际部署，Q4_K_M是推荐的量化选择，兼顾性能与资源约束。

title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
summary: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

AI.tldr: TIDE 2.0 是一个开源（MIT 许可）的临床文本去标识化引擎，将识别与匿名化分为两个可分离阶段，支持本地部署、加密式替身生成、保间隔的日期偏移与密钥隔离，并配套发布由大语言模型蒸馏的识别器 TIDE2-Sentry。
AI.motivation: 临床记录是患者诊疗信息的主要载体，但含受保护健康信息（PHI），未去标识化则无法用于研究。作者指出将去标识化仅视为"检测问题"并不充分：单纯删除会连同临床内容一起剥离，日期置空会破坏纵向分析所需的时间间隔，而每次出现都分配新的随机替身则会切断同一患者不同记录间的关联。因此需要一种兼顾隐私保护与数据可用性的去标识化方案。
AI.method: 提出 TIDE 2.0，包含两个可分离阶段：可替换的识别器（recognizer）与带密钥的匿名化器（keyed anonymizer），二者均可在机构自有硬件上运行。替身通过密码学方式生成，不保留链接表；日期按每位患者进行保间隔的偏移；在给定密钥下同一取值在所有出现位置获得相同替身；在新密钥下生成的发布数据无法与既往发布数据关联。同时发布 TIDE2-Sentry——一个从大语言模型蒸馏得到的识别器。
AI.result: 在两个来自不同机构的金标准标注语料上，默认配置在域内达到 span 级召回率 0.88，在第二家机构语料上召回率为 0.77；对应精确率分别为 0.88 和 0.87。除总体指标外，还报告了各细分类别的召回率与精确率。
AI.conclusion: 该引擎开源，识别器以受限的研究用途协议提供，使机构能够在自身环境中运行、审查并扩展这两部分。

title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
comment: The first three authors contributed equally, and their order was determined by drawing lots. Project Lead: Jiuming Liu. Corresponding Author: Ayush Tewari. Project page: https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/
summary: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 Artemis：一种基于几何、具有显式记忆共享的多智能体世界模型，通过重建显式3D世界地图实现跨智能体统一3D状态，提升多视角一致性与生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型从单智能体转向多智能体，但多采用跨注意力的隐式智能体通信，缺乏显式几何约束与统一3D状态，导致多视角一致性差且难以恢复视线外的智能体；同时多数方法假设背景静态，无法表示不受控的背景动态。
AI.method: 从多智能体观测重建显式3D世界地图以强制统一3D状态；设计动作引导的几何注入模块，同时渲染解耦的前景-背景控制图，并通过 GeoAdapter 块注入扩散Transformer；GeoAdapter 还能区分不受控的非智能体动态，依据其多帧历史位置提供一致运动线索；采用渐进式视频 rollout 中选取的关键帧逐步更新重建的3D世界地图；并构建基于CARLA模拟器的新数据集 MA-CARLA。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在生成视频的视觉保真度与跨视角一致性上优于现有方法；Artemis 支持2D视频与3D点图同时维护的多模态 rollout，可扩展至两智能体以上及多相机场景。
AI.conclusion: Artemis 通过显式3D世界地图记忆共享与几何注入，解决了多智能体世界模型中的一致性与背景动态建模问题，具备良好的可扩展性与多模态能力。

title: CISB-Bench: An Auditable Source--IR Dataset of Compiler-Introduced Security Bugs
summary: Compiler-introduced security bugs (CISBs) arise when an optimization, lowering, or instrumentation decision changes a security-relevant property of the generated program. They are difficult to study because their evidence is distributed across issue reports, reduced tests, historical configurations, and compiler artifacts; a security-related report also does not imply that every associated reduction establishes a security-bearing compiler failure. We present CISB-Bench, an auditable dataset of 429 exact C-program rows mined from GCC and LLVM. Each row contains its C reduction, a standardized LLVM IR analysis bundle at -O0 through -O3, public provenance, a final binary label, and a primary mechanism or boundary annotation. Two reviewers independently labeled the fixed corpus, agreeing on 369 rows (86.0%, Cohen's kappa=0.662); the 60 disagreements were adjudicated. The final dataset comprises 280 CISBs and 149 hard non-CISB cases. The prediction task is to recover this reviewed exact-row label from the supplied artifacts; it is not a claim that standardized IR alone reproduces every historical compiler failure. We characterize the security mechanisms and evidence boundaries represented by the corpus, and demonstrate how its paired artifacts support source-only, IR-aware, and joint analyses. CISB-Bench provides a reusable, inspectable target for compiler-security mining and detection research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CISB-Bench，一个从GCC和LLVM中挖掘的429行C程序可审计数据集，用于编译器引入的安全漏洞（CISB）检测研究，包含280个CISB和149个困难非CISB案例。
AI.motivation: 编译器引入的安全漏洞（CISB）因证据分散在问题报告、简化测试、历史配置和编译器产物中而难以研究；且安全相关报告并不意味着每个简化结果都构成安全性的编译器失败，因此缺乏一个可复用、可检验的标注数据集。
AI.method: 构建CISB-Bench数据集：从GCC和LLVM挖掘429个精确C程序行，每行包含C简化代码、-O0至-O3的标准化LLVM IR分析包、公开溯源信息、最终二进制标签及主要机制/边界标注；由两名评审独立标注，对369行达成一致（86.0%，Cohen's kappa=0.662），对60处分歧进行仲裁；预测任务为从提供的产物中恢复经过审查的精确行标签。
AI.result: 最终数据集包含280个CISB和149个困难非CISB案例；论文刻画了语料库代表的安全机制与证据边界，并展示了配对产物如何支持仅源码、IR感知和联合分析。
AI.conclusion: CISB-Bench为编译器安全挖掘与检测研究提供了一个可复用、可检查的目标；预测任务的目标是从给定产物恢复审查后的标签，而非声称仅靠标准化IR即可复现所有历史编译器失败。

title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
summary: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recursive Game Creator，一个以体验为导向的递归式智能体游戏开发框架，将粗原型迭代为可玩性更高的游戏，在多个基准上取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏设计智能体虽能生成可运行的游戏，但程序正确并不代表玩家能获得良好体验，缺乏面向"好玩"的迭代优化机制。
AI.method: 围绕四个组件组织递归开发：Designer 将用户指令与 Reviewer 反馈转为详细计划；Builder 将计划生成候选游戏；编码原生 Player 通过程序化接口创建并执行可复用策略，高效收集多样化游戏轨迹，缓解慢速 GUI 采集带来的评估偏差；Reviewer 用基于轨迹的指标推断玩家偏好，结合视觉证据与显式文本偏好按游戏特定标准评估，接受更优版本并给出下一轮改进意见以闭环。
AI.result: GameCraft-Bench 上总体性能达 77.89，为当前最优；GameASG-Bench 上严格任务成功率 53.2%，较同模型基线提升 34.1%，运行检查平均通过率 93.4%，为对比方法中最高；用户研究显示游玩时间更长、评分更高。
AI.conclusion: 以体验为导向的递归开发范式能有效将游戏原型提升为更具娱乐性的成品，验证了轨迹评估与闭环反馈的价值。

title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

AI.tldr: 提出 JIVEAdapter，一种多任务"加性"低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为共享的 Joint 结构与任务专属的 Individual 结构，并自适应分配秩，在 GLUE/SuperGLUE 上以匹配有效秩达到与强基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩适配器多为单任务，且以乘性方式表示权重更新，未显式区分跨任务共享信息与任务专属信息，缺乏可解释性与复用性。
AI.method: 受统计方法 JIVE 启发，将每个权重更新分解为跨任务共享的 Joint 结构与每任务独立的 Individual 结构；对 Individual 施加近似正交惩罚以保持共享与专属信号分离可解释；在共享 Joint 池与任务 Individual 池间自适应分配秩；Joint 可一次联合学习或逐任务增量学习，之后冻结并作为新任务先验复用，无需重训共享部分。
AI.result: 在 DeBERTaV3-base 上于 GLUE 与 SuperGLUE，匹配每任务有效秩时，性能与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需 MoE 等额外模块；当存在相关"held-in"任务时，冻结的 Joint 可借复用该任务 Individual 加廉价逐方向缩放来服务"held-out"任务，否则训练一个小型新 Individual。
AI.conclusion: JIVEAdapter 通过加性分解显式分离共享与任务专属信号，实现高效、可解释、可复用的多任务参数高效微调。

title: Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis
summary: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kurate系统，利用大语言模型对已发表研究进行多维度的证据质量评估，并已在4,347篇论文（多为随机试验）上验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有科学检索系统能找出与问题相关的论文，但一般不评估这些论文所提供证据的质量。作者希望实现大规模、可追溯的研究质量评估，以支持元科学研究问题。
AI.method: Kurate使用大语言模型，结合论文本身及其相关文档（如试验注册、研究方案）进行判断，并将每项判断链接到其所依据的具体文本片段。系统对4,347篇论文（其中3,913篇为随机试验）从8个研究设计与报告维度评分：统计功效、因果识别、预注册、选择性报告、测量效度、分析预设定、报告透明度、利益冲突与资助。
AI.result: 语料中最常见的问题集中在统计功效、选择性报告和分析预设定，但不同临床领域的平均质量存在差异。在与60份留出临床试验文档的专家标注对比中，Kurate提取信息与专家标签一致的为：方案评分点221/242，结果发表评分点294/370，AC1分别为0.94和0.81。以一项高质量临床试验为示例，展示了单篇论文总体评级如何分解为各项判断，且每项判断均链接到注册、方案和发表报告中的具体证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，这种大规模质量评估是可行的，并可用于回答元科学研究问题。

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
summary: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了巴基斯坦旁遮普省作物产量预测原型（Random Forest、XGBoost、SVR、Ridge堆叠集成 + MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，并配SHAP解释的网页应用），但审计发现数据存在严重重复问题，导致高R²实为假象；去重后简单线性趋势反而优于机器学习模型，叶片分类器也因无配对产量数据而无用。论文以负面发现为主。
AI.motivation: 产量预测对规划者与农民决定投入、储存和进口很重要，但小规模农业数据表会导致在新一季上报告的精度失效。作者希望构建一个真实可用的作物产量预测原型，并检验其可靠性。
AI.method: 针对旁遮普省构建原型：结合Random Forest、XGBoost、支持向量回归与Ridge堆叠集成，外加MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，部署为带SHAP解释的网页应用。采用随机80/20划分的Kaggle合并表（414行），并进行数据审计；随后用留一整年（leave-one-year-out）、FAOSTAT更长数据（1990-2024，70观测）、逐作物线性趋势，以及独立的36个地区×13季小麦面板进行验证。
AI.result: 随机80/20划分下集成模型R²=0.991，但审计发现表中仅46个独立观测，因九个温度记录按年连接使每个作物-年份重复九次。留一整年时XGBoost的R²从0.994降至-0.20；去重后及FAOSTAT上，逐作物线性趋势（留一年RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha）优于所有未给年份信息的模型（0.84-1.06）。农药使用与全国温度变化均无法解释趋势残差；Kaggle表中的农药增益在FAOSTAT上消失（其农药序列多为插补且两版本不一致）。地区级小麦面板显示旁遮普大部分变异是空间性的，地区均值加共同趋势即可匹配学习模型。叶片分类器在PlantVillage上准确率99.87%，去除近重复后对336张未见病叶召回率96.4%，但无叶片图像与产量记录配对，故健康分数系人为构造且无增益。
AI.conclusion: 论文以报告负面发现为主：小规模且重复的数据会产生虚高的精度指标，简单方法（线性趋势、地区均值）在真实独立评估下即可匹敌或超越复杂模型；应优先保证数据独立性与外部验证，同时公开这些负面结果以免误导。

title: HarnessSecurity-Bench: Do Security Mechanisms Really Protect Coding Agent Harnesses?
summary: Coding agent harnesses mediate tool use and authorize actions, yet their security mechanisms and runtime effects remain incompletely characterized. We present HarnessSecurity, the first systematic empirical study and benchmark of open- and closed-source coding agent harnesses. First, we derive a ten-mechanism taxonomy and then assess 400 harness-mechanism cells using independent ratings by researchers and large language model (LLM) judges. We find that about half of confirmed mechanism implementations are opt-in, while closed-source harnesses exhibit substantial evidence gaps. Second, we introduce HarnessSecurity-Bench, a benchmark of 23 tasks across five attack surfaces without sacrificing legitimate task requirements. Using separate deterministic oracles to measure task utility and attack effects with security setting comparisons, we evaluate nine mechanisms across six leading harnesses: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, and GitHub Copilot. Under a controlled LLM baseline GLM-5.2, we conduct 2,500 trials, recording 81,155 tool calls and over 2.2 billion tokens. Enabling auto-approve increases utility and raises attack success from 29.2% to 95.6%. Network isolation and read-only mode reduce attack effects with substantial utility losses, while command allowlisting and command denylisting reduce attack effects with a small utility loss and a utility gain, respectively. Task-level cases show that restrictions on a shared capability can obstruct both legitimate and malicious operations, and that allowed tools or commands can leave unauthorized operations reachable through alternative execution paths. Harness providers should make security settings verifiable, test alternative execution paths to protected operations, and assess attack effects alongside task utility and execution costs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究并基准测试了开源与闭源编码智能体执行框架（harness）的安全机制与运行时效果，构建了十机制分类法和包含23项任务的 HarnessSecurity-Bench，在六个主流框架上进行了2500次试验（81,155次工具调用、超22亿token），发现自动批准将攻击成功率从29.2%提升至95.6%，网络隔离与只读模式降低攻击效果但损失大量效用。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体框架负责中介工具使用并授权操作，但其安全机制与运行时影响尚未被充分刻画；缺乏对开源与闭源框架安全能力的系统评估与可比较的基准。
AI.method: 1）推导十机制分类法，通过研究者与LLM评判的独立评分评估400个"框架-机制"单元；2）构建HarnessSecurity-Bench，覆盖五类攻击面的23项任务，在保留合法任务需求的前提下，用独立的确定性判定器分别度量任务效用与攻击效果，并对比不同安全设置；3）在受控LLM基线GLM-5.2下，对Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、gptme、Qwen Code、GitHub Copilot六个框架中的九种机制开展2500次试验。
AI.result: 约一半已确认的机制实现为可选（opt-in），闭源框架存在明显证据缺口。启用自动批准提升任务效用，同时将攻击成功率从29.2%提高到95.6%；网络隔离与只读模式降低攻击效果但伴随显著效用损失；命令白名单与命令黑名单降低攻击效果，分别带来小幅效用损失与效用增益。任务级案例显示，对共享能力的限制会同时阻碍合法与恶意操作，且被允许的工具或命令可能通过替代执行路径触达未授权操作。
AI.conclusion: 框架提供方应使安全设置可验证，测试通往受保护操作的替代执行路径，并在评估攻击效果的同时考量任务效用与执行成本。

title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
summary: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文将物理有效性建模为推理期约束优化问题，提出两种闭式投影算子应用于扩散模型的去噪估计 $\hat{x}_0$，在不重训练的情况下使 AlphaFold 3 类共折叠模型输出物理有效的复合物结构。
AI.motivation: AlphaFold 3 风格的共折叠模型虽能高精度预测复合物结构，但大量输出在物理上无效（链间重叠、配体键长键角失真、环非平面、手性反转）。现有方案要么用物理势引导采样，导致采样成本与显存开销激增、无法处理大复合物；要么微调模型，耗时且与特定架构绑定。
AI.method: 将物理有效性视为推理期约束问题，对扩散模型去噪后的干净坐标估计 $\hat{x}_0$ 施加两种闭式投影算子：(1) 链间范德华投影，推开冲突最严重的原子对；(2) 配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子均为局部、稀疏、位移受限，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不修改去噪器及其权重，可直接嵌入任意 AF3 风格采样器。
AI.result: 在 Boltz-2 与 OpenFold-3 两个独立模型上，于 CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters 单体与复合物集、Boltz 物理有效性测试集五个基准测试中，方法恢复了完美的物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时与显存开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一条实用且模型无关的路径，实现物理有效的全原子结构预测，无需重训练即可嵌入现有 AF3 风格采样流程。

title: Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"洞见来源"(Insight Provenance)任务，判定评审洞见源自人类、LLM还是混合贡献，并构建InsightProv-v0数据集与两阶段对抗框架，发现AI洞见多贴近通用或论文已有信息，人类洞见更常引入外部知识与独立判断。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM参与科学写作与同行评审，仅识别"谁写了文本"已不够，还需判定"洞见由谁贡献"；同时原始数据上的高表现可能源于语言与文本作者身份的捷径，掩盖真实来源信号。
AI.method: 基于4,057篇科学论文与12,660条人类评审构建InsightProv-v0，用GPT-4o、Gemini、DeepSeek模拟不同LLM参与程度并进行句级来源标注；提出两阶段对抗框架，抑制捷径信号同时保留来源相关信息，并采用逐步去偏的评估方式。
AI.result: 原始数据上的强性能在去偏评估下显著下降，说明模型依赖捷径；论文背景与相邻评审上下文提供互补来源信号；人类、混合与AI洞见在信息来源与失败模式上系统不同，AI洞见多停留于通用或论文已有信息。
AI.conclusion: 措辞可被LLM改写，但洞见的来源留下更深、更持久的信号；该研究为识别智力作者身份提供了任务、数据集、方法与实证洞见。

title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
summary: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy. VMD consistently achieves the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), signifying exceptional noise reduction and feature preservation. The study analyses the trade-offs between soft and hard thresholding: soft thresholding maintains intricate visual details, whilst harsh thresholding provides enhanced noise reduction. The suggested method surpasses traditional techniques in both reference and non-reference quality criteria, indicating its potential for broader application in medical imaging and future incorporation with adaptive thresholding algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合图像去噪框架，将EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD等分解技术与Curvelet变换阈值处理结合，在CT图像上验证其去噪效果，其中VMD表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪需在降低噪声的同时保留关键结构元素，传统方法难以兼顾去噪效果与特征保持，因此需要探索更有效的混合去噪框架。
AI.method: 融合经验模态分解（EMD）、变分模态分解（VMD）、多通道EMD（MEMD）、二维EMD（BEMD）等多种分解技术与Curvelet变换阈值处理；对每个分解模态分别进行软阈值与硬阈值处理，再组合去噪后的模态重建最终图像；在多种重建核（B50、B46、B41、B36）的CT图像数据集上进行全面评估。
AI.result: VMD始终取得最高的峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似度（SSIM），在噪声抑制与特征保留方面表现优异；软阈值保留复杂视觉细节，硬阈值提供更强的噪声抑制；所提方法在参考与非参考质量指标上均优于传统技术。
AI.conclusion: 该混合去噪框架在医学影像领域具有更广泛的应用潜力，未来可结合自适应阈值算法进一步提升性能。

title: SkillPoison: Progressive Skill Poisoning via Successful Experiences
summary: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly distill successful experiences into persistent, reusable skills. Existing skill attack methods corrupt this learning pipeline by injecting malicious triggers, behaviors, or false facts into individual experiences or extracted skills. However, such attacks are easily detected, and the injected malicious behaviors often fail to accumulate as persistent skills. In this paper, we show that skill poisoning can arise even from verified successful experiences, without making any individual trajectory malicious. Based on this insight, we propose SkillPoison, a novel framework that progressively poisons skill via successful experiences. SkillPoison first constructs a set of successful experiences that reinforce a target behavior, and then removes the contextual conditions that constrain when the behavior applies. Rather than injecting malicious content, SkillPoison shapes how the skill extractor generalizes, allowing useful behavior to support task success while inducing harmful behavior when they are misapplied. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that SkillPoison achieves 95.71% attack success rates, while all injected experiences remain task-correct and pass verification and lexical inspection. Our code, data and implementation details are available for the community at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/SkillPoison.

AI.tldr: SkillPoison通过构造成功经验并移除其上下文约束条件，诱导技能提取器过度泛化，从而在无恶意轨迹的情况下实现技能投毒。
AI.motivation: 现有技能攻击通过向经验或技能注入恶意触发、行为或虚假事实来破坏学习流程，但这类攻击容易被检测，且注入的恶意行为往往难以累积为持久技能。作者希望探究能否在不使任何单条轨迹恶意化的情况下，仅凭经过验证的成功经验实现技能投毒。
AI.method: SkillPoison框架首先构造一组能够强化目标行为的成功经验，随后移除约束该行为适用场景的上下文条件。它并非注入恶意内容，而是塑造技能提取器的泛化方式，使有用行为支撑任务成功的同时，在被误用时产生有害行为。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的大量实验表明，SkillPoison达到95.71%的攻击成功率，同时所有注入的经验仍保持任务正确，并通过验证与词法检查。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明技能投毒可以源自经验证的成功经验，无需单条轨迹恶意化，暴露了自改进智能体技能学习流程中一个更隐蔽的安全隐患。

title: When Tools Lie: Reliability of Mathematical Agents Under Corrupted Tool Feedback
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MathAI) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Mathematical problem solving often requires deterministic computational steps that agents delegate to tools and implicitly trust. Yet tools can fail silently, returning plausible but incorrect results. How well can agents detect and correct corrupted tool call outputs? We study this through a controlled corruption framework where a hidden interceptor replaces tool call results with plausible incorrect information on targeted problems. We evaluate agents across 31 problems under four verification designs including no verification (baseline), mandatory same-context reflection, optional fresh-context verification, and optional structural verification. Without verification, corruption causes dramatic accuracy loss, from 100% down to 72.4%. Mandatory reflection fully recovers this performance to 100%. Optional verification improves accuracy only when models actively invoke it. Our results show that checking frequency is strongly associated with robustness differences, while unequal invocation prevents a controlled comparison of verifier quality. A supporting recovery experiment shows that full problem restart succeeds in 100% of cases after explicit detection. These findings demonstrate that verifier availability and verification policy are separate components of mathematical-agent reliability. Mandatory policies enforce verification while optional policies depend on the model's own choice to invoke it.

AI.tldr: 工具调用可能静默出错并返回看似合理的错误结果。研究通过受控污染框架评估智能体的检测与纠正能力：无验证时准确率从100%降至72.4%，强制反思可完全恢复至100%，可选验证仅在模型主动调用时有效。验证频率与鲁棒性密切相关。
AI.motivation: 数学问题求解常需将确定性计算步骤委托给工具并默认信任其结果，但工具可能静默失败，返回貌似合理却错误的答案。因此需要研究智能体对受损工具调用输出的检测与纠正能力。
AI.method: 提出受控污染框架，由隐藏拦截器在目标问题上将工具调用结果替换为貌似合理的错误信息。在31个问题上评估智能体，比较四种验证设计：无验证（基线）、强制同上下文反思、可选新上下文验证、可选结构化验证。并辅以恢复实验。
AI.result: 无验证时污染导致准确率大幅下降，从100%降至72.4%；强制反思可将性能完全恢复至100%；可选验证仅在模型主动调用时提升准确率。检查频率与鲁棒性差异强相关，但不均衡的调用阻碍了对验证器质量的受控比较。恢复实验显示，显式检测后完全重启问题在100%情况下成功。
AI.conclusion: 验证器的可用性与验证策略是数学智能体可靠性的两个独立组成部分。强制策略可确保验证发生，而可选策略则依赖模型自身是否选择调用验证。

title: CuratorMAS: Automating Dataset Curation via Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: High-quality datasets are essential for reliable machine learning, but dataset curation remains costly and hard to generalize across domains. Existing methods typically rely on manually designed heuristics or model-dependent signals, limiting their applicability across tasks and user queries. To address these limitations and automate data curation, we propose \textbf{CuratorMAS}, a multi-agent collaboration framework that orchestrates agents to evaluate and curate high-quality datasets. To achieve the goal of flexible curation, CuratorMAS decomposes the complex curation process into five programmable execution stages and forms a parallelizable workflow. Specifically, CuratorMAS first performs dataset exploration to collect contextual information such as file structures and constraint cues, thereby developing a comprehensive understanding of the given task. In order to acquire up-to-date information, CuratorMAS retrieves domain knowledge from online sources to augment the evaluation process. Next, CuratorMAS derives the necessary evaluation criteria and computes the corresponding metrics. Based on these results, CuratorMAS executes filtering accordingly. Finally, an evolution module summarizes the evaluation outcomes and updates the relevant skills. Extensive and comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CuratorMAS significantly reduces the noise rate by up to 36.03 percentage points (pp) while also improving the F1 score of downstream models by up to 8.88 pp.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体协作框架 CuratorMAS，将数据策展解耦为五个可编程执行阶段并构建可并行工作流，实现自动化、可泛化的数据集评估与筛选。
AI.motivation: 高质量数据集对可靠的机器学习至关重要，但数据策展成本高昂且难以跨领域泛化。现有方法多依赖人工设计的启发式规则或依赖特定模型的信号，限制了其在不同任务与用户查询下的适用性。因此需要一种能自动化数据策展并具备灵活性的方案。
AI.method: CuratorMAS 通过编排多个智能体协同完成数据评估与策展，将复杂策展流程拆解为五个可编程执行阶段，形成可并行的工作流：1）数据集探索，收集文件结构、约束线索等上下文信息以理解任务；2）从在线来源检索领域知识以获取最新信息并增强评估过程；3）推导必要的评估标准并计算相应指标；4）依据评估结果执行过滤；5）通过演化模块总结评估结果并更新相关技能。
AI.result: 大量综合实验表明，CuratorMAS 可将噪声率最多降低 36.03 个百分点，同时将下游模型的 F1 分数最多提升 8.88 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CuratorMAS 以多智能体协作与可编程分阶段工作流的方式实现灵活、自动化的数据策展，在降噪与提升下游模型性能方面均有显著效果，为跨任务、跨领域的数据策展提供了可行路径。

title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
comment: Published in Proceedings of IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT) 2026
summary: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.

AI.tldr: AccentCL是一个面向英语口音分类的类增量学习框架，对类别不平衡和跨语料库域偏移具有鲁棒性，可在不完整重训的情况下增量添加新口音类别。
AI.motivation: 传统口音分类器使用固定标签集，无法随新数据加入而容纳新口音类别；同时口音语音语料库常存在严重类别不平衡，且因录音条件差异导致跨语料库域偏移。
AI.method: 从冻结的Whisper-Large-v3编码器提取多层表示；使用不平衡感知交叉熵损失减少对多数口音类的偏置，使用域均值对齐损失最小化跨训练语料的分布均值偏移；通过基于回放的持续学习扩展标签空间，利用冻结基模型保持知识，并用旧到新边界损失减少对新类的过度预测。
AI.result: 在五类口音分类任务上达到77.1%平衡准确率和76.9%宏平均F1。添加西班牙口音英语时，新类F1为83.3%，基类平衡准确率保持77.3%；随后添加中国口音英语时，新类F1为61.8%，已学类平衡准确率保持77.6%。
AI.conclusion: AccentCL实现了稳健的区域口音分类，并支持在不完整重训的情况下增量加入新的口音类别。

title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
summary: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD--QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEMD-QBF框架，将锐核CT图像转换为类似软核的表示，在保持解剖结构的同时降低噪声，无需原始投影数据。
AI.motivation: CT重建核的选择存在固有矛盾：锐核提升空间分辨率但增加噪声，软核降低噪声却损失边缘清晰度。研究旨在无需原始投影数据的情况下，后处理阶段提升图像质量。
AI.method: 采用二维经验模态分解（BEMD）将图像分解为内禀模态函数，并在四元数框架内结合四元数双边滤波（QBF）进行噪声抑制与结构保持。
AI.result: 在多个重建核（B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31）上评估，与非局部均值、各向异性扩散、双边滤波及QBF对比，SSIM与PSNR指标显示BEMD-QBF在结构保真度上更优，且降噪效果具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BEMD-QBF可有效增强后重建CT图像，在无需原始投影数据的前提下获得更优图像质量。

title: PerSpectron: Detecting Invariant Footprints of Microarchitectural Attacks with Perceptron
comment: Author manuscript of MICRO 2020. 14 manuscript pages plus publication-notice page
summary: Detecting microarchitectural attacks is critical given their proliferation in recent years. Many of these attacks exhibit intrinsic behaviors essential to the nature of their operation, such as creating contention or misspeculation. This study systematically investigates the microarchitectural footprints of hardware-based attacks and shows how they can be detected and classified using an efficient hardware predictor. We present a methodology to use correlated microarchitectural statistics to design a hardware-based neural predictor capable of detecting and classifying microarchitectural attacks before data is leaked. Once a potential attack is detected, it can be proactively mitigated by triggering appropriate countermeasures. Our hardware-based detector, PerSpectron, uses perceptron learning to identify and classify attacks. Perceptron-based prediction has been successfully used in branch prediction and other hardware-based applications. PerSpectron has minimal performance overhead. The statistics being monitored have similar overhead to already existing performance monitoring counters. Additionally, PerSpectron operates outside the processor's critical paths, offering security without added computation delay. Our system achieves a usable detection rate for detecting attacks such as SpectreV1, SpectreV2, SpectreRSB, Meltdown, breakingKSLR, Flush+Flush, Flush+Reload, Prime+Probe as well as cache-attack calibration programs. We also believe that the large number of diverse microarchitectural features offers both evasion resilience and interpretability---features not present in previous hardware security detectors. We detect these attacks early enough to avoid any data leakage, unlike previous work that triggers countermeasures only after data has been exposed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于感知机学习的硬件预测器 PerSpectron，利用相关联的微架构统计特征来检测和分类硬件攻击，在数据泄露前触发缓解措施，性能开销极小。
AI.motivation: 近年来微架构攻击（如 Spectre、Meltdown、Flush+Flush 等）大量出现，具有contention（争用）或 misspeculation（错误推测）等内在行为特征。现有硬件安全检测器往往在数据已经泄露后才触发countermeasures，无法防止泄露，且缺乏可解释性和抗规避能力，因此亟需能在泄露前检测攻击的高效硬件方案。
AI.method: 系统研究硬件攻击的微架构足迹，证明其可通过高效硬件预测器检测与分类。提出利用相关联的微架构统计数据，设计基于感知机（perceptron）学习的硬件神经预测器 PerSpectron。感知机方法此前已成功用于分支预测等硬件应用。监控的统计量与已有 performance monitoring counters 开销相近，且预测器运行于处理器关键路径之外。
AI.result: PerSpectron 对 SpectreV1、SpectreV2、SpectreRSB、Meltdown、breakingKSLR、Flush+Flush、Flush+Reload、Prime+Probe 以及缓存攻击校准程序等均达到可用的检测率。性能开销极小，且不增加计算延迟。检测足够早，可避免任何数据泄露。
AI.conclusion: 基于感知机的硬件预测器能够有效检测和分类多种微架构攻击，具备极小开销、泄露前阻断、抗规避与可解释性等优势，优于以往只能在数据暴露后触发countermeasures的工作。

title: How Much Evidence Should a Coding Agent's Self-Correction Carry? Adaptive Dirichlet Evidence for Self-Distillation
summary: Execution feedback lets coding agents revise programs and learn from their own corrections. A correction's learning weight should reflect both the transitions supported by its executions and the amount of evidence behind that support. We introduce Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), which represents these quantities separately. Normalized execution relevance determines relative transition support and an effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior then produces an uncertainty-penalized weight for KL-anchored correction learning. Under a symmetric prior, changing mass preserves category ordering, and effective mass yields a supervised coefficient bounded by its matched fixed-mass counterpart. Across four model-domain history sweeps, increasing visible observations from one to eight reduces future-outcome NLL by 55.0-59.3%. At eight observations, effective mass achieves lower NLL than fixed mass in all four comparisons.
