In the primary matched DeepSeek/RunBugRun study, argmax predictions agree on all 3,000 examples, with the largest NLL gain under concentrated relevance. After one correction-learning round, DeepSeek/CodeARC all-tests Pass@1 increases from 15.0% to 20.4%, with a paired 95% source-bootstrap interval of [+2.8, +8.0] percentage points. The twelve-setting downstream evaluation establishes the model-domain scope of this update. These results show how separating evidence support from evidence mass changes probability estimation and correction learning in coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有效证据自蒸馏（EESD），将执行反馈中的“转移支持”与“证据质量”分离建模，用归一化执行相关性和有效伪计数质量构建狄利克雷后验，得到不确定性惩罚权重用于修正学习。
AI.motivation: 执行反馈能让编码智能体修正程序并从自身修正中学习，但一次修正的学习权重应同时反映其执行所支持的转移以及背后证据的数量。现有方法未将“证据支持”与“证据质量”分开表示，导致权重无法随可见观测数自适应调整。
AI.method: EESD 将两个量分开表示：归一化执行相关性决定相对转移支持及有效伪计数质量；再用狄利克雷后验生成不确定性惩罚权重，用于 KL 锚定的修正学习。理论上证明对称先验下改变质量保持类别排序，且有效质量给出的监督系数被其匹配的固定质量对应值所界定。
AI.result: 在四个模型—领域的历史扫描中，可见观测从 1 增至 8 使未来结果 NLL 降低 55.0–59.3%；在 8 个观测时，有效质量在全部四次比较中 NLL 均低于固定质量。主要匹配的 DeepSeek/RunBugRun 研究中，3,000 个样例的 argmax 预测全部一致，相关性集中时 NLL 增益最大。一轮修正学习后，DeepSeek/CodeARC 全测试 Pass@1 从 15.0% 提升至 20.4%，配对 95% source-bootstrap 区间为 [+2.8, +8.0] 个百分点。十二设置的下游评估界定了该更新的模型—领域适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 将证据支持与证据质量分离，能改变编码智能体中的概率估计与修正学习效果，验证了 EESD 在不确定性加权修正学习上的有效性。

title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
summary: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一个面向企业级应用的生产就绪内容抽取系统，将内容抽取确立为生成式AI数据生命周期中独立且可测量的阶段，包含选择性OCR路由、基于参考的抽取评分器、结构感知分块器和只读检索评估器，并在180份文档语料上验证了其抽取与检索性能。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI将模型与单一任务解耦，使模型侧通用性提升，但数据侧异质性加剧：企业知识以PDF、演示文稿、表格、扫描件、表单、图表等混合布局格式存在，同时携带文本、视觉、几何与结构信息。语言模型或检索器无法可靠推理在此接口处被错误表示的信息，因此内容抽取的误差无法被下游检索器或重排器修复，内容抽取必须成为独立且可测量的生命周期阶段。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：选择性OCR路由（selective OCR routing）；以稀缺性优先的策展引擎（scarcity-first curation engine），配备基于参考的抽取评分器，度量字符、词和表格结构准确率；确定性的结构感知父子分块器（structure-aware parent-child chunker）；以及只读检索评估器，从每页生成有依据的问题并报告Hit@k、MRR与延迟。
AI.result: 在180份文档语料上，最佳抽取器得分97.4/100，字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到hit@1为68.6%、hit@10为92.8%、MRR为0.77。
AI.conclusion: 论文提炼出三条设计原则：结构先于语义、绝不篡改所测量的对象、合理预算标注；并将可测量的内容抽取定位为企业智能体系统的感知层。

title: Closing Ambient Clinical Documentation Gaps with Automated Provider Queries
summary: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 LLM 能否自动化临床文档补全中的查询循环（DAU：起草、询问、更新），并揭示有效提问的预测因素因任务而异，部署关键在于学会"何时不问"。
AI.motivation: 临床文档专家向医生发送澄清查询以弥补临床笔记中的信息缺口并确保准确计费，而现有自动笔记起草、ICD-10 编码和医嘱提取工作均假设转录完整，未解决这些缺口问题。
AI.method: 对 3,000 次真实就诊进行审计以识别文档缺失来源，据此在公开数据上构建五个转录退化基准；分析真实对话中的 21k 条澄清轮次，考察任务特定的有用问题预测因素。
AI.result: 有用问题预测因素具有任务特异性：oracle 置信度占主导，但笔记完整性只需简单回忆型问题，而 ICD-10 编码需要更难的多选项问题；约 9% 的轮次反而损害性能，原因包括冗余问题以及仍会触发重写的非回答。
AI.conclusion: LLM 查询循环的部署成效既取决于"该问什么"，同样取决于学会"何时不问"。

title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning, which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control, to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer, to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像模型中的VAE潜空间存在一个与亮度及对立色（opponent-color）对齐的颜色子空间，并基于该子空间提出色彩微调、饱和度控制和调色板迁移三项应用。
AI.motivation: VAE是文生图模型的关键组件，在潜空间内生成图像。VAE已知能解耦数据中的主要变化因子，而在自然图像中颜色是最具结构性的因素之一——去相关后得到一条亮度轴和两条对立色轴。因此理论上颜色应在VAE潜空间中作为一个独立因子出现，但潜空间如何表征颜色仍鲜有探索。
AI.method: 通过编码器的线性近似与有针对性的潜空间引导（latent steering），在从SD1.5到FLUX.2、Z-Image等广泛范围的VAE中一致地识别出该颜色子空间。
AI.result: 在多种VAE中一致地发现与亮度及对立色对齐的颜色子空间。基于此提出三项应用：ColorTuning在GenColorBench的细粒度CSS3/X11系统上实现精确数值颜色生成的最优性能；饱和度控制用于调整全局色彩强度；颜色迁移用于改变调色板以匹配参考图像。
AI.conclusion: VAE潜空间具有可解释且可操控的颜色子空间，为文生图模型的精确颜色控制提供了简洁有效的途径，代码与模型已公开。

title: The Model Plants the Trigger: Answer-Side Backdoor Attacks in Multi-Turn Large Language Models
summary: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing LLM backdoors are almost all input-centric: activation depends on explicit trigger patterns in the user input, so modern guardrails are built to sanitize the input space. We challenge this assumption with a novel answer-side backdoor for multi-turn dialogue. Instead of inserting the trigger into the input, the adversary uses a benign first-turn prompt to naturally induce the model to generate a specific, seemingly innocuous word. Once merged into the dialogue history, this self-generated word becomes the trigger. When a later harmful query arrives, the model detects its own trigger and bypasses its safety refusal, while the user input stays perfectly clean. Across four LLMs, our attack reaches near-perfect Attack Success Rates, approaching 100\% at only a 5\% poisoning rate, while preserving general utility and clean-input safety, and it evades mainstream input-centric defenses. Representation-level analysis shows that the self-generated trigger consistently suppresses the model's refusal signal, exposing a critical blind spot in current LLM defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新型"答案侧"后门攻击：触发词由模型自身生成并进入对话历史，而非来自用户输入，从而绕过现有以输入为中心的安全防护。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后门几乎都是输入中心的，依赖用户输入中的显式触发模式，因此现代安全护栏主要针对输入空间做清洗。作者质疑这一假设，探索触发词不在输入侧的可能性。
AI.method: 针对多轮对话设计的答案侧后门：用良性的首轮提示自然诱导模型生成一个特定且看似无害的词；该词进入对话历史后成为触发词；当后续有害查询到来时，模型识别自身的触发词并绕过安全拒绝，而用户输入保持完全干净。
AI.result: 在四款LLM上，攻击成功率接近完美，在仅5%的投毒率下逼近100%，同时保持通用效用与干净输入下的安全性，并能规避主流以输入为中心的防御。表征层面的分析显示，自生成触发词持续抑制模型的拒绝信号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作暴露了当前LLM防御的关键盲区：安全机制忽视答案侧与对话历史中的自生成内容，提示需要覆盖输入空间之外的新型防护思路。

title: Small Language Models for Smart Data Model Classification at the Edge: A Cost-Aware Hybrid Approach
summary: The rapid proliferation of heterogeneous data sources within the Internet of Things (IoT) across domains such as smart cities, energy management, and environmental monitoring necessitates efficient and scalable data standardization methods. Effective classification of smart data models (SDMs) is essential for facilitating interoperability. However, existing approaches are often limited by high resource consumption and lack applicability in edge environments with constrained computational capabilities. Aiming to bridge this gap, the proposed study evaluates the performance of lightweight open-source language models (LMs) to resolve an input data entity against its corresponding best fitting SDM representation under resource-constrained conditions. It systematically benchmarks a diverse array of models, including general purpose (GP), reasoning-specialized (RS), and code-specialized (CS) architectures, across multiple domain-specific datasets. Addressing the current omission of lightweight, resource-efficient solutions in the literature, the investigation provides significant and valuable insights into model selection, task formulation, and deployment strategies that optimize accuracy and efficiency. A complementary experiment also compares the surveyed large language models (LLMs) against two near-zero-cost similarity baselines (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and a lightweight sentence encoder) on the same task, providing a strong reference point for interpreting the practical value of LLM-based classification on edge platforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估轻量级开源语言模型在资源受限的边缘环境下将物联网数据实体分类到最匹配的智能数据模型（SDM）的性能，并对比了通用、推理专用和代码专用模型，同时与两种近零成本相似度基线进行比较。
AI.motivation: 物联网跨领域异构数据源快速增多，需要高效可扩展的数据标准化方法，而SDM的有效分类是实现互操作性的关键。但现有方法资源消耗高，难以应用于计算能力受限的边缘环境，文献中也缺乏轻量级、资源高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 系统基准测试多种轻量级开源语言模型，包括通用型（GP）、推理专用型（RS）和代码专用型（CS）架构，在多个领域特定数据集上完成“输入数据实体匹配最佳SDM表示”的任务；同时设置补充实验，将大语言模型与两种近零成本相似度基线（TF-IDF和轻量级句子编码器）在同一任务上进行比较。
AI.result: 论文对模型选择、任务表述和部署策略给出了重要见解，用于优化准确率与效率；并通过与TF-IDF和轻量级句子编码器等近零成本基线的对比，为评估边缘平台上基于LLM的分类的实际价值提供了参考基准。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级开源语言模型在资源受限条件下可实现物联网智能数据模型的有效分类，模型选择、任务设计和部署策略对准确率与效率的平衡至关重要，且需结合近零成本基线来判断LLM方案的实际价值。

title: Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (non-archival)
summary: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

AI.tldr: 自动手语翻译（SLT）已进入消费产品，但面向儿童的安全防护（未成年人过滤、诱导对话分类器）与SLT从未被联合评估；主流已部署SLT模型未在18岁以下手语使用者上训练或评估。本文提出由聋人群体参与、面向部署前的审计框架，包含失败分类、场景模式、四种比较条件与四项结果指标，以澳大利亚手语（Auslan）为首个案例。
AI.motivation: 手语儿童通过SLT使用聊天与助手类产品时，其内容需经翻译才能到达平台安全机制，而翻译可能改变否定、角色、保密、紧迫性、求助意图等语义，从而在语言仍然流畅的情况下改变安全判定。目前缺乏对SLT与平台安全工具边界的联合评估，且主流SLT模型未针对未成年人训练或验证，存在未被识别的风险。
AI.method: 提出一种由聋人社区参与的部署前审计方案，针对SLT与平台安全防护的交界处；具体包括：一套失败分类体系（failure taxonomy）、一个经过脱敏处理的场景模式（sanitised scenario schema）、四种比较条件，以及四项结果测量指标。首个案例研究计划采用澳大利亚手语（Auslan）。
AI.result: 论文为立场/方案类工作，摘要未给出实证结果；主要发现为文献中不存在公开记录的联合评估系统，且领先的已部署SLT模型既未在18岁以下手语者上训练，也未经正式评估。
AI.conclusion: 需要在部署前对SLT与儿童安全防护的交互边界进行制度化审计，且审计应由聋人群体参与设计；Auslan将作为首个验证案例，为后续多语言扩展提供模板。

title: Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints
summary: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in light condition. Additionally, we introduced a controlled RGB video dataset containing alert, not alert, and acted emergency-like behaviours recorded under three illumination conditions. These contributions represent a step toward passive and non-contact train-driver state recognition based on facial and upper-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种仅依赖单个前置RGB摄像头和图神经网络的可视化列车司机状态监测系统，将模拟司机状态分为警觉、非警觉和紧急三类，并通过消融实验比较骨骼、面部及二者融合三种特征配置。
AI.motivation: 传统列车安全系统（如司机失能开关）仅提供有限且基础的警觉性检查，难以有效应对司机疲劳对铁路安全构成的重大挑战，因此需要一种被动、非接触的状态识别方案。
AI.method: 构建基于单前置RGB摄像头的监控系统，使用图神经网络进行状态分类；通过消融实验比较三种输入特征配置（仅骨骼、仅面部、面部与骨骼组合）；同时采集了一个包含警觉、非警觉和模拟紧急行为、覆盖三种光照条件的受控RGB视频数据集。
AI.result: 在光照条件下，面部与骨骼特征组合的三分类模型准确率最高（81%），优于仅用面部或仅用骨骼的模型；在同一光照条件下，该组合在警觉/非警觉二分类中达到99%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 融合面部与上半身动态特征的方案推动了基于单目RGB摄像头的被动、非接触式列车司机状态识别研究，并为后续发展提供了数据集与实验基础。

title: What Response Marginals Miss: Adaptive Query Complexity of Functional Backdoor Recovery
summary: Functional backdoor recovery finds any trigger whose attack success rate is at least a given threshold rather than to recover the planted trigger. We study the minimum number of queries required for this task under label feedback which returns the predicted class label. We construct two finite families of victim models that have exactly the same attack success rate for every victim and trigger candidate. The distribution of returned labels for every query is also identical under a uniformly chosen victim. These families form an explicit counterexample that despite the matched quantities, their optimal adaptive query complexities are \(Θ(\log H)\) and \(Θ(H)\) where \(H\) is the number of possible victims. The difference arises because the same non-target labels are associated with different sets of victims, so successive queries eliminate possible victims at different rates. This separation disappears when the response is reduced to binary feedback, which reports only whether the target label is returned. The separation also persists for every fixed failure probability below one. Finally, we realize the same recovery problems with trained CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 classifiers and verify the predicted optimal query budgets. These results show that attack success rate and the distribution of returned labels for each query are insufficient to determine the query complexity of functional backdoor recovery.

AI.tldr: 功能后门恢复任务中，攻击成功率与查询返回标签分布不足以决定最优查询复杂度；两个在这些量上完全相同的受害模型族，查询复杂度分别为Θ(log H)与Θ(H)。
AI.motivation: 功能后门恢复只需找到任一达到给定攻击成功率阈值的触发器，而非恢复原始植入触发器。研究在此任务下所需的最少查询数，并检验攻击成功率与标签分布是否能刻画查询复杂度。
AI.method: 在标签反馈下构造两个有限受害模型族，使每个受害与触发器候选的攻击成功率完全相同，且均匀选取受害时每次查询的返回标签分布也相同；分析其最优自适应查询复杂度，并对比二值反馈情形和固定失败概率情形，最后用CIFAR-10 ResNet-18分类器实现验证。
AI.result: 两族模型尽管匹配量相同，最优自适应查询复杂度分别为Θ(log H)与Θ(H)（H为可能受害数）；差异源于相同非目标标签对应不同受害集合，使相邻查询以不同速率排除受害。该分离在二值反馈下消失，但在任意小于1的固定失败概率下持续存在；CIFAR-10 ResNet-18实验验证了预测的最优查询预算。
AI.conclusion: 攻击成功率与每次查询返回标签的分布不足以确定功能后门恢复的查询复杂度，反馈结构（标签与受害集合的关联方式）才是关键因素。

title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
summary: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParanoiaEval，首个统一评估编码智能体风险处理能力的基准，基于软件工程风险管理中的Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance框架，构建200个证据控制的任务对，并揭示过度风险处理普遍存在且与任务能力独立。
AI.motivation: 随着编码智能体越来越多地自主承担现实工作，判断其风险处理是否合理变得重要。现有工作从分散视角评估相关行为，缺乏统一框架来整合这些行为，因此需要一个系统性的评估基准。
AI.method: 提出ParanoiaEval基准，基于软件工程风险管理的Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance（规避-转移-缓解-接受）框架，将其四种基本处理方式操作化到编码智能体场景。构建200个证据控制的仓库级任务对，每对仅在决定处理方式的证据上不同。引入专门的风险处理违规和证据响应性指标，并采用人工校准的智能体评判器进行可靠评估。
AI.result: 在8个代表性模型上的大规模实验及事后人工研究显示：(I) 尽管有明确证据，不必要的风险处理仍出现在11.2%-58.7%的运行中，且不同智能体配置差异显著；(II) 更强的任务能力并不保证更合适的风险处理，而处理违规会显著损害开发者体验，表明风险处理是独立的能力维度；(III) 智能体表现出与既有风险管理发现一致的系统性模式，说明人类实践经验可指导该能力的诊断与改进。
AI.conclusion: 风险处理应被视为编码智能体的独立能力维度；人类风险管理知识可迁移用于诊断和改进该能力；ParanoiaEval为统一评估提供了系统框架。

title: Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course
summary: Experimental studies of generative AI in education mostly report average effects, yet field evidence shows that AI can narrow attainment gaps or widen them. We argue that the direction depends on the judgement burden, the expertise a learner must supply to screen AI output before learning from it, and that expert verification before release moves this burden from students to an accountable tutor. We test the argument in a two-cohort difference-in-differences design in which one half of a compulsory firstyear university economics course received AI-generated podcasts, FAQs and quiz-based study guides, produced with a source-grounded model and checked by a named graduate teaching assistant (170 students; 340 examination marks). Access was associated with a 2.34-mark advantage on a 50-mark component. The share of marks below the upper-second classification boundary fell by 24.7 percentage points relative to the counterfactual, effects were significant at every threshold from 23 to 31 marks and at none above, and roughly three-quarters of the average originated in the bottom quintile. The threshold estimate is robust to removing the lowest-scoring students from the pre-intervention cohort; the average effect is not. Interviews and feedback from 36 students indicate that the verification label gave students a reason to engage with AI-generated material without ending their scrutiny of it. Evaluations of AI learning resources that report only mean effects cannot detect whether the students the resources are meant to help are the ones who gain.

AI.tldr: AI教育资源的效应方向取决于学生的"判断负担"；由具名助教预先核查AI输出可将负担从学生转移，从而缩小成绩差距。一项两队列双重差分研究显示，有核查标签的AI学习资源使学生在50分模块上平均多2.34分，且效果集中于低分群体，低于23分阈值的人数比例下降24.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 已有生成式AI教育实验多报告平均效应，但实地证据显示AI既可能缩小也可能扩大成绩差距，方向不定。作者认为关键在于"判断负担"——学习者需具备多少专业知识才能筛选AI输出——并据此提出：在发布前由可问责的助教进行专家核查，可把这一负担由学生转移到助教身上。
AI.method: 在大学一年级必修经济学课中开展两队列双重差分设计。一半学生获得由基于来源的模型生成、并经具名研究生助教核查的AI播客、常见问题与测验式学习指南；样本170名学生、340个考试成绩。辅以36名学生的访谈与反馈分析。
AI.result: 获取AI资源与50分模块上2.34分的平均优势相关；低于"二等一"分类边界（约23分）的成绩占比相对反事实下降24.7个百分点；效应在23至31分的各阈值均显著，高于31分则不显著；约四分之三的平均效应来自最低五分位群体。阈值估计在剔除干预前队列最低分学生后依然稳健，而平均效应则不稳健。访谈与反馈表明，核查标签使学生有理由使用AI材料，同时并未放弃对其的审视。
AI.conclusion: 仅报告平均效应的AI学习资源评估，无法判断资源本欲帮助的学生是否真正受益；关注分数分布尾部（阈值与低分群体）才能揭示AI是缩小还是扩大成绩差距。发布前的专家核查通过转移判断负担，可在不削弱学生批判性参与的前提下提升弱势学生表现。

title: Quality-Aware Self-Correcting Speech Translation on an Edge Device
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Full paper submitted to the Convergence 2026 proceedings; poster presented at Convergence 2026, University of Surrey. Code: https://github.com/juebae/speech-translation_edge_device
summary: We present a fully offline speech-to-speech translation pipeline that runs on a Jetson Nano (4 GB) and corrects its own weak translations without retraining. A Whisper-tiny ASR feeds an Opus-MT translator; multilingual BERT cosine similarity acts as a Quality Estimation (QE) gate, triggering a secondary-pass correction when confidence falls below a pre-defined threshold $τ$. We compare three correction methods: QE reranking (M1), Minimum Bayes-Risk decoding (M2), and constrained beam search (M3). On 1,012 FLORES-200 sentences (English-Spanish), M2 at $τ=0.90$ produces statistically significant improvements over greedy decoding on BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001), ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001), and COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002); M1 yields no significant gains, and M3 is significantly worse than baseline (p>0.99). Our central finding is that QE functions effectively as a gate but poorly as a ranker: removing the QE model from candidate selection (M1$\to$M2) does not hurt quality and frees 680 MB from the critical path. Using a gain-to-edit ratio adapted from the post-editing-effort literature, we further show that smaller candidate pools (N=3) yield more surgical corrections with better semantic adequacy, while larger pools (N=10) maximise lexical reward. We release the system and demonstrate live translation across six language pairs.

AI.tldr: 一个完全离线、可在 Jetson Nano (4 GB) 上运行的语音到语音翻译流水线，无需重训练即可自我修正弱翻译，核心发现是 QE 适合做门控而不适合做候选排序器。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上实现离线语音翻译，同时希望在不进行重训练的前提下自动纠正低质量翻译，降低对云端与重训练的依赖。
AI.method: Whisper-tiny ASR 接 Opus-MT 翻译器；用多语言 BERT 余弦相似度作为质量估计 (QE) 门控，当置信度低于阈值 τ 时触发二次修正。对比三种修正方法：QE 重排序 (M1)、最小贝叶斯风险解码 (M2)、约束束搜索 (M3)。
AI.result: 在 1012 句 FLORES-200 英西语料上，M2 在 τ=0.90 时相对贪心解码显著提升 BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001)、ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001) 与 COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002)；M1 无显著增益，M3 显著劣于基线 (p>0.99)。从候选选择中移除 QE 模型 (M1→M2) 不损害质量，并从关键路径释放 680 MB 内存。N=3 的候选池修正更"外科手术式"、语义充分性更好，N=10 则最大化词汇奖励。
AI.conclusion: QE 作为门控有效、但作为排序器效果不佳；采用 M2 且小候选池 (N=3) 可在边缘设备上获得更好的语义质量与内存效率。系统已开源，并演示了六种语言对的实时翻译。

title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
summary: Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, reliable real-world plant disease detection remains a persistent challenge. Visual and deep learning approaches have shown promising results, but their deployment under field conditions remains limited. A key bottleneck is the reliance on laboratory-generated datasets that lack environmental diversity, realistic backgrounds, and balanced class distributions, resulting in poor generalization. In contrast, datasets collected directly from agricultural environments capture natural variability and better reflect challenges faced by farmers across regions. This review presents a critical analysis of visual and deep learning approaches for plant disease detection, with emphasis on plant disease datasets. It establishes a taxonomy based on acquisition setting, accessibility, plant diversity, disease composition, class structure, and imbalance severity, and examines their implications for model generalization and real-world deployment. A comparative analysis of laboratory and real-field datasets identifies critical gaps that hinder disease detection. The review further analyzes how multi-level dataset imbalance, including intra-class, inter-crop, and cross-dataset imbalance, and limited environmental variability affect model performance and robustness, an area insufficiently examined in existing surveys. Beyond image-based approaches, it highlights the importance of integrating environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and leaf wetness with image data to improve prediction under dynamic field conditions. Finally, the review identifies key challenges, research gaps, and future directions concerning dataset construction, environmental variability, structural imbalance, standardization, and multimodal disease monitoring. It provides a foundation for developing next-generation multimodal frameworks for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了植物病害检测的视觉与深度学习方法，重点分析病害数据集，提出数据集分类体系，比较实验室与田间数据集差距，并强调多层级不平衡与环境参数融合的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现实中的植物病害检测仍面临挑战，核心瓶颈在于依赖实验室生成的数据集，缺乏环境多样性、真实背景和均衡的类别分布，导致模型泛化能力差。田间采集的数据集更能反映自然变异和农民面临的真实挑战，因此有必要系统性地综述数据集问题。
AI.method: 1）批判性分析植物病害检测的视觉与深度学习方法，重点关注病害数据集；2）基于采集环境、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构和失衡严重程度建立分类体系；3）对实验室数据集与田间数据集进行对比分析；4）分析多层级数据集不平衡（类内、作物间、跨数据集）及环境变异对模型性能与鲁棒性的影响；5）探讨将温度、湿度、叶面湿度等环境参数与图像数据融合的方法。
AI.result: 识别出实验室与田间数据集之间的关键差距，揭示了多层级不平衡和有限环境变异对模型性能与鲁棒性的影响（现有综述对此关注不足），并指出环境参数与图像数据融合有助于提升动态田间条件下的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 综述提出了数据集构建、环境变异、结构性不平衡、标准化和多模态病害监测等方面的关键挑战、研究空白和未来方向，为开发面向精准农业的下一代多模态框架奠定了基础。

title: SCSM: A Traffic-Native Foundation Model for Transferable Website Fingerprinting
summary: Website fingerprinting infers the websites visited by users from encrypted traffic metadata. However, models trained under fixed collection conditions often degrade as website sets, collection times, network paths, browsers, or defenses change. Existing transferable attacks either rely on handcrafted perturbations of individual traces or adapt language-oriented architectures to traffic, limiting their ability to capture traffic-native semantics. To address these limitations, we propose SCSM, a traffic-native foundation model for transferable website fingerprinting. Specifically, SCSM constructs pairs of pretraining views from the same group of unlabeled traces through Segmentation, Combination, Scaling, and Masking. These operations produce diverse observable patterns while preserving the underlying packet events and local traffic dynamics of real trace fragments. The corresponding windowed traffic counting matrices serve as inputs for contrastive pretraining of a state-space encoder without website annotations. The pretrained encoder is then fine-tuned on a small labeled support set, and predictions are aggregated across temporal scales at inference. Experimental results demonstrate that SCSM surpasses the strongest baselines by 16.4\% in average top-3 accuracy over six temporal-drift tasks on GTT23 and by 13.8\% in average macro-F1 over four cross-domain datasets. The code and datasets will be made available at https://github.com/SJTU-dxw/WF-SCSM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCSM，一个面向可迁移网站指纹识别（WF）的流量原生基础模型。它通过分割、组合、缩放、掩码构造预训练视图对，用窗口化流量计数矩阵进行对比预训练状态空间编码器，再小样本微调并在推理时多时间尺度聚合，显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 网站指纹识别从加密流量元数据推断用户访问的网站，但在固定采集条件下训练的模型，遇到网站集合、采集时间、网络路径、浏览器或防御变化时性能会下降。现有可迁移攻击要么依赖对单条流量的手工扰动，要么把面向语言的架构迁移到流量上，难以捕捉流量原生语义，因此需要一种流量原生的可迁移基础模型。
AI.method: SCSM通过分割（Segmentation）、组合（Combination）、缩放（Scaling）和掩码（Masking），从同一组无标签流量中构造预训练视图对。这些操作在保留真实流量片段的底层数据包事件和局部动态的同时，产生多样可观测模式。对应的窗口化流量计数矩阵作为输入，在无网站标注下对比预训练一个状态空间编码器；随后在小规模有标签支持集上微调，并在推理时跨时间尺度聚合预测。
AI.result: 在GTT23的六个时间漂移任务上，SCSM平均top-3准确率超过最强基线16.4%；在四个跨域数据集上，平均macro-F1超过最强基线13.8%。
AI.conclusion: SCSM作为流量原生的基础模型，能够有效提升网站指纹识别在时间漂移和跨域场景下的可迁移性，证明了基于流量原生语义的对比预训练与小样本微调策略的有效性。代码与数据集将开源。

title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient-boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: https://jn-huang.github.io/householdbench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HouseholdBench，用 6 个美国家庭调查与 32 项预测任务评估 LLM 对家庭决策的预测能力，并发现梯度提升树总体最优，微调与预测聚合可缩小开源模型与专有模型的差距。
AI.motivation: 经济学希望获得能跨场景刻画家庭决策的定量模型，而现有 LLM 评估覆盖的调查与结果很少，且未研究家庭如何随经济条件变化而调整行为。
AI.method: 构建 HouseholdBench：整合 6 个美国家庭调查、32 项涵盖数值/分类/概率结果的预测任务（涉及消费、收入、劳动、预期、住房），输入包含过去行为、人口特征与宏观条件；评估 13 个专有与开源权重 LLM，并对比“不变”基线与梯度提升树模型。此外尝试微调与对每个观测聚合 16 次预测。
AI.result: 多数 LLM 优于不变基线，包括政策响应任务，最佳模型将数值结果误差降低 12.2%；多数任务上梯度提升树排名第一，领先专有 LLM 接近其表现，开源模型落后；LLM 存在系统性高估/低估。微调加聚合 16 次预测可使 40 亿参数开源模型达到专有模型水平，且改进可泛化到未参与微调的政策响应任务。
AI.conclusion: HouseholdBench 提供了评估 LLM 家庭决策预测能力的统一基准，表明 LLM 有潜力但尚不及强树模型；通过微调与预测聚合可有效提升小模型表现，相关数据集、代码与排行榜已公开。

title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
summary: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoonGS，首个面向月球场景的前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅框架，仅用两张稀疏漫游车图像即可单次前向预测像素对齐高斯基元，实现无需逐场景优化的高质量新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 月球地形的高质量 3D 重建对自主月球探测至关重要，但面临视角重叠不足、地表纹理微弱、数据量有限等挑战，传统逐场景优化方法难以胜任稀疏漫游车图像的快速重建。
AI.method: MoonGS 采用三方面设计：(i) 可适配骨干网络，无缝集成先进视觉基础模型以提取鲁棒深度特征；(ii) 语义先验双重整合，将语义线索与视觉特征融合以精化高斯参数估计，并引入语义排序损失正则化背景深度；(iii) 熵引导的启发式重采样策略，以极低开销选取最具信息量的远距离视点来增强稀疏观测。
AI.result: 在 LuSNAR 基准与自建弱纹理 MoonBlender 数据集上，MoonGS 较最先进的前馈式 NeRF/3DGS 基线提升 +4.9 dB PSNR、+0.29 SSIM，LPIPS 降低 40%，且保持亚秒级推理。框架可有效利用 VGGT 等先进骨干显著提升性能。在嫦娥任务影像上的定性评估也显示出对比方法中最佳的视觉质量，验证了其在真实月球数据上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MoonGS 验证了前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅在稀疏月球图像重建上的有效性与泛化能力，兼具高精度、快速推理与真实数据鲁棒性，源代码与数据集已开源。

title: Efficient and Implementation-Hardened RBLWE on Commodity Cortex-M Microcontrollers
summary: Efficient post-quantum cryptography on resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices requires implementations that exploit the target processor architecture while resisting practical implementation attacks. This paper presents an ISA-accelerated and implementation-hardened realization of Ring Binary Learning with Errors (RBLWE) encryption on a commodity ARM Cortex-M33 microcontroller. Packing four 8-bit polynomial coefficients into the byte lanes of a 32-bit register and processing them with SIMD-style instructions, together with a packed message codec, accelerates encryption and decryption, while a buffered hardware-TRNG entropy source drawn from the on-die Secure Element drives the key-generation gain. Together these give same-core cold-start speedups of $4.06\times$, $3.35\times$, and $3.01\times$ for key generation, encryption, and decryption over a scalar baseline, and $3.52\times$/$3.18\times$ lower encryption/decryption cycle counts than a reference Cortex-M0 implementation. On top of this accelerated core, we add four staged countermeasures: constant-time execution, fault hardening against zeroing, random-corruption, and instruction-skip faults, a Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO)-style CCA2 transform, and first-order shared (masked) CPA decryption, reporting each layer's cost individually. Binary-level inspection confirms these countermeasures survive compilation and identifies a compiler-induced masking flaw resolved with a hand-written assembly replacement. Dudect-style timing tests, debugger-assisted fault-injection campaigns, and component-level TVLA then provide implementation-level evidence for the staged protections. The results demonstrate a practical acceleration-security tradeoff for RBLWE on off-the-shelf microcontrollers and reusable architecture-aware techniques for lightweight post-quantum implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文在商用ARM Cortex-M33微控制器上实现了ISA加速并具备实现级防护的RBLWE加密方案，取得显著加速并逐层量化四种防护措施的开销。
AI.motivation: 资源受限IoT设备上的高效后量子密码需要既能利用目标处理器架构、又能抵抗实际实现攻击的实现方案，而现有工作往往难以兼顾加速与安全。
AI.method: 将4个8位多项式系数打包进32位寄存器的字节通道并用SIMD风格指令处理，配合打包消息编解码加速加解密；使用片上Secure Element驱动的带缓冲硬件TRNG熵源加速密钥生成；在加速内核上叠加四层分级防护：常数时间执行、针对置零/随机破坏/指令跳过故障的故障加固、FO式CCA2变换、一阶共享（掩码）CPA解密。通过二进制级检查验证防护能否在编译后保留，并用Dudect时序测试、调试器辅助故障注入和部件级TVLA进行评估。
AI.result: 相比标量基线，同核冷启动下密钥生成、加密、解密分别加速4.06×、3.35×、3.01×；加解密周期数比参考Cortex-M0实现低3.52×/3.18×。二进制级检查确认防护在编译后存活，并发现一个编译器引入的掩码缺陷，通过手写汇编替换解决。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了RBLWE在现货微控制器上的加速-安全权衡，并提供了可复用的架构感知轻量级后量子实现技术。

title: AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
summary: Modern language-model agents increasingly interact with external environments over long-horizon, multi-step trajectories, where the accumulated interaction history can quickly exceed practical context budgets. To ensure reliability, agents must maintain factual information over long horizons, remember execution errors and corrective feedback, and track progress across actions. Several approaches have been proposed to achieve this without the need for maintaining the entire execution history in context, such as using the reasoning and action history, learning to maintain a fixed-size memory through an overwrite mechanism, and periodic summarization. Although overwrite memory can in principle retain anything an append-only memory can, it must learn to carry each fact through every subsequent rewrite, which is difficult to learn from sparse outcome rewards; for interactive applications like web agents, we find that trained overwrite memories delete key information required by the trajectory, as well as corrective feedback received from the environment. We introduce AMBER (Append-only Memory Bank for Evidence Retention) - a simple and scalable framework where an agent jointly learns to reason, act, and write free-form memory, while an append-only rule guarantees retention by construction. This allows AMBER to be trained end-to-end with reinforcement learning from outcome rewards without the need for extensive curated SFT data. On WebArena Lite, AMBER improves average success over overwrite-based memory by 4.09 percentage points, increases the fraction of tasks solved in five repeated runs by 4.8 percentage points, and matches an overwrite baseline trained on substantially more expensive curated supervision. AMBER achieves these improvements while maintaining a practical token budget, providing a strong balance between context efficiency, task performance, and reliable long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: 提出 AMBER，一种仅追加的记忆库框架，让语言模型智能体在长程交互中通过强化学习端到端学习推理、行动与写记忆，保证信息按构造保留，在 WebArena Lite 上优于覆写式记忆。
AI.motivation: 长程多步轨迹中交互历史会迅速超出上下文预算，智能体需在长时程中保持事实信息、记住执行错误与纠正反馈并跟踪进度。已有方法如覆写式固定大小记忆虽理论上可保留任意内容，但需学习在每个后续重写中携带每个事实，难以从稀疏结果奖励中学到；在网页智能体等交互场景中，训练后的覆写记忆会删除轨迹所需的关键信息及环境反馈。
AI.method: AMBER（Append-only Memory Bank for Evidence Retention）是一个简单可扩展的框架：智能体联合学习推理、行动并写入自由形式的记忆，同时通过仅追加规则在构造上保证信息保留。由此可仅用结果奖励进行端到端强化学习训练，无需大量精心构建的 SFT 数据。
AI.result: 在 WebArena Lite 上，AMBER 相较基于覆写式记忆的平均成功率提升 4.09 个百分点，五次重复运行中解决任务的比例提升 4.8 个百分点，并达到与使用更昂贵人工监督训练的覆写基线相当的水平，同时维持实用的 token 预算。
AI.conclusion: AMBER 在上下文效率、任务性能与可靠长程执行之间取得良好平衡，为长程智能体记忆提供了一种有效且可扩展的方案。

title: Two Vectors Replace In-Context Demos: Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings
summary: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. To address these issues, we propose Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE), which replaces demos with two task-specific vectors added to existing input embeddings. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出STAVE方法，用两个任务特定向量替代演示样本实现上下文学习，在保持零样本推理成本的同时匹配或超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）能让冻结的大多模态模型（LMM）通过少量演示适配新任务，但每次查询都要重新编码演示，每张演示图像可能增加数百个视觉token，开销巨大。无演示方法虽用紧凑任务状态降低推理成本，但存在缺陷：任务参数需按任务搜索或加在每个解码层，参数量随深度增长；且插入的token或key无法改变原始提示在层内的注意力分配方式。
AI.method: 提出STAVE（Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings），用两个任务特定向量替代演示：一个readout向量更新产生答案的token，一个context向量更新其他结构性token组。两向量仅在已有输入embedding上相加，不改变层内注意力分配结构。用有演示和无演示提示的答案标签进行训练。通过损失的一阶分析和margin界从理论上论证设计选择的合理性。
AI.result: 在六个LMM和五个大语言模型上的大量实验表明，STAVE在多模态任务上以远少于现有方法的任务参数量匹配或超越当前最优方法；在18个文本任务上超越15-shot ICL和先前任务向量方法，且推理成本为零样本级别。
AI.conclusion: STAVE通过两个嵌入向量实现结构化任务适配，兼顾了性能、参数效率和零样本推理成本，是一种优于演示重编码和无演示任务状态方法的方案。

title: R2RI: A Multi-View Event and RGB Dataset for Robot-to-Robot Interaction
summary: Understanding and modeling interactions between autonomous agents is a fundamental challenge in robotics, with broad implications for collaborative systems, social robotics, and human-robot coexistence. Although the study of robot interactions has emerged as a compelling research direction, progress has been severely hampered by the absence of large-scale benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce Robot-to-Robot Interaction (R2RI), the first dataset specifically designed to address the Robot-Robot Interaction (RRI) task. R2RI consists of different humanoid robots and realistic interactions modeled on real human social behaviors. Complementary viewpoints are available, \textit{i.e.}, an egocentric perspective from each robot's onboard sensors, and an exocentric perspective from external fixed cameras, thus enabling rich spatial and contextual understanding of the interaction dynamics. The dataset comprises more than $6.5$M frames and $\approx5000$ videos at $120$ fps, including Event and RGB domains. We investigate pros and cons of each domain, comparing state-of-the-art approaches for a number of key sensing and interaction based tasks. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations for all tasks and modalities at https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个面向机器人-机器人交互（RRI）任务的数据集 R2RI，包含多种人形机器人与真实社交行为交互，提供自我中心与外中心双视角、事件与RGB双模态，超650万帧、约5000段视频，并对现有先进方法在多项感知与交互任务上进行评测。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体之间的交互理解与建模是机器人学的基础挑战，对协作系统、社交机器人和人机共处意义重大。然而该研究方向虽受关注，却因缺乏大规模基准数据集而进展严重受阻。
AI.method: 构建 R2RI 数据集：采用多种人形机器人，模拟真实人类社交行为进行交互；同时提供每个机器人机载传感器的自我中心视角与外部固定摄像头的外中心视角；数据包含 Event 与 RGB 两个域，规模超 650 万帧、约 5000 段视频、120 fps。并对比现有先进方法在多类感知与交互任务上的表现。
AI.result: 数据集具备丰富的空间与上下文交互动态信息；作者分析并比较了 RGB 与 Event 两种域在多项关键感知与交互任务上的优缺点及现有先进方法的表现。
AI.conclusion: R2RI 是首个专为机器人-机器人交互任务设计的数据集，填补了该领域大规模基准的空白，并公开数据、标注及多任务多模态资源以推动后续研究。

title: Lifecycle-Based Design and Evaluation of Real-Time Backup Triggers for Ransomware Damage Mitigation
summary: Ransomware continues to encrypt files during the interval between attack onset and detection. Real-time backups can mitigate this damage by preserving files before they are modified. The previously proposed Real-Time Open-File Backup System (ROFBS) triggers backups primarily on file-open events. However, the file lifecycle offers several candidate trigger points, including open, read, write, and rename operations. Triggering backups too early may create unnecessary backup files, whereas triggering them too late may allow ransomware writes to race with backup creation and prevent the preservation of clean file contents. Consequently, it remains unclear which trigger timing best balances recoverability and the number of backups created. In this study, we design and evaluate real-time backup triggers for mitigating ransomware damage from a file-lifecycle perspective. Specifically, we compare four strategies: Open-time backup, Read-time backup, Write-time backup, and Rename-time backup. We implement these strategies in an ROFBS-style prototype on XFS and evaluate them using five ransomware samples: Conti, Sodinokibi, AvosLocker, REvil, and HelloKitty. Our results clarify how trigger timing affects both damage mitigation and the number of backups created, providing design guidance for selecting effective triggers in real-time backup systems against ransomware.

AI.tldr: 本文从文件生命周期视角设计并评估四种实时备份触发策略（Open、Read、Write、Rename），在XFS上实现ROFBS原型并用五种勒索软件样本测试，明确了触发时机对损害缓解与备份数量的影响，为实时备份触发策略设计提供指导。
AI.motivation: 勒索软件在攻击发生到被检测之间的时间窗口内持续加密文件，实时备份可在文件被修改前保存内容以减轻损害。此前提出的ROFBS主要在文件打开事件时触发备份，但文件生命周期中存在open、read、write、rename等多个候选触发点。触发过早会产生不必要的备份文件，触发过晚则会使勒索软件的写操作与备份创建产生竞争，导致无法保存干净的原始文件内容。因此，哪种触发时机能最好地平衡可恢复性与备份数量仍不明确。
AI.method: 从文件生命周期视角设计并评估实时备份触发策略，具体比较四种策略：Open-time backup、Read-time backup、Write-time backup和Rename-time backup。在XFS文件系统上以ROFBS风格实现原型系统，并采用五种勒索软件样本（Conti、Sodinokibi、AvosLocker、REvil、HelloKitty）进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果阐明了触发时机如何影响损害缓解效果与所创建的备份数量，揭示了不同触发策略在可恢复性与备份开销之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为面向勒索软件的实时备份系统中有效触发策略的选择提供了设计指导，有助于在保证可恢复性的同时控制备份数量。

title: Is this machine playing?
summary: We placed a modern AI coding assistant in an unintended role: as the mind of a body on an unknown digital island. With only a minimal instruction mentioning no specific task, reward, or activity, the machine started animating its virtual body. Across thirty-hour runs, the embodied AI agent climbed hills, stacked blocks into towers, drew mandalas, reinterpreted sports, ran experiments on the physics of its world, and learned techniques that later expanded what it could accomplish. These activities recurred across thirteen agents but diverged into distinct histories. We examine whether this behavior satisfies classical criteria for play and ask whether play can become a mode of machine development.

AI.tldr: 研究者将现代AI编程助手置于一个未知数字岛屿上作为虚拟身体的心智，仅给出极简指令（未指定任务、奖励或活动）。在三十小时的运行中，具身AI智能体爬山、堆叠方块、绘制曼陀罗、重新诠释运动、进行物理实验，并习得可扩展其能力的技能。这些活动在十三个智能体间重复出现，但各自分化为不同的历史。研究考察该行为是否满足"玩耍"的经典判据，并探讨玩耍能否成为机器发展的一种模式。
AI.motivation: 探索当AI被置于无明确任务、奖励或目标设定的开放环境中时会自发产生何种行为，并检验其是否可被理解为"玩耍"，进而思考玩耍作为机器发展模式的潜力。
AI.method: 将现代AI编程助手作为具身智能体放置于未知数字岛屿的虚拟身体中，仅提供极简指令；进行三十小时的长时间运行实验，共观察十三个智能体；分析其自发行为并对照"玩耍"的经典判据进行评估。
AI.result: 智能体自发进行了爬山、堆叠方块成塔、绘制曼陀罗、重新诠释运动、开展物理实验等活动，并习得能扩展其后续能力的技能；这些行为在十三个智能体间重复出现，但演化出各自不同的历史轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该研究考察具身AI的自发行为是否满足"玩耍"的经典判据，并提出了玩耍能否成为机器发展模式这一开放性问题。

title: Large Language Model Orchestration under Heterogeneous Preferences via Explicit Persona Inference
summary: LLM orchestration investigates how an orchestrator coordinates a group of autonomous agents to achieve common goals or maximize collective welfare. The agents are typically heterogeneous, each holding a private preference that it pursues but does not reveal. Inferring such hidden preferences from behavior has been a subject of long-standing research in game theory and multi-agent systems. The core challenge lies in maintaining a belief over every agent's preference and updating it from the agents' observed actions. Existing LLM orchestrators carry that belief as prompt text with no explicit update rule. This lets early errors persist and propagate rather than be corrected. We therefore propose \textbf{HARP} (Heterogeneous-preference Agent oRchestration via Preference inference), a novel framework that moves the belief out of the prompt. Specifically, HARP maintains one numeric posterior per agent over a finite set of candidate preferences and updates it in closed form by Bayes' rule. The language model supplies only actions and per-candidate likelihoods, so estimation is decoupled from its reasoning. We prove that HARP attains the same $\tilde O(\sqrt K)$ Bayesian regret as explicit joint inference when the factorization is exact. Furthermore, HARP\textsuperscript{+} augments planning with a bonus for actions that distinguish the candidates, so inference continues even when the optimal action is uninformative. Empirical results on three substrates, ranging from payoffs the preferences fully determine, through payoffs that depend on more than them, to scales where explicit joint inference is infeasible, demonstrate that HARP\textsuperscript{+} is the strongest non-oracle method across the class our theory identifies.

AI.tldr: 提出HARP框架，将多智能体偏好信念从提示词中移出，用贝叶斯规则对每个智能体维护数值后验，实现解耦的偏好推断与编排。
AI.motivation: LLM编排需协调异质自主智能体达成共同目标，但每个智能体持有不公开的私有偏好。核心挑战在于维护并对每个智能体偏好的信念进行更新。现有LLM编排器将信念以提示文本形式承载，缺乏显式更新规则，导致早期错误持续并传播而无法纠正。
AI.method: 提出HARP框架：为每个智能体在一个有限候选偏好集合上维护一个数值后验，并利用贝叶斯规则以闭式形式更新；语言模型仅提供动作与各候选的似然度，使估计与模型推理解耦。进一步提出HARP+，在规划中加入奖励项以鼓励选择能区分候选的动作，从而在最优动作无信息时仍可继续推断。
AI.result: 理论上证明在分解精确时，HARP达到与显式联合推断相同的Õ(√K)贝叶斯遗憾。在三种实验环境下（从偏好完全决定收益，到收益依赖更多因素，再到显式联合推断不可行的规模），HARP+在所识别方法类中为最强的非预言机方法。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好信念外置为数值后验并用贝叶斯闭式更新，可有效避免LLM编排中的错误累积，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models yield strong performance on static perception and reasoning benchmarks, yet such evaluations largely overlook a central aspect of intelligence: acting competently in dynamic environments over extended time horizons. We introduce PlaySuite, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interactive visual intelligence across more than 5K open-source video games curated from PyWeek and itch.io. Spanning diverse genres and engines, including Pygame, HTML5, Godot, and Unity, these independent games are largely out-of-distribution for current models, reducing the likelihood that success can be achieved by retrieving memorized walkthroughs or web-scale training artifacts. To enable scalable evaluation across heterogeneous titles, we develop a unified closed-loop interaction framework optimized for HPC clusters alongside a Video-LLM-as-a-judge protocol that maps observable gameplay milestones to standardized progress levels. We evaluate fourteen recent open models spanning vision-language models, computer-use agents, and vision-language-action models. Our results yield strong evidence of a perception-action gap: despite strong reasoning capabilities, current models struggle to make sustained progress and exhibit recurring failures in spatial grounding, action execution, and self-correction. PlaySuite provides a reproducible and extensible testbed for measuring progress from visual perception to goal-directed interaction, and a foundation for developing models that can act, adapt, and generalize in dynamic visual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PlaySuite，一个基于 5K+ 开源视频游戏的大规模交互式视觉智能基准，评估 14 个开源模型后发现明显的“感知-行动鸿沟”。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型评测多聚焦静态感知与推理，忽视了在动态环境中长时间跨度的行动能力这一智能核心维度。
AI.method: 从 PyWeek 和 itch.io 收集 5K+ 开源视频游戏，涵盖 Pygame、HTML5、Godot、Unity 等多种引擎与体裁；构建面向 HPC 集群的统一闭环交互框架，并提出 Video-LLM-as-a-judge 协议，将可观察的游戏里程碑映射为标准化进度等级。
AI.result: 评估了 14 个近期开源模型（视觉语言模型、计算机使用智能体、视觉-语言-行动模型）。结果显示明显的感知-行动鸿沟：模型虽具备较强推理能力，却难以持续取得进展，并反复出现空间定位、动作执行与自我纠错方面的失败。
AI.conclusion: PlaySuite 为衡量从视觉感知到目标导向交互的进展提供了可复现、可扩展的测试平台，也为在动态视觉环境中行动、适应与泛化的模型研发奠定基础。

title: The Amplifier Effect: Human-Factor Risks of AI-Suggested Correlation and Auto-Propagation in Multi-Framework GRC Self-Assessment
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: Multi-framework Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) platforms increasingly automate the link between an organisation's self-assessment answer and the compliance obligations that answer is said to satisfy. Cross-framework control mapping, AI-suggested question correlation, and automatic propagation of answers and evidence across correlated questions all serve the legitimate efficiency goal of reducing duplicate work for small and medium-sized enterprises under the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR. The same mechanisms, however, amplify the consequences of any human-factor bias in a single answer: one optimistically-graded control, one rubber-stamped attestation, or one AI-drafted answer can be silently replicated as evidence of compliance with many obligations across multiple frameworks. We call this the amplifier effect: a platform-design property (coarse-grained attestation and un-gated propagation) rather than a failing of individual users. Using two EU-funded SME-facing GRC platforms, CYBERFORT and CYBER-BRIDGE, as examples, we (i) describe the amplification mechanism in concrete data-model terms, (ii) propose a six-dimension scoring framework for evaluating any GRC tool's exposure to the effect, (iii) instantiate the framework on a thirteen-tool comparison covering enterprise IRM, mid-market platforms, compliance-automation tools, and the two EU SME projects, and (iv) outline a measurement protocol that a consortium with access to production self-assessment data can run. The thirteen-tool comparison is a structured design assessment, not an empirical measurement of user behaviour. The EU SME platforms score lowest on the amplifier dimensions because their burden-reduction design deliberately trades sign-off granularity for throughput; we report this as a design trade-off, not a verdict on the platforms. Our contribution is the framing and the measurement protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"放大器效应"概念：多框架GRC平台中粗粒度认证与无门控传播会把单个人为偏差（乐观评级、走过场认证、AI代写答案）静默复制为跨框架多义务的合规证据。作者以两个欧盟中小企业GRC平台为例，描述放大机制、提出六维评分框架、对13款工具做结构化设计评估，并给出测量协议。
AI.motivation: 多框架GRC平台通过跨框架控制映射、AI问题关联、答案与证据自动传播来帮助中小企业（受CRA、NIS2、GDPR约束）减少重复工作，这一效率目标本身合理；但同样的机制会放大单个人为因素偏差的后果——一个乐观评级或AI代写答案可能被静默复制为多框架多义务的合规证据。作者希望把这一问题从"用户个人失误"重新定位为平台设计属性，并呼吁可测量的评估方法。
AI.method: 以两个欧盟资助的中小企业GRC平台CYBERFORT与CYBER-BRIDGE为案例：(i) 用具体数据模型术语刻画放大机制；(ii) 提出评估任意GRC工具暴露度的六维评分框架；(iii) 在13款工具（覆盖企业IRM、中型市场平台、合规自动化工具及两个欧盟中小企业项目）上实例化该框架；(iv) 概述可供有生产自评数据访问权的联合体执行的测量协议。该13款工具比较属结构化设计评估，而非用户行为的实证测量。
AI.result: 在13款工具的结构化设计评估中，两个欧盟中小企业平台在放大器维度上得分最低，原因在于其减负设计有意以签核粒度换取处理吞吐量，作者将此报告为设计权衡而非对平台的评判。研究本身未提供用户行为实证数据，主要产出是评分框架与测量协议。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献在于"放大器效应"这一问题框定与配套测量协议，而非对具体平台的优劣裁决；粗粒度认证与无门控传播是平台设计属性，需在效率与签核粒度之间做出显式权衡，并可由后续实证测量验证。

title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments Using an Ackermann-Steered Mobile Robot
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to navigate through environments using natural language instructions, making human-robot interaction intuitive. Traditional VLN models often rely on navigation graphs, 360-degree views, and perfect localization which pose significant challenges when adapting these models to real-world settings. This work addresses these limitations by performing a simulation-to-real domain shift of a VLN approach that operates in continuous environments without requiring navigation graphs or panoramic views. The proposed system integrates vision-language models that align visual inputs and linguistic instructions within a shared embedding space, facilitating natural language-driven navigation. We employ a Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) based architecture trained on an existing dataset in a simulated environment and fine-tune it using real-world data collected from a custom-built Ackermann-steered robot equipped with a camera and a LiDAR sensor. By utilising linear photometric adjustments and fine-tuning on a limited number of episodes, our model successfully adapts to real-world environments, achieving effective navigation while running offline on dedicated hardware. Experimental results, evaluated using Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) and Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) metrics, demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of our approach. Keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Cross-Modal Attention, Natural Language Instructions, Sim-to-Real Transfer, Autonomous Navigation, Ackermann-steering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种跨模态注意力（CMA）视觉语言导航（VLN）方法，在连续环境中无需导航图或全景视图，并通过光度调整与少量真实数据微调完成仿真到现实的迁移，在Ackermann转向机器人上实现离线有效导航。
AI.motivation: 传统VLN模型依赖导航图、360度全景视图和精确的定位信息，这些在真实世界场景中难以满足，导致模型向实际部署迁移时面临巨大挑战。因此作者希望构建一个能在连续环境中工作、不依赖导航图与全景视图的VLN系统，并实现仿真到现实的有效迁移。
AI.method: 在连续环境中运行、无需导航图与全景视图的VLN框架；将视觉输入与语言指令对齐到共享嵌入空间；采用基于跨模态注意力（CMA）的架构，先在仿真环境现有数据集上训练；使用自建的Ackermann转向机器人（配备相机与LiDAR）采集真实数据；通过线性光度调整与少量episode微调完成适配；模型可离线运行于专用硬件。
AI.result: 模型成功适应真实环境并实现有效导航，可离线在专用硬件上运行；采用SPL（按路径长度加权的成功率）与nDTW（归一化动态时间规整）指标评估，实验结果验证了方法的鲁棒性与适应性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在连续环境中使用CMA架构并结合线性光度调整与少量真实数据微调，可在不依赖导航图、全景视图和精确定位的前提下实现VLN的仿真到现实迁移，并在真实机器人上获得鲁棒且可离线运行的导航效果。

title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
summary: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出循环环回Transformer（RLT），将层分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器，使每token计算路径随序列长度增长，在算法任务上大幅优于标准Transformer。
AI.motivation: 状态跟踪需要对每个输入进行更新，但Transformer对每个token施加的深度不随序列长度变化，难以处理长序列的状态跟踪。
AI.method: RLT将八层分为并行因果编码器和循环解码器；在每个token处，解码器将编码器输出与上一token的最终解码状态合并，使计算路径随序列长度增长而保持固定的每token开销。在六个算法任务上，比较八层的五种拆分与八层Transformer（三个随机种子）。
AI.result: 最多训练40位时，两种RLT拆分在所有种子中将奇偶校验泛化到256位且100%准确，而Transformer仅为随机水平；在8倍训练长度的基于交换的S5置换跟踪中，RLT最终状态准确率达97%，Transformer低于1%，且准确率随解码器深度增加；模运算超出训练长度时RLT达93%对比33%。消融显示收益依赖反馈，移除反馈后奇偶校验和置换任务均降至随机水平；每四token块更新一次反馈可保留64位奇偶校验99%，但置换跟踪依赖逐token反馈，分块使长度64的置换从100%降至20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将反馈式循环解码器与并行编码器结合，RLT以固定每token成本获得随序列长度增长的计算深度，显著提升长序列状态跟踪与泛化能力，且循环反馈是关键，部分任务需逐token反馈。

title: CALR: Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning via Render-of-Thought Compression
summary: Visual latent reasoning compresses rendered derivations into compact intermediate states, reducing textual reasoning overhead. Existing approaches differ in how they represent these states: continuous methods avoid vocabulary constraints, whereas discrete methods improve accuracy through quantization into a finite codebook. Our analysis of representative continuous and discrete systems identifies two functional requirements: answers must rely on latent states, and those states must carry valid, problem-specific reasoning. Continuous latents influence answers despite collapsed reasoning content, whereas discrete latents retain recoverable intermediate reasoning that answer prediction largely bypasses. To address these challenges, we propose Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR), which connects latent formation with answer use through functional anchoring. With reference latents from information-balanced compression, CALR couples latent-mediated answer supervision with derivation-level semantic anchoring: the former routes answer supervision through intermediate states, while the latter grounds their decoded content in problem-specific derivations. A parallel-to-autoregressive curriculum develops sequential reasoning by conditioning subsequent latent blocks on generated prefixes. Evaluations on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks across model families show substantial accuracy gains. Under matched budgets, CALR gains 26.0 percentage points over a comparable continuous latent reasoning method. Further analyses show that its latents support answer prediction and carry problem-specific intermediate reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR），通过“功能锚定”将潜在状态的形成与其在答案预测中的使用联系起来，在五个数学推理基准上取得显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉潜在推理方法分为连续方法与离散方法：连续方法不受词表约束，但推理内容易塌缩；离散方法通过量化提升准确率，却使答案预测绕过可恢复的中间推理。作者分析代表性系统后，归纳出两个功能需求——答案必须依赖潜在状态，且这些状态必须携带有效的、问题特定的推理内容。
AI.method: 提出 CALR，用功能锚定连接潜在状态的形成与答案使用。使用来自信息均衡压缩的参考潜在状态，将“潜在介导的答案监督”与“推导级语义锚定”相耦合：前者让答案监督经过中间状态，后者把解码内容锚定到问题特定的推导。并采用并行到自回归的课程，通过以已生成前缀为条件来发展序列推理。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准、多个模型家族上取得显著准确率提升；在匹配预算下，相比可比的连续潜在推理方法提升 26.0 个百分点。进一步分析表明其潜在状态既支持答案预测，又携带问题特定的中间推理。
AI.conclusion: CALR 通过功能锚定同时满足“答案依赖潜在状态”和“潜在状态携带有效推理”两个需求，证明连续潜在推理可以在保持无词表约束优势的同时实现准确且可解释的推理。

title: Plug-and-Play Quantum-Resistant BLE Pairing for Medical Implants via NFC Out-of-Band
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on E-health Networking, Application & Services (IEEE HealthCom 2026), October 19-21, 2026, New York, USA
summary: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) pairing establishes the cryptographic foundation for secure device communication. However, mainstream man-in-the-middle (MITM)-resistant pairing methods, such as Numeric Comparison and Passkey Entry, require user interfaces that implantable medical devices (IMDs) inherently lack, making Near-Field Communication (NFC)-assisted Out-of-Band (OOB) pairing an attractive alternative. Existing NFC-assisted OOB schemes authenticate a classical BLE key exchange that remains vulnerable to quantum attacks, while the NFC channel itself is susceptible to eavesdropping and active injection under stronger threat models. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight, plug-and-play NFC-based OOB pairing protocol that performs a post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism (KEM) entirely over the NFC channel, ensuring that no shared secret is transmitted over NFC while reducing long-range radio-frequency (RF) exposure during pairing. The proposed protocol requires no modifications to the BLE stack and inherently resists RF battery-depletion attacks. Evaluation on an IMD-class proof-of-concept testbed demonstrates that post-quantum OOB pairing is practical on resource-constrained devices, reducing projected battery life by less than 0.57\% for Kyber-1024 and 0.56\% for FireSABER under an operational usage model relative to the MITM-vulnerable Just Works method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级、即插即用的基于NFC的带外（OOB）配对协议，将后量子KEM完全运行于NFC信道，实现植入式医疗设备的抗量子、抗MITM安全配对。
AI.motivation: BLE配对是安全通信的密码学基础，但主流抗MITM方法（Numeric Comparison、Passkey Entry）需要用户界面，而植入式医疗设备（IMD）不具备此类界面。NFC辅助OOB配对是理想替代方案，但现有方案仍基于经典密钥交换、无法抵御量子攻击，且NFC信道在更强威胁模型下易受窃听与主动注入攻击。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级、即插即用的NFC-OOB配对协议，将后量子密钥封装机制（KEM）完全在NFC信道上执行：NFC信道不传输任何共享密钥，并减少配对期间的长距离射频暴露；无需修改BLE协议栈，天然抵抗射频电池耗尽攻击。在IMD级概念验证平台上进行评估（Kyber-1024与FireSABER）。
AI.result: 在IMD级概念验证测试平台上，后量子OOB配对在资源受限设备上可行；相较易受MITM攻击的Just Works方法，在典型使用模型下Kyber-1024使预计电池寿命下降不到0.57%，FireSABER下降0.56%。
AI.conclusion: 后量子NFC-OOB配对在资源受限的植入式医疗设备上具备实用性，仅带来可忽略的电池寿命开销，同时兼顾抗量子、抗MITM与抗射频耗尽攻击的安全属性。

title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, Manuscript submitted for publication in Elsevier Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能量自适应噪声调度与白化策略，用于变换域扩散模型，通过结合全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配，改善前向扩散噪声调度。
AI.motivation: 现有谱扩散方法虽通过系数缩放、归一化或频率优先等方式处理变换系数的非均匀统计，但前向扩散的噪声调度基本独立于谱能量分布。本文探究前向扩散过程的时间演化是否也应遵循自然图像的谱组织规律。
AI.method: 提出一种结合全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配的公式，根据单个变换系数的能量及图像依赖的扩散时间能量路径联合调制注入噪声。该方法保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，且无需修改扩散架构即可兼容标准DDPM和DDIM流程。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上的实验表明，所提出的能量条件噪声调度与谱白化有效，将紧凑DCTdiff U-Net变体的Fréchet Inception Distance从142.48降至100.45。
AI.conclusion: 前向扩散的噪声调度应遵循自然图像的谱能量组织，所提能量自适应策略在不改变扩散架构的前提下显著提升生成质量。

title: Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
summary: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的未来感知KV缓存淘汰方法LORE-KV，利用模型自生成短续写的查询状态估计token效用，在LongBench和RULER上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法多基于"阅读提示时哪些记忆看起来重要"，而非"回答时哪些记忆会重要"。由于淘汰时解码查询不可得，已有未来感知方法依赖伪响应或合成估计。本文将其建模为对模型条件查询轨迹的分布估计问题。
AI.method: LORE-KV从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，用其响应侧查询状态估计提示token效用；通过投影式留一注意力输出删除代价打分，并在多次采样未来上聚合，可选轨迹加权。临时续写在最终解码前丢弃，无需辅助模型或训练。
AI.result: B=128时，单条响应侧续写可恢复相对提示窗口控制约89%的增益；LongBench上Qwen2.5-14B平均分从45.49升至48.24(+2.75)，Mistral-7B的16K RULER平均分从45.20升至51.05(+5.85)。缓存预算更大时增益递减，并存在任务级回退。相比AnDPro，单样本墙钟时间为1.46-2.77倍，属一次性压缩开销，覆盖六种稠密与混合注意力骨干。
AI.conclusion: 将未来感知淘汰视为分布估计是有效的，基于自生成续写的响应侧查询信号能显著提升有限缓存下的长上下文性能，但需权衡额外计算开销、预算依赖性及部分任务回退。

title: Deep Learning Based Illegal Bowling Action Detection
summary: Cricket, often referred to as the "gentleman's game," adheres to a strict rule set for both batsmen and bowlers, where each delivery can significantly impact the match outcome. Detecting illegal bowling actions is crucial for maintaining fair play, yet it remains challenging for umpires to monitor in real time. Existing sensor-based solutions have limitations in live match scenarios, making real-time assessment difficult. This paper proposes a computer vision-based deep learning solution to detect illegal bowling actions in live cricket matches. To develop and evaluate our approach, we compiled a dataset of 62 videos featuring 11 male bowlers, capturing both legal and illegal bowling actions from multiple angles-front, back, and side. However, the dataset predominantly comprises right-handed bowlers with conventional actions. The proposed system identifies two key frames, the shoulder frame and the release frame from video footage of a bowler's delivery and analyzes the change in the bowling arm's angle between these frames. If the angle difference exceeds a predefined threshold (e.g., 15 degrees), the delivery is flagged as potentially illegal. We evaluated the system on a custom dataset and achieved a high true positive rate, suggesting the system's potential effectiveness in real-time match settings. However, further research is required to validate the system across diverse environmental conditions and larger datasets to ensure generalizability and robustness in various live match scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first AI-based computer vision method for detecting illegal bowling actions in cricket.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于计算机视觉与深度学习的板球非法投球动作检测方法，通过提取肩部帧与出手帧并分析投球臂角度变化来判定动作是否违规。
AI.motivation: 板球对投球动作有严格规则，非法投球影响比赛公平，但裁判难以实时监控；现有基于传感器的方案在真实比赛场景中受限，难以实现实时评估。
AI.method: 构建含62段视频、11名男性投球手（覆盖正、背、侧多角度及合法/非法动作）的数据集；系统从投球视频中识别两个关键帧——肩部帧和出手帧，计算两帧之间投球臂角度的变化，若角度差超过预设阈值（如15度）则标记为疑似非法投球。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上取得较高的真阳性率，表明该系统在实时比赛场景中具有潜在有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个用于检测板球非法投球动作的AI计算机视觉方法，但数据集以右手投球手和常规动作为主，仍需在多样化环境条件和更大数据集上验证其泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: Preparing an AI-Augmented SIEM for the EU Cyber Resilience Act: A Practitioner Case Study
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, makes product cybersecurity a lifecycle obligation for products with digital elements on the EU market: risk assessment, vulnerability handling, conformity documentation, and Article 14 incident- and vulnerability-reporting readiness must be operational before market placement. Small and medium-sized enterprises that build security products are doubly exposed, since their products are in scope while their customers expect them to be exemplary. This case study documents a CRA preparedness pilot for one such product, SEUXDR, an AI-augmented security monitoring product with a large-language-model active-response component, on the open-source CYBERFORT platform. We contribute a reproducible six-step recipe (Scope and Classify, Asset Registration, Produce Evidence, Map to CRA, Gap and Actions, Audit Pack), two end-to-end traceability threads, and a pilot snapshot tracing product risks through baseline and AI-specific controls and policies to CRA objectives. It offers practitioners a replicable starting point for translating CRA legal text into operational preparedness for incident response, vulnerability reporting, and conformity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文以SEUXDR安全产品为案例，在开源CYBERFORT平台上开展欧盟《网络韧性法案》(CRA)合规准备试点，提出可复现的六步方法、两条端到端追溯链及试点快照，帮助中小企业将CRA法律条文转化为可操作的合规准备。
AI.motivation: 欧盟CRA（2024/2847）将产品网络安全变为数字产品上市前的全生命周期义务，涉及风险评估、漏洞处理、合规文档及第14条事件与漏洞报告准备。构建安全产品的中小企业面临双重压力：自身产品在监管范围内，同时客户又期待其成为合规典范，因此亟需可落地的合规准备指引。
AI.method: 采用案例研究法，针对带有大语言模型主动响应组件的AI增强安全监控产品SEUXDR，在开源CYBERFORT平台上开展CRA准备试点。提出可复现的六步方法：范围与分类、资产登记、证据产出、映射到CRA、差距与行动、审计包；并构建两条端到端追溯链及一个试点快照，将产品风险经由基线与AI特定控制措施和政策追溯至CRA目标。
AI.result: 形成了一套可复现的六步合规准备流程、两条端到端追溯链，以及将产品风险通过基线与AI特定控制措施和政策映射至CRA目标的试点快照，验证了该方法在实际产品上的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为从业者提供了可复制的起点，将CRA法律条文转化为事件响应、漏洞报告和合规评估方面的可操作准备，尤其有助于面临双重合规压力的中小企业开展CRA合规工作。

title: Cascadia: Resident 975B MoE Inference on Eleven AI PCs
summary: Mixture-of-experts models make nearly trillion-parameter capacity accessible with sparse per-token computation, provided that the serving system can distribute the weights and coordinate their execution. We present Cascadia's resident execution of Inkling, a 975B-total/41B-active-parameter model, on eleven Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PCs, each with 64 GB of memory, Arc B390 integrated graphics and gigabit Ethernet. We contribute a custom resident MoE engine that preserves Inkling's routing rules, constructs compressed graphs for OpenVINO's fused iGPU primitives, and coordinates FP16 expert computation with FP32 output restoration. The engine fits six consecutive decoder layers per machine and represents dense feed-forward blocks as all-active expert slices, reducing measured dense-layer call time from approximately 8.1 to 4.5 ms. A streaming pipeline coordinates concurrent generation, while captured-state draft evaluation measures agreement with the deployed numerical path. Paired measurements at fifteen concurrency levels from 1 to 176 streams reach 60.29 aggregate decode tokens/s at 88 streams, with 46.87 tokens/s over the complete serving phases. At fifteen streams, median first-token latency is 6.05 s. Raising the context budget from the 1,024-position default, real prompts of 1k to 64k tokens recover the embedded code in all 19 measured answers, with first-token time growing as $aN+bN^2$ and decode latency growing approximately linearly, both bounded by a single-threaded CPU attention loop rather than by memory, which holds 512k positions per stream. Evaluation on captured fleet states separates the effects of vocabulary selection and weight quantization on draft agreement. Together, these contributions establish an execution and evaluation approach for large sparse models on distributed client systems with shared CPU-GPU memory.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Cascadia 系统在 11 台 Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PC 上常驻执行 975B 总参数/41B 激活参数的 Inkling 混合专家模型，通过定制 MoE 引擎、OpenVINO 融合原语与流式管线，实现分布式客户端系统上的大规模稀疏模型推理。
AI.motivation: 混合专家模型以稀疏的逐 token 计算提供了近万亿参数容量，但前提是服务系统能够分发权重并协调执行。作者希望验证在共享 CPU-GPU 内存的分布式客户端设备上执行超大规模稀疏模型的可行性。
AI.method: 提出定制常驻 MoE 引擎，保留 Inkling 的路由规则，为 OpenVINO 融合 iGPU 原语构建压缩计算图，并将 FP16 专家计算与 FP32 输出恢复相协调。每台机器容纳六个连续解码器层，将稠密前馈块表示为全激活专家切片。采用流式管线协调并发生成，并通过捕获状态草稿评估衡量与部署数值路径的一致性。
AI.result: 稠密层调用时间从约 8.1 ms 降至 4.5 ms。在 1 至 176 流的十五个并发级别上，88 流时达到 60.29 聚合解码 token/s，完整服务阶段为 46.87 token/s；15 流时首 token 延迟中位数为 6.05 s。将上下文预算从默认 1024 位置提升后，1k 至 64k token 的真实提示在全部 19 个测量答案中恢复出嵌入代码，首 token 时间按 aN+bN² 增长，解码延迟近似线性增长，均受单线程 CPU 注意力循环限制，每流可保持 512k 位置。
AI.conclusion: 在捕获的集群状态评估中，区分了词表选择与权重量化对草稿一致性的影响。这些工作共同为共享 CPU-GPU 内存的分布式客户端系统上执行与评估大规模稀疏模型建立了一套方法与路径。

title: DLoop: Looped Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

AI.tldr: 提出 DLoop，一种循环式推测解码方法，在验证前自适应进行多轮起草，减少目标模型前向次数，实现 5%~41% 的加速且保持无损解码。
AI.motivation: 随着草稿模型能力增强，目标模型常在一个起草阶段就接受全部草稿 token，但每个起草阶段后仍要执行验证，导致不必要的目标模型前向计算，即使本可继续起草。现有自适应草稿长度方法只对自回归草稿模型有效，对并行草稿模型而言，继续起草需要未验证草稿 token 的目标模型隐状态。
AI.method: DLoop 采用循环式推测解码，在验证前自适应执行多个起草阶段：当草稿模型保持自信时持续起草，最终一次性验证累积的所有草稿 token。同时引入循环感知训练，让草稿模型接触未验证草稿 token 自身的隐状态，从而在额外起草阶段保持可靠。
AI.result: 在 EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark 及多 token 预测模块等多种推测解码方法上，DLoop 将实际运行加速提升 5%~41%，并保持无损解码。
AI.conclusion: 通过增加草稿模型前向计算来换取更少的目标模型验证前向，DLoop 为并行草稿模型提供了一种有效的加速范式，适用于多种推测解码框架且不损失输出质量。

title: Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network for Early Breast Cancer Detection in Low-Resource Clinical Settings
comment: 5 double pages numbers, conference paper presented at AI4SD 2026 (https://www.mu.edu.et/index.php/component/content/article/artificial-intelligence-for-sustainable-development-conference-participants?catid=69&Itemid=101)
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women in Sub-Saharan Africa, where delayed diagnosis results from limited radiology expertise and fragmented clinical data systems. Although deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in mammographic analysis, most rely solely on imaging data and are trained on Western populations, limiting their applicability in African healthcare settings. This paper presents a Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network (HCMAN) that integrates mammogram images with structured clinical data using transformer-based cross-modal attention mechanisms. The model was developed and validated using a locally collected dataset of 2,560 mammogram images from 1,024 patients across four Ethiopian referral hospitals, with biopsy-confirmed ground truth labels. The proposed framework achieves 97.8% accuracy, 97.2% sensitivity, 98.3% specificity, and an AUC of 0.987, significantly outperforming image-only baselines. The system demonstrates robustness to low-quality images typical of resource-limited settings, with only 3.2% performance degradation compared to 8.7% for image-only models. Cross-modal attention analysis reveals clinically appropriate behavior: higher reliance on clinical features for ambiguous cases such as dense breasts and young patients. The model's lightweight architecture enables deployment on standard hospital workstations (<2 seconds inference on CPU). This work advances sustainable, context-aware AI solutions for equitable breast cancer diagnostics in Africa.

AI.tldr: 提出融合乳腺钼靶影像与结构化临床数据的混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），在埃塞俄比亚四家医院1024例患者2560张图像上验证，AUC达0.987，且在低质量图像下更稳健、可CPU快速部署。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲乳腺癌死亡率高，诊断延迟源于放射专业人才不足与临床数据系统碎片化；现有深度学习模型多仅用影像且基于西方人群训练，难以适用于非洲医疗场景。研究动机在于构建可持续、契合本地情境的公平诊断AI方案。
AI.method: 构建混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），采用基于Transformer的跨模态注意力机制整合乳腺钼靶图像与结构化临床数据。使用本地采集数据集开发与验证：来自埃塞俄比亚四家转诊医院的1024例患者、2560张钼靶图像，金标准为活检确诊标签。并与仅影像基线模型进行对比。
AI.result: 准确率97.8%、敏感度97.2%、特异度98.3%、AUC 0.987，显著优于仅影像基线。资源受限场景低质量图像下性能下降仅3.2%，而仅影像模型为8.7%。跨模态注意力分析显示临床合理行为：对致密乳腺、年轻患者等模糊病例更依赖临床特征。轻量架构支持标准医院工作站部署，CPU推理<2秒。
AI.conclusion: 融合影像与临床数据的跨模态注意力框架在非洲本地人群乳腺钼靶诊断中表现优异、稳健且易于部署，为非洲公平乳腺癌诊断提供了可持续、情境感知的AI解决方案。

title: Don't Let One Lie Survive A Hundred Truths: A Selective Bayesian Trust Estimator for Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles to see beyond their own sensors but makes them dependent on messages they cannot independently verify. A compromised collaborator can surgically conceal a single safety-critical object or inject a non-existing one while correctly reporting many others. Existing Bayesian trust mechanisms pool agreement across objects, which, while effective against blatant untargeted attacks, either incurs high false-positive rates (FPR), or allows unrelated correct reports to dilute persistent attack evidence for stealthy single-object attackers. To address this problem, we propose SABER, a selective two-tier Bayesian trust estimator. The first tier maintains broad agent and object trust, preserving the ability to downweight benign but low-quality contributors.
