summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens that are verified by a target model in parallel. However, the standard acceptance rule focuses on exact distribution correction and rejects tokens that remain highly plausible under the target model when the draft model assigns excess probability. This conservative verification limits the number of draft tokens retained after each verification forward pass. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a relaxed verification method that incorporates target-model plausibility into speculative decoding. NSD accepts a draft token if it satisfies the standard acceptance rule or belongs to the target model's nucleus. We theoretically characterize the distributional deviation introduced by our method and show that the single-step error is exactly determined by the draft model's excess probability within the target nucleus. We further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds that quantify how local deviations accumulate over autoregressive decoding. Experiments across multiple target models and proposal mechanisms demonstrate that NSD consistently improves speculative decoding efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance. Our method achieves throughput speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and up to $3.15\times$ over standard speculative decoding. These improvements coincide with longer accepted lengths, allowing more output tokens to share the cost of each target verification pass. Analysis shows that plausibility-aware verification provides an effective approach for relaxed verification and speculative decoding efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD)，一种放宽验证条件的推测解码方法，将目标模型合理性纳入验证，提升效率并保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 标准推测解码的接受规则只关注精确分布校正，会拒绝在目标模型下仍高度合理的 token，导致每次验证后保留的草稿 token 数量受限，验证过于保守。
AI.method: NSD 放宽验证：若草稿 token 满足标准接受规则，或属于目标模型的 nucleus，则接受该 token。理论上刻画了引入的分布偏差，证明单步误差由草稿模型在目标 nucleus 内的超额概率决定，并推导序列级保真度界。
AI.result: 在多种目标模型和提议机制上实验，NSD 持续提升推测解码效率并保持竞争力。吞吐量相比自回归解码最高加速 5.16 倍，相比标准推测解码最高加速 3.15 倍，同时接受长度更长。
AI.conclusion: 合理性感知的验证是放宽验证与提升推测解码效率的有效途径，NSD 让更多输出 token 分摊每次目标验证成本。

title: Semantic Capability Acquisition and Specialization During Vision-Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary:
Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) is typically evaluated at a single downstream checkpoint, obscuring whether a semantic capability was never acquired or emerged earlier and later declined during specialization. We ask how semantic capabilities are acquired, when they peak, how well they transfer, and what remains at deployment. We study these dynamics as a semantic capability trajectory, tracking identity- and attribute-based capabilities over training.
  We formulate a trajectory-based framework that separates capability acquisition, capability-specific optima, and later specialization, and introduce Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) to study how the representation of supervision shapes what is acquired. Across six pretrained backbones spanning DFN, MetaCLIP, and OpenAI CLIP, we show that fine-tuning can acquire semantic capability beyond the pretrained state, including gains observed on held-out evaluations. Unstructured name-and-attribute supervision produces strong name-and-attribute retrieval with comparatively weak name-free attribute-profile retrieval, whereas SSR yields substantially stronger name-free attribute-profile retrieval and is further strengthened by stochastic name-branch dropout. Different capabilities can peak at different stages, so a checkpoint selected by target class-name retrieval need not coincide with a transferable semantic optimum. Continued optimization can therefore preserve strong target class-name retrieval while reducing previously acquired transferable semantic capability. In a representative diagnostic study, this late specialization is consistent with reduced cross-modal semantic accessibility while substantial image-only class structure remains available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义能力轨迹"框架，追踪微调过程中语义能力的获得、峰值与后期专门化，并引入结构化语义路由（SSR）考察监督表示形式对能力习得的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM微调评估只在单一的下游检查点进行，无法判断某项语义能力是从未获得，还是早期出现却在专门化过程中衰退。作者希望回答语义能力如何被习得、何时达到峰值、迁移性如何，以及部署时还剩下什么。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹的框架，将能力获得、能力专属最优和后期专门化分离；引入结构化语义路由（SSR）研究监督的表示形式如何塑造所学内容。在DFN、MetaCLIP和OpenAI CLIP的六个预训练骨干上进行实验，并对比非结构化的"名称+属性"监督与SSR，以及随机名称分支dropout的作用。
AI.result: 微调可获得超越预训练状态的语义能力，包括在留出评估上的提升。非结构化名称-属性监督在名称-属性检索上较强，但无名称属性画像检索较弱；SSR显著提升无名称属性画像检索，且随机名称分支dropout可进一步增强。不同能力峰值阶段不同，按目标类名检索选出的检查点未必是迁移性语义最优。持续优化可保持强目标类名检索，却降低已获得的迁移性语义能力；这种后期专门化与跨模态语义可及性下降一致，而大量仅图像的类别结构仍然可用。
AI.conclusion: 语义能力在微调中呈现非单调轨迹，单一检查点评估会掩盖能力的获得与衰退。监督结构（如SSR）决定所学能力的类型，部署检查点的选择需权衡目标性能与可迁移语义能力。

title: HE-OFT: Privacy-Preserving One-Shot Federated Fine-Tuning under Homomorphic Encryption
comment: Technical report. 32 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/CRYPTO-KU/HE-OFT
summary: Many organizations adapt large pretrained models to their own tasks by fine-tuning on private data. Several of these parties often hold data for the same task and wish to fine-tune a model together without pooling that data. Federated learning (FL) enables joint fine-tuning, but reconstruction attacks on shared intermediate values (the model or its gradients) remain a privacy risk. A one-shot protocol that exchanges one encrypted contribution exposes no intermediate value. Such a protocol still gives the trained model to every participant, which is not permitted where the model is a regulated or proprietary asset. We present HE-OFT, the first cryptographically secure one-shot federated fine-tuning protocol in which no party receives the trained model. Each client fine-tunes a low-rank adapter and a classifier head on a frozen public backbone and keeps the adapter. The client uploads one encrypted head displacement, which the server combines under multiparty CKKS and never decrypts. A quorum of clients returns only the predicted label to the querier. On four text classification tasks and one vision task, HE-OFT reaches 61 to 79 per cent accuracy, against 20 to 48 per cent for a client training alone. HE-OFT keeps 85 to 96 per cent of the accuracy of a disclosed model. A test-time query takes 443.1 to 1713.1 s on one core, or 56.1 to 255.1 s with level restoration on a GPU. Restoring levels at the server cuts the traffic per query from up to 1.6 GiB to 13.5 MiB.

AI.tldr: HE-OFT 是首个密码学安全的一次性联邦微调协议，任何参与方都拿不到训练好的模型，仅通过加密的头部位移和多方 CKKS 聚合实现联合微调。
AI.motivation: 机构希望在不汇集私有数据的前提下联合微调大模型，联邦学习虽可实现联合微调，但共享的中间值（模型或梯度）仍面临重构攻击风险。一次性协议只交换一次加密贡献，不暴露中间值，但仍会把训练好的模型交给每个参与方——当模型是受监管或专有资产时这是不被允许的。
AI.method: 每个客户端在冻结的公共骨干网络上微调低秩适配器和分类头，并保留适配器；客户端上传一份加密的头部位移，服务器在多方 CKKS 下合并且从不解密；由客户端组成的法定人数只把预测标签返还给查询方。
AI.result: 在四个文本分类任务和一个视觉任务上，HE-OFT 达到 61%–79% 准确率，而单独训练的客户端为 20%–48%；HE-OFT 保留了已披露模型 85%–96% 的准确率。单核测试时查询耗时 443.1–1713.1 秒，GPU 上配合层级恢复为 56.1–255.1 秒；在服务器恢复层级可将每次查询的流量从最高 1.6 GiB 降至 13.5 MiB。
AI.conclusion: HE-OFT 证明了一次性联邦微调可以在密码学安全的前提下实现，且不让任何参与方获得训练好的模型，同时保持与披露模型相近的准确率并具备可行的查询效率。

title: Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization: Learning to Reason with Adaptive Rationale Scaffolding
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is often limited by reward sparsity: when a model fails to discover correct trajectories for difficult problems, the optimization process receives little useful signal and may stagnate. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by incorporating off-policy demonstrations, expert traces, or model-generated solutions, but they typically require the auxiliary data to match the format of the reinforcement-learning task, often relying on rejection sampling from stronger models to obtain suitable training trajectories. We introduce Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a framework that adaptively leverages ground-truth rationale information according to the model's current capability while preserving its freedom to explore. Rather than treating reference solutions as fixed imitation targets, RGPO uses them as temporary scaffolds: rationales help the model generate improved responses, after which only higher-reward, model-generated solutions are transferred back to the original unguided setting. This design allows training to exploit available ground-truth information without requiring off-policy data to follow the same format as the RL task. Across both language-only and vision-language reasoning settings, RGPO consistently improves performance over RLVR baselines, and ablation studies show that adaptive rationale guidance is a key contributor to these gains. These results suggest that RGPO offers a practical and general approach for reducing reward sparsity, stabilizing reinforcement learning, and improving reasoning performance in both text-only and multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RGPO框架，通过将标准答案理由作为临时脚手架来缓解强化学习中的奖励稀疏问题，在纯语言与多模态推理任务上均优于RLVR基线。
AI.motivation: on-policy强化学习是提升大模型推理能力的核心范式，但受限于奖励稀疏：当模型无法发现正确轨迹时优化信号匮乏、易停滞。已有方法借助off-policy示范、专家轨迹或模型生成解，但通常要求辅助数据与RL任务格式一致，往往依赖更强模型的拒绝采样。
AI.method: 提出Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO)，根据模型当前能力自适应利用标准答案理由信息，同时保留探索自由。不将参考解视为固定模仿目标，而是作为临时脚手架：理由辅助模型生成更优响应，随后仅将更高奖励的模型自生成解回迁到原始无引导设定，从而无需off-policy数据与RL任务格式一致。
AI.result: 在纯语言与视觉-语言推理两类设定下，RGPO性能稳定优于RLVR基线；消融实验表明自适应理由引导是性能提升的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: RGPO为缓解奖励稀疏、稳定强化学习并提升纯文本与多模态模型的推理性能提供了一种实用且通用的方法。

title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist in moral reasoning, omission bias, the tendency to prefer inaction even when equivalent framings reverse substantive outcomes, poses a significant risk of skewed decision-making. Yet omission bias remains underexplored in LLM evaluation, with the few existing studies limited in scale and focused largely on utilitarian-deontological conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce OMIT, a benchmark consisting of 218 paired-frame scenarios across 10 conflict types, constructed by leveraging disagreement patterns from an LLM-based, five-perspective philosophical persona panel (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism). Evaluating eight LLMs, we find that omission bias is pervasive but inversely correlates with model size within families. We further evaluate four inference-time interventions and find that interventions encouraging models to consider moral principles before committing to a yes/no answer reduce omission bias and increase frame-consistent responses, although lower omission bias rates can also coincide with shifts toward action-biased responses. Ultimately, this work contributes not only the OMIT benchmark, but also a methodology for using diverse philosophical disagreement signals to evaluate framing-sensitive inaction preferences and the distributional effects of mitigation attempts in LLMs under complex moral conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OMIT基准（218个配对框架场景，覆盖10类道德冲突），用于评估大语言模型中的不作为偏见，并测试了四种推理时干预方法。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地参与道德推理，不作为偏见（即使等价的框架反转了实质结果，仍倾向于选择不行动）可能导致决策偏斜。然而该问题在LLM评估中研究不足，现有研究规模有限且多聚焦于功利主义与义务论的冲突。
AI.method: 利用基于LLM的五视角哲学人格小组（功利主义、义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）的分歧模式，构建了涵盖10类冲突的218个配对框架场景基准OMIT，并对八个LLM进行评估，同时测试四种推理时干预。
AI.result: 不作为偏见普遍存在，但在同一模型家族内与模型规模呈负相关；鼓励模型在给出是/否答案前先考虑道德原则的干预能降低不作为偏见并提高框架一致性，但较低的不作为偏见率也可能伴随向行动偏向的转变。
AI.conclusion: 本工作不仅贡献了OMIT基准，还提供了一种利用多元哲学分歧信号来评估框架敏感的不作为偏好，以及复杂道德冲突下LLM缓解尝试的分布效应的方法论。

title: ElasticFit: Fit-Aware 3D Object Insertion via VLM Reasoning and Generative Adaptation
summary:
Inserting objects into existing 3D scenes requires more than selecting a plausible location:
  the inserted object must also fit local geometry while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility.
  Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and generative models enable semantic reasoning and visual content creation, they offer limited 3D grounding and geometric control when an inserted object must fit into constrained local spaces.
  We introduce \textbf{ElasticFit}, a VLM-guided framework for fit-aware object insertion centered on a novel scene-grounded representation.
  Given a language instruction and rendered scene observations, ElasticFit infers structured fitting cues that specify where the object should be grounded, what volume it should occupy, how it should be oriented, and its adaptation mode (rigid placement, uniform scaling, or elastic fitting).
  These cues convert high-level VLM reasoning into explicit 3D constraints that condition object generation and guide downstream geometric fitting.
  ElasticFit then generates a scene-conditioned object prior, reconstructs it in 3D, and refines the mesh through mode-specific fitting while enforcing collision avoidance, contact consistency, and physical grounding.
  In fixed-asset baseline comparisons, ElasticFit improves spatial relation success from 50.8\% to 69.7\% and support success from 48.3\% to 91.7\% over the strongest baseline, while providing novel support for generative "make-it-fit" insertions in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: ElasticFit是一个VLM引导的"适配感知"3D物体插入框架，通过场景锚定表示将语言指令转化为显式3D约束，实现刚体放置、均匀缩放与弹性变形三种适配模式。
AI.motivation: 将物体插入已有3D场景不仅需要选择合理位置，还需使物体契合局部几何、保持语义意图与物理合理性。现有VLM与生成模型虽具备语义推理与视觉生成能力，但在受限局部空间中的3D grounding与几何控制方面能力有限。
AI.method: 提出以场景锚定表示为核心的新框架：给定语言指令与渲染的场景观测，推断结构化适配线索（grounding位置、占据体积、朝向、适配模式）；将高层VLM推理转为显式3D约束，用于条件化物体生成并指导几何拟合；随后生成场景条件物体先验、重建为3D并做模式特定的网格精修，同时约束碰撞避免、接触一致性与物理接地。
AI.result: 在固定资产基线对比中，最强基线上空间关系成功率从50.8%提升至69.7%，支撑成功率从48.3%提升至91.7%，并在复杂场景中支持生成式"make-it-fit"插入。
AI.conclusion: ElasticFit通过显式的3D约束与模式化拟合，有效弥合了VLM语义推理与3D几何控制之间的鸿沟，显著提升插入的合理性与物理一致性。

title: Contextual Chain: Lightweight Continuity Authentication for Intermittently Connected Devices
summary: Can authentication make memory, rather than computational hardness, the attacker's bottleneck? Contextual Chain is a lightweight continuity protocol for intermittently connected devices that share evolving physical or operational context. An honest device follows one realized history, updating a compact accumulator and fixed hash-based readiness lanes; outages cause pause or bounded rollback, not branch search. After the epoch is frozen, a fresh challenge selects one lane under a short deadline. An outsider that missed context may therefore need to prepare for many mature histories before learning which one will be tested. In the standard random-oracle model, a causal counting theorem lower-bounds the deadline-accessible retained state required for a target success probability against arbitrary nonlinear preselection encoding and adaptive post-selection queries, accounting for sequential depth, candidate queries, and cross-target protected information obtained online. Honest readiness memory remains fixed and independent of the number of plausible histories. Contextual Chain thus converts shared-experience uncertainty into a tunable preparation requirement without transferring combinatorial complexity to lightweight devices.

AI.tldr: Contextual Chain 是一种轻量级连续性协议，利用共享的演化上下文，把攻击者的瓶颈从计算难度转移到记忆（保留状态）上。
AI.motivation: 探索认证能否让记忆而非计算硬度成为攻击者的瓶颈，同时不让轻量设备承担组合复杂性。
AI.method: 诚实设备沿单一实现历史更新紧凑累加器与基于哈希的就绪通道，中断只导致暂停或有界回滚；epoch 冻结后由新挑战在短期限内选择一条通道。并在随机预言机模型下用因果计数定理对任意非线性预选编码与自适应后选查询给出下界。
AI.result: 该定理下界了达到目标成功概率所需的、截止期限可访问的保留状态，同时计入顺序深度、候选查询以及在线获得的跨目标受保护信息；诚实方的就绪记忆保持固定，且与可能历史数量无关。
AI.conclusion: Contextual Chain 将共享经验的不确定性转化为可调的准备工作要求，而不把组合复杂性转移给轻量设备。

title: Trajectory-Retrieval Speculative Decoding: When Does a Model's Own History Help?
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning increases sequential decoding cost while creating a growing history of potentially reusable continuations. We investigate when this history supplies useful drafts and complements an existing drafter. Controlled source comparisons reveal trajectory-specific reuse, motivating our method Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR). TLAR retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current trajectory and uses recent verification outcomes to adapt retrieval activation and candidate width. TLAR combines retrieved continuations with model-generated drafts in a shared candidate tree, preserving the target model's output distribution through exact verification. Across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing, our evaluation connects source reuse, incremental acceptance, and execution cost. Combining TLAR with strong retrieval baselines improves token acceptance under matched verification budgets and increases end-to-end throughput over the draft-model baseline. These findings support generated trajectories as runtime memory for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR)，从当前长链推理轨迹中检索近似匹配的续写作为草稿，并结合近期验证结果自适应调整检索激活与候选宽度，在保持目标模型输出分布的前提下提升解码吞吐。
AI.motivation: 长链思维链推理增加顺序解码成本，但同时积累了大量潜在可复用的续写历史；作者希望探究这种历史何时能提供有用草稿并补充现有草稿模型。
AI.method: 通过受控的来源比较揭示轨迹特异的复用现象，据此提出TLAR：从当前轨迹检索近似匹配的续写，利用近期验证结果自适应控制检索激活与候选宽度，并将检索续写与模型生成草稿合并到共享候选树中，通过精确验证保持目标模型输出分布。
AI.result: 在代码调试、数学和开放式写作任务上，评估关联了来源复用、增量接受与执行成本；TLAR与强检索基线结合，在匹配验证预算下提升token接受率，并相对草稿模型基线提高端到端吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持将生成的推理轨迹作为运行时记忆用于自适应推理。

title: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数高效微调方法 DyPAM，通过对 query/key 表示进行动态、分维度、分头、分层的调制来适配位置信息对注意力的贡献，在数学与常识推理基准上超越现有 PEFT 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 PEFT 方法多采用均匀、静态的适配方式，忽视了注意力在维度、头、层和输入 token 上的结构化异质性。实际中注意力表示是非均匀的，且 RoPE 等位置编码会引入维度相关的位置结构，使得均匀适配并非最优。
AI.method: 提出 DyPAM，直接在 query 和 key 表示上操作，调控位置信息对注意力的贡献。它结合了输入条件化的分维度调制，以及分头、分层的结构调制，从而在符合 RoPE 位置结构的前提下实现细粒度的位置注意力适配，且不修改预训练主干网络。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型的数学与常识推理基准上进行的大量实验表明，DyPAM 始终优于现有强 PEFT 基线。
AI.conclusion: DyPAM 通过结构化的动态位置注意力调制，实现了更优的参数高效微调效果。

title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
summary: Protective perturbations aim to stop malicious instruction-guided editing of personal photos, but they are optimized and evaluated at the editor's working resolution, whereas shared photos have 10 megapixels or more and editors first downscale them by an unknown factor. We model this resize as a frequency-selective channel. In this model, a perturbation computed at the native resolution decays with the downscaling factor and is weak even without a resize, and a perturbation computed at a fixed working resolution protects only a window of scales. The best worst-case protection over an unknown range of scales degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, and averaging over scales does not reach it. Guided by this analysis, we propose SRIM, which samples a grid of anchor scales covering the whole range, with weights that favor the currently weakest scale, at the cost of standard expectation over transformation. On full-resolution photos of 9 to 30 megapixels and downscaling factors from 2 to 8, SRIM raises the worst-case disruption of FLUX.2-klein edits from 0.192 LPIPS, attained by the strongest published protection, to 0.463. At equal visibility, it roughly doubles the protection. The same protected photos also protect against the 9B model and against FLUX.2-dev, with worst cases of 0.450 and 0.386 against at most 0.184 for published protections, and SRIM leads on InstructPix2Pix as well.

AI.tldr: 提出SRIM方法，通过多尺度锚点采样与偏向最弱尺度的加权，在未知缩放因子下实现高分辨率照片的强防护编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有防护扰动在编辑器工作分辨率下优化与评估，但共享照片像素达千万级，编辑器会先以未知因子下采样。该缩放导致固定分辨率下的扰动在真实场景中衰减、仅能覆盖有限尺度。
AI.method: 将缩放建模为频率选择信道；理论分析表明最优最坏情况防护随尺度范围宽度仅对数退化，且尺度平均无法达到该界。据此提出SRIM：在覆盖整个范围的锚点尺度网格上采样，并以偏向当前最弱尺度的权重加权。
AI.result: 在9–30百万像素全分辨率照片、2至8倍下采样下，SRIM将FLUX.2-klein编辑的最坏情况破坏从最强已发表防护的0.192 LPIPS提升至0.463；同等可见度下防护约翻倍。对9B模型与FLUX.2-dev最坏情况分别为0.450和0.386（已发表防护至多0.184），在InstructPix2Pix上也领先。
AI.conclusion: SRIM有效解决了未知缩放下的防护衰减问题，在多种编辑模型上显著提升最坏情况防护效果。

title: Zeppelin: Client-Side BFV Encryption and Decryption for Helium-Powered Microcontrollers
summary: The growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) has raised concerns over the privacy of data collected by resource-constrained sensing devices. Homomorphic encryption (HE) addresses this by letting a device encrypt its data once and an untrusted cloud server compute on the ciphertext without seeing the values. In practice, HE's memory and computational cost have kept it out of reach of microcontroller-class devices. Prior work, SEAL-Embedded, made this feasible using CKKS, but left three gaps: its arithmetic is entirely scalar, even on hardware with a vector instruction set; it never decrypts on the device, so the client cannot consume a result; and it does not explore BFV, whose encoding uses only integer arithmetic and decrypts exactly. We present Zeppelin, the first HE library to use an embedded vector instruction set, the first to support both encryption and decryption on an embedded device, and the first BFV implementation on MCU-class hardware. Zeppelin vectorizes the number-theoretic transform, HE's main bottleneck, for ARM's Helium extension, and includes a decryption procedure that avoids large-integer arithmetic and timing leakage of the secret key. A server-side adapter converts Zeppelin's ciphertexts into a format compatible with Microsoft SEAL, so the device handles encryption and decryption while the server performs all homomorphic computation. On an STM32N6 MCU with an ARM Cortex-M55, Zeppelin encodes and encrypts 4096 packed values in 4.76 ms (seeded symmetric, 128-bit security per the HE standard) and decrypts and decodes the result in 5.38 ms, using under 500 KB of RAM, with the vectorized NTT engine ${\sim}2.7\times$ faster than an equivalent scalar implementation on the same core.

AI.tldr: Zeppelin是一个面向MCU级嵌入式设备的同态加密库，首次在嵌入式向量指令集（ARM Helium）上实现NTT向量化，首次支持设备端加解密，也是首个MCU上的BFV实现，在STM32N6上以低延迟、低内存完成编解码与加解密。
AI.motivation: IoT传感设备采集的数据隐私问题突出，同态加密允许设备加密数据后由不可信云服务器在密文上计算。但HE的内存与计算开销使其难以用于微控制器级设备。已有工作SEAL-Embedded虽用CKKS实现了可行性，但存在三个缺口：算术完全标量化（未利用向量指令集）、从不在设备端解密（客户端无法获得结果）、未探索采用纯整数编码且可精确解密的BFV方案。
AI.method: 提出Zeppelin库：1）针对ARM Helium扩展向量化NTT（HE主要瓶颈）；2）设计避免大整数运算与密钥时序泄漏的设备端解密流程；3）实现MCU级BFV；4）服务端适配器将Zeppelin密文转换为与Microsoft SEAL兼容的格式，使设备负责加解密、服务端承担全部同态计算。
AI.result: 在搭载ARM Cortex-M55的STM32N6 MCU上，Zeppelin对4096个打包值的编码与加密耗时4.76 ms（种子对称、按HE标准128位安全），解密与解码耗时5.38 ms，RAM占用低于500 KB，向量化NTT引擎比同核上的等效标量实现快约2.7倍。
AI.conclusion: Zeppelin首次将嵌入式向量指令集、设备端加解密能力以及BFV方案引入MCU级同态加密，在保持低内存占用的同时显著提升了NTT性能，并通过与Microsoft SEAL的兼容适配打通了设备端与服务端的协同流程，为资源受限IoT设备上的实用化HE提供了可行方案。

title: Evaluating Escalation Signals for LLM Routing: Targets, Controls, and Five Ways to Fool Yourself
summary: Deciding when to escalate a query from a small language model to a larger one requires a cheap signal that predicts, before the large model is called, whether escalating would help. Semantic entropy, originally developed to detect hallucinations, is a natural candidate: it measures how much a model's sampled answers disagree in meaning, and high disagreement often signals an unreliable answer. We test it across three benchmarks and two model families. On GSM8K, with a small/large pair about twelve times apart in size, semantic entropy reliably distinguishes the small model's mistakes (AUROC 0.871) and improves routed accuracy over random escalation by up to nine points at matched cost. An earlier strong-looking result on a synthetic benchmark proved misleading: a simple rule based only on question difficulty, with no model involved, matched semantic entropy almost exactly. This paper's main contribution is a set of checks that catch this before it is reported as real. We show that scoring a cheap, question-only difficulty estimate alongside any signal reveals whether the signal adds real information or just tracks how hard a question looks; that two reasonable definitions of "escalation worked" can produce very different results on the same data; that a benchmark can leave almost no room for any signal to beat simply always using the large model; and that the true cost of live sampling can make routing more expensive than calling the large model directly. For a cheaper alternative that reuses cached past outcomes, we show how to predict whether it will work on a new dataset -- confirmed by correctly forecasting a collapse from AUROC 0.908 to chance level (0.518) ahead of time. We offer these as a general checklist for evaluating escalation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套评估“是否升级到更大模型”信号的方法学清单，并检验语义熵的有效性。
AI.motivation: 决定何时将查询从小模型升级到大模型需要廉价信号，语义熵是自然候选，但易受假象误导。
AI.method: 在三个基准和两个模型家族上测试语义熵，并加入仅依赖问题难度的廉价基线、两种“升级成功”定义、成本与天花板效应检查，以及缓存复用替代方案。
AI.result: GSM8K 上语义熵可区分小模型错误（AUROC 0.871），在同等成本下比随机升级提升最多九点；但合成基准上仅问题难度规则几乎完全匹配语义熵。缓存替代方案可从 AUROC 0.908 正确预测崩溃至随机水平 0.518。
AI.conclusion: 语义熵在合适设置下有效，但需通过难度基线、定义一致性、基准天花板和真实成本等检查，避免误报为真实增益。

title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.

AI.tldr: ReFold：一种无需训练的渲染层，通过可逆地折叠交互历史中的冗余内容来压缩长时程LLM智能体的上下文。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体每步都重发完整的追加式交互历史，导致上下文与成本随步数增长直至超出上下文窗口。现有方法依赖上下文需求预测，需额外模型调用、启发式规则或训练策略，带来运行时开销、使前缀缓存失效，且永久丢弃内容、无法保证恢复。
AI.method: ReFold是无需训练的渲染层，保留底层交互历史，仅压缩模型渲染出的上下文。无需辅助预测器即可去除两类跨轮冗余：一是早前轮次已展示过的内容，用存根替换；二是智能体自报已完成的轮次，折叠为一行笔记。两种操作均采用分块渲染，每几步重写一次缓存前缀，而非每步重写。每次移除严格可逆，误删只需从历史恢复一次。
AI.result: 在五个长时程基准和两个前沿LLM上评估：token消耗最多降低2.5倍，每会话KV缓存内存减半，任务成功率不下降；在受限上下文预算下避免最多92%的强制压缩；在并发服务负载下，请求排队延迟最多降低100%，推理加速最多1.7倍，推理成本最多降低3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: ReFold作为即插即用的渲染层，可跨标准ReAct式框架使用，在不损失任务成功率的前提下显著降低长时程智能体的token消耗、内存占用与推理成本。

title: LARK: A Low-Cost, Accurate, Occlusion-Resilient, Kalman Filter-Assisted Tracking System for Image-Guided Surgery
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, including appendices. Supplementary document included as an ancillary file. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/ApZ8q9DjB-4
summary: Image-guided surgery (IGS) depends on accurate tracking of surgical instruments to provide real-time navigation relative to anatomical structures. Commercial stereo infrared trackers are accurate but prone to occlusion and cost-prohibitive for many settings. This work presents LARK, a multi-camera optical tracking system using commodity RGB hardware and multi-view redundancy and fusion. We develop and evaluate two complete tracking methods: multi-view monocular pose fusion and multi-view triangulation. Both methods are assessed under varying occlusion levels using a precision-machined grid and an anatomical head phantom, and compared against a gold-standard stereo infrared system. With five cameras and adaptive Kalman filtering, LARK achieves median target registration errors of 0.64 mm for point localization with triangulation and 0.73 mm for trajectory tracking with pose fusion on the machined grid. Camera-subset experiments show graceful degradation in adaptive pose-fusion accuracy as fewer views remain available. With tracking hardware costing under $1,000 USD, LARK provides a low-cost platform for image-guided surgery research. Hardware designs and software are publicly available at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/software/ , and datasets at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/data/ .

AI.tldr: LARK 是一个基于商用 RGB 相机与多视角冗余的低成本多相机光学追踪系统，用于图像引导手术中的器械追踪，精度接近金标准立体红外系统。
AI.motivation: 商用立体红外追踪系统精度高，但易受遮挡且成本高昂，限制了图像引导手术在多数场景中的可及性，因此需要一种低成本且抗遮挡的光学追踪方案。
AI.method: 采用商用 RGB 硬件构建多相机系统，开发并评估两种追踪方法：多视角单目位姿融合与多视角三角测量；结合自适应卡尔曼滤波，使用精密加工网格和头部解剖体模在不同遮挡水平下测试，并与金标准立体红外系统对比。
AI.result: 五相机加自适应卡尔曼滤波时，在加工网格上，三角测量点定位的中位目标配准误差为 0.64 mm，位姿融合轨迹追踪为 0.73 mm；相机子集实验显示，随可用视角减少，自适应位姿融合精度呈平滑退化。硬件成本低于 1000 美元。
AI.conclusion: LARK 以低于 1000 美元的硬件成本实现了较高追踪精度和良好的遮挡鲁棒性，为图像引导手术研究提供了低成本平台，硬件设计与软件已公开。

title: MARCO: The Radioactive Watermark for Protein Generative Models
summary: Protein Generative Models (PGMs) have revolutionized structural biology by enabling the design of complex 3D protein structures from sequence data. However, this breakthrough introduces a dual-use challenge, exposing high-value PGMs to economic risks like unauthorized model extraction and biosecurity threats such as biohazard synthesis. To mitigate these threats, we propose \textbf{MARCO} (\textsc{COnformation waterMARk}), the first radioactive watermarking framework specifically tailored for PGMs. MARCO establishes a Dual-Layer defense that simultaneously protects intellectual property and ensures the forensic traceability of potential biosecurity misuses. (i) To preserve efficiency, MARCO iteratively embeds watermarks during diffusion reverse denoising via an auxiliary encoder-decoder, allowing the original PGM parameters to remain frozen for broad compatibility. (ii) To preserve biophysical fidelity and maximize robustness, we employ specialized loss functions targeting $C_α$-atom pairwise distances and torsion angles ($ψ, φ$) within an adversarial training framework integrated with stochastic attack simulations. (iii) Crucially, MARCO exhibits ``radioactivity'' where the watermark automatically transfers to the outputs of any pirate models trained on the watermarked data, effectively countering model extraction attacks. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MARCO achieves superior fidelity and robustness while successfully validating watermark transferability.

AI.tldr: 提出MARCO，首个面向蛋白质生成模型的"放射性"水印框架，通过双层防御同时保护知识产权并实现生物安全溯源。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质生成模型（PGMs）可从序列设计复杂3D结构，但带来双重用途风险：一是高价值模型面临未经授权的模型提取等经济风险，二是可能被用于生物危害合成等生物安全威胁。现有缺乏针对PGMs的水印保护手段。
AI.method: MARCO在扩散反向去噪过程中通过辅助编码器-解码器迭代嵌入水印，原始PGM参数保持冻结以兼容多种模型；设计针对Cα原子成对距离与扭转角（ψ, φ）的专用损失函数，结合对抗训练与随机攻击模拟以保持生物物理保真度并提升鲁棒性；水印具有"放射性"，可自动转移到基于带水印数据训练的盗版模型输出中。
AI.result: 综合实验表明MARCO在保真度和鲁棒性方面表现优越，并成功验证了水印的可转移性。
AI.conclusion: MARCO作为首个面向PGMs的放射性水印框架，通过冻结参数嵌入、生物物理约束与对抗训练、以及水印自动转移机制，能同时应对模型提取与生物安全误用风险，为PGMs提供知识产权保护与取证溯源的双层防御。

title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
summary: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

AI.tldr: 在1,119条标注的agent动作上检验运行时门控的误差是否按乘法叠加；发现两个LLM判官约等效1.2–1.4层，规则层+一个判官约等效1.86–2.09层，单独准确率无法预测边际贡献，且存在模型版本漂移与评分口径反转结论的问题。
AI.motivation: 运行时门控（gates）常被叠加使用，隐含假设各层误差相互独立、从而按乘法相乘地提升安全性。本文要检验这一假设在真实agent工具调用标注数据上是否成立，并量化叠加栈实际的等效层数。
AI.method: 使用来自三个语料的1,119条标注agent动作，不引入自适应对手。门控栈含一个确定性规则层和四个LLM判官，其中三个重新采集并记录每次调用所服务的模型。用n_mult（乘法等效层数）刻画栈的合成效果，并给出完美耦合下的下界。采用STRICT（升级到人工计为未拦截）与PRIMARY（升级计为已捕获）两种漏检定义，做成对显著性检验与区间估计，并检验单独准确率对边际贡献的预测力。
AI.result: STRICT下，任意两个判官合成约1.2–1.4层（φ中位数+0.430，6/6成对显著，下界1.02–1.17）；规则层加一个判官为1.86–2.09层（φ中位数+0.014，0/4显著，下界1.01–1.09）。PRIMARY下区间分别为1.21–1.57与1.80–2.13，区间在合并数据上分离，逐语料点估计则分裂，第三方判官落入判官区间。单独准确率不预测边际贡献：某云规则包将规则层单独漏检率降低20%却未带来新的联合覆盖。判官耦合中难度占比不可识别（31.8%–61.8%，随探针与定义而变）。一个判官层级在112批中有50批被非请求的模型版本服务，集中于外部语料；该事件推翻了预先声明的分析规则，且对审查判定的评分反转了五项结论，两者均予报告。
AI.conclusion: 门控栈的误差并非简单相乘：LLM判官之间的等效层数远低于名义层数（约1.2–1.4而非2），而规则层与判官组合却接近2层且耦合不显著；单独准确率不能预测边际贡献，难度与耦合份额难以识别。模型版本漂移可实质改变分析结论，需在部署与评估中显式记录并同时报告受影响的结论。

title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://visual-abstention.github.io
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"视觉拒答"概念和Draw-or-Decline基准，发现统一多模态模型的编辑能力与拒答能力相互独立，并提出VisTA训练方法使模型在生成前判断任务可行性。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽整合了理解与生成能力，但其生成行为很少受到对任务理解的控制。当请求的视觉变换在规则下不可能完成时，模型本应识别无解并拒绝生成，但现有模型缺乏这种能力。
AI.method: 1）形式化"视觉拒答"（visual abstention）概念；2）构建Draw-or-Decline（DoD）基准，包含7类任务共1,050对可行-不可行请求，同时衡量编辑成功率与对不可行请求的拒答；3）评估8个UMMs；4）提出VisTA训练方法，通过配对可行与不可行样本，让模型在生成前先判断可行性，并训练VisTA-BAGEL。
AI.result: 最强的编辑器编辑准确率达68.4%，但仅拒答0.4%的不可行请求；显式提示可增加文本拒答但会降低编辑准确率。VisTA-BAGEL在无提示下拒答93.0%的不可行请求，误拒可行请求仅0.8%，并完成74.3%的可行编辑，超过所评估的8个UMMs。
AI.conclusion: 编辑能力与拒答能力是两种不同的能力；通过配对训练的VisTA方法可显著提升拒答率且不牺牲编辑准确率，为统一多模态模型的可行性判断与拒答行为提供了有效方案。

title: AIMS: Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis for Scalable Novel View Rendering
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis methods achieve strong generalization from posed multi-view inputs, but scaling them to large input view sets remains challenging. Transformer-based approaches that jointly process all input-view tokens incur rapidly increasing computation and memory as the number of views grows, while simple view subsampling discards potentially useful observations. We introduce Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis (AIMS), a scalable framework that decouples the number of available observations from the number of views processed by the global synthesis model. AIMS selects a fixed set of spatially distributed anchor views using farthest point sampling, groups nearby observations around each anchor, and uses a lightweight learnable integrator to fuse their information into enriched anchor representations. This allows additional observations to contribute to synthesis while keeping the downstream global view budget fixed. Evaluations on RealEstate10K and ScanNet demonstrate a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off against transformer-based and Gaussian-based baselines. AIMS achieves 29.41 dB and 17.73 dB PSNR on the two datasets, respectively, with rendering averaging 7.24 ms per view.

AI.tldr: AIMS将可用观测数量与全局模型处理的视角数量解耦：用最远点采样选固定数量锚点视角，将邻近观测分组并经轻量可学习积分器融合到锚点表示中，从而在固定全局计算预算下利用更多观测。
AI.motivation: 前馈新视角合成泛化能力强，但难以扩展到大规模输入视角集合：Transformer类方法联合处理所有输入视角token，计算与内存随视角数快速增加；而简单视角下采样又会丢失有用观测。
AI.method: AIMS（Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis）用最远点采样选出一组空间分布固定的锚点视角，将邻近观测围绕各锚点分组，再用轻量可学习积分器把各组信息融合为增强的锚点表示。由此更多观测可参与合成，而下游全局视角预算保持固定。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和ScanNet上，AIMS相比Transformer类与高斯类基线取得更好的质量—效率权衡，PSNR分别为29.41 dB和17.73 dB，平均每视角渲染约7.24 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过锚点选择与分组融合实现可扩展的前馈多视角合成，在固定全局视角预算下有效利用额外观测，兼顾合成质量与渲染效率。

title: Case-Level Verification in Scanner-LLM Cascades: Overcoming the Alert Aggregation Bottleneck to Expand the FRR-TPR Trade-off Space
comment: Accepted at the 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Data Analysis (ICDA 2026). To appear in the ACM International Conference Proceedings Series (ICPS). 17 pages
summary: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) scanners achieve high recall but also produce a large number of false positives, resulting in substantial manual triage costs. Large Language Models (LLMs), when used for independent detection, achieve extremely high recall (95.4%-100%) but also exhibit prohibitively high false positive rates (49.6%-85.0%), precluding their use as standalone replacements for scanners. A natural solution is a two-stage cascade consisting of scanner detection followed by LLM verification. However, a verification-granularity issue that has long been overlooked in practice creates a structural bottleneck: alert aggregation binds multiple true and false cases into a shared decision unit, such that removing a false positive inevitably eliminates true positives aggregated within the same alert group. This creates a trade-off bottleneck between the False-positive Reduction Rate (FRR) and the True-positive Rate (TPR). We formalize this bottleneck by showing that the alert-level false-positive set is a subset of the case-level false-positive set, and introduce a Case-Level, per-case verification strategy that shifts the decision granularity from the alert level to the instance level, independently replaying HTTP requests and making an independent determination for each detected case. Evaluation on the dual testbeds of Damn Vulnerable Web Application (DVWA) and WebGoat shows that the empirically best Alert-Level operating point achieves FRR=42.86% (TPR=51.7%). The Case-Level Baseline achieves FRR=47.6%, an improvement of 4.7 percentage points (+4.7 pp), while the Case-Focused Evidence Verification Prompt (CEV-Prompt) increases TPR from 55.2% to 62.1% at the same FRR.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究DAST扫描器与LLM级联验证中的"验证粒度"瓶颈问题，并提出案例级（Case-Level）验证策略以突破假阳性削减率（FRR）与真阳性率（TPR）之间的权衡瓶颈。
AI.motivation: DAST扫描器召回率高但假阳性多，人工筛查成本高；LLM单独检测召回率极高（95.4%-100%）但假阳性率也高（49.6%-85.0%），无法单独替代扫描器。将二者结合的两阶段级联看似可行，但存在被长期忽视的验证粒度问题：告警聚合把多个真阳性和假阳性绑定到同一决策单元，导致去除一个假阳性时必然连带去掉同一告警组内的真阳性，形成FRR与TPR之间的权衡瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者将该瓶颈形式化，证明告警级假阳性集合是案例级假阳性集合的子集；进而提出案例级、逐案验证策略，将决策粒度从告警级降到实例级，独立重放HTTP请求并对每个检测到的案例单独判定。此外还设计了案例聚焦证据验证提示（CEV-Prompt）。
AI.result: 在DVWA和WebGoat双测试平台上：经验最优的告警级操作点达到FRR=42.86%（TPR=51.7%）；案例级基线达到FRR=47.6%，提升4.7个百分点（+4.7 pp）；CEV-Prompt在相同FRR下将TPR从55.2%提升至62.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将验证粒度从告警级细化到案例级，能够有效缓解级联方案中FRR与TPR的结构性权衡瓶颈；配合CEV-Prompt可进一步在相同假阳性削减水平下提升真阳性检出率，为DAST与LLM结合的实用化提供了更优路径。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemCo，一个以记忆为中心的LLM智能体协作框架，通过维护互补的局部与全局记忆空间，并在交互过程中按智能体当前状态和决策阶段路由相关记忆，实现对未见交互环境的泛化，提升任务成功率并减少冗余探索。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地在交互环境中进行序列决策，记忆能帮助其复用经验，但现有工作孤立地设计记忆，收集足够轨迹来填充记忆代价高昂。共享记忆方法虽能跨任务和环境汇集情景记忆，但面临检索粒度难题：检索到的记忆要么过于具体而无法保持当前情境的接地，要么过于粗糙而无法支持下一步动作。
AI.method: 提出MemCo这一以记忆为中心的协作框架，用于将LLM智能体泛化到未见过的交互环境。该框架维护互补的局部和全局记忆空间：局部保留特定环境细节，全局则从局部轨迹中归纳可迁移的工作流。在线交互时，MemCo根据智能体当前状态和决策阶段路由相关的局部与全局记忆，使智能体能在不盲目迁移环境特定细节的前提下复用其他智能体的经验。
AI.result: 在交互式决策基准上的实验表明，与孤立记忆和共享记忆基线相比，MemCo提高了任务成功率并减少了冗余探索。代码已开源于 https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas。
AI.conclusion: MemCo通过局部与全局互补记忆及状态感知的记忆路由，有效缓解了共享记忆检索的粒度问题，实现LLM智能体对未见交互环境的泛化，兼顾环境特定细节的保留与可迁移经验的复用。

title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出成对忠实性基准PFaithBench，评估模型在支持性/非支持性上下文下对同一问题切换回答与弃答的能力，发现忠实性本质是回答与弃答的权衡，多数模型偏向过度回答，且训练数据构成对此高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有忠实性评估多针对单个问题-上下文实例独立评估，无法捕捉忠实行为的根本要求：模型应根据可用上下文的变化调整响应。理想模型应在证据充分时给出正确答案、证据不足时弃答，而这种自适应切换能力在实例级评估中被忽略。
AI.method: 提出成对忠实性基准PFaithBench，对同一问题分别在支持性与非支持性上下文下评估模型能否在回答与弃答之间切换。在39个模型、7个模型家族上进行评测，并开展不同数据构造下的忠实性训练研究。
AI.result: 忠实性本质上涉及回答与弃答之间的权衡；多数现有模型强烈偏向回答，多数忠实性错误源于过度回答（即使上下文不足仍编造答案）。训练结果对回答/弃答数据的具体组合高度敏感；用不匹配来源构造回答与弃答数据会令模型依赖数据集特定捷径而非真正的上下文充分性；增加答案监督数据提升回答表现但加剧过度回答，增加弃答数据减少幻觉但导致过度弃答。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应被理解为回答与弃答之间的权衡问题，需在成对情境下评估；数据构造策略对训练结果影响显著，需谨慎平衡回答与弃答数据以避免捷径学习和两种极端偏差。代码与数据已开源。

title: CETUS: How Far Do Representations Trained on Earth Transfer to Cassini SAR of Titan?
comment: Research work at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/CETUS
summary: Cassini synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images reveal the dunes, plains, and lake basins of Titan, providing an instance of representations learned from Earth imagery for planetary terrain classification. Cross-domain Evaluation of Earth-to-Titan Transfer Using SAR (CETUS) compares features from DINOv2, DOFA and CROMA with classical image measurements and features from an untrained vision transformer on the U.S. Geological Survey's Cassini SAR mosaic. The classifiers learn terrain labels from an expert geomorphological map and predict those labels in geographically separate Titan regions. Under logistic regression settings, pretrained encoders achieve higher mean macro F1 than the combined classical features. Encoder rankings change when feature scaling, optimization, and regularization change together. Further training on Titan improves DINOv2 performance, degrades DOFA performance, and leads to mixed results for CROMA under the tested settings. Architectural and input processing differences prevent these comparisons from isolating the effect of pretraining. Classifier fitting and performance on individual terrain classes matter when assessing representation transfer for planetary mapping. Since the map draws partly on the same radar observations, the scores measure agreement with expert interpretation.

AI.tldr: CETUS 研究比较了 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 等预训练编码器与传统图像特征在土卫六 SAR 地形分类中的跨域迁移表现，发现预训练编码器在逻辑回归下平均宏 F1 更高，但排名受缩放、优化与正则化影响，且在土卫六上继续训练效果各异。
AI.motivation: 评估地球影像表征能否迁移至行星地形分类，尤其是土卫六（Titan）的沙丘、平原与湖盆等 SAR 地形，检验现有预训练模型在跨域场景中的适用性与可靠性。
AI.method: 基于美国地质调查局 Cassini SAR 镶嵌图，将 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 的特征与经典图像测量特征及未训练视觉 Transformer 特征进行对比；使用专家地貌图作为标签，在地理上分离的土卫六区域预测地形类别，并考察逻辑回归下特征缩放、优化与正则化的联合变化，以及在土卫六数据上继续训练的影响。
AI.result: 在逻辑回归设置下，预训练编码器的平均宏 F1 高于经典特征组合；编码器排名随特征缩放、优化与正则化共同变化而改变。继续在土卫六上训练时，DINOv2 性能提升，DOFA 性能下降，CROMA 结果混合。架构与输入处理差异使比较无法单独分离预训练的影响。
AI.conclusion: 行星制图中的表征迁移评估需关注分类器拟合与各具体地形类别的表现；由于标签图部分基于相同雷达观测，所得分数衡量的是与专家解释的一致性，而非绝对真值。

title: Federated Bayesian Surveillance of Mechanical Thrombectomy Adverse Events: A Population Risk Layer for Surgical Digital Twins
comment: Presented at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) Workshop on Surgical Digital Twins (SurgTwin). 3 pages, 1 figure
summary: Learned surgical simulators and world models can roll out plausible procedural futures, but they carry no grounded estimate of how often interventional devices actually harm patients. We propose treating population-scale adverse-event surveillance as a distinct belief layer of the surgical digital twin, and we evaluate a federated Bayesian protocol for learning it under formal privacy guarantees. Each site holds per-class Gamma-Poisson posteriors over adverse-event rates and exchanges only Rényi-differentially-private natural-parameter updates. We benchmark on the complete FDA MAUDE cohort for thrombus-retrieval catheters (product code NRY): 8,617 reports, of which 6,491 are classified by transparent keyword rules into five thrombectomy complication classes and partitioned across $K=8$ manufacturer sites. At a matched privacy budget of $(\\varepsilon \\approx 2.09, \δ= 10^{-5})$, the conjugate protocol attains a held-out Poisson score of -5.78 per test event versus -26.58 for FedAvg with differential privacy. The non-private federated model also outperforms centralized pooling (+3.19 vs +2.93), evidence that manufacturer-specific complication profiles are real and that federation preserves them. Because MAUDE lacks procedure denominators, outputs are relative rate orderings rather than absolute risks, and we report all privacy-utility operating points.

AI.tldr: 提出将人群级不良事件监测作为手术数字孪生的独立"信念层"，并在形式化隐私保证下用联邦贝叶斯协议学习该层。在FDA MAUDE血栓取出导管队列上，共轭协议（Gamma-Poisson）在匹配隐私预算下达-5.78的Poisson得分，远优于差分隐私FedAvg（-26.58）。
AI.motivation: 已学习的手术模拟器与世界模型能推演合理的手术未来，但无法提供介入器械实际伤害患者的频率的真实估计。因此需要一个有据可依的不良事件率估计层，且需在隐私受限的多机构数据下学习。
AI.method: 将人群级不良事件监测视为手术数字孪生中独立的信念层；各站点保存各类别的Gamma-Poisson后验（不良事件率），仅交换满足Rényi差分隐私的自然参数更新，采用联邦贝叶斯协议。数据为FDA MAUDE中产品代码NRY（血栓取出导管）全队列：8,617份报告，其中6,491份通过透明关键词规则归入五类血栓切除并发症，并划分到K=8个制造商站点。
AI.result: 在匹配隐私预算(ε≈2.09, δ=10⁻⁵)下，共轭协议在留出测试事件上的Poisson得分为-5.78/事件，而带差分隐私的FedAvg为-26.58。非隐私联邦模型也优于集中式池化(+3.19 vs +2.93)，表明制造商特异的并发症特征是真实存在的，联邦学习能保留这些差异。报告了所有隐私-效用工作点。
AI.conclusion: 联邦贝叶斯方法可在差分隐私保证下有效学习不良事件率，性能优于差分隐私FedAvg，且联邦比集中池化更能保留制造商特异并发症特征。

title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
summary: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个2×2的深度防御框架，将内部激活引导与外部记忆处理分离，用于缓解长期记忆带来的"记忆诱发谄媚"问题。实验在MemSyco-Bench上评估四种开放权重模型，发现外部记忆过滤（尤其Router Gate）稳健有效，而反向引导的增益未获统计显著证据支持。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆让大语言模型能维持跨交互的个性化上下文，但检索到的用户历史会引发"记忆诱发谄媚"（memory-induced sycophancy），使模型偏向存储的用户信念而非客观证据。现有防御主要作用于检索上下文，且很少与模型内部行为偏差联合评估，因此需要一个同时覆盖内部与外部机制的防御框架。
AI.method: 提出2×2深度防御框架，分离内部激活引导与外部记忆处理。从100对配对提示中提取谄媚引导方向，在MemSyco-Bench上评估四种开放权重模型，覆盖10个引导系数与5种记忆防御配置，并使用三个LLM评判员。其中3种配置为新设计（重写每条记忆、Router Gate逐条保留/重写/丢弃记忆、丢弃全部记忆），另2种为MemSyco基线。
AI.result: 选择性Router Gate过滤比完全移除记忆保留了显著更多的MemSyco平均准确率，且该差异在模型被引导向谄媚时依然存在。在Llama 3.1 8B配合Router Gate时，温和反向引导（α=-1.5）将评判员平均谄媚率从35.80%降至31.32%，平均准确率从43.99%降至43.31%；该降低在三个评判员下方向一致，但不具统计显著性（149项上配对p=0.08至0.63）。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是整体设计中稳健有效的部分；数据未能证明反向引导能在其基础上带来额外增益。

title: ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, including references and appendices. Author-prepared version
summary: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出ARIA两阶段音频驱动框架，从粤语歌唱录音生成音调一致的粤语歌词，并构建大规模对齐数据集。
AI.motivation: 粤语歌词创作需词汇声调与旋律音高紧密对齐。现有旋律引导的歌词生成方法多依赖符号化旋律，而真实创作场景中旋律常表现为原始歌唱音频或哼唱录音，音高隐含、含噪且非结构化，导致现有方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: ARIA为两阶段音频驱动的旋律-声调关系建模框架。第一阶段设计三流关系感知声调估计器（TRATE），通过建模多流声学线索与关系性声调结构，从带时间戳的歌唱音频预测0243序列；第二阶段提出解耦检索增强的声调条件歌词生成器（DRA-TCLG），在预测的声调规划与检索增强词汇引导下生成流畅歌词。此外构建大规模对齐的音频-粤拼-0243数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明ARIA在0243预测与声调一致的歌词生成两方面均取得强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 验证了所提框架的有效性，为音频驱动的粤语歌词创作提供了可行方案。

title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
summary: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REViT-v2，一种可扩展的旋转-反射群等变视觉 Transformer，基于窗口化群卷积自注意力和分层特征架构，可扩展到百万参数级并在 ImageNet 上训练。
AI.motivation: 群等变视觉 Transformer 此前难以扩展到百万参数规模与实用尺寸图像的大规模数据集（如 ImageNet），可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 采用窗口化群卷积自注意力（windowed group-convolutional self-attention）与分层特征架构（hierarchical feature architecture）构建旋转-反射群等变视觉 Transformer。
AI.result: 所提方法可扩展到百万参数级的群等变 ViT，并可在 ImageNet 这类图像尺寸实用的大规模数据集上训练；代码与预训练权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: REViT-v2 验证了群等变视觉 Transformer 的可扩展性，为该方向的规模化研究提供了开源实现与预训练模型。

title: RAG-PIBench: A Leakage-Aware Benchmark for Prompt-Injection Detection in Trustworthy RAG Systems
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to prompt-injection attacks embedded in retrieved content. We introduce RAG-PIBench, a benchmark for RAG-style prompt-injection detection containing 4,876 contextual examples across frozen train, validation, and protected-test splits. Using a leakage-aware construction pipeline and strict evaluation protocol, we compare keyword-based, semantic-reference, TF-IDF, and transformer-based detectors. DistilBERT achieves the best protected-test performance (F1 = 0.896, PR-AUC = 0.968), while TF-IDF SVM and logistic regression remain competitive. Our results demonstrate the value of leakage-aware benchmark design and strong sparse baselines for reliable prompt-injection detection in RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAG-PIBench，一个包含4,876条上下文样本的RAG式提示注入检测基准，采用防泄漏构建流程，对比多种检测器，其中DistilBERT在受保护测试集上表现最佳（F1=0.896，PR-AUC=0.968）。
AI.motivation: RAG系统因检索内容可被植入提示注入攻击而存在安全隐患，亟需可靠的检测方法与无泄漏的评测基准来支撑相关研究。
AI.method: 构建RAG-PIBench基准，包含4,876条上下文样本并划分为冻结的训练、验证与受保护测试集；采用考虑数据泄漏的构建流程与严格评测协议，比较关键词法、语义参考法、TF-IDF及基于Transformer的检测器。
AI.result: DistilBERT在受保护测试集上取得最佳性能（F1=0.896，PR-AUC=0.968），TF-IDF SVM与逻辑回归同样具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 防泄漏的基准设计具有重要价值，强稀疏基线方法可为RAG系统中的提示注入检测提供可靠支持。

title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
summary: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.

AI.tldr: 提出 2D-FET-Bench V2，一个基于显微剥离二维薄片轮廓的 128 项 FET 版图任务基准，用确定性验证器与完整性检查评估语言模型智能体自动生成 GDSII 版图的能力。
AI.motivation: 二维薄片上的 FET 版图通常依赖人工逐片绘制，需根据光学显微图中薄片的形状与位置手工放置接触与栅极。目前缺乏可执行的基准来检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成这种"因片而异"的版图构建任务。
AI.method: 构建 128 项版图任务的基准，任务源自显微轮廓，包含带孔薄片与多薄片任务；每项任务给出文本器件规格与轮廓坐标。智能体生成带类型的多边形与路径操作并渲染为 GDSII。采用确定性验证器检查几何与结构要求，另设完整性检查以确认给定轮廓未被修改。脚本参考版图全部通过 128 项任务，验证任务可解。评估 6 个模型及 GPT5.6-Luna 的 7 种工作流/脚手架变体，每任务 5 次尝试。
AI.result: 6 模型面板中表现最佳的配置为 GPT5.6-Luna + ReAct-3：单次尝试通过率 62.3%，任务覆盖率 80.5%（至少一次成功），一致性 43.8%（五次全过）。ReAct-3 相比单轮 Plan-and-Execute 的 pass@1 高出 27.0 个百分点，但 token 消耗为 2.46 倍。对每个覆盖任务抽样一份通过验证器的版图进行专家审核，在五种 ReAct-3 配置下接受率为 56.4% 至 63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准聚焦于 FET 版图的几何与结构构建能力评估，为语言模型智能体在二维材料器件自动化设计中的表现提供了可执行、可验证的衡量标准，并揭示当前模型在可靠性与一致性上仍有明显提升空间。

title: Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing
summary: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

AI.tldr: 研究测试了五个大语言模型在意大利语假词加工任务上是否与人类一样对亚词汇线索敏感，结果发现LLM并不总是共享驱动人类假词加工的亚词汇线索。
AI.motivation: 系统性（形式到意义的概率映射）普遍存在于语言各层面，亚词汇线索已被证明支配人类的假词加工。然而，大语言模型（LLM）是否对这类线索具有可比敏感性仍不清楚，因此需要检验。
AI.method: 在两项意大利语二选一强制选择假词实验中对五个LLM进行测试，并将其反应与人类行为基线进行比较；同时考察亚词汇余弦相似度线索在人类-人类、人类-fastText与人类-LLM一致性中的作用，以及推理token消耗与人类加工难度的关系。
AI.result: 当真实词选项提供词汇熟悉度线索时，LLM与人类的一致性更可靠；而在纯假词条件下，LLM表现显著低于字符n-gram模型fastText。驱动人类-fastText一致性的亚词汇余弦相似度线索未能一致地迁移到人类-LLM一致性上，推理token消耗与人类加工难度也没有稳定关系。
AI.conclusion: LLM不一定共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索；作者讨论了分词（tokenization）和训练数据覆盖度作为可能的解释。

title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
summary: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is hard: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.

AI.tldr: PhysLDM提出统一的潜在扩散范式，用于一次性体素可变形仿真：核心是整体时空VAE避免时间压缩"阶梯"伪影，在高达78倍token压缩下实现约2.48mm重建精度；实验表明混沌动力学下扩散优于确定性回归，模型可零样本泛化到未见OOD数据集并支持逆问题与设计优化。
AI.motivation: 高保真可变形体神经仿真在计算机图形学与物理AI中是基础性难题。高分辨率3D体网格的长时程预测面临两难：自回归方法易累积误差，而在原生分辨率上直接多帧预测计算代价过高。这促使研究者寻求紧凑的时空潜在表示，但该方向在基于网格的体物理中尚少探索；同时，确定性回归与生成式扩散哪种预测范式更合适也尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出PhysLDM，一个用于一次性体可变形仿真的统一潜在扩散范式。其核心是整体（holistic）时空VAE，避免标准时间压缩（如常见视频VAE）带来的"阶梯"伪影，在米级场景上达到约2.48mm重建精度与最高78倍token压缩。基于该可靠潜在空间，系统比较回归与扩散方法，发现复杂可变形动力学常呈混沌特性：确定性回归倾向产生非物理的平均结果，而扩散能更好建模其分布。据此采用潜在扩散模型从混沌数据中学习，生成物理合理的轨迹。
AI.result: 在Objaverse规模数据集上纯运动学训练后，单个PhysLDM可零样本泛化到未见OOD数据集（GSO与Toys4K）。其可微性进一步支持高效求解逆问题与高阶设计优化。
AI.conclusion: PhysLDM是首个面向体可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与潜在扩散范式，为神经仿真提供了可扩展且稳健的方法。

title: TwinViT-DeepJSCC: Adversarially Robust Semantic Image Communication
summary: Learning-based semantic communication is vulnerable to adversarial perturbations introduced before semantic encoding or over wireless channels. This paper proposes TwinViT-DeepJSCC, a preventive-corrective semantic image transceiver operating under a fixed channel-use budget. Two Vision Transformer (ViT)-based deep joint source-channel coding (DeepJSCC) branches learn complementary latent representations protected by sensitivity-aware masking. At the receiver, confidence-aware fusion, blind corruption-severity estimation, and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)-severity-conditioned denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) purification mitigate residual corruption without requiring attack metadata. Experiments on the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research 100-class (CIFAR-100) dataset consider fast gradient sign method (FGSM), projected gradient descent (PGD), natural evolution strategies (NES), and Carlini-Wagner (CW) source-domain attacks, as well as random jamming and channel-aware adversarial waveforms over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and block-flat Rayleigh fading. Under matched channel-use and attack budgets, TwinViT-DeepJSCC achieves maximum peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) gains of approximately 9.5 dB under 20-step PGD and 10.8 dB under channel-aware waveform attacks over block-flat Rayleigh fading. Under PGD, it also improves Top-1 accuracy by up to approximately 38 percentage points over the undefended baseline and 13 percentage points over the strongest competing defense. Ablation results confirm the complementary contributions of the proposed transmitter- and receiver-side mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwinViT-DeepJSCC，一种在固定信道使用预算下的预防-纠正语义图像收发系统，用于提升语义通信对抗干扰的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的语义通信在语义编码前或无线信道中易受对抗扰动攻击，现有方法缺乏无需攻击元数据的有效防护。
AI.method: 采用两个基于ViT的DeepJSCC分支学习互补潜在表示并施加敏感度感知掩码；接收端结合置信度感知融合、盲式损坏严重度估计，以及受SNR-严重度条件约束的DDIM净化。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上测试FGSM、PGD、NES、CW源域攻击及AWGN与块平坦瑞利衰落下的干扰；匹配预算下PSNR最大增益约9.5 dB（20步PGD）与10.8 dB（信道感知波形）；PGD下Top-1准确率较无防护基线提升约38个百分点，较最强对比防御提升13个百分点；消融验证了收发两端机制贡献。
AI.conclusion: TwinViT-DeepJSCC通过收发端互补机制，在无需攻击元数据下显著增强语义图像传输的抗对抗与抗信道干扰能力。

title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了时间卷积分类器在慢性踝关节不稳步态生物反馈中的模型性能，并观察了自适应干预组与对照组之间额状面踝角的变化。
AI.motivation: 自适应步态生物反馈可能有助于慢性踝关节不稳患者的重复练习，但对其评估需同时考虑模型性能与人体响应。
AI.method: 在20名参与者中，采用留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）评估时间卷积分类器对基于角度推导的GOOD/BAD步态周期标签的分类表现。7名自适应干预组参与者完成3周9次训练，每次分析一次动作捕捉记录；将失败训练后更新的模型与其母模型在候选选择所用的同次验证子集及首次后续自适应训练记录上离线比较。同时比较自适应组与10名顺序入组对照组在基线、后测及7天保留期的额状面踝角。
AI.result: 20个留出折的平均AUROC为0.948，超出角度阈值BAD周期的敏感度为0.941，满足角度阈值GOOD周期的特异度为0.366。候选模型的平均BAD类F1在同次子集上高0.187，在首次后续记录上高0.118。后测时，自适应组经基线调整后的额状面踝角比对照组低5.168度（95%CI：低1.766–8.569度）；保留期对比结果不确定。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了重复生物反馈使用中群体模型判别能力与离线个体化更新，并发现非随机化后测额状面踝角关联；但未建立独立临床步态分类，也不能证明模型更新的因果获益。

title: Leveraging a four-quadrant approach for evaluating Redpine Science
summary: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at https://github.com/redpine-ai/benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该报告从检索相关性与模型答题质量两个层面评估 Redpine Science 文献检索工具，使用公开基准与专家验证问题集进行四项评测，并公开评测集与复现说明。
AI.motivation: 公开基准虽便于跨实验室比较，但存在饱和与记忆化风险，因此需要补充专家验证的问题集来更可靠地衡量检索工具的实际价值。
AI.method: 通过 MCP 与 API 接入经同行评审的文献库；采用两类评测：(1) 公开基准（ScholarQABench SciFact 答题质量、公共检索基准的前十召回）；(2) 专家验证问题集（要求陈述的必需论点覆盖率）与盲评专家相关性小组（Precision@5）。对照条件包括无检索、仅限网络搜索、以及 PubMed 检索工具。
AI.result: ScholarQABench SciFact 上，使用 Redpine Science 的智能体正确回答 94.4% 的论断，无检索为 87.6%；专家验证集上，陈述必需论点 80.1%，仅限网络搜索为 70.2%；公共检索基准 668 条查询（去除模型推理）Recall@10 为 83.1%，基准创建者为 79.3%；盲评 Precision@5 为 75.2%，PubMed 检索工具为 39.8%。
AI.conclusion: Redpine Science 在答题质量与检索相关性上均优于无检索、网络搜索及 PubMed 检索的对照方案；作者公开了专家验证问题集及全部头条结果的复现说明。

title: Disentangling Dual Image References in Frequency Aware Diffusion Models for Personalized Generation
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, to appear at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Personalized image generation aims to synthesize text-driven images conditioned on reference images, while mainly casting the generation as image customization for foreground and style transfer for background. Previous arts of diffusion models suffers from the text misalignment with background for image customization and foreground for style transfer during the denoising process. Such facts, as we observed, rooted from the entanglement among hybrid frequency bands during the denoising process. To address such salient limitation, in this paper, we study personalized generation based on dual references - customization and color and style reference - and propose a paradigm to disentangle these Dual image references within Frequency-aware Diffusion Models, dubbed Dual-FDM, to simultaneously tackle two crucial personalized image generation tasks: customization style transfer and color style transfer, by disentangling different frequency bands via mask strategy within frequency domain. For customization style transfer, we replace the mid-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from the foreground of the customized reference. For color style transfer, we substitute the low-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from both the foreground and background of the color reference. Both the substituted frequency bands are used as the key and value to reconstruct the query foreground and background of the denoised personalized image.Extensive experiments validate the superiority of Dual-FDM over the state-of-the-art diffusion models for personalized image generation. Our code can be accessed from https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-FDM，在频域中解耦双参考图像的不同频段，统一解决定制化风格迁移与色彩风格迁移两类个性化图像生成任务，性能优于现有扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型做个性化生成时，图像定制存在背景文本错位、风格迁移存在前景文本错位问题。作者观察到其根源在于去噪过程中混合频段的纠缠，因此希望从频域解耦角度解决该局限。
AI.method: 基于双重参考（定制参考与色彩/风格参考），提出频域感知扩散模型范式Dual-FDM。通过频域掩码策略解耦不同频段：定制化风格迁移时，用定制参考前景的中频段替换风格参考背景的中频段；色彩风格迁移时，用色彩参考前景与背景的低频段替换风格参考背景的低频段。替换后的频段作为key和value，用于重建去噪图像的query前景与背景。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Dual-FDM在个性化图像生成任务上优于当前最先进的扩散模型，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将个性化生成建模为双参考下的频段解耦问题，可在统一框架内同时完成定制化风格迁移与色彩风格迁移，验证了频域解耦思路的有效性。

title: Semantic Behavioral Watermarking: Paraphrase-Robust and Forgery-Resistant Provenance for LLM Agents
summary: Behavioral watermarking embeds an owner identifier in an LLM agent's high-level action choices, giving provenance without touching output tokens. Prior agent watermarks break in two ways. First, all three prior schemes bind the watermark to the exact action symbol, so renaming a tool desynchronizes decoding even when the observation is untouched; in AgentMark's own robustness test, paraphrasing the observation alone drops bit-recovery to 16.8%. Second, every prior agent watermark studies only removal: none asks whether an adversary can forge a trajectory that verifies as someone else's, a question answered affirmatively for text watermarks (Jovanović et al., 2024). We present Semantic Behavioral Watermarking (SBW): watermarking over semantic action clusters under history conditioning, with the public-cluster bin replaced by keyed collision-resistant binning whose fresh-bucket assignment is provably unpredictable in the random-oracle model. Across five agent models (3B-14B, four vendors) and three encoders the ordering holds on both benchmarks: on ToolBench (600 trajectories per model) detection under rewriting is 0.49-0.66 for cluster-level versus 0.05-0.17 for exact-symbol at a permutation-calibrated 1% FPR, at 72-83% choice agreement against 22-27% for logit biasing; on ALFWorld (100 episodes per model) it is 0.92-0.97 versus 0.00-0.01. Keyed binning takes adaptive forgery from 100% to the false-positive floor at the primary operating point (bge, r=64). We also mark the boundary that guarantee does not cover: when the adversary copies the victim's own steps, shuffled splicing is neutralized (0.000 on Qwen2.5-3B) but chained replay remains at 0.76-0.98 across the five models, reported as open. Paraphrase robustness costs about half of the per-step watermark capacity. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SBW-Agent-Watermark.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出语义行为水印（SBW），通过在历史条件下的语义动作聚类上进行水印嵌入，并采用密钥化抗碰撞分箱，显著提升了 LLM 智能体在动作重写下检测的鲁棒性，并首次防止了轨迹伪造。
AI.motivation: 已有智能体水印存在两大缺陷：一是将水印绑定到确切动作符号，导致工具重命名或观察改写即失效（如 AgentMark 中仅改写观察即令比特恢复率降至 16.8%）；二是只研究去除攻击，未考虑伪造攻击（而文本水印已被证明可被伪造）。论文旨在解决重写鲁棒性与可伪造性问题。
AI.method: 提出语义行为水印（SBW）：在历史条件下的语义动作聚类上嵌入水印，并用密钥化抗碰撞分箱替代公共聚类分箱，其新鲜桶分配在随机预言机模型下可证明不可预测。
AI.result: 在五个模型（3B-14B、四家厂商）与三个编码器上：ToolBench 重写下检测率为 0.49-0.66（聚类级）对 0.05-0.17（确切符号级），选择一致率 72-83% 对 22-27%；ALFWorld 为 0.92-0.97 对 0.00-0.01。密钥化分箱将自适应伪造从 100% 降至假阳性下限。但链式重放仍有 0.76-0.98 的存活率。
AI.conclusion: SBW 在语义层面实现重写鲁棒且抗伪造的智能体行为水印，但改写会损失约一半的每步水印容量，且链式重放攻击仍是未解决的开放问题。

title: When Does AI Supervision Help? A Role-Aware Study of Network Fraud Decision Management with Blockchain Auditability
summary: When does a second artificial intelligence (AI) component improve a primary network-fraud decision rather than add operational burden? We study this question through a role-aware Decider-Supervisor (DS) framework with blockchain auditability, evaluating four directional configurations that combine centralised machine learning, a Federated Averaging (FedAvg)-trained federated meta-model, and Base or Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) large language model variants. The analysis compares primary-only and supervised decisions using non-hard fraud performance, intervention burden, conditional calibration, traffic-mix and Review-capacity sensitivity, dependability tests, and blockchain lifecycle controls. The deterministic hard gate resolves 89.994% of fraudulent requests, leaving the non-hard population as the main AI decision setting. Conditional validation calibration does not produce a consistently transferable supervisory advantage on deployment replay. DS-3 QLoRA is the least disruptive supervised configuration, but it still underperforms its primary FedAvg stage in F1 and total errors. Across 36 reweighted traffic mixtures, supervision reduces total errors only for DS-4 Base in two extreme high-fraud scenarios. Blockchain tests support digest verification, tamper detection, authorisation, single-use review resolution, and post-finalisation integrity, while exposing a pre-finalisation single-write limitation. The results show that the value of AI supervision depends on role assignment, calibration, escalation policy, traffic composition, and lifecycle controls rather than on the presence of a second model alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角色感知的 Decider-Supervisor（DS）框架，研究在何种条件下引入第二个 AI 组件能真正改善网络欺诈决策，而非仅增加运营负担。
AI.motivation: 探讨叠加第二个 AI 组件是否真能提升网络欺诈决策质量，还是仅带来额外运营负担，需明确其价值成立的条件。
AI.method: 采用具备区块链可审计性的角色感知 Decider-Supervisor 框架，评估四种方向性配置，组合集中式机器学习、FedAvg 联邦元模型与 Base/QLoRA 大语言模型变体；比较 primary-only 与监督式决策，考察非硬欺诈性能、干预负担、条件校准、流量混合与审查容量敏感性、可靠性测试及区块链生命周期控制。
AI.result: 确定性硬门控解决 89.994% 欺诈请求，非硬人群为主要 AI 决策场域；条件验证校准未带来可迁移的监督优势。DS-3 QLoRA 干扰最小但 F1 与总错误仍劣于其 FedAvg 主阶段；36 种重加权流量中仅 DS-4 Base 在两个极端高欺诈场景降低总错误。区块链支持摘要验证、篡改检测、授权、单次审查与终局后完整性，但暴露终局前单写限制。
AI.conclusion: AI 监督的价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成与生命周期控制，而非第二个模型本身。

title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache.
