We introduce \textbf{MacJEPA}, a missing-modality-robust \textbf{Ma}sked-\textbf{c}ontext query \textbf{JEPA} that recognizes visual actions and acoustic events from supplied interval queries over audio-visual context. Window-local modality dropout simulates these sensor outages during training. MacJEPA further repurposes masking in JEPA from a self-supervised pretext into a supervised robustness objective, aligning masked and clean latent representations of both multimodal content tokens and the task-conditioned queries. All objectives are optimized jointly with recognition in a single stage, requiring no test-time adaptation. Across Epic-Kitchens-100 and Epic-Sounds, a single checkpoint remains competitive under complete input and consistently surpasses published missing-modality baselines when either the dominant or auxiliary stream is removed. MacJEPA thus unifies strong full-input recognition with temporal missing-modality robustness in a single model operating on untrimmed multi-event videos.

AI.tldr: MacJEPA将自我中心模态缺失重新定义为未剪辑多事件观测中的时间局部传感器故障，并提出掩码上下文查询JEPA框架，在单阶段联合训练下同时实现强完整输入识别与时间维度缺失模态鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频自我中心动作识别模型通常假设推理时双流均可用，而现有缺失模态方法仅处理已剪辑的单事件片段，即某模态整体存在或整体缺失。真实传感器失效与恢复发生在长时、未剪辑观测中，因此需要重新定义模态缺失问题。
AI.method: 提出MacJEPA（掩码上下文查询JEPA），通过窗口局部模态dropout模拟传感器故障；将JEPA中的掩码从自监督预训练任务改造为监督鲁棒性目标，对齐多模态内容token与任务条件查询的掩码和干净潜在表示；所有目标与识别任务单阶段联合优化，无需测试时适配。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-100与Epic-Sounds上，单一检查点在完整输入下保持竞争力，并在移除主导流或辅助流时持续超越已发表的缺失模态基线。
AI.conclusion: MacJEPA在单一模型中统一了强完整输入识别与时间缺失模态鲁棒性，适用于未剪辑多事件视频。

title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.

AI.tldr: 量化智能体的容错评估结论高度依赖提示词、评估目标与评分策略，单一设置无法给出稳定结论。
AI.motivation: 训练后量化可降低语言模型智能体的部署成本，但其对临时工具故障恢复能力的影响尚不明确，且现有评估方式可能掩盖结论的不稳定性。
AI.method: 在二十个确定性工具任务与五种提示词下，对比Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的8位与4位量化变体；在不同评估目标（仅在各自通过任务上评分、同一任务集评分、全流程评分）与不同评分策略（严格输出解析）下重复评估。
AI.result: 8位与4位的恢复比较会随提示词和评估目标改变方向：Llama差异为0至+20.2个百分点，Qwen为-50.0至+35.0个百分点；全流程点估计下8位Llama在五种提示词中均占优，而Qwen结果随提示词反转。评估目标也能反转结论，如某提示词下Llama可分别偏向4位17.5点、无差异、偏向8位28.3点；改用严格输出解析后该+28.3变为-15.0，Qwen基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 单一提示词、单一筛选任务集与单一评分策略不足以建立关于量化智能体鲁棒性的稳定结论。评估应在匹配任务上比较变体、报告全流程成功率以支持部署决策、明确评分策略，并跨任务而非仅跨注入故障点量化不确定性。

title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文将深度学习角点检测集成到完整的条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）系统标定流程中，系统分析了角点定位误差在标定链中的传播，并在混合数据集上将相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素、投影仪重投影误差降低约50%，提升了三维重建几何精度。
AI.motivation: FPP需要精确的系统标定才能实现可靠的三维重建，而标定精度高度依赖棋盘格特征的稳健定位，在镜头模糊、标定靶姿态变化等恶劣成像条件下定位质量会下降。现有基于深度学习的角点检测器通常仅用检测指标和相机重投影误差来评估，未考虑其对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性以及整体测量精度的更广泛影响。
AI.method: 提出一套完整的FPP标定流程，将深度学习角点检测融入标准相机标定工作流；通过采样标定靶白色方格中心的相位值来标定投影仪；该框架不将角点检测视为孤立任务，而是显式分析定位误差如何在整个FPP标定链中传播。评估采用检测指标（精确率、召回率）、相机与投影仪重投影误差以及相机-投影仪立体标定结果。
AI.result: 在包含清晰与退化图像的混合数据集上，相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差降低约50%；对重建工件的尺寸评估显示，相比传统流程几何精度得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在恶劣成像条件下系统级标定的稳健性得到提升，从而可实现更可靠的工业FPP测量。

title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.

AI.tldr: 将长上下文推理分解到多个协作智能体可降低单次调用的活跃KV缓存，但持久化推理痕迹层无准确率收益。
AI.motivation: KV缓存内存成为瓶颈时，需要区分"分解降低峰值缓存"与"持久层提升准确率"两个常被混同的主张，并检验后者是否只是消融实验的假象。
AI.method: 在同一三层智能体架构上同时测量两种效应：对比分解、单次推理与检索增强基线的峰值KV工作集；在八个受控数据集对、每臂n=100下测量持久化痕迹层的缓存代价与准确率变化；并记录四次测量修正对结论的影响。
AI.result: 分解有效：每查询峰值KV工作集14.3 MiB，低于单次推理35.5 MiB和检索增强35.3 MiB。持久层无效：增加+0.368 MiB峰值缓存（95% CI [+0.167, +0.590]），准确率变化+0.015（95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]），无显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 持久记忆层的零效应是结构性的：单题基准自带证据且独立评分，召回无可检索之物。给出智能体记忆消融必须满足的条件及与具体缺陷无关的检测流程。

title: TSRN-RTVD: Real-Time Video Deblurring System
summary:
As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult.
  We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU.

AI.tldr: 提出 TSRN-RTVD 实时视频去模糊系统，通过显式重建曝光期间相机轨迹来引导复原，在单块消费级 GPU 上以 30 FPS 运行并在 GoPro 数据集取得 30.08 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 手持与边缘设备拍摄导致相机抖动产生的运动模糊普遍存在，降低感知质量并损害下游视觉任务。现有最强去模糊网络虽细节出色，但计算量大、结构复杂，消费级硬件无法实时运行。复原质量与端侧速度之间的差距正是实时去模糊的难点。
AI.method: 开发并实现 TSRN-RTVD 高效视频去模糊系统，显式重建曝光期间的相机轨迹，并利用恢复的运动信息指导复原，将模糊的物理成因转化为驱动锐化的信号。系统运行于单块消费级 GPU，并提供交互式可视化：模糊输入与去模糊输出的并排对比、实时吞吐量以及恢复的相机轨迹屏幕显示。
AI.result: 在单块消费级 GPU 上以 30 FPS 恢复视频，在 GoPro 数据集上达到 30.08 dB PSNR；演示视频见 https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相机轨迹重建作为显式信号引导去模糊，TSRN-RTVD 在消费级设备上实现了兼具质量与实时性的视频去模糊，并支持交互式演示。

title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
summary: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attacca，通过解耦目标图像、掩码预测与行为阶段条件训练视觉目标条件策略，显著提升长时程具身任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉目标条件策略多在目标已可见的孤立交互上评估，无法应对连续长时程任务中目标不在视野、状态被前序任务改变等真实挑战，导致智能体难以接续完成下一任务。
AI.method: Attacca 基于完整"搜索—交互"轨迹训练策略：采用上下文解耦目标采样，将每个示范与来自其他世界的类兼容掩码目标图像配对，去除场景与位姿对应；通过目标掩码预测头学习密集的当前视野 grounding，提供动作模仿之外的辅助监督；并引入行为阶段条件，使策略区分 Search、Approach、Interact 三阶段并随执行进展调整控制。
AI.result: 在 Minecraft 多项短时程与长时程具身任务上，Attacca 取得 39.0-47.5% 的干净成功率，较最强基线提升 1.7-2.4 倍；长时程任务完成率分别为 54%、30%、28%，最高提升达 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦目标表示、强化视野 grounding 与显式建模行为阶段，可有效提升智能体在长时程连续任务中的视觉目标条件控制能力。

title: Whose Face Is It Anyway? A Multi-Model Audit of Facial Affect Recognition on Children, and Why the Gap Is the Head, Not the Features
summary: Facial affect models are trained almost entirely on adults, yet are increasingly applied to children in education, health, and developmental research. We present a controlled, multi-model audit of five AffectNet-pretrained expression models (EmoNet, EmotiEffLib, DDAMFN++, OpenFace 3.0, LibreFace) on children, across four child image datasets, the AffectNet-8 validation set, and two spontaneous child video datasets, through one shared harness. Three findings emerge. First, the child gap is model-agnostic: every architecture degrades from posed to naturalistic faces and shares the fear$\rightarrow$surprise confusion. Second, it is concentrated and corroborated across all five models: open-mouth faces (read as surprise, correlating with the AU26 jaw drop) and South-Asian children degrade systematically, with a smaller averted-gaze penalty, while closed-mouth faces, White and Black children, and direct gaze do not; the bias tracks expression morphology and specific populations, not skin tone. Third, the gap is diagnosable: a linear probe on frozen features reaches 0.75-0.91 on unseen children versus 0.48-0.66 zero-shot, so it lies largely in the classifier head, not the representation, whereas dimensional valence/arousal regression degrades sharply under domain shift. Building on this, recalibrating only the head on a little target data recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.28$ on the two largest child sets across all five models at negligible adult cost, though the gain is in-distribution and does not transfer across child collections. We will release the harness, per-sample predictions, and analysis code; the child face data stays license-locked and is never redistributed.

AI.tldr: 本文对五个基于AffectNet预训练的表情识别模型在儿童图像上进行了受控多模型审计，发现儿童表情识别存在跨模型一致的性能下降，问题主要集中在分类头而非表征，仅重校准分类头即可显著改善。
AI.motivation: 面部情感模型几乎完全用成人数据训练，却被越来越多地应用于儿童相关的教育、健康和发展研究，存在潜在的适用性风险，因此需要系统评估这些模型在儿童群体上的表现。
AI.method: 通过统一测试框架，在四个儿童图像数据集、AffectNet-8验证集和两个儿童自发视频数据集上，对EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace五个模型进行多模型审计，并采用线性探针与分类头重校准进行分析。
AI.result: 儿童性能差距与模型架构无关，所有模型从摆拍转向自然表情均退化并共现恐惧→惊讶混淆；张口面孔（与AU26下颌下垂相关）和南亚儿童系统退化，而闭口面孔、白人和黑人儿童、直视目光不受影响；线性探针在未见儿童上达0.75-0.91，而零样本仅0.48-0.66；仅重校准分类头可提升+0.13至+0.28，但增益为分布内且不跨儿童数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 儿童表情识别差距是可诊断的，主要源于分类头而非特征表征；通过少量目标数据重校准分类头即可低成本显著提升性能，但增益有限且不可泛化，需谨慎应用于儿童场景。

title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.

AI.tldr: OOPMAS是一个免训练框架，以面向对象方式在单查询粒度生成智能体集合与协作工作流，在混合任务基准上取得89.6%准确率，超最强基线18.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统自动化设计方法大多在任务级别运行，为每个基准生成单一固定工作流并统一应用于所有查询。但现实条件下查询难度差异大，且工作负载混合多种异质任务类型，这一假设不成立。
AI.method: 提出OOPMAS：以面向对象类定义表示智能体，具备专属角色、工具与持久状态；将工作流表达为作用于这些智能体对象的可执行main函数；通过动态技能库在多轮优化中从执行反馈积累结构化经验，实现无需梯度更新或微调的上下文内改进。
AI.result: 在覆盖代码、数学与问答的混合任务基准上达到89.6%准确率，比最强基线高出18.1个百分点；跨四种LLM主干的模型替换研究显示一致的扩展性，最强模型上达到92.4%。
AI.conclusion: 查询粒度的智能体与工作流协同生成，配合免训练的技能积累机制，可有效应对难度波动与异质任务混合的现实场景，并随底层模型能力提升而稳定受益。

title: Event Detection in Table Tennis Videos using 2D Keypoints
comment: Accepted at the 9th International ACM Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events: (1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center. A small keypoint transformer combines them into a compact representation that is robust to changes in viewpoint, lighting, and background clutter. (2) The temporal sequences of these frame-based representations are processed by a transformer encoder that predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, indicating how close the current frame is to the next and previous ball-racket contact. One novelty is a new, temporal cosine-like target signal. Furthermore, we introduce viewpoint augmentation via 3D reprojection and frame-rate augmentation to improve robustness and generalization. Our extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1 score of 91.16% and a mean frame deviation between ground truth and predicted frame of 0.42 on the Latte-MV dataset and 73.08% / 1.16 on the challenging TTHQ dataset. Overall, our work demonstrates that 2d keypoint-based temporal modeling with our EventNet architecture is a promising and practical approach for automatic event detection in table tennis videos.

AI.tldr: 提出EventNet两阶段流水线，用2D关键点与Transformer实现乒乓球视频帧级事件检测。
AI.motivation: 现有3D球轨迹与旋转估计方法需预先已知球拍触球等关键事件，难以应用于长时未剪辑视频。
AI.method: 两阶段：先提取双方上半身、球桌角点与球心的2D关键点，用小型关键点Transformer融合为紧凑表示；再用Transformer编码器处理时序表示，逐帧预测到前后两次触球的时间距离。引入类余弦时间目标信号、3D重投影视角增强与帧率增强。
AI.result: Latte-MV数据集F1为91.16%、平均帧偏差0.42；TTHQ数据集为73.08%/1.16。
AI.conclusion: 基于2D关键点的时序建模是乒乓球视频自动事件检测的实用有效方案。

title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型（LLM）中的错觉模式感知，发现其比人类更易在随机数据中构造虚假关联与因果叙事，并通过稀疏自编码器揭示了其内部机制。
AI.motivation: 错觉模式感知是人类在随机数据中推断虚假意义关系的认知倾向，会导致系统性推理错误。本文关注LLM是否也具备此类倾向，从而影响下游应用的可靠性，而这一问题此前未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将经典心理学范式改编为三项任务，与人类行为进行直接实证对比；并构建基于稀疏自编码器（SAEs）的特征可解释性框架，分析模型内部表征。
AI.result: LLM常表现出比人类更强的错觉模式感知：倾向于将高频正面属性过度关联于多数群体或大型组织，并更倾向从模糊事件中构建因果叙事。SAE分析显示，整体频率感知与分析性认知取向与错觉感知的出现相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM存在一种此前未被充分探索的类认知错觉，可能影响其推理可靠性；代码已开源。

title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance
summary: Counter-UAV systems based on thermal infrared detection must stay accurate as operational datasets evolve, yet sequential fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of prior tasks, a problem that remains insufficiently characterized in this domain. This continual-learning study measures the stability-plasticity trade-off in YOLOMG, a YOLOv5-based detector run as a single thermal-infrared stream with the motion channel disabled, trained sequentially across three anti-UAV benchmarks of rising scale difficulty: Anti-UAV-RGBT, Anti-UAV410, and CST Anti-UAV. Naive fine-tuning on CST yields a Forgetting Measure of -0.605 against the Stage 1 ceiling, corresponding to a 90% capability loss, with -0.572 occurring in Stage 3 alone. In contrast, knowledge distillation from a frozen teacher is associated with FM = -0.033 +/- 0.004 across three seeds, corresponding to 95% retention. Because no Stage 2 no-KD control is included, this result establishes retention under KD training rather than a causal KD effect. Per-stratum analysis shows large-target detection collapsing to near zero within the first epoch, despite an inter-stage cosine similarity of 0.987 over the gradient-updated weights, pointing to scale-conditioned gradient imbalance, rather than weight drift, as a candidate mechanism. Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH), a 300-exemplar buffer balanced across four UAV size strata, roughly halves the forgetting (FM = -0.605 to -0.311) and keeps large-target detection non-zero. An ablation attributes the gain primarily to scale stratification rather than herding: random-stratified replay performs at least as well (FM = -0.221 versus -0.311 for SSH). These replay results are single-seed and should therefore be treated as preliminary.

AI.tldr: 针对热红外反无人机检测器YOLOMG的持续学习研究：朴素微调导致90%能力损失，知识蒸馏可保留95%性能，尺度分层回放能减半遗忘。
AI.motivation: 基于热红外检测的反无人机系统需随运行数据集演化保持精度，但顺序微调会引发对先前任务的灾难性遗忘，而该领域对此问题刻画不足。
AI.method: 在YOLOv5基线的YOLOMG（单热红外流、关闭运动通道）上，按难度递增的Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV三个基准顺序训练；采用冻结教师的知识蒸馏；提出尺度分层牧群（SSH）——跨四个无人机尺寸层平衡的300样本缓冲区，并进行消融对比随机分层回放。
AI.result: 朴素微调FM为-0.605（相对Stage 1上限，约90%能力损失），仅Stage 3即-0.572；冻结教师KD下FM=-0.033±0.004（三个种子），保留约95%。分层分析显示大目标检测在首轮即近乎归零，而阶段间梯度更新权重余弦相似度达0.987，指向尺度条件性梯度失衡而非权重漂移。SSH将遗忘从-0.605降至-0.311并保持大目标检测非零；消融显示增益主要来自尺度分层而非牧群策略，随机分层回放表现至少相当（FM=-0.221 vs -0.311）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究刻画了热红外反无人机检测中的稳定性-可塑性权衡，表明KD训练与尺度分层回放可有效缓解遗忘，其中尺度分层是回放增益的关键因素；因缺少Stage 2无KD对照，KD结论仅为相关性而非因果效应，回放结果为单种子，应视为初步结论。

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

AI.tldr: 当财务信息缺失时，LLM 的资产配置建议会因"投资者是谁"而大幅摇摆：从完整披露到零披露，两个财务相同但身份不同的角色之间的权益配置差距平均由 4.78 个百分点升至 10.34 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 人们常向大语言模型咨询理财，却很少完整描述自身财务状况。论文关注"信息缺口"下模型的行为：在财务状况固定、仅改变投资者身份的情形下，考察披露程度如何放大身份对建议的影响，以评估此类顾问系统在真实使用场景中的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建 100 个财务画像 × 138 个角色 × 7 种披露条件的 96,600 条提示，输入 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；将提示中的财务证据从 8 条事实递减至 0 条，测量推荐权益配置的变动。采用双向聚类 bootstrap（对重复提示只计一次）估计比率，并按角色层级聚类标准误；同时进行线性探针解码与性别方向消融实验。
AI.result: 平均身份差距从完整披露的 4.78 个百分点升至零披露的 10.34 个百分点；bootstrap 比率 2.16（95% 区间 1.69–2.79），仅保留 1 条事实时已达 1.69 倍。身份在完整披露下解释 5% 的画像内变异，零披露下升至 96%。家庭规模是唯一随证据撤除而稳定增强的属性。按角色聚类后，会议版本中多数属性特定交互失去显著性；性别表现为完整披露也无法消除的小幅固定差距。单说风险偏好即可造成相当于 2–7 条通用事实的摇摆。零披露时模型会引用从未告知的收入、债务与储蓄，且对大家庭更常转向不利。
AI.conclusion: 模型的网络内部各层均可线性解码性别，但在五层消融性别方向并不改变总体身份摇摆，说明该效应并非单一线性方向所致。基于此类模型的顾问系统应在用户实际达到的披露水平上接受审计，并在整个身份空间而非单一属性上评估。

authors: Heyam Bin Jahlan Areej Alhothali Abeer Alhothali
title: Transferable Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack on Black-Box Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: The rapid integration of Vision Language Models (VLMs) into sensitive systems introduces critical safety vulnerabilities that remain unexplored in exist studies. While adversarial attack robustness has been extensively studied for image-based models, the susceptibility of VLMs to temporally-aware adversarial attacks against video in driving context poses a distinct and under examined threat. In this paper, we introduce novel adversarial attack against video targeting VLM models used for autonomous driving scenes named Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack (STCA). Our attack comprise from three stages: modalities expansion, Spatial attack, and STCA attack. In modalities expansion, we propose caption-guided frame selection method in order to ensure that adversarial perturbation target the most semantically significant frames. Secondly.In spatial attack, we craft effective perturbation and preserve high similarity. Then the perturbed video generated fed into STCA stage that disrupt cross-frame temporal coherence using motion guided mask. Our method operate under black box threat model against victim target VLMs, relying solely on transferability from white-box surrogate model.We conduct our experiments on the BDD100K and nuScenes autonomous driving datasets across three VLM models: Video LLaVA-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Dolphin. Experimental results demonstrate spatial attack achieves an ASR with high SSIM. Our finding reveal that existing video language model, remain highly susceptible to adversarial attack in autonomous driving scenarios, underscoring the urgent need for robust defense for VLM models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向自动驾驶视频的时空一致性对抗攻击STCA，在三种VLM模型上验证其脆弱性。
AI.motivation: VLM被快速集成到敏感系统，但其面向视频的时空对抗攻击鲁棒性研究不足，尤其在自动驾驶场景下存在未被充分探索的安全威胁。
AI.method: 提出STCA攻击，含三阶段：模态扩展（基于caption引导的关键帧选择）、空间攻击（生成高相似度扰动）、STCA攻击（利用运动引导掩码破坏跨帧时间一致性）；采用黑盒威胁模型，仅依赖白盒替代模型的迁移性。
AI.result: 在BDD100K和nuScenes数据集上针对Video LLaVA-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Dolphin进行实验，空间攻击在高SSIM下取得较高ASR。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频语言模型在自动驾驶场景中仍高度易受对抗攻击，亟需构建鲁棒的VLM防御机制。

title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.

AI.tldr: ThinkFuse：一种免训练测试时融合框架，通过对比段级不确定性偏移与轨迹级不确定性趋势，识别不稳定推理点并选择性融合辅助推理路径，提升小推理模型的复杂推理表现。
AI.motivation: 小推理模型（SRM）虽能通过长链思维在复杂推理任务上表现良好，但一旦推理走入错误路径便难以恢复。现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号决定触发时机，易受瞬时不确定性波动误导，可能强化不稳定的推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 ThinkFuse，一种免训练的测试时融合框架，选择性干预不可靠推理片段。其核心是对比段级不确定性偏移与轨迹级不确定性趋势，以识别不稳定推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合进主模型轨迹中。
AI.result: 在数学与知识密集型推理基准上优于基线，在不同模型家族组合下均有一致增益，且在主模型规模较小时仍保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: ThinkFuse 所需融合触发次数更少、生成 token 更少，体现了选择性触发的高效性。代码已开源。

title: Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
summary: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.

AI.tldr: 提出数字孪生驱动的 Real2Sim2Real 流水线（DT-R2S2R），在无需目标区域真实图像的情况下合成逼真驾驶数据，用于训练 3D 检测器。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的 3D 感知依赖大量标注数据，部署到新区域需重新采集标注。现有生成增强方法存在两难：标签条件方法需消耗其本想替代的标注，仿真器条件方法虽有免费标注但缺乏对具体真实环境的视觉接地。
AI.method: 通过在地理配准的数字孪生（DT-R2S）中重建录制的驾驶片段，以几何对齐的仿真渲染作为扩散模型的条件，建立数字孪生接地的 Sim2Real 模型（DT-S2R）。
AI.result: DT-S2R 能在孪生覆盖范围内的重建场景与新场景中，基于低成本且地理配准的仿真数据生成逼真驾驶图像。多种 3D 检测器验证有效；DETR3D 在不使用目标图像训练的条件下达到目标区域真实数据 oracle 的 93.18% mAP，且与已有的非目标真实数据简单协同训练可超越 oracle。
AI.conclusion: DT-R2S2R 可大幅降低数字孪生覆盖区域的人工现场数据采集与标注成本，为 3D 感知的规模化提供实用基础。

title: DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models
summary: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 提出DIPrune，一种无需训练的多模态大模型剪枝框架，通过双重要性评分机制联合优化层内静态显著性与层间动态语义演化，在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有无需训练的MLLM剪枝方法虽能降低计算开销，但因任务无关设计或不可靠的注意力估计，常导致语义退化。实证分析发现：浅层显著token会通过数值惯性持续压制新出现的语义token，导致深层推理所需的关键信号被过早丢弃。
AI.method: 从任务导向角度，将无需训练剪枝重新表述为最终任务损失失真的最小化问题，推导出可处理的token级上界作为代理目标，该表述揭示了一个此前被忽略的跨层梯度项。据此提出DIPrune，一个基于排序的框架，采用双重要性评分机制共同优化层内静态特征显著性和层间动态语义演化。
AI.result: 在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上的大量实验表明，DIPrune持续取得最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务导向的损失失真最小化建模与双重要性评分，DIPrune有效缓解了浅层显著token对新兴语义信号的抑制问题，在无需训练前提下实现了MLLM剪枝的性能领先。

title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
summary: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic SemS，一个面向 AI-RAN 的闭环语义感知框架，通过剖面条件因果 Transformer、KV 缓存与语义效用网络实现自适应剖面选择与语义早退。
AI.motivation: 现有语义感知多为开环：感知配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法根据任务级证据的变化自适应调整。作者希望在通信可行剖面集合内实现闭环控制，使感知配置与时长随证据演化而调整。
AI.method: 提出剖面条件因果 Transformer，从流式观测更新语义信念；利用 key-value 缓存支持跨剖面变化的高效状态更新，避免重复处理完整历史。语义效用网络在计入感知成本后估计各可行剖面下获取下一观测块的任务级收益。由此得到的延续效用同时支持下一剖面选择与语义早退，并进一步将期望语义增益与条件互信息关联，给出持续在线感知的价值信息解释。
AI.result: 在 Widar3.0 与六个仿真感知剖面上，相比全序列 High 设置，资源高效的 Agentic 设置将归一化累积感知成本降低 25.33%，同时达到 85.79% Macro-F1。在同一效用检查点，语义早退相比无早退的自适应感知再降低 12.35% 成本，Macro-F1 仅下降 0.97 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Agentic SemS 在通信可行约束下实现闭环语义感知，能够在保持较高任务性能的同时显著降低感知成本，并为在线感知的持续价值提供信息论解释。

title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolarScale 基准，将全斯托克斯重建中的辐射尺度作为显式预测与评估目标，并系统评测多种模型在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有从类RGB输入推断偏振的方法仅预测归一化斯托克斯分量或相对描述符，辐射尺度被除掉，导致无法进行完整斯托克斯重建；该尺度本身是被忽略的关键量，因此需要将其显式化。
AI.method: 基于已有三色全斯托克斯测量构建 PolarScale 基准，输入为逐场景归一化总强度图 s0（场景参照线性图像），要求模型预测归一化斯托克斯分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 及逐场景尺度；由于尺度被除掉而物理上不可辨识，采用数据集条件下的语义尺度估计并设常数尺度对照，配合角度、自一致性及物理边界指标评估。测试了七种复原类与生成式骨干及三种预测策略。
AI.result: 最强复原模型尺度估计平均相对误差为3.6-4.3%，常数对照为5.7%，物理边界违例少于0.25%像素；两个生成式基线尺度坍缩至近零；显式描述符监督提升描述符精度（MAE 下 23.66 对 18.88 dB PSNR）。预测的全斯托克斯表示改善了漫反射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但在漫反射/镜面分离上学习尺度仅与常数对照相当。
AI.conclusion: PolarScale 将辐射尺度确立为可预测、可评估的目标，揭示了复原模型可有效估计尺度而生成模型存在坍缩问题，并证明全斯托克斯预测对多项下游任务有益，但尺度学习的实际增益在某些任务上仍有限。

title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

AI.tldr: 提出 DHCG 框架，将多智能体系统设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，动态构建分层协作图，在多个推理基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统存在组合能力有限、依赖关系错位、扩展不灵活等问题，难以在执行过程中适应推理需求的变化。
AI.method: 将 MAS 设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，动态确定系统的组合与规模；提出 DHCG 框架，协调 Planner、Worker 和 Generator 三个模块，基于查询和执行反馈从零逐步构建动态分层协作图；Planner 在反馈引导下生成互补角色并选择性路由信息，可提前终止或逐步扩展图；并引入动作感知偏好优化训练 Planner。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理和领域特定推理基准上评估，DHCG 取得对比方法中最优的平均性能，比单智能体基线提升 13.06 分，优于静态和动态 MAS 基线 2.77-8.02 分；在不同 Planner 骨干和未见 Worker 模型上也展现出泛化性。
AI.conclusion: DHCG 通过动态构建分层协作图有效解决了现有 MAS 的局限，提升了性能与泛化能力。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 QuAR，一种面向量化 ViT 的单次前向、免反向传播、免参数更新的测试时自适应方法，通过对齐激活的逐通道统计量来缓解量化模型在分布偏移下的激活码分布失真问题。
AI.motivation: 量化视觉 Transformer 在边缘部署中很常见，但在分布偏移下性能急剧下降。现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法大多需要反向传播、额外前向或参数更新，开销大，且未针对量化特有的失效模式：偏移下激活落入冻结量化器标定区间的分布发生变化，导致码分布被扭曲。
AI.method: QuAR 在冻结量化器的输入端对激活进行重新校准，将测试流的运行逐通道统计量映射回源域的标定统计量，从而对齐量化器码分布。方法为单次前向，不反向传播，也不更新任何模型参数。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-C、ViT-B 上，QuAR 在 3/4/6/8 比特权重激活精度下取得免反向传播 TTA 方法中最高的平均准确率，8 比特比最强基线高 2.28 点，3 比特高 4.00 点，延迟降低 46%，内存额外开销仅 0.17 MB（占峰值推理内存 0.01%）。诊断表明增益源于降低了量化器处逐通道失配，恢复了码分布。
AI.conclusion: 单一固定配置在连续流、非独立同分布标签偏移、七个 OOD 套件及三种其他骨干网络上均保持领先，说明 QuAR 是一种高效、通用且针对量化失效模式的 TTA 方案。

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 RA-MoWE 框架，用工作流亲和度嵌入对查询聚类，生成可复用的专家工作流，兼顾个性化推理策略与优化成本。
AI.motivation: 针对整个任务集合优化的工作流会忽视单个查询所需的推理策略差异，而为每个查询单独搜索新工作流又会重复高昂的优化成本，本文旨在解决这一权衡。
AI.method: 利用工作流亲和度嵌入对查询聚类：每个嵌入记录一组固定参考工作流解决该查询的效果，以揭示有效推理策略的相似性；用每个簇的查询与平均嵌入来初始化并通过执行反馈优化专用工作流；再用嵌入编码器从查询文本预测嵌入，使新查询无需先执行参考工作流即可选择已生成的专家工作流。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、科学和编程四个基准的 300 条查询测试集上，相较在参考工作流中选择，RA-MoWE 将平均任务得分提升 4.04 个百分点，同时推理时语言模型调用次数减少 27.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过工作流亲和度嵌入的聚类与专家工作流生成，RA-MoWE 在提升任务表现的同时降低了推理开销，验证了在通用与逐查询优化之间取得平衡的可行性。

title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Image-Based Visualization Reading
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material. Accepted by the VISxGenAI workshop at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans.

AI.tldr: 本文将Stevens幂律引入AI模型可视化阅读能力的测量，通过参照-比较的估计任务，评估十二种视觉变量，使算法模型的感知机制可量化、可与人比较、更具可解释性。
AI.motivation: AI模型阅读可视化的"先天能力"（内置感知机制）缺乏可量化、可与人对比的测量方法；作者希望借用心理物理学中的Stevens幂律来揭示算法模型的内建感知机制。
AI.method: 采用Stevens幂律作为测量框架；在无图例（no legend）的设定下，模型先观看一个参照视觉表示并估计其量级，再对同一表示的后续图像相对于参照进行量级估计；该流程应用于十二种视觉变量的评估。
AI.result: 对十二种视觉变量的评估表明，该方法能够度量算法模型如何阅读视觉编码，使其具备可测量性、与人类感知的可比性，并提升对人类的可解释性（属试点研究结果）。
AI.conclusion: 将Stevens幂律迁移至AI视觉化阅读研究是可行的，可为模型感知机制提供可量化、可比较且可解释的评估路径。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps 是一个多智能体工作流编排框架，通过从历史工作流中学习智能体协作先验，并按需扩展智能体池，提升复杂知识工作的执行效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统的编排层大多缺乏记忆：每个新任务都从零开始分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功执行的经验。
AI.method: 提出三个耦合机制：(1) 转移概率矩阵，从历史工作流中捕获智能体两两协作频率，在DAG构建中通过层内排序优化、概率阈值边建议和传递约简进行软引导；(2) 充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，通过语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，用LLM生成专用智能体并注入协作矩阵；(3) 分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句嵌入做快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信案例调用LLM验证。
AI.result: 在代码、数学和问答混合测试集上，WorkflowOps 相比近期的工作流构建基线提高了端到端通过率，在结构化、可分解任务上收益最大。分层语义匹配相比纯LLM方法减少超过80%的LLM路由调用。
AI.conclusion: 从历史工作流中学习协作先验并按需扩展智能体池，能有效提升多智能体编排的任务通过率，同时分层语义匹配显著降低LLM调用开销。

title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

AI.tldr: 提出UniCounting，将固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数建模为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推理，仅训练一个3267参数的关系头，在COCO clean500上取得优于校准OWLv2-All80的向量计数精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数通常针对单一指定目标，模型需依赖图像特定示例、文本查询或目标类别，仅输出单一计数。本文关注更现实的设定：每个运行固定一个全局词表，仅给定RGB图像，模型需在不知晓哪些类别出现的情况下，预测完整的分→计数向量。
AI.method: 将计数转化为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推理。冻结SAM 2.1生成掩码，冻结DINOv2与OpenCLIP提供关系与类别特征。仅训练一个3267参数、类别共享的关系头，利用掩码派生监督预测同实例亲和度。随后通过稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与背景边界准入，将每个被接纳的连通分量转换为一个计数，并给出可复现的组证据。训练不使用计数或密度图目标。
AI.result: 在COCO clean500上，UniCounting的点估计向量ℓ1误差与缺失类别虚假质量均低于校准的OWLv2-All80，微观存在F1相当。在匹配解码器下，学习到的关系相比掩码包含、掩码IoU、CLIP与DINO同时降低两类误差，并揭示碎片化—合并权衡。另在OmniCount-sub、FSC-147与CARPK上报告迁移诊断结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅学习实例关系、以结构推理方式聚合过完备提议，可在无图像查询、无计数监督的条件下实现多类别计数，并优于强基线，同时揭示关系推理中的碎片化—合并权衡。

title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 UP-MOPD，通过对优化器更新进行投影来缓解多教师在线策略蒸馏中的梯度冲突。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏可结合不同领域专长，但梯度冲突阻碍知识整合。梯度修正方法在普通 SGD 下有效，然而在 AdamW 等优化器中，动量、自适应缩放和权重衰减可能使修正后的梯度变成一阶意义上增大某领域损失的更新，因此需要针对优化器更新的修正方案。
AI.method: UP-MOPD 让原始混合梯度先更新优化器状态并生成候选位移，仅对违反约束的候选在提交到参数前进行投影，投影给出欧氏距离下最接近候选的唯一可行更新。
AI.result: 在医学与通用领域实验中，UP-MOPD 在训练后期将 IFEval-loose 准确率比原始 M-OPD 提升 2.96 点；八项指标平均分 60.03，高于梯度投影的 59.00 和更新拒绝的 59.15。在覆盖数学、代码和指令遵循的公开基准上，六项任务平均分最佳（32.67），在 LiveCodeBench v5 领先，并在 IFEval 上并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对优化器更新进行投影可有效减少领域间干扰，优于梯度投影与更新拒绝等替代方案。

title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
summary: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP），并开发营养智能体 ShanLiangRen，通过约束建模、精确检索增强生成与帕累托引导的迭代精化，生成满足个性化约束与多维营养目标的可执行膳食方案，已上线微信小程序。
AI.motivation: 膳食营养规划对慢性病管理和健康维持至关重要，但实际应用中需同时满足个性化约束与合理的多维营养目标，二者常相互冲突；且用户约束会随反馈演变，导致通用指南与可执行方案之间存在显著差距。
AI.method: 首先形式化提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP）；随后构建营养智能体 ShanLiangRen：将膳食规格、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言需求转化为个性化约束规划实例；采用精确检索增强生成方法，从大规模食材与食谱空间中缩减可行候选集；最后采用帕累托原则引导的精化过程，由 LLM 在确定性营养计算与约束验证反馈下迭代修订候选方案。
AI.result: 系统输出包含明确食材与分量的全量化膳食方案，并给出营养合规报告，展示约束满足情况与营养素区间达成度；系统已作为微信小程序 ShanLiangRen 在线发布，并提供演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过问题形式化与检索增强、帕累托精化相结合的智能体框架，弥合了通用膳食指南与个性化可执行方案之间的差距，并已实现真实场景的在线部署应用。

title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
summary: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 GeoPID，从几何视角分解 VLM 的多模态信息为冗余、模态独有与协同成分，并定向放大视觉独有子空间，提升视觉 grounding，平均相对准确率提升 7.63%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽表现优异，但普遍存在利用视觉信息不足、过度依赖文本上下文的问题，需要从机制上理解并缓解这一偏差。
AI.method: GeoPID 为免训练框架，通过视觉与文本表示子空间之间的几何关系，将信息分解为 Redundant、Modality-Unique、Synergistic 三类成分；基于此几何分析，在推理时引入定向干预，沿 vision-unique 子空间选择性放大视觉表示，无需更新任何模型参数。
AI.result: 在 22 个 VLM 和 14 个基准上开展分析，确认当问题强依赖视觉 grounding 时，正确预测具有更强的视觉独有成分；干预后视觉 grounding 能力增强，平均相对准确率提升 7.63%。
AI.conclusion: 从几何角度刻画多模态信息可有效诊断并缓解 VLM 的视觉信息利用不足问题，且仅靠推理期干预即可显著提升性能，无需额外训练。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将海表温度（SST）区域多步预测建模为条件数值生成任务，用文本上下文（历史SST/异常、对齐日期的环境记录、静态海洋知识）结合图神经网络生成的连续空间前缀输入大语言模型（LLM），在南海SST预测中取得最优MAE与R²，并附带基于规则的可溯源事后解释。
AI.motivation: SST预测同时依赖局部时间持续性、区域空间依赖以及随预测日期变化的环境条件，这些异质条件难以统一表示；且直接把完整SST网格序列化为文本输入LLM代价高、不现实，因此需要探索如何在不序列化整张网格的前提下，把这些异质条件有效呈现给LLM。
AI.method: 将预测形式化为条件数值生成：历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录、静态海洋知识构成文本上下文；区域空间状态通过连续图导出前缀提供。静态图编码长期地理-气候关系，动态图编码近期SST相关性与局部热带气旋影响；两个图神经网络生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合后注入LLM输入。
AI.result: 在南海SST预测任务上，完整配置在十个预测步长上相比对比方法取得最佳MAE与R²。
AI.conclusion: 文本上下文与图导出连续前缀相结合的LLM条件生成框架能有效完成区域多步SST预测；同时规则模块可将预测趋势与环境因子方向同知识条目匹配，返回带来源链接的事后情境解释，提升可解释性。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究序列内容充分性，提出信息论分解方法并构建CANOPE框架，证明几何规整性不能保证可恢复的序列内容。
AI.motivation: 研究表征是否保留了输入中可用的有序目标信息，即序列内容充分性问题。核心动机是揭示表征的几何规整性（如一致性、高斯性）与真实可恢复信息之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出信息论分解，将问题拆分为输入歧义、表征损失与读出失配三部分；构造可恢复视图（完美一致性与联合各向同性高斯性并存但目标信息为零），并分析确定性典型锚点带来的限制。利用token log-loss给出单侧信息损失界，用固定惩罚岭分析说明秩无法决定预测风险。基于此提出CANOPE框架：非自回归、有序潜在画布、典型token监督与几何正则化。
AI.result: 在4万条验证序列上，潜在一致的PL0与token接地的PL2池化秩几乎相同，但在强自然损坏下（给定正确目标长度）位置Recall@1分别为13.5%与98.8%。在3,930条LJSpeech验证话语上，冻结PL2配合训练好的MatchaTTS读出的WER为21.54%，而冻结PL0为99.22%，端到端MatchaTTS为10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠几何规整性无法保证序列内容可恢复，也无法保证下游有效访问，这一结论在所研究的文本设置中成立。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出置信推理图（CRGs），一种无需特权模型访问或训练数据的推理时框架，通过将"智能体完成任务"这一主张分解为基于轨迹证据的子主张并逐层估计与聚合置信度，在多个基准上实现了更好的置信校准与风险感知决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM智能体时，判断是否信任其输出或进行干预需要对其成功概率有校准的置信度。但智能体置信估计困难：证据分散在异质且相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；实际部署中前沿LLM内部信号访问受限、智能体推演成本高、训练数据可能缺失或迅速过时。因此需要一个不依赖特权访问和训练数据的置信估计方法。
AI.method: 提出置信推理图（CRGs）——推理时框架。它从"智能体完成任务"这一根主张出发，将其分解为基于轨迹证据的上下文子主张，对每个终端主张估计置信度，最后聚合为整体置信估计。该方法仅需单条轨迹，不需要特权模型访问或训练数据。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准、三个骨干模型和三个智能体框架上，CRGs在置信校准和风险感知决策方面均优于口头表达、采样类和白盒替代基线。研究发现单独看校准误差可能误导：一个白盒替代基线看似校准良好但区分度接近随机。消融实验表明CRG的改进来自主张级置信估计与聚合，而非仅图结构构建。CRG还暴露了每个置信估计背后的主张与轨迹证据，可在决策时审计。
AI.conclusion: CRGs提供了一种无需特权访问和训练数据、可审计的智能体置信估计方法，能带来更好的校准与风险感知决策；同时提示评估时应关注区分能力而非仅校准误差。

title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
summary: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向图像比特流细粒度理解（IBFU）的基础模型 BFG，直接从未完全解码的比特流中生成细粒度描述，并在比特流损坏场景下保持稳定性能，适用于隐私友好的 AIoT 应用。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉理解需将图像解码至像素域，导致像素级内容暴露，难以满足 AIoT 场景中的隐私保护需求；同时，图像比特流在传输与存储中易受损，现有方法在比特流损坏时性能下降严重。因此需要一种无需像素重建、能直接处理比特流且鲁棒的理解范式。
AI.method: 提出 Bitstream Fine-grained Generator（BFG）基础模型，包含两部分：Bitstream Semantic Encoder（BSeE）直接从编码比特流中建模语义表示，不进行显式像素重建；Fine-grained Semantic Generator（FSeG）通过自回归生成将比特流语义转化为细粒度自然语言描述。同时构建大规模损坏比特流细粒度理解数据集 CFU-D，涵盖完整比特流及多种损坏类型与程度。
AI.result: BFG 在比特流损坏下仍能稳定生成细粒度描述。例如在 Stanford Dogs Caption 数据集上平均 CIDEr 仅从 0.6339 微降至 0.6077，而 Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini 与 GPT 等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
AI.conclusion: BFG 为 AIoT 场景下的隐私友好细粒度理解提供了实用范式，验证了直接基于比特流进行语义分析的可行性与鲁棒性。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续记忆机（CMM），一种具有矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态的循环架构，通过Transformer联合更新两个记忆库，实现快速神经元级处理与长期保持的结合。
AI.motivation: 传统循环神经网络将信息压缩到单一向量状态中，迫使短期计算与长期保持共享同一表示，形成瓶颈。现有扩展虽能增加容量或分离时间尺度，但缺乏生物学中"快速神经元级处理"与"长期保持"的结合。
AI.method: 基于连续思维机（CTM），CMM设置矩阵值的短期与长期记忆状态，各司其职：短期记忆追踪近期神经活动，配有独特参数化的神经元级模型学习利用活动模式进行计算；持久长期记忆存储信息供后续使用；由Transformer联合更新两个记忆库，提供富有表达力的双向读写机制，使每个存储可重组自身内容并相互读写。
AI.result: 在算法任务、上下文学习和循环推理任务中，CMM优于广泛的基线方法，比以往记忆增强网络具有更强泛化能力，同时保留了CTM可解释的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过分离且双向交互的短期与长期记忆设计，有效突破单一状态瓶颈，兼顾快速处理与长期保持，取得了更优性能、泛化性和可解释性。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIGMA，一种让模型仅凭"Model Spec"即可自我提升安全对齐的数据生成与训练流程，在单轮数据上训练但在多轮智能体环境中显著降低有害性，超越Deliberative Alignment和Constitutional AI基线且保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在软件工程、数学等易验证目标上可递归自我改进，但对齐难以验证，形成外部监督瓶颈，存在能力增长而安全对齐滞后的风险，尤其当能力扩展至自动研究与网络安全时。作者追问：当前模型能否自我提升安全对齐。
AI.method: 提出SIGMA流程。仅给定描述期望行为的"Model Spec"，先进行规格引导的任务合成，用候选模型作为任务设计者智能体，生成多样化对齐困境场景并转化为压力测试其对Spec理解的训练任务；再进行自我评判的对齐训练，通过监督微调与基于评分标准的强化学习，由模型自身充当奖励模型。
AI.result: 尽管仅在单轮对话数据上训练，SIGMA在多轮智能体环境中提升了安全对齐：AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8，优于Deliberative Alignment与Constitutional AI基线，并保持通用能力。分析表明，平衡无害性与有用性的Model Spec、安全审议的测试时推理以及任务设计智能体生成的高质量评分标准，是有效自我改进的关键。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型可在无外部监督的条件下实现安全对齐的自我提升，并泛化至分布外场景，为缓解能力—对齐失衡提供可行路径。

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.

AI.tldr: DAEDALUS 提出一种无需既有任务或 oracle 验证器，即可从自生成练习中引导可复用智能体记忆的方法。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在新环境中缺乏操作知识，需自行探索工具行为与环境约定；没有过往记忆时会在不同任务中重复犯错，导致失败率上升、轨迹变长。现有方案依赖人工编写指南，或依赖训练任务与 oracle 验证器构建程序性记忆，均需先验环境知识。
AI.method: DAEDALUS 配对两个智能体：探索者与环境交互，生成有挑战但可解的任务；求解者尝试这些任务。每次求解失败后推导启发式规则，仅当求解者在上下文中反复使用该启发式并持续成功时才接受。这些结果同时反馈给探索者以调整未来任务难度。被接受的启发式被整合为记忆库，供测试时使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、τ²-bench 与 AutomationBench 上，DAEDALUS 相比无记忆基线将平均成功率提升至多 15.9 个百分点，pass^5 提升至多 2.2 倍；与使用训练任务的方法相当，且推理成本低于多数方法。较小探索预算即可带来性能增益，其启发式还可惠及其他模型家族的智能体。消融显示求解轨迹是推导有效启发式的关键信息，分解早期发现可提升探索成本效率。DAEDALUS 生成的任务可作为基准任务的代理，用于按性能对模型排序。
AI.conclusion: DAEDALUS 能在无先验任务与 oracle 验证器条件下，通过自生成练习引导可复用记忆，显著提升智能体成功率与稳定性，并具备跨模型迁移与低成本优势。

authors: for the Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative
for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
summary: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

AI.tldr: ConnectomeX 以 FlyVision 架构将果蝇连接组启发的并行 ON/OFF、循环计算与图交互保留并可扩展，在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1K、皮肤病、胸片和 BrainAGE MRI 年龄预测上以远少于 ResNet18 的参数达到接近或更优性能。
AI.motivation: 生物连接组编码了视觉计算的结构化解法，可能为人工视觉提供可复用的归纳偏置，因此作者希望验证这种连接组启发的计算能否在不同规模和任务上迁移。
AI.method: 提出 ConnectomeX，核心是 FlyVision：一种可训练架构，保留并行 ON/OFF 处理、循环计算和群体级图交互，同时随任务扩展模型容量；并扩展出 BrainAGE，用共享的 ImageNet 预训练 FlyVision Large 编码器处理每例 24 张矢状、冠状和轴状切片，通过置信度调制的 高斯投票融合切片级年龄估计。
AI.result: MNIST 99.34%（80,608 参数）、CIFAR-10 78.03%（81,408 参数）；ImageNet-1K 上 Base/Large 为 60.79%/66.25%（1.8M/3.7M 参数），Large local-k7 加低频分支为 66.53%，ResNet18 为 69.25%（11.7M）；22 类皮肤病 63.78% 和 95.28% macro-AUROC（2.99M）；四类胸片 92.60%/92.76%（1.33M/2.97M），ResNet18 为 91.56%（11.18M）；BrainAGE 在 433 例留出扫描上三轴融合 MAE 5.98 年、R^2=0.868。
AI.conclusion: 在 224x224 分类任务中，最佳 FlyVision 配置在 ImageNet-1K 和皮肤病分类上距 ResNet18 三个百分点以内，并在胸片分类上超越 ResNet18，且参数显著更少；表明保守的连接组启发计算可从紧凑识别扩展到大规模自然与生物医学视觉。

title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出"前瞻性学习"(prospective learning)，用后见经验监督交互前的前瞻预测，实例化为自回溯蒸馏(SRD)，在10个智能体任务上超越RLVR与自蒸馏基线，奖励对比稀缺时增益可达24.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: RLVR主要通过交互后的标量结果奖励产生学习信号，但在组相对目标下，当所有rollout获得相同奖励时该信号会消失，即使轨迹中包含任务要求与失败模式的有用信息。作者提出补充性问题：后见之明能否教会智能体在行动前预判什么？
