AI.method: 提出前瞻性学习(prospective learning)，利用事后经验监督来自交互前视角的前瞻预测，并实例化为自回溯蒸馏(SRD)：将完整轨迹所揭示的"特权后见"蒸馏为同一策略的、对轨迹不可见的前瞻预测，前瞻仅作训练目标，推理时无需显式生成。
AI.result: 在10个工具集成推理与长时程智能体任务上，SRD与RLVR及自蒸馏基线互补，增益最高达24.2个百分点。在跨模型规模中37%–98%的rollout组奖励均匀时优势尤为明显；2B设置下98%组为全失败，RLVR训练成功率为0.0%，加入SRD后在相同rollout预算下达到60.6%。
AI.conclusion: 事后智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改进行为，还可用于在可用交互之前塑造预测性表征。

title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
summary: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可变形CT-超声配准框架，利用CT解剖先验（组织刚度、接触位移、扇形几何约束）结合SIREN隐式神经表示，在机器人辅助光学跟踪的刚性初始化基础上逐帧估计形变，配准精度较刚性初始化提升17%，并优于经典可变形基线且拓扑折叠接近零。
AI.motivation: US与术前CT的切片到体配准可增强微创介入（如术中定位CT可见的软组织）。光学跟踪可实现初始刚性配准，但探头接触引起软组织形变，导致对齐失准，因此需要引入解剖先验的可变形配准方法。
AI.method: 先用机器人辅助光学跟踪系统完成刚性配准；再用正弦隐式神经表示（SIREN）逐帧估计可变形变换。从CT的HU值近似组织刚度，作为空间变化正则项以抑制骨等刚性结构形变、允许软组织更灵活；引入两项探针接触物理约束：接触区位移先验（使位移场压缩探头面下方组织）和基于波束方向与凸阵探头视场的扇形几何正则项。参数采用归一化梯度场（NGF）优化。
AI.result: 所提方法相比刚性初始化将配准对齐提升17%，优于经典可变形基线方法，同时保持接近零的拓扑折叠。
AI.conclusion: 将CT解剖先验与探针接触物理约束融入SIREN可变形配准，可有效补偿探头接触导致的软组织形变，提升CT-超声配准精度并保持良好拓扑性质。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR构建用户个性化应用状态评估管线与RePAIR个性化感知强化学习训练方法，发现GUI智能体在用户条件下可靠性显著下降，RePAIR能有效提升跨用户可靠性。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体日益在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上运行，但其在不同用户间的可靠性尚未被充分探究，缺乏可控的跨用户评估手段。
AI.method: 提出PAIR（个性化应用状态实例化与渲染）管线，构建用户条件下的应用状态，实现对同一任务在不同用户间的可控评估；并提出RePAIR（基于个性化感知交互奖励的强化学习），从子目标结果的跨用户差异中学习以提升可靠性。
AI.result: 在六个智能体上发现任务成功率在不同用户间存在显著差异，用户条件下子目标达成率下降6.98至15.4个百分点；使用用户自有内容的个人目标下降更大（8.77至22.0个百分点）；失败多表现为选错目标项，尤其在目标暴露前。RePAIR在未见用户上较其SFT父模型提升用户条件SAR（+5.87 pp）、全成功（+7.50 pp）和整体任务成功率（+9.42 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 显式地从跨用户差异中学习可提升GUI智能体的可靠性，为个性化环境下的智能体训练提供了初步证据。

title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

AI.tldr: POLAR是一个面向小型工具调用智能体的护栏框架，通过结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性，在执行前剪枝高风险动作，提供可审计的结构化判定。
AI.motivation: LLM工具使用智能体在动态环境中行动，许多操作带有运行风险，但多数安全机制仅在错误发生后才反应。现有预防性方法要么用思维链微调，要么把自然语言护栏编译为运行时检查，都缺乏结构化、可审计的判定结果。
AI.method: POLAR通过结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性：为每个动作推导候选逆序序列，据此给出分级可逆性分数，分数未达阈值的调用在执行前被剪枝。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench上对六种智能体模型评估，POLAR在airline域使六个中的四个智能体平均任务奖励提升0.11至0.18分，但十八个模型-域组合中仅八个整体改善，retail域及较强智能体常出现回退。
AI.conclusion: POLAR提供了可审计的结构化检查，并刻画了其任务效用权衡；奖励并非所避免危害的直接度量。

title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
summary: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在合成人体运动数据集上自监督预训练视频Transformer，提出以人体关键点和边界框区域为中心的掩码策略，显著提升性能并缩小与Kinetics预训练的差距。
AI.motivation: 现代动作识别模型依赖从网络爬取的大规模视频（如Kinetics-700）预训练，但这些数据通常未获得被拍摄者同意，存在伦理问题。高质量合成视频数据集（如BEDLAM2.0）提供了有前景的伦理替代方案，但直接沿用标准预训练方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 作者首先验证标准VideoMAE掩码策略在合成数据上预训练效果明显劣于Kinetics。为此提出一种以人为中心的掩码方案，利用人体关键点（body keypoints）和人物边界框区域（person bounding box regions）进行掩码，引导模型在预训练中关注人体运动的结构与动态。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于在合成数据上使用标准VideoMAE预训练。在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设定下，在不使用任何真实视频帧进行预训练的情况下，将合成数据与Kinetics预训练之间的差距缩小了49%。
AI.conclusion: 以人为中心的掩码策略能有效利用合成人体运动数据进行视频Transformer自监督预训练，为构建符合伦理的动作识别模型提供了可行路径，作者将公开预训练模型以促进相关研究。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HMED 机制，通过回溯并重置发现的初始状态，在同一条件下对比旧版与新版元技能，将差异蒸馏为可复用的“元经验”，从而改进元技能学习。
AI.motivation: 现有方法从原始技能搜索轨迹和分支结果中改进元技能，但分支表现同时混杂了初始发现状态和元技能修订本身的影响，难以判断一次修订真正改变了什么，导致更新偏向于“受益于有利初始状态”的修订，而非真正改善改进过程的修订。
AI.method: HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation）回溯产生某次修订的已完成事件，在相同恢复的发现状态下重新执行旧元技能与修订后的元技能，使两者的变化在共享条件下可被观察；每次对比被蒸馏为结构化的“元经验”记录，供未来更新复用，即使该修订最终未被保留也能提供学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准上，使用开源与闭源模型，HMED 相比强基线一致地提升了技能发现性能，将元技能学习从关注分支结果转向关注“改变改进过程”的后果。
AI.conclusion: HMED 通过控制初始状态、统一比较条件并蒸馏元经验，有效解耦了初始发现状态与元技能修订的贡献，使元技能学习更关注改进过程本身，并在多个基准和模型上验证了其有效性。

title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

AI.tldr: QRAKEN 是一种无需训练、与本体无关的神经符号流水线，通过将 LLM 的 SPARQL 生成建立在经验图证据（TTQL）而非模式预期之上，在 Text2SPARQL 任务上显著提升严格 F1。
AI.motivation: 自然语言访问 RDF 知识图谱是语义网的核心目标。尽管 LLM 推动了 Text2SPARQL 的发展，但在陌生图上常生成语法有效却错误反映实际数据模型的查询。该工作旨在用经验图证据替代模式预期来引导生成。
AI.method: QRAKEN 为免训练、本体无关的神经符号流水线。离线蒸馏器生成 TTQL：紧凑描述已填充的多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件下的字面量示例，以及类-属性共现矩阵。在线阶段，TTQL 引导 LLM，同时由确定性语法、词汇和数据模型检查提供诊断，用于迭代精化。
AI.result: 在 CK25 上按匹配条件于 QLever 快照重算：GPT-4.1 mini 严格 F1 为 0.643±0.026，GPT-5.4 为 0.652±0.012，相对最强重算参赛系统分别提升 30% 和 32%，并优于使用同一基础模型族的系统。消融显示 TTQL 模式是主要驱动（较仅形状基线 +0.31 严格 F1）；精化循环提供低成本安全网，拒绝共现矩阵不支持的元组模式。相较自动推导的 SHACL，TTQL 严格 F1 高 64%。两个本地 35B 4-bit 开放权重模型在零边际成本下匹配最强重算参赛者。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持经验模式优于仅暴露模式的价值。但结论基于单个相对较小的基准，仅为初步经验信号；TTQL 在非常开放的跨域图上的单体式注入是主要局限。

title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: Knee3DVLM是一个序列感知的视觉语言模型，利用全容积DESS和TSE膝关节MRI预测57个MOAKS二分类诊断目标，融合双序列配置性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中的应用日益增多，但在膝关节MRI领域应用有限，尤其是对临床中互补序列的解读尚不充分。
AI.method: 提出Knee3DVLM，一个序列感知的视觉语言模型，使用全容积DESS和流体敏感TSE MRI预测源自MOAKS的57个解剖定位二分类诊断目标以支持结构化报告；在受试者不重叠的骨关节炎倡议分区上评估DESS单序列、TSE单序列和DESS-TSE配对三种配置。
AI.result: 在1,074例留出队列中，融合模型达到72.98%平均准确率、71.17%平衡准确率、78.96%平均ROC-AUC和78.74%宏ROC-AUC，为三种配置中最高；在与3DReasonKnee队列对齐的二级多分类分析中，Knee3DVLM在五个病理类别上数值上高于最强的已报告3DReasonKnee配置。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持采用双序列全容积建模进行全面的膝关节MRI评估。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 该论文从"外部"评判世界模型：在完整十英雄MOBA（206单位、最长6000 tick）中学习多智能体世界模型，仅在想象中训练策略（1400 tick自由运行），再在真实游戏中评测。以异步Dyna循环在线修复模型，策略在真实比赛（radiant方）胜率70.2%。
AI.motivation: 以往世界模型多从"内部"指标评判（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度），但这些指标无法反映策略迁移到真实环境后的表现。作者希望从"外部"——真实游戏的胜负——来评判世界模型，并揭示内部指标所掩盖的问题。
AI.method: 构建结构化多智能体MOBA世界模型（206个单位，每英雄每tick行动，最长6000 tick）；仅在想象中训练策略（1,400 tick自由运行的想象回合）；运行连续异步Dyna循环：真实游戏不提供梯度，而是提供策略对局作为世界模型的训练数据，并用在线评测来选择和锚定策略。
AI.result: 策略在radiant方真实对局中胜率70.2%（600局421胜，95% CI 66.4–73.7，且使用未参与任何决策的随机种子），而仅靠梦想训练为0%、加循环前为33.7%；在dire方胜率为0，内置对手自我对弈时亦为0。加Dyna修复带来+9.2个百分点的真实胜率提升（策略配方固定）。
AI.conclusion: 四项发现解释结果：（1）模型利用在梦想内部不可见，未锚定的运行在几次更新内崩溃且无内部指标能追踪；（2）在训练语料上准确的世界模型在策略自身对局上严重失准，Dyna可在此修复；（3）策略逐机制继承世界模型的保真度剖面：模型能表征宏观博弈，但无法表征控制技能、施法时机与致命性；（4）策略靠全图压力取胜，几乎没有协同团战。作者公开世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评测协议及全部策略与日志。

title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，利用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在网格状数据结构上迭代推理二维空间关系，在数独、迷宫最短路径等图像类谜题上取得当前最优且可解释的结果，并具备很强的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现代学习方法在空间推理任务上仍存在困难，缺乏利用感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题的能力。作者希望弥合这一差距，让模型能对图像等网格化数据中的二维空间关系进行有效推理。
AI.method: 提出自适应神经细胞自动机（Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata, aNCA）架构。该架构使用可变形卷积（deformable convolutions）来动态适应感受野，并在网格状数据结构（如图像）上迭代地进行二维空间关系推理。
AI.result: 在公开基准测试上取得了当前最优（state of the art）且可理解（可解释）的结果；在解决基于图像的谜题（如数独、寻找迷宫中的最短路径）方面表现出很强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: aNCA 通过可变形卷积与细胞自动机的结合，为网格化数据上的空间关系推理提供了一种有效、可解释且泛化性强的新范式，可用于数独求解和迷宫寻路等任务。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 提出重复运行评估框架，用主题流失率与数量不一致两个指标衡量AI智能体处理非结构化数据的可重复性，发现分类体系锚定（TGA）显著提升稳定性。
AI.motivation: AI智能体被越来越多用于自动化处理大规模非结构化数据的知识工作，这类自动化要求可重复性：当底层证据不变时，智能体返回的分类、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间出现实质漂移，即便单次答案看似合理。然而现有评估缺乏对重复运行一致性的系统度量。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估框架，对语义等价的类别进行对齐，聚焦两个运行指标：主题流失率（返回类别集合的归一化变化）和数量不一致（持续存在类别的计数变化）。在八种前沿模型上评估三类循环出现的客户反馈任务，语料规模100至5000条，多种提示词，并比较三种执行设计：原始生成、无分类体系的层级分解、以及使用持久主题/子主题与记录级预测的分类体系锚定智能体（TGA）。
AI.result: 在固定Claude Opus 4.8与1000条语料下，TGA相较原始生成和层级分解将主题流失率降低86%–88%，且匹配主题的数量不一致为零。TGA比筛选中的所有原始模型更稳定，在各语料规模下均保持稳定，并在主题匹配标准收紧或放宽时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 分类体系锚定能产生更一致、更可重复的输出，适用于循环性知识工作。虽在客户反馈上评估，该框架可推广至金融报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献等更广泛的非结构化语料重复综合任务。

title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无回放的持续学习方法CoDe-LoRA，通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由缓解正交投影导致的"正交性困境"，在4个骨干模型和3个持续学习基准上取得最佳平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需要持续适应不断演进的任务，但会遭遇灾难性遗忘。现有低秩适配加正交投影方法（如O-LoRA）虽能隔离任务参数，却因严格的几何约束产生"正交性困境"：刚性参数隔离阻碍了语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与累积。
AI.method: 提出无回放新方法CoDe-LoRA，将学习过程解耦为"巩固通用知识"与"解耦任务特定知识"两部分，并借助自适应零空间投影机制与语义路由，在知识累积与任务特定适配之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在四种骨干模型和三个持续学习基准上的实验表明，CoDe-LoRA取得了最佳的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: CoDe-LoRA通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由有效缓解正交性困境，实现共享知识迁移与任务隔离的平衡，是一种有效的LLM持续学习方案；代码已开源。

title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: MedCORE是一个将临床结构化推理融入视觉-语言架构的诊断框架，通过临床标准分解、证据定位与多尺度编码、图注意力建模标准间依赖、文本对齐与不确定性加权聚合，在皮肤镜、乳腺超声和糖网病三个数据集上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型往往绕过临床诊断的结构化推理过程，直接把图像特征映射到疾病标签，未显式评估医生系统检查的形态学和纹理标准，导致诊断透明性不足，可能影响临床安全部署。
AI.method: MedCORE将诊断过程分解为临床定义的标准，对每个标准在图像中空间定位诊断相关区域，通过多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据，并用图注意力网络显式建模标准间依赖；标准表示进一步与临床文本描述对齐，通过类别视觉原型强化，并采用不确定性校准的加权聚合，按比例降低低置信度证据权重。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2018皮肤镜病变分类上达到89.2%准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；BUSI乳腺超声病变表征上96.1%准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；IDRiD糖尿病视网膜病变分级上84.3%准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC。相较CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念及原型类强基线均有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: MedCORE通过在视觉-语言架构中操作化临床推理，实现了跨三种异质影像模态的一致性能提升，说明结构化、证据驱动的诊断框架有助于提升诊断透明度与准确性。

title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: https://www.aisafety.fun. Preregistrations: https://osf.io/wda8q, https://osf.io/q2j3y, https://osf.io/8kreb
summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

AI.tldr: 论文将"对齐是否随模型规模变易"重构为一族可度量的缩放关系：对每个风险类别定义对齐负担 B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r，以指数 alpha_r 判定缩放是有利(<1)、持平(~1)还是累积对齐债务(>1)，并给出理论证明、预注册协议与两项实证检验。
AI.motivation: 以往关于"模型变大后对齐更难还是更易"的争论往往基于孤立发现，仿佛对齐是单一属性。作者主张应将其视为一族可测量的缩放关系，从而把模糊的定性争论转化为可预注册、可复现的定量问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义每类风险的对齐负担 B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r（N 为能力代理），给出三种负担的操作化并区分观测对齐、审计对齐与真实对齐；构建"修正消耗能力余量"的玩具模型；证明若干性质（最大指数而非平均决定长期机制、指数>1 时维持余量下限需超指数增长、小模型拟合低估大尺度指数、无假阳性的审计不会低估真实对齐）；提出可预注册协议并做两次缩减版应用。
AI.result: 对 Pythia 分类器的公开对抗训练数据再分析：将攻击成功率压到 10% 以下所需算力约按 N^0.60 增长。对 Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B 的预注册试点：真实性指数 -0.05、陈述性倾向 0.48（均属缩放有利，但顶部局部斜率趋近 1；在 Qwen3 0.6B-14B 上复现）；谄媚 0.89（加入 72B 两个随机种子后为 0.83）与植入后门结果未定——触发器已知时后门快速移除，但在盲安全训练下五个规模中有四个存活。
AI.conclusion: 对齐应按风险类别分别考察其缩放指数，长期机制由已修正风险中的最大指数决定；作者不主张对当前前沿模型属于哪种机制下结论，而是提供一套可预注册的测量框架、理论边界与初步证据，并公开了四款演绎这些规律的浏览器游戏。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何对齐得分对模态退化的响应机制，提出方向性几何响应（DGR）指标，证明几何响应不能由扰动位移幅度单独解释，而需同时考虑表示所处的工作点、位移幅度与方向。
AI.motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐得分能紧凑建模模态间的高阶一致性，但其对模态退化的响应机制尚不明确。本文旨在检验：多模态几何得分的响应该是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅度决定。
AI.method: 使用MSR-VTT（N=878）与DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结队列，施加受控的视频模糊与音频噪声，分析得分所定义的关系几何的响应。通过Gramian体积的闭式一阶展开导出方向性几何响应（DGR），即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，同时刻画干净工作点、位移幅度与位移方向。
AI.result: 位移幅度最多只能解释绝对响应样本外方差的15%，且幅度匹配的配对响应存在系统性差异，说明标量幅度无法组织响应。绝对一阶DGR项的样本外R^2达0.838-0.969，幅度匹配排序准确率0.864-0.963，响应符号准确率0.909-0.989；而所测试的无方向替代方案在相应评估协议下表现薄弱或不稳定。预设的增益归一化候选V/(g_V+eps)未通过可预测性与干净顺序检验。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应取决于表示在何处运作、退化将关系几何移动多远以及朝哪个方向移动。DGR使用已观测的退化状态位移，因此是解释性量而非部署时预测器。

title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEEDRUNBENCH，通过9款电子游戏的速通任务评估LLM智能体的策略形成能力。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体已能解决人类已有可测解法的复杂任务，但能否超越人类已知解法尚不明确。当缺乏上下文或训练数据时，人类既有方案不足，发展高级策略的能力变得至关重要。
AI.method: 借助速通这一社区实践研究智能体的策略形成能力。速通要求参与者寻找特定条件下通关游戏的最快方式，挖掘非常规玩法。提出SPEEDRUNBENCH基准，覆盖9款游戏，要求智能体反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已有知识，并在长时程动作中推理。
AI.result: 实验显示，前沿智能体在简单平台游戏中接近人类世界纪录，但在更长、更复杂的游戏中，在实际预算下仍落后于人类表现。
AI.conclusion: SPEEDRUNBENCH是研究智能体策略形成能力的有效测试平台，也是抗饱和的评估方法，因为几乎总存在更快的通关时间等待被发现。

title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

AI.tldr: 冻结的VideoLLM内部已线性编码"证据就绪度"信号，无需修改模型即可读出，并据此实现问答时机控制，最高提升9.75个百分点。
AI.motivation: 流式视频语言模型不仅要决定"回答什么"，还要决定"当前问题的证据是否已经到达"。现有系统把这一决策作为一个独立的触发模块来学习；本文追问：未经修改的模型是否本身就已经计算了这一决策。
AI.method: 从带时间戳的证据（而非模型输出）构造标签，在冻结的VideoLLM激活上训练线性探针来检验"证据就绪度"信号；通过更换问题、问题盲控制、错误回答子集等实验验证其条件性与独立性；并与不确定性估计器、已发布的流式触发模块进行对比。
AI.result: 在最严格的"未就绪"采样下，7个模型均呈现线性可读的就绪信号（AUROC 0.733–0.905），而拟合时钟几乎只有随机水平；在全新基准族视频上训练的探针仍可读出该族信号；换问题可逆转66.1%配对样本的读数；错误回答中AUROC仍达0.722；就绪度优于不确定性估计器及其监督组合，也更贴近独立人工判断；已训练触发模块与就绪度近似正交。将其转为Readiness Gating后，在等长视频下最高提升+9.75pp，计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 证据就绪度是冻结VideoLLM中固有、线性可读且受问题条件化的信号，可低成本转化为答案时机策略；其增益随任务可用准确率空间而变化，说明该方法的效果受任务上限约束。

title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

AI.tldr: 提出RSJEV，一种单次（one-pass）多模态判别式决策框架，将遥感场景分类建模为候选类别条件下的多模态判别决策，而非自回归生成，在三个基准上取得更优性能并显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景分类现有三类范式各有缺陷：任务专用视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间；CLIP类方法依赖静态图文对齐；多模态大模型（MLLM）在已有明确候选类别的情况下仍进行不必要的token级自回归生成，效率低。
AI.method: RSJEV将场景分类重构为候选类别条件下的多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表示、任务指令与候选类别语义；核心组件为OnePass Decider，提取多模态决策状态并在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，从而省去自回归解码，同时保留视觉-语言交互。
AI.result: 在UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45三个常用基准上，RSJEV优于代表性CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；同时大幅降低推理成本，以仅0.8B参数的紧凑模型实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，状态条件下的多模态决策方式对高效遥感图像理解是有效的，为非生成式MLLM分类提供了可行方向；代码将开源。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出基于token成本的并行决策准则，构建SquidAgent消除再探索与对齐开销，相比单/多智能体基线取得显著加速。
AI.motivation: 并行多智能体本应带来近线性加速，实际却常慢于串行单智能体。作者归因于并行引入的两项隐藏成本：再探索成本（工作者重复重建编排者已掌握的上下文）与对齐成本（协调独立生成输出间不一致的开销）。
AI.method: 推导出原则性决策准则：仅当某层的关键路径成本加再探索与对齐开销低于串行成本时才并行。由于LLM对墙钟时间估计校准差，改用预测输出token度量成本。据此提出SquidAgent：单步规划中估算所有token预算，worker直接从编排者会话分叉以消除再探索成本，用预生成的共享约定块将对齐转为有界的前置成本，并由确定性调度器逐层应用准则。
AI.result: 相比Claude Code，平均吞吐提升2.2倍、墙钟时间加速2.6倍；相比最强多智能体基线，吞吐提升2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 以token而非墙钟时间作为成本度量更可靠，配合分叉会话与共享约定可有效降低成本，实现并行多智能体的实际加速。

title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. Code and model are available at https://github.com/SALT-NLP/Sherpa
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sherpa，一个多轮强化学习框架，通过构建多种学生原型并直接以学生学习效果为优化目标来训练 LLM 教师模型，使其能够自适应教学。
AI.motivation: 现有训练 LLM 作为教师的方法依赖示范、偏好数据或预设的教学标准，这些信号往往未与个体学生的学习效果挂钩，而有效的教学策略在不同学习者之间存在显著差异。
AI.method: Sherpa 采用多轮强化学习框架，实例化多个由 LLM 构建的学生原型，这些原型以不同的学习偏好为条件，并训练教师模型通过直接最大化学生的学习效果来自适应其教学策略。
AI.result: 经 Sherpa 训练的教师模型使所有原型的受教学生表现平均提升 20.5 个百分点；在 MathTutorBench 评估中，整体教学分数从 52.5% 提升至 79.2%；人类研究中，训练后的教师在 79.6% 的成对比较中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: Sherpa 能够训练 LLM 教师适应多样化的模拟学生，并更好地与人类教师对齐，为 AI 导师教授真实学生铺平道路。

title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
summary: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sparse2comm：一种带宽高效且鲁棒的协同3D目标检测框架，将不可靠协同视为对退化协同特征的渐进式恢复。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可提升自动驾驶3D检测性能，但实际部署受带宽受限与协同不可靠制约。丢包、传输延迟和空间错位会共同退化和影响协同特征流，而现有方法通常只降低通信成本或仅补偿单一退化类型，难以充分应对耦合干扰。
AI.method: 提出Sparse2comm框架，将不可靠协同建模为渐进式恢复流程：1）稀疏特征编码：以随机掩码采样的前景特征进行通信，自车重建稠密语义表示，实现超低带宽通信与丢包恢复；2）延迟感知对齐：预测运动流以补偿延迟消息；3）自校准融合：自监督估计残余空间偏移后进行自适应跨智能体融合，从而有序恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V和V2V4Real数据集上，Sparse2comm保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单一及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。相比Where2comm，在三个数据集混合设置下AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升+20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
AI.conclusion: Sparse2comm通过稀疏到稠密通信与渐进式恢复流水线，有效兼顾带宽效率与鲁棒协同3D检测，在多种真实退化场景下显著优于选择性特征通信基线。

title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
summary: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究联邦学习在皮肤病变分割中的可行性，结果表明联邦模型性能接近集中式训练，并优于本地训练模型。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌是全球重要健康问题，早期检测与准确描绘病变对诊疗至关重要。传统深度学习分割模型依赖集中式训练，需将图像与掩码收集到中央服务器，这在医疗场景中带来隐私问题，并需要大量集中计算资源。
AI.method: 使用ISIC 2018皮肤病变分割挑战赛的训练集与验证集模拟分布式学习环境，构建联邦分割模型；并在ISIC 2018测试集与PH2数据集上评估其性能与泛化能力。
AI.result: 联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，并持续优于各本地训练模型，同时在跨数据集评估中具备一定泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明联邦学习可在无需集中汇聚医学图像的前提下实现协作式皮肤病变分割，具有应用潜力。

title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"执行一致性"这一概念，通过规范状态使用、信息交接和最终状态一致性的职责来定义，并强调相同记忆记录可能对应合规或违规的不同执行，需要显式证据条件才能可靠判定。
AI.motivation: 共享记忆能协调智能体动作，但正确记录并不能证明动作满足任务要求；记忆治理与失败诊断只规范或检查记录信息，无法单独确定信息是否足以判定任务职责，因此需要一个明确的执行一致性定义。
AI.method: 定义执行一致性：以规范状态使用、信息交接与最终状态一致的职责为核心，并给出判定履行的显式证据条件；通过受控移除证据（回执、动作依赖、响应有效性）与恢复进行验证；使用 CAVERT 框架从日志中抽取受支持的关系并应用该判定标准，与合同提示 LLM 及基于规则的基线对比。
AI.result: 受控移除证据使 82.4% 的相反标签对无法区分，恢复后可将 97.9% 的合并对分开；自然日志标注能在实际执行中识别所定义的违规；CAVERT 在全部 12 个基准-执行器设置上均优于合同提示 LLM 与规则基线，并在全部 4 个环境中优于规则引导恢复。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出智能体记忆与执行接口应当保留的执行证据，以保证可靠判定；相同留存记录可对应合规或违规执行，说明显式证据条件与一致性诊断框架对可靠判断至关重要。

title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
summary: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

AI.tldr: 该论文以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，微调激光雷达条件深度模型，研究在重度稀疏化输入下能恢复多少LiDAR扫描，并量化恢复与分辨率的权衡。
AI.motivation: 高线束LiDAR成本高，但许多感知流程需要密集的角度采样，因此需要探索在低线束预算下恢复密集LiDAR信号的可能性。
AI.method: 使用预训练Stable Diffusion作为骨干，结合二维基础模型的伪深度目标微调LiDAR条件深度模型；训练中对LiDAR条件在不同线束预算下随机抽取（decimate）；在nuScenes上针对物理上保留的真实线束进行评估，并将恢复性能与拟合精度分开报告。
AI.result: 在极稀疏场景下优势最大：4线束输入时δ_{1.25}准确率达66.8%，而散点插值仅45.1%；按类别分层的误差分析显示平面表面最先恢复，而引入深度不连续性的目标最早退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了基础模型引导的LiDAR增强中恢复质量与分辨率之间的权衡关系。

title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
summary: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DSV-Mem 基准，用于评估对话式多模态大模型智能体的"密集有状态视觉记忆"能力，覆盖专业工作流中结构化、频繁更新的工件与组合式查询，发现最强基线得分低于45%，状态演化是主要难点。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦非正式日常交互、生活场景、自然照片、孤立静态物件和回忆型问题，未能覆盖专业场景：专业场景含结构化、信息密集、频繁修订与权威更新的工件，以及需跨多版本核对状态、精确追踪的组合式查询，这一能力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出 DSV-Mem 基准，包含经专家审阅的场景与1000道问题，分为五类（当前状态、过去状态、派生状态、变更历史、冲突/拒答）；采用受 Hartley 启发的准则，偏好具有更广泛视觉证据检视需求的问题；并设计生成框架，将状态转移合成与对话填充解耦以生成评测套件。
AI.result: 在覆盖前沿与开源权重模型及多种记忆管理方法的27种配置上评测，最强基线在 DSV-Mem 上得分低于45%。分析发现：1）多模态与信息密度均增加难度，但状态演化（尤以主导性更新次数）是测试中最主要的因素，而原始对话/长文本长度、OCR 与算术并非主要瓶颈；2）模型常在回答前未能依据先前状态更新核验用户前提；3）增加推理投入与记忆管理方法收益有限，而状态感知设计更有效。
AI.conclusion: DSV-Mem 揭示了对话式多模态智能体在专业场景有状态视觉记忆上的显著不足，指出状态演化是核心挑战，并表明状态感知设计优于单纯增加推理量或通用记忆管理。基准与代码将公开发布。

title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
summary: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出 RGE 框架，将预训练模型中稀疏的“原始敏感性”内部组件视为取证储备，通过 F-lens 定位并用轻量适配器激发，实现高效伪造检测。
AI.motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠检测对维护视觉信息信任至关重要。现有方法多依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表征，未能充分利用模型内部的取证知识来指导检测。
AI.method: 1）用 Forensic Lens (F-lens) 将各层和 token 组的激活分解为独立组件，依据真实图与生成图的响应差异全局筛选，识别储备位点与方向；2）将选定方向映射回隐状态空间构造固定储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；3）固定骨干参数、预拟合参考分类器与子空间基，仅训练 FRA 系数图，生成受子空间约束的输入相关残差更新，增强既有取证响应。
AI.result: 仅用 500 张标注训练图像、可训练参数低于骨干 0.2%，RGE 在三个检测基准上取得竞争性性能且无需目标基准适配；在涵盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八个编码器上，RGE 均持续优于对应的冻结检测器。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉模型中广泛存在潜在的取证能力，RGE 能以极低代价将其激发，为通用伪造检测提供了高效新思路。

title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartBmkAgent，将能力缺口（错误分类学）自动转化为完整 Chart QA 诊断样本，实现目标保留与诊断数据生成。
AI.motivation: MLLM 发展快而基准滞后，需要表达力强且可按需构建的任务格式。Chart QA 因图表信息丰富而适合探测感知与推理耦合，但现有自动化构建方法把目标引导与从零生成割裂：目标引导方法需预置数据/图表/模板，从零生成方法只保证工件有效性，不显式控制新内容是否与外部诊断目标对齐。
AI.method: ChartBmkAgent 从稀疏的错误分类学规范出发，构建完整 Chart QA 样本。中心化 harness 统筹专门化 agents，要求提供与原始错误类别对齐的分阶段证据，并记录每个接受决策的依据。
AI.result: 在 300 个覆盖全分类学的样本上，MLLM 准确率为 32.7%–84.3%，呈现不同类别轮廓；三次源模型对比中，针对性追问得分为 50.0% vs 匹配对照 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶），六次跨模型对比方向一致；多个评估模型判定 86.4% 样本确实测试了其指定错误类别，证实目标保留。
AI.conclusion: ChartBmkAgent 可把识别出的能力缺口转化为有针对性诊断证据，实现目标保留的诊断数据生成，为按需基准构建提供可行路径。

title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

AI.tldr: 视频语言模型的评测帧采样存在被忽视的"相位"参数，仅报采样率不足；相位会显著改变模型答案。作者提出PHASEFUSION，融合多相位网格的后验，在不损失精度的前提下降低对相位的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型基准通常以均匀网格帧上的多项选择准确率排名，网格有两个参数——采样率和相位，但基准只报告采样率。作者发现相位会实质性地改变模型的答案：两个仅在相位上半步偏移的采样器会在23.6%的问题上给出不同答案，而得分却相差不到1个百分点；跨越两个家族四个版本，仅移动相位在控制选项顺序后也会改变约五分之一答案。因此相位是一个被忽略但影响重大的评测变量。
AI.method: 提出PHASEFUSION：解码三个偏移网格，并对选项后验进行平均。这三个网格是密集网格的多相（polyphase）分量。此外，用一个单次前向的答案边界（answer margin）来标记仅影响呈现方式的选项顺序问题。
AI.result: 在预设的容差范围内（logit打分），融合方法的准确率与32帧单次前向相当；同时，将所有三个网格半步偏移所改变的答案比例从18.2%降至10.1%。
AI.conclusion: 建议在报告时要么将相位约定与预算一同报告，要么对相位进行边缘化处理；PHASEFUSION可作为实现后者的可行方案。

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练测试时智能体自适应框架（含测试时记忆演化与规则对齐协作），在J1-EVAL和LegalWorld上跨五种骨干模型取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 法律智能需支持长程法律流程中的可靠决策，但真实部署中案件在事实、证据和程序情境上异质性大，静态智能体策略存在局限；且法律推理在角色与程序阶段间相互依赖，全局可靠性与单角色能力本质不同。因此研究免训练的测试时智能体自适应，利用部署时信号而不更新参数。
AI.method: \method包含两部分：(1) 测试时记忆演化——从先前案例中检索可复用经验，适配当前事实与程序情境，并整合累积经验用于后续决策；(2) 规则对齐协作——按行为与程序要求验证修正角色特定动作，实现跨角色、跨阶段的协调决策。
AI.result: 在J1-EVAL与LegalWorld上、五种骨干模型上，相较代表性推理与智能体基线均取得一致提升，且交互与计算成本合理；消融与案例研究显示两组件在经验适配与跨角色协调上互补，提升长程法律推理的可靠性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 免训练测试时自适应可有效应对案件异质性与跨角色依赖，记忆演化与规则对齐协作互补，是提升长程法律推理可靠性与效率的有效途径。

title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

AI.tldr: 提出 Selective-RL，通过隔离并选择性迁移 RL 阶段的参数更新来提升 VLM 推理能力。
AI.motivation: 基于端点的能力迁移会混淆模型原有差异与推理后训练带来的变化，需从训练阶段视角分离 RL 更新。
AI.method: 隔离 RL 阶段更新，保留其主导的矩阵级方向并保持幅度，迁移至 VLM 的语言模块。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族、五个视觉推理基准上，15 组比较中 12 组优于全更新插值，Qwen 上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 区分了后训练中"获得的"与"可迁移的"能力，为跨模型能力迁移提供训练阶段新视角。

title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
summary: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

AI.tldr: 提出 FocusGate——一个可弃权的无注视先验门控集成方法，通过逐帧门读取散焦图的三个形状统计量来选择可信帧，仅在估计器平均高于随机水平的帧上融合，显著提升多个领域与模型的视频注视预测性能。
AI.motivation: 视频注视预测主要由训练了注视数据的模型主导，但无注视先验本身也携带有价值信号，只是这些模型未能吸收。关键在于判断何时可以信任这些先验，因此需要一个能够选择性地采纳先验的机制。
AI.method: FocusGate 采用门控集成架构：成员可弃权。逐帧门读取散焦图的三个形状统计量，选择估计器平均高于随机的帧进行融合；被拒绝的帧完全退化为基线。引入中位秩（midrank）归一化，使全零先验在零参数下即可弃权。
AI.result: 在电影、体育和网络视频上，门控融合显著为正，而无条件融合在体育上有害、在网络上无效。将其加入四个监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军），在全部十六个"模型-领域"单元上提升 shuffled AUC，其中十五个显著，且仅给冠军增加 1% 延迟。单独使用时，在电影域以 16 帧因果均值超越 TASED-Net 和 UNISAL。
AI.conclusion: 无注视先验在恰当的门控选择下能有效补充监督模型，FocusGate 以极低成本实现稳健且显著的性能提升，验证了"知道何时信任先验"这一核心思路的有效性。

title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
summary: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

AI.tldr: 在107组镁合金挤压条件数据上，研究能否从显微组织与织构反推合金成分与工艺参数；传统晶粒/织构统计描述子在识别合金上表现最好。
AI.motivation: 合金开发通常正向进行（由成分与工艺调出组织以满足性能目标），而从优化组织反推配方仍依赖专家知识。作者希望探究这一"逆向步骤"是否可被机器学习学到。
AI.method: 使用内部数据集：14种合金、107个挤压条件，每个条件配有光学显微照片和X射线织构测量。比较三种组织与织构描述子：传统晶粒与织构统计量、预训练图像编码器的视觉嵌入、晶粒网络上的图神经网络。每种描述子搭配预测头，完成两项任务：由工艺给成分（任务A）、由成分给工艺参数（任务B）。采用5折交叉验证。
AI.result: 5折交叉验证下，传统描述子对65%的留出条件识别出正确合金（始终猜最常见合金仅17%），而学习型嵌入低于30%。工艺参数可恢复但噪声更大：相比仅用成分，加入组织可将温度误差约减半。由于铸造合金和压机设置选项有限，两个答案都是离散的；从已知选项中选择并尊重其顺序的预测头优于自由数值预测头。
AI.conclusion: 从组织反推配方的逆向步骤在很大程度上是可学习的，但传统组织描述子在此任务上优于学习型嵌入；离散、有序的建模方式更适合该问题。

title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
summary: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDB（Point-Based Deformation Blending），一种点基变形混合的面部动画重定向方法，无需网格结构对应即可跨网格迁移表情，兼顾运动保真与表面伪影抑制。
AI.motivation: Mesh-agnostic面部动画重定向需在不同结构网格间传递表情，但现有方法难以在保留面部运动的同时避免表面伪影，且常依赖预定义cage、预计算坐标或全局求解等约束。
AI.method: PDB从源中性-表情对预测一小组变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重。权重对每个目标仅计算一次并可跨帧复用，控制点随源表情变化。用ReLU保证权重非负并允许精确为零，再进行逐行归一化。目标网格通过权重与控制点直接相乘重建，无需预定义cage、预计算坐标、学习式逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解。仅用自重定向重建监督训练。
AI.result: 实验显示重定向准确、推理快速，学习到的权重具有局部支撑性。联合评估表情准确度与局部表面保持度表明，相比所评估的稠密位移方法，表面伪影减少且保留了预期运动。感知评估进一步支持自重定向与跨身份重定向中的表情保真度与视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: PDB提供了一种无需网格结构对应、无需配对跨身份训练数据的面部动画重定向框架，在准确性、效率与表面质量上取得良好平衡。

title: LFHE: Local-First Heuristic Evolution for Bounded Local Topology Search in Decentralized Learning with Non-IID Data
summary: Decentralized learning is highly sensitive to communication topology under non-IID data. Adaptive peer-selection methods can exploit local model information, but broader peer discovery may require increasingly large control state, whereas direct spectral optimization typically relies on graph-wide information. We study the intermediate setting of bounded local topology search and propose Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a representation-driven rewiring framework whose candidate discovery and scoring use only ego-neighborhood and friend-of-a-friend (FoF) information. The structural score admits an exact interpretation through graph Dirichlet energy: its sum across clients equals twice the representation Dirichlet energy, which under standard linear consensus dynamics governs the instantaneous dissipation of representation disagreement. LFHE combines this state-dependent structural signal with early exploration and degree control, while algebraic connectivity remains an offline graph diagnostic. Under bounded sparse degree, its FoF candidate state remains local rather than expanding toward population-wide peer tracking. Across four image, speech, and text benchmarks, LFHE achieves competitive decentralized learning performance. Matched-protocol controls identify the structural term as the principal empirical topology-selection signal, while comparison with broader peer discovery exposes a trade-off between predictive performance and discovery-state locality. Together, these results motivate state-aware bounded local topology search between pairwise peer selection and globally informed topology optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE)，一种基于表示驱动的去中心化学习拓扑重连框架，其候选发现与打分仅依赖自我邻域和好友的好友（FoF）信息，在有限稀疏度下保持局部状态，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 去中心化学习在非IID数据下对通信拓扑高度敏感。自适应对等选择方法可利用局部模型信息，但更广的对等发现需要越来越大的控制状态；而直接的谱优化通常依赖图全局信息。因此作者研究介于两者之间的"有界局部拓扑搜索"这一中间设定。
AI.method: 提出 LFHE 框架，候选发现与打分仅使用自我邻域与 FoF 信息。其结构分数可通过图 Dirichlet 能量精确解释：各客户端分数之和等于两倍的表示 Dirichlet 能量，在线性一致性动力学下主导表示分歧的瞬时耗散。LFHE 将该状态相关结构信号与早期探索、度控制相结合，代数连通度仅作为离线图诊断指标。
AI.result: 在图像、语音、文本四类基准上，LFHE 取得有竞争力的去中心化学习性能。匹配协议对照实验表明结构项是主要的经验性拓扑选择信号；与更广的对等发现对比，揭示了预测性能与发现状态局部性之间的权衡。在有界稀疏度下，其 FoF 候选状态保持局部，而不会向全局对等追踪扩展。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在成对对等选择与全局知情拓扑优化之间，采用状态感知的有界局部拓扑搜索这一方向。

title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的EC-RAG框架，将视频组织为事件链进行检索增强，提升长视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时帧往往被独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有检索增强方法多在帧或片段层面操作，无法建模事件随时间演变及相互关系。
AI.method: 免训练框架：先将视频划分为语义连贯的片段，用多模态信号表示每个片段，再将其链接为保留时间顺序并刻画事件间关系的结构化事件链；给定查询时，在链中定位相关事件并聚合关联模态的支持证据。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上，以事件为中心的设计持续优于帧级检索基线。
AI.conclusion: 事件级抽象与结构化多模态融合对长视频理解至关重要，且具备即插即用兼容性，凸显建模时间结构的重要性。

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍基于LogiKEy方法的多逻辑教学法，用经典高阶逻辑(HOL)作为通用元逻辑，在单一证明助手(如Isabelle/HOL)中编码并比较多种对象逻辑，并通过分级课堂示例(从命题逻辑到模态、动态认知、道义及本体论论证)展示其教学效果。
AI.motivation: 面向计算机科学、数学和哲学混合学生群体教授逻辑存在困难；不同逻辑体系通常需要不同工具，学生难以在同一环境中学习、实验和比较各种(经典与非经典)逻辑。
AI.method: 采用logico-pluralistic的LogiKEy方法：以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)为通用元逻辑，通过定义语义对对象逻辑(含非经典逻辑)做语义嵌入，使单一证明助手(Isabelle/HOL)及其自动定理证明器与(反)模型查找器成为统一的学习环境；设计分级课堂示例序列，每一步转换由前一表示的局限、更显式建模需求或新应用驱动。
AI.result: 示例序列：说谎者-诚实者谜题引导从命题逻辑到模态逻辑；智者谜题引向动态认知逻辑；Boolos的奇特推理说明高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的价值；Chisholm悖论引向道义逻辑并从标准道义逻辑到二元道义逻辑；Gödel本体论论证推进到研究级形而上学论证。作者还反驳了"将一切嵌入经典HOL是独断论而非多元论"的质疑，反思了三年教学经验，并概述该方法在Isabelle之外的移植性。
AI.conclusion: 以经典HOL为通用元逻辑的LogiKEy方法是一种可行的多元逻辑教学框架，能在单一环境中实现多逻辑的比较与实验；该方法具有良好的教学效果与可移植性，可推广至其他证明助手环境。

title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
summary: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.
