AI.tldr: 该论文提出了RenderBench，一个包含12个真实世界重建场景的基准，用于评估视频模型的"渲染到真实"（render-to-real）生成能力，提供配对真实目标视频与可编辑3D数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 现代视频模型能够基于真实外观参考和指定场景结构、视角变化与运动的代理渲染生成逼真视频。评估这种render-to-real能力需要同时具备描绘相同场景演变的真实目标视频和可编辑、几何配准的3D副本，但此类数据传统上依赖大量人工建模、标定和动画制作。
AI.method: 构建流程结合了视觉几何、神经重建和辅助3D创作。每个场景被分解为静态物体和动态角色，配准到采集相机，并仅在通过多视角几何与时间验证后才被接受。每个评估单元包含外观参考图像、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染以及渲染器原生场景标注。
AI.result: 首个版本保留了14个注册样本中的12个（85.7%），包含1,496对真实-代理帧。所有发布场景均通过文件完整性和环境编辑审计，代理诊断得到深度si-RMSE为0.2170、实例mIoU为0.3673。基准覆盖大规模室内环境和自我中心视角，包含静态与动态设置。
AI.conclusion: RenderBench提供了配对的真实观测和可编辑场景状态，可用于评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持情况，并支持按物体、可见性、关节和运动来定位失败。

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Learn2Play Bench，一个由规则新颖或反直觉的文本游戏组成的基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体从交互经验中学习的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评测规则已在指令中给出或预训练模型已熟悉的游戏，难以区分「从交互中学习」与「用已有知识推理」，因此需要一个能真正考察经验学习的评测方案。
AI.method: 设计规则新颖/反直觉的文本游戏，提供可复现反馈与自动评分，支持多次尝试下的受控评测；并通过变换游戏实例测试迁移能力；据此评测骨干模型、自进化方法与智能体框架对学习能力的影响。
AI.result: 三项发现：(1) 保留完整的动作与反馈记录比将其总结为规则/策略更有利于学习；(2) 顶尖人类玩家峰值分数高于被测智能体，人类探索更多样策略、重复动作更少；(3) 固定骨干模型时，更换框架可提升性能并降低预估推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示 LLM 智能体从经验中学习的机制与不足，为提升其学习能力指明方向。

title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

AI.tldr: SpaTime 是一个流式视觉语言模型，通过将因果几何 token 融合进语言模型，实现边接收视频边进行三维空间推理，并利用响应时间损失监督答题时机。
AI.motivation: 现有具备 3D 几何先验的 VLM 空间推理能力强，但只能离线运行，必须等完整视频才能作答；而流式 VLM 虽能因果处理帧并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式 3D 表示。论文旨在结合两者优势，解决流式场景下的三维空间推理与响应时机问题。
AI.method: 提出 SpaTime 流式 VLM，在每一帧将因果几何 token 仅基于已观测帧融合进语言模型。为监督模型何时作答，设计响应时间损失，将逐帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，并惩罚其与真值帧的距离。同时构建 StreamVSTI-Bench 和 StreamVSI-Bench 两个流式评测基准。
AI.result: 在 StreamVSTI-Bench 上，SpaTime 总体准确率达到 49.2%，相对最强流式基线将平均响应时间误差降低 66%。
AI.conclusion: SpaTime 将流式处理与显式 3D 几何表示相结合，并通过响应时间损失有效监督答题时机，在流式三维空间推理任务上取得了准确率与响应效率的双重提升。

title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
summary: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

AI.tldr: 提出量子纠缠多模态融合网络 QEMFN，用参数化纠缠作为归纳偏置进行图文融合，在检索任务上优于经典融合基线，并在真实超导设备上可执行。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言系统主要依赖拼接、注意力、双线性池化或张量交互等经典算子进行融合，缺乏结构化的归纳偏置，且量子纠缠这一物理机制尚未被系统性地作为可训练融合机制加以探索和评估。
AI.method: 将预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧凑潜空间，编码为角度参数化量子态，经模态内与跨模态配对纠缠线路处理，测量后得到融合表示用于检索；在同等参数量预算和相同冻结 CLIP 骨干下，与 MLP、张量融合、FiLM、交叉注意力、紧凑 Transformer 及去量子化的配对拓扑对照进行对比，并开展消融、量子中心分析（Meyer-Wallach 纠缠能力、可表达性、梯度方差与贫瘠平台界、熵-性能相关性）以及纠缠组件的干预研究；执行方式包括基于采样的估计、含噪声模型的模拟后端和带零噪声外推的真实超导设备。
AI.result: 在 COCO-5k 和 Flickr30k 上，QEMFN 在参数预算匹配且骨干冻结的条件下优于所有经典融合基线；消融将量子模块的贡献与周围经典投影分离，量子中心分析给出纠缠能力、可表达性、梯度方差界与熵-性能相关性等指标。
AI.conclusion: 本工作不主张量子计算优势，其贡献在于框架本身以及受控的经验与量子中心评估，将可训练纠缠定位为一种可解释、可在当代设备规模下硬件执行的融合机制。

title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
summary: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

AI.tldr: 本文将路径-流对齐作为流匹配的统一训练目标，联合训练保端点的路径网络与流网络；发现仅用对齐损失学习路径会导致"路径过拟合"，并用品路径正则项（隐藏部分源信息）引入熵下限来抑制瓶颈，在ImageNet-256×256上稳定提升FID。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径、只学速度场，路径本身未被优化。作者希望把路径也纳入学习，用一个统一的路径-流对齐目标同时训练路径与流，以提升生成质量。但需要解决"路径如何学才可靠"这一问题。
AI.method: 联合训练一个保端点的路径网络和一个流网络，共用同一对齐损失：流去匹配路径速度，路径去对齐当前流的速度。诊断出"路径过拟合"失败模式——对齐损失下降但样本质量变差，与诱导概率路径中的低熵瓶颈（中间边缘分布过度集中）相关。为此提出随机路径正则项：在保持端点精确的同时，向路径网络隐藏部分源信息，从而为随机训练路径的边缘分布提供显式熵下限。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256×256、SiT骨干上，该方法在各模型尺度上一致提升FID，并可扩展到model-guidance训练；推理阶段的架构与采样器保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 仅用对齐损失不是路径学习的可靠判据；通过随机路径正则引入熵下限、抑制瓶颈后，联合路径-流训练变得有效，且不增加推理开销。

title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
summary: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal

AI.tldr: 上下文先验在提升神经到语言解码准确率的同时会重塑候选得分，导致置信度被同样重塑，使残余错误可能更"自信"却难以被察觉。本文在MEG-MASC和MOUS上研究该现象，发现置信度排序反转，并提出分离局部与先验得分的解码方案。
AI.motivation: 上下文先验通过重塑候选分数改善神经到语言的解码，但置信度也从这些被重塑的分数中读取，因此先验留下的错误可能变得更自信，而准确率却没有变化来暴露这一问题。作者希望研究先验如何塑造置信度。
AI.method: 在MEG-MASC与MOUS上研究语音检索，使用局部解码分数、通过加性浅融合组合的上下文先验，以及融合后top-two margin作为置信度；并采用仅改变融合权重的因果干预来验证机制。
AI.result: 在最初错误的预测中出现置信度排序反转：正确候选初始排名靠前时margin越大越易修复，初始排名较低时则越难修复。MEG-MASC上整体正确性AUROC为0.87，但区分修复与残余错误的AUROC从初始排名2-3的0.70降至排名21-50的0.39；排名20以外的错误占融合后全部错误的46.6%。因果干预改变融合权重可将反转移到更深排名；在词级LM先验下，准确率增益达峰后反转仍继续移动。分离局部与先验分数后，解码器在74.5%（而非56.7%）窗口作答，且92%输出集仍含正确候选。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出分数层面的解释：修复必须先弥补正确候选的初始劣势，限制其最终margin；而残余错误可在两个错误候选间形成大margin。融合后的置信度应保留每个预测背后的局部与上下文证据，而非仅依赖融合分数；分离读取两者可改善选择性解码。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
summary: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种后训练提升（lifting）方法，针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型，将多视角2D检测器信息融合到高斯基元上以完成三维语义标注，并分离检测器、提升与表示转换三类误差来源。
AI.motivation: 同一高斯基元在多视角下的类别判断常不一致：有时被遮挡，检测器置信度也随视角变化。此外真值以标注网格给出，因为两次训练不会产生相同的高斯分布，导致标注与高斯之间缺少直接对应关系。
AI.method: 一种逐类别的后训练提升方法：同时累积目标与非目标证据，并按每个高斯在各视角中的可见性加权。之后用两个阈值过滤高斯：主阈值β选出高置信度种子，较低的γβ阈值补充其周围的连通分量。评估时将标签从高斯迁移到既可见又被标注的网格顶点，从而分离2D检测器、提升过程和表示转换三部分误差。阈值与迁移算子仅在七个Replica验证场景上选取，随后以固定参数评估十个留出的ScanNet++场景。
AI.result: 验证场景平均mIoU：使用数据集标注掩码为0.93，使用YOLO掩码为0.65；ScanNet++测试场景分别为0.80和0.54。相比逐视角阈值化的旧版本方法，本文方法在测试mIoU上提升0.24，并使得两个数据集的所有类别和场景可共用单一阈值。
AI.conclusion: 多视角证据累积与连通分量补充的阈值化策略显著优于逐视角阈值化，且泛化性好、参数统一。误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器，说明提升与迁移环节已较为可靠。

title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.tldr: 提出OSFP4量化方案，通过优化平滑与缩放参数降低NVFP4量化误差，在保持高推理吞吐的同时提升精度。
AI.motivation: NVFP4数据类型具有存储紧凑和原生张量核加速的优势，适合大语言模型推理，但使用NVFP4保持精度需要精细的量化处理，现有方案在精度与效率的平衡上仍存在不足。
AI.method: 针对每个线性投影使用对角平滑矩阵，其元素经优化以最小化NVFP4下的矩阵乘量化误差，并考虑舍入方式（最近舍入或GPTQ式连续干扰消除）。通过对乘性抖动FP4量化器（而非固定确定性量化器）进行分析，实现平滑条目与块缩放的联合优化。
AI.result: 在相应量化设置下，OSFP4在评估的竞品中取得最高平均精度，同时在测量工作负载上保持了约94-97%的厂商NVFP4预填充吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: OSFP4是一种兼顾精度与效率的NVFP4量化方案，代码已开源。

title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
summary: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于图块的高光谱图像分类中同类训练-测试空间重叠导致的数据泄漏问题，提出重叠百分比（OP）和平均重叠率（AOR）两种度量，并在Pavia University数据集上证明随机采样会显著虚高分类性能。
AI.motivation: 基于图块（patch-based）学习通过利用局部光谱-空间信息提升了高光谱图像（HSI）分类效果，但从同一图像中随机划分训练-测试样本会导致空间图块重叠，进而产生数据泄漏，使性能评估过于乐观。论文旨在系统量化并揭示这一问题的严重程度。
AI.method: 提出两种度量：重叠百分比（OP）用于量化全局重叠的测试图块像素比例；平均重叠率（AOR）用于衡量受影响测试图块中的局部重叠严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，采用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba六种模型，对比随机与非随机空间采样的表现，并进行图块尺寸分析。
AI.result: 随机采样下深度图块模型精度很高，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；非随机空间采样下性能大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。图块尺寸从5x5增至19x19时，随机采样的重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。
AI.conclusion: 基于随机图块的评估会大幅虚高分类性能，对强烈依赖空间上下文的模型尤为明显。研究提示HSI分类研究需警惕同图训练-测试空间重叠带来的数据泄漏，应采用更严格的采样策略进行评估。代码已开源。

title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
summary: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) 建模范式，用自然语言作为连接多模态传感与动作的语义接口，并构建大规模 SLA 基准与统一模型 OpenSLA，实现动作预测、状态理解与解释。
AI.motivation: 现有传感器模型大多止步于感知，只做状态识别或结果预测，动作建模往往独立进行且依赖任务特定、封闭的标签空间，缺乏对传感证据与动作之间统一、可解释的关联建模。
AI.method: 提出 SLA 框架，将多模态传感观测、自然语言与动作整合到统一模型中，以语言为语义接口表示、预测并解释异构动作，同时保持对传感证据的接地；构建覆盖 116,000+ 个体、79 种传感模态、60 个动作组的大规模基准及多维度描述生成流水线；基于此提出统一模型 OpenSLA，支持分层动作预测、状态理解与动作解释。
AI.result: 在临床预测、手术室和代谢健康等真实任务上，OpenSLA 性能优于现有最先进方法，并展现出语言引导的证据接地以及对未见动作和人群的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SLA 为连接感知与行动提供了统一建模范式，语言作为语义接口有效桥接传感证据与动作，OpenSLA 验证了该框架在多领域任务中的优越性、可解释性与泛化潜力。

title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出BASA，一种后端无关的稀疏注意力机制，通过跨DiT块的移位局部窗口注意力实现全局信息交互，兼顾视觉质量与实际加速。
AI.motivation: DiT全注意力计算量随分辨率二次增长，难以支撑高分辨率生成；分区窗口注意力高效但阻断跨窗口交互，产生网格伪影；滑窗注意力虽恢复交互，却因不规则计算导致理论与实际加速差距大，且需针对不同硬件定制内核。
AI.method: BASA用移位局部窗口注意力替换视觉自注意力，通过在DiT各块间引入结构化窗口移位方案，让被窗口边界分隔的token在后续层中互相通信，从而达成全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影；设计不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核，可直接部署于现有注意力后端。
AI.result: 在FLUX上实现的加速超过理论估计值的90%，在Wan上实现4.52倍注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BASA弥合了理论稀疏性与实际加速之间的差距，兼具视觉质量与实用加速，且后端无关、易于部署。

title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.

AI.tldr: LeanPlan 是首个利用 LLM 生成启发式函数、并通过机器验证其可采纳性来求最优规划计划的规划系统。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM 能生成启发式函数以在满足性规划中取得先进性能，但这些启发式无法保证可采纳性，可能产生次优计划；本文旨在兼顾 LLM 生成启发式的高效性与最优规划的保证。
AI.method: 给定领域描述与训练任务，采用智能体循环，利用规划器反馈迭代改进可复用的领域特定启发式、其可采纳性证明及所需领域假设；并在 Lean 4 中实现该启发式、证明以及带机器验证的实例化与搜索的高效规划器。
AI.result: 在来自国际规划竞赛的十个领域和三个新领域上评估，测试任务规模最多为训练任务的 57 倍对象数；使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 驱动智能体循环，成功为所有领域生成启发式与可采纳性证明。所得启发式下，LeanPlan 通常比最先进的 Scorpion 规划器扩展更少状态，并总体求解更多任务。
AI.conclusion: LeanPlan 表明 LLM 生成的启发式可在机器验证可采纳性的前提下用于最优规划，并在多个领域展现出优于最先进规划器的效率与求解能力。

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
summary: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出 CtrlCache，一种免训练的控制感知缓存框架，用于交互式视频世界模型的块级自回归生成。它利用“控制先于去噪到达”这一信号，按动作变化把块分为初始/过渡/转折/稳定四类，在不同状态下自适应复用残差并引入频率混合历史先验，在 Matrix-Game 2.0 与 LingBot-World v1/v2 上实现 1.21x–1.41x 加速且提升 WBench 分数。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应用户控制。块级自回归+少步去噪虽减少迭代，但每块仍需多次昂贵去噪。现有免训练缓存依赖模型内部去噪动态决定复用，未显式考虑控制切换；而交互生成本身暴露了可用信号：每块的控制信号在该块去噪前已到达，据此制定调度无需额外前向。
AI.method: 首先分析不同控制状态下相邻块的结构相似性，发现动作变化附近结构相似度下降，低频结构比高频细节更持久。据此提出 CtrlCache：动作感知的调度与刷新策略跨块及块内检测动作变化，将块标记为初始、过渡、转折、稳定四态；在选定的单个内部去噪步上，初始与过渡块保留完整计算，转折与稳定块复用同一块内最近一次完整计算步的 transformer 残差。并引入频率混合历史先验引导，在无额外 DiT 前向的情况下融合前一个干净 latent 的互补信息以利用稳定交互期低频结构的持久性。
AI.result: 在 Matrix-Game 2.0 和 LingBot-World v1/v2 上评估，CtrlCache 在无需重新训练模型的情况下实现 1.21x 至 1.41x 的 DiT 主干加速，同时在三个模型上相比原始推理均提升了 WBench Overall 分数。
AI.conclusion: CtrlCache 表明，利用交互生成中天然可获得、无需前向的控制信号来驱动缓存决策，可在免训练条件下同时实现交互式视频世界模型的加速与生成质量提升。

title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MASC框架与CRPC-Bench基准，用于心理谘询中保持一致性的来访者模拟，实验显示其在多维度一致性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多用于谘询师培训和心理谘询研究中的来访者模拟，但可靠模拟要求来访者在长时间交互中保持心理一致性。现有角色扮演方法多依赖静态画像提示，易出现人格漂移、不现实的高度配合，以及心理状态、沟通行为和情绪的不一致；同时缺乏统一评测基准来同时考察稳定的来访者特征与动态变化的心理过程。
AI.method: 提出MASC（多智能体自校准框架），结合构念引导生成、协作精炼、一致性验证与基于记忆的修正，形成闭环校准回路，在对话展开过程中检测并纠正不一致；同时构建CRPC-Bench基准，涵盖会话级画像信息与大五人格特质，以及轮次级心理状态、沟通行为和情绪表达，包含38个动机式访谈来访者画像并附加人格与情绪标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，MASC在画像、人格、接受度和轮次级一致性方面均优于现有方法，其中异构配置取得最强的整体表现。
AI.conclusion: MASC与CRPC-Bench为AI辅助谘询研究与培训中开发并评估心理一致的来访者模拟提供了统一基础。

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
summary: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

AI.tldr: ALIVE 框架让插入视频的对象能与原视频内容产生连贯交互（如被拿起、被操作），仅需编辑首帧和一条命名新对象的指令，并通过 VLM 预测交互引导进一步提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑工具虽能插入对象，但难以让插入对象参与"被拿起""被操作"等交互，插入对象与原视频内容之间缺乏协调的行为关系。
AI.method: 1) 构建 35,800 对编辑视频对，融合 3D 渲染、模型生成与真实视频，并接入 ROSE 的通用编辑对；每对仅改变目标对象是否存在而保持周围动作一致，从而学习协调的对象行为与源内容保持。2) 训练一个视觉语言模型（VLM），从相同输入预测交互引导。
AI.result: 在无 VLM 引导时，ALIVE 在两个基准上的 Overall 指标分别比最强基线提升 43.9% 和 4.4%；加入 VLM 预测的引导后，ALIVE-interaction 分数进一步提升 0.95 分，且无需额外用户输入。
AI.conclusion: ALIVE 通过专门的数据设计与 VLM 引导，实现了插入对象与源视频的连贯交互，并显著优于现有基线，同时提出 ALIVE-interaction 基准用于评估交互保真度、源保持与视觉连贯性。

title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
summary: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.

AI.tldr: 提出 zkLLMPoT 零知识框架，通过对训练后的检查点进行前向评估（而非验证优化轨迹）来证明审计者定义的属性，使认证成本与训练迭代次数无关。
AI.motivation: 当模型权重和训练数据私有时，审计 LLM 训练结果的难度很大；而在 Transformer 规模上对整个训练过程进行密码学证明的成本又高得难以承受。
AI.method: zkLLMPoT 分两阶段：1) 训练者固定架构并承诺模型权重，随后审计者选择挑战序列，防止训练者针对审计数据修改检查点；2) 训练者证明该已承诺模型在这些序列上达到的目标值。方法基于 sumcheck 与 lookup 论证来认证 Transformer 计算，并支持下一 token 损失及任务特定审计目标。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族上，算子级基准测试显示：1.1–1.5B 参数模型的证明时间为 41–59 秒，13B 模型在所覆盖算子上为 131 秒，序列长度 512 时验证时间低于半秒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在不公开模型权重、也不需要私有训练数据的前提下，实现与训练迭代次数无关的 LLM 训练结果认证，且验证开销极低。

title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
summary: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 4D-HOF是一个前馈式框架，利用条件流匹配从视觉基础模型生成的粗略估计出发，重建4D手-物交互，并在传输过程中融入物理约束与2D证据进行引导，实现稳定且准确的交互重建。
AI.motivation: 现有4D手-物重建方法依赖昂贵的逐序列优化，而生成式方法多从随机噪声合成交互，容易导致交互预测不稳定。因此需要一个既能前馈推理、又能保证交互稳定性的重建方案。
AI.method: 提出条件流匹配模型，将视觉基础模型导出的手-物状态传输到交互流形上，从而以馈送方式纠正平移、旋转和对齐误差；同时利用该生成式建模的特性，在传输过程中引入物理交互约束与观测到的2D证据进行测试时引导，使重建在生成过程本身中被细化，而非事后优化。
AI.result: 在多个域外基准上的实验表明，4D-HOF达到了最先进性能，能生成更稳定、更准确的4D手-物重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过在多样化数据集上训练生成模型，4D-HOF对具有挑战性的真实场景具备稳健泛化能力，验证了将前馈生成与测试时引导结合用于4D手-物交互重建的有效性。

title: Building Rome from a Single Image
summary: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将物体中心式3D生成器改造为可同时处理室内外单图场景生成的方法，通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应与合成室外数据，在几何精度与感知质量上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 单图场景生成需从单张图像重建含未见区域的完整3D网格。现有预训练3D物体生成器虽有强形状先验，但面向固定规范体积中的孤立物体，且偏重室内场景，因为室外3D数据稀缺。
AI.method: (a) 将场景划分为随相机距离缩放的自适应块，近处小块保留细节、远处大块覆盖建筑等结构；(b) 令生成器通过提升图像特征并感知自由空间、已观测表面与未观测区域，来建立显式2D-3D对应；(c) 合成约4000个室外场景以扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++及真实图片上，方法在室内外场景的几何精度与感知质量均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 改造以物体为中心的预训练生成器（如Trellis 2），结合自适应分块、2D-3D对应建模与合成室外数据，可有效扩展至室内外单图场景生成并保持原有先验。

title: The Standardization Trap: Certifying Joint Label Processing in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Linear regression and kernel smoothing offer tractable explanations of in-context learning: in both, the features determine the weight assigned to each context label. However, whether this fixed-weight account describes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) remains unclear. Testing this account using derivatives runs into a standardization trap: public TFM packages standardize the labels before the model sees them, yet ordinary derivatives also reflect behavior outside the set of standardized labels, making a model appear nonlinear even when every prediction it makes agrees with a fixed-weight map. We propose two certificates that depend only on predictions at standardized labels and can reject two distinct explanations: fixed-weight prediction and sums of independent nonlinear label transformations. Across the five public TFMs that we evaluate, our certificates show that changing one context label alters how other labels influence the prediction, a behavior we call joint processing. We further find that joint processing emerges with training and that attention scores carry most of the measured interaction. Together, these findings motivate TFM explanations that account for how context labels change the influence of individual examples.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验预训练表格基础模型（TFM）是否遵循"固定权重"解释（即特征决定各上下文标签的权重），提出两种仅依赖标准化标签预测的证书，证明五个公开TFM均存在"联合处理"现象。
AI.motivation: 线性回归与核平滑为上下文学习提供了可解释的固定权重框架，但该框架是否适用于预训练表格基础模型尚不清楚。直接使用导数检验会遇到"标准化陷阱"：公开TFM包在模型接收标签前会先标准化标签，而普通导数还反映标准化标签集之外的行为，导致即使模型每个预测都符合固定权重映射，也显得非线性。
AI.method: 提出两种证书，仅依赖标准化标签下的预测结果，可分别拒绝两种解释：固定权重预测，以及独立非线性标签变换之和。在五个公开TFM上进行评估。
AI.result: 证书表明改变一个上下文标签会改变其他标签对预测的影响，作者称之为"联合处理"。此外，联合处理随训练出现，注意力分数承载了大部分测得的交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现要求对TFM的解释应能说明上下文标签如何改变单个样本的影响力，而非诉诸固定权重假设。

title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
summary: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"世界模型的物理期末考"（World Models' Last Exam in Physics），一个基于测量的物理一致性基准，涵盖40个受控任务与六大物理领域，通过任务特定定量测量评估视频世界模型的物理一致性，实验显示八个模型在1280个视频上普遍存在物理不一致，最佳模型得分仅57.76/100。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理上不一致的序列，影响其在具身智能预测与规划中的可靠性；而现有评估多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试又主要局限于力学，缺乏覆盖多物理领域、可解释且基于测量的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建包含40个受控任务的基准，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学、表面张力；每个任务由初始图像与生成提示搭配预定义物理判据，无需参考视频即可可解释地检验可观测物理关系；评估器结合任务可观测性筛选与任务特定定量物理测量。
AI.result: 在八个视频生成模型的1280个视频上实验，发现持续存在的物理不一致与任务间显著差异，最佳模型总分57.76/100；合成视频验证了测量模块在受控条件下的有效性；评估器在任务内排序与成对比较中与人类判断的一致性均高于直接使用视觉语言模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该基准结合多物理领域覆盖、基于可测量证据的评分以及明确的测量局限，为诊断物理不一致并追踪视频世界模型向物理一致方向的发展提供了可解释依据。

title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
summary: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.

AI.tldr: 在 Lean 等形式化证明助手中，证明必须通过机器编译检验，因此无需人工评分。直接生成在多步数值命题上易失败：证明有效要求每个整数正确，通过率受单整数精度 k 次方上界约束。SCOPE（状态条件化算子规划与执行）将任务分解为模型规划算子、符号引擎执行数值、编译器渲染证明。在 218 题测试集上，135M 骨干模型认证 191/218（87.6%）；7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 以 27.5 倍 token、37.5 倍耗时认证 18/218；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向对偶集上认证为零。多步思考每题消耗 6.12 次离散决策动作，且不产生自然语言思考文本。用当前引擎状态替换决策帧中的滞后状态使通过率从 117/218 提升至 191/218，而加重链末端损失反而有害。在 Lean-Workbook 公共库上，3,536 道可评分合规题中认证 2,132 道（60.29%），主测试集无回归。限制自由生成并保持决策时信息可见，比扩大模型规模更直接有效。
AI.motivation: 在 Lean 等形式化证明助手中，证明必须通过机器编译检查，因而评估无需人工打分。但直接生成方法在多步数值命题上表现很差：证明只有在所有内容整数都正确时才有效，导致通过率被单整数精度的 k 次方所限制。作者通过跨 2,617 条参考证明的受控破坏实验验证了这一幂律，从而提出需要一种更可靠、可控的证明生成范式。
AI.method: 提出 SCOPE（State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution，状态条件化算子规划与执行）：模型在算子词汇表上进行规划，符号引擎执行数值计算，编译器负责渲染证明，从而强制实现"规划—执行—渲染"的自然分工。此外，方法上还关注决策帧中引擎状态的时序问题（滞后状态 vs 当前状态）以及链末端损失的加权策略。
AI.result: 在 218 题测试集上，135M 骨干模型的 SCOPE 认证 191/218（87.6%）；相比之下 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 仅认证 18/218，却消耗 27.5 倍 token 和 37.5 倍墙钟时间；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向对偶集上认证为零。多步思考每题消耗 6.12 次离散决策动作，不产生自然语言思考文本。将决策帧中的滞后引擎状态替换为当前状态使通过率从 117/218 提升至 191/218，而加重链末端损失反而降低性能。在公共 Lean-Workbook 库上，3,536 道可评分合规题中认证 2,132 道（60.29%），主测试集零回归。所有读数来自版本冻结评审，并经过独立复核与反向验证。
AI.conclusion: 限制自由生成并保持决策时信息可见，是比单纯扩大模型规模更直接有效的提升形式化证明生成可靠性的路径。SCOPE 用极小的骨干模型即显著超越大规模专用模型，表明正确的问题分解与状态信息管理比模型体量更为关键。

title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出MedZERO自进化框架，用于开放式医学推理，通过Examiner出题与Reasoner多轮循证求解配合可控知识累积，在五个医学推理基准上以4B和8B模型稳定超过基线与先前自进化方法，最多提升13.7个准确率点。
AI.motivation: 大模型在医学问答与临床推理中受限于静态参数知识与昂贵专家监督；现有自进化方法多针对数学、代码等可精确验证的领域，而医学推理开放式、知识密集且仅部分可验证，因此需要专门的自进化框架。
AI.method: MedZERO包含一个Examiner，用于生成前沿医学问题-选项对；一个Reasoner，借助外部知识工具进行证据驱动的多轮推理求解。为支持可靠持续改进，采用可控知识累积：在推理中同时维护临时探索性知识与经筛选的持久性知识。
AI.result: 在五个公开医学推理基准上，使用4B与8B规模基模型、开放式评测，MedZERO在所有设置下均一致优于原基模型及先前自进化基线，相比次优自进化基线最高取得13.7个平均准确率点提升。
AI.conclusion: MedZERO表明面向开放式医学推理的自进化范式是可行且有效的，可控知识累积与出题-求解耦合设计能突破静态知识限制，为难以精确验证领域的自进化提供了参考方向。

title: An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture
summary: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项 AI 辅助的 Lean 4 庞加莱猜想形式化工作，提出以数学家蓝图配合明确里程碑的组织方式，支持并行智能体工作并便于定位阻塞点。
AI.motivation: 证明背后的几何分析缺乏可复用的形式化基础设施，组织大规模形式化工作困难，需要一种能让数学家在关键节点介入指导的工作流程。
AI.method: 将数学家准备的证明蓝图与显式里程碑声明相结合，用里程碑拆分任务以支持多个智能体并行推进，并为数学家提供定位阻塞点、提供数学指导的明确接口。
AI.result: 识别出该工作流中关键的人工干预点与组织性选择，并产出了可复用的形式化基础设施起点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来形式化项目提供了可复用基础设施的起点，此类基础设施一旦成熟，有望降低几何分析中数学结果验证的成本。

title: MoF: Preference-Aware Mixture Modeling for Black-Box LLM Personalization
summary: Proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, yet aligning their outputs with diverse user preferences remains challenging. Existing personalization approaches for black-box LLMs often rely on user-specific scoring heads, causing the number of personalized parameters to grow linearly with the number of users and requiring additional adaptation for unseen users. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture-of-Facets (MoF), a scalable personalization framework for black-box LLMs that models user preferences as compositions of shared latent preference facets rather than dedicated user-specific parameters. MoF performs personalization through history-conditioned routing over shared facet heads, enabling personalization for users unseen during training without additional parameter updates. Across diverse personalization tasks, MoF delivers stronger personalization performance while maintaining a more scalable and parameter-efficient design than prior approaches. Additional analysis indicates strong generalization to unseen users.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Mixture-of-Facets (MoF) 框架，通过对共享潜在偏好刻面的路由组合来实现黑盒 LLM 的可扩展个性化，避免用户参数随用户数线性增长，并能泛化到未见用户。
AI.motivation: 专有（黑盒）大语言模型能力强大，但使其输出对齐多样化的用户偏好仍具挑战。现有针对黑盒 LLM 的个性化方法多依赖用户专属的评分头，导致个性化参数数量随用户数线性增长，并且对新用户需要额外适配。
AI.method: 提出 Mixture-of-Facets (MoF)，将用户偏好建模为共享潜在偏好刻面的组合，而非专用用户参数。MoF 通过基于历史条件的路由在共享刻面头上进行个性化，从而无需额外参数更新即可为训练中未见过的用户实现个性化。
AI.result: 在多种个性化任务上，MoF 相比既有方法取得了更强的个性化性能，同时保持更具可扩展性与参数高效的设计。额外分析表明其对未见用户具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MoF 通过共享刻面组合与历史条件路由，为黑盒 LLM 提供了一种可扩展、参数高效且能泛化到未见用户的个性化范式，优于依赖用户专属参数的既有方法。

title: Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime
summary: Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions. This architecture integrates data acquisition, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, risk assessment, decision-making, and explainable AI into a closed-loop framework. With reference to the architectural components, a review and discussion of relevant maritime studies is performed, outlining their methods, advantages, and limitations. Furthermore, it highlights current challenges, including uncertainty and robustness, model generalization, explainability, limited availability of maritime datasets, and operational deployment, and identifies future research directions toward trustworthy AI-assisted maritime decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了海事系统中用于可解释故障预测与预防的关键AI技术，并提出一个闭环概念架构。
AI.motivation: 海事系统运行于高度动态环境，设备意外故障会危及安全、可靠性与运营效率。尽管AI、机器学习、数字孪生和预测性维护等技术可实现主动故障预测与预防，但在安全攸关的海事应用中，确保可信且可解释的决策仍是重大挑战。
AI.method: 采用综述与概念架构设计相结合的方法。提出一个集成数据采集、时间序列预测、异常检测、风险评估、决策制定和可解释AI的闭环框架，支持自主或人在回路的纠正措施；并围绕各架构组件对相关海事研究进行综述与讨论，梳理其方法、优势与局限。
AI.result: 系统梳理了海事领域中与故障预测和预防相关的AI技术及应用研究，明确了各组件的研究现状，并归纳出当前面临的主要挑战：不确定性与鲁棒性、模型泛化能力、可解释性、海事数据集稀缺以及实际部署问题。
AI.conclusion: 文章指出朝向可信AI辅助海事决策的未来研究方向，强调可解释性与闭环决策框架对安全攸关海事应用的重要性。

title: Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations
summary: Frontier AI evaluations increasingly use open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks whose transcripts can span hundreds of pages of outputs and actions from complex multi-agent networks. The observability envelop-the range of what evaluators can reliably infer about an agent's behaviours-is therefore narrowing. Language model assistants can help classify and interpret agent behaviour but also afford human evaluators significant analytical degrees of freedom, threatening the reproducibility and auditability of language-model-based transcript analysis. Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript. Users specify task context and behavioural vocabulary in a reusable evaluation-family configuration, with judge models and analysis settings supplied separately. Transect's navigable reports align recorded events, token use, sub-agent activity, and model-generated behavioural labels on a common turn-based timeline. Reviewers can quickly grasp a run's narrative, trace any label or event to its source turns, and export the underlying data tables for cross-run analysis. We demonstrate the workflow on an AI R&D evaluation that generated almost 13 million tokens, dividing the agents' work into behavioural phases aligned with research-skill classifications, sub-agent delegations and interactions, and token use. The combined view shows a focus on operational work and manuscript production, with little evidence of a sustained hypothesis generation stage-arguably a necessary component for high-quality scientific outputs. Transect's flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: Transect 是一个基于 Inspect Scout 的开源工具包，通过可配置的行为词表与判分模型，将长程智能体运行记录对齐到统一的回合时间线，帮助评估者理解运行过程、定位可审查行为并核查解释，并在近1300万token的AI研发评估中展示了工作流。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI评估日益采用开放式、智能体式、长时程任务，其记录可长达数百页，涉及复杂多智能体网络，评估者可可靠推断智能体行为的"可观测范围"正在收窄。语言模型助手虽能辅助分类与解释行为，但带来大量分析自由度，威胁基于语言模型的记录分析的可复现性与可审计性。
AI.method: Transect 是建立在 Inspect Scout 之上的开源软件包。用户在可复用的"评估族"配置中指定任务背景与行为词表，判分模型与分析设置另行提供。其可导航报告将记录事件、token使用、子智能体活动与模型生成的行为标签对齐到统一的基于回合的时间线。
AI.result: 在生成近1300万token的AI研发评估中，工作流将智能体工作划分为与研究技能分类对齐的行为阶段、子智能体委派与交互以及token使用。综合视图显示工作侧重操作性任务与手稿产出，几乎没有持续假设生成阶段的证据——而这可能是高质量科学产出的必要组成部分。
AI.conclusion: Transect 提供灵活、可定制的记录分析流水线，使评估者能跟上更长、更复杂、更频繁的AI评估，同时支持科学严谨性、透明度与可复现性。审查者可快速把握运行叙事、将标签或事件追溯至来源回合，并导出底层数据表用于跨运行分析。

title: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
summary: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMHO框架，在保持具身模型冻结的前提下，通过分析执行轨迹与历史harness自我进化harness；并提出EMHO-Merge在子任务间共享单一harness，在EmbodiedBench上持续提升成功率和交互质量。
AI.motivation: 现有提升具身智能体的工作多聚焦于训练底层模型，而负责规划、上下文和工具使用的harness通常依赖人工工程设计。作者希望探索harness能否在稀疏环境反馈下，直接从经验轨迹中自我改进。
AI.method: 提出EMHO自我进化框架：冻结具身模型，迭代地分析执行轨迹与先前harness历史来修订harness，优化范围超出技能或恢复提示，涉及进度监控、视觉工具使用、观察落地和失败响应等。为支持多子任务共享单一harness，引入EMHO-Merge，利用episode级增益与损失指导证据支持的细化，决定修订行为何时及如何应用。
AI.result: 在EmbodiedBench的导航与操作任务上评估EMHO，对Qwen 9B和27B模型均能持续提升任务成功率。定性分析显示EMHO不仅从失败和低效动作中恢复，还重塑了具身智能体理解和交互环境的方式。
AI.conclusion: harness可以通过经验轨迹自我进化，而无需训练底层模型；EMHO与EMHO-Merge有效提升多任务具身任务表现并改变智能体与环境的交互方式，为具身智能体优化提供了新方向。

title: AssemState: Manual and Physical-State-Guided Reasoning for Zero-shot Furniture Assembly
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding, but precise 3D spatial reasoning integrated with physical environment remains difficult. Furniture assembly requires not only recovering step-level operations from diagrammatic manuals, but also translating semantic attachment relations into 6D pose updates that enable parts to physically interact with the environment and previously assembled components. To study this problem, we propose AssemState, a zero-shot framework for manual and physical-state-guided furniture assembly. It firstly employs anchor-guided boundary assembly states to decompose manual pages into single-part operations and recover an assembly-tree. Then, it uses iterative after-state feedback refinement to guide successive (SE(3)) updates and corrections, and validates their physical plausibility through simulation-based release tests. Experiments show that compared with the strongest prior baseline, AssemState improves F1 from 38.58\% to 62.80\% and Tree Exact Match from 28.24\% to 53.92\% for assembly-tree recovery. On 243 independently evaluated part-level operations, our proposed iterative refinement improves judge-accepted operations from 0 to 5.3\% and reduces mean Chamfer distance from 5.4111 to 1.7744. However, visually plausible candidate poses may still suffer from collision, floating, mirror-orientation errors, incomplete seating, and wrong-side attachment. These results show that AssemState improves operation-structure recovery and selected local pose metrics, while MLLMs remain limited for spatial relationship reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AssemState，一个零样本框架，用于从图解手册和物理状态引导的家具装配，将手册操作转化为 6D 姿态更新并进行物理仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉理解上进展显著，但精确的 3D 空间推理与物理环境结合仍很困难。家具装配不仅需要从图解手册中恢复步骤级操作，还需将语义连接关系转化为 6D 姿态更新，使部件能物理交互。
AI.method: 框架首先采用锚点引导的边界装配状态，将手册页分解为单部件操作并恢复装配树；然后使用迭代式后状态反馈精化，引导连续的 SE(3) 更新与修正，并通过基于仿真的释放测试验证物理合理性。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，装配树恢复的 F1 从 38.58% 提升至 62.80%，树精确匹配从 28.24% 提升至 53.92%；在 243 个独立评估的部件级操作上，迭代精化将评审通过的操作从 0 提升至 5.3%，平均 Chamfer 距离从 5.4111 降至 1.7744。但视觉上合理的候选姿态仍存在碰撞、悬浮、镜像朝向错误、不完全就位和错误侧连接等问题。
AI.conclusion: AssemState 改善了操作结构恢复与部分局部姿态指标，但 MLLM 在空间关系推理方面仍存在局限。

title: Cylindrical Geodesic Flow Matching for Quasiperiodic Physiological Signal Transformation
summary: Paired translation between quasiperiodic physiological waveforms (i.e., recovering a target oscillatory signal from the source) is central to the interpretation of cardiovascular signals derived from wearables placed at different body locations. This source-to-target mapping in these problems carries inherent geometric structure: the phase wraps around the cycle and must be treated as a circular variable, the amplitude remains strictly positive, and the beat-to-beat alignment can drift unpredictably across cycles and subjects. While deep neural networks have been used for phase estimation and complex-valued signal modeling, prior work does not explicitly learn phase transport between paired signals. Consequently, neither endpoint-supervised regression nor the standard affine path used in flow matching accounts for this phase--amplitude structure. We introduce \emph{cylindrical geodesic flow matching} for paired cardiovascular waveform translation. We show that the standard affine path used in flow matching distorts intermediate amplitude and instantaneous frequency when interpolating between quasiperiodic signals; replacing it with a closed-form geodesic on the phase--amplitude cylinder eliminates these artifacts and converts each training pair into dense, geometry-consistent velocity supervision. On zero-shot photoplethysmography and limited-support seismocardiography adaptation benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms interpolation baselines and matches or exceeds direct supervised prediction, reducing Hilbert Transform, $L_2$, and Dynamic Time Warping distance by up to ${\sim}15\%$ over the strongest competing baseline. These results suggest that bridge geometry is a critical inductive bias for flow matching on oscillatory signal translation.

AI.tldr: 提出"柱面测地流匹配"方法，用相位-振幅柱面上的闭式测地路径替代标准仿射路径，实现准周期生理波形的配对翻译。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备在不同身体位置采集的心血管信号之间存在源到目标的配对翻译需求（如从源振荡信号恢复目标信号）。该映射具有内在几何结构：相位绕周期回卷需视为循环变量、振幅严格为正、逐拍对齐在周期与受试者间不可预测漂移。现有深度网络虽用于相位估计与复值信号建模，但未显式学习配对信号间的相位传输，端点监督回归与流匹配中的标准仿射路径均未考虑该相位-振幅结构。
AI.method: 提出柱面测地流匹配（cylindrical geodesic flow matching）用于配对心血管波形翻译。证明流匹配中标准仿射路径在准周期信号间插值时会扭曲中间振幅与瞬时频率；将其替换为相位-振幅柱面上的闭式测地线，消除这些伪影并将每个训练对转化为密集的、几何一致的速率监督。在零样本PPG与有限支持SCG适配基准上验证。
AI.result: 在零样本光电容积描记（PPG）与有限支持心震图（SCG）适配基准上，方法持续优于插值基线，并能匹配或超越直接监督预测；相比最强竞争基线，希尔伯特变换、L2与动态时间规整距离最多降低约15%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，桥接几何（bridge geometry）是振荡信号翻译流匹配中的关键归纳偏置。

title: AnyBottle: A Recipe to Only Keep the Concepts You Really Need
summary: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make predictions inspectable and intervenable by routing them through human-interpretable concepts, but originally required concept annotations. Annotation-free variants remove this requirement, but typically use large concept vocabularies, static at both training and inference, producing bottlenecks larger than any task or prediction needs and harder to inspect. We propose AnyBottle, a single recipe for building compact, task-specific CBMs. AnyBottle assumes only a frozen backbone and an unsupervised concept pool, such as a sparse autoencoder. A black-box teacher trained on the same backbone then guides selection: each round adds the concept that best explains the bottleneck's current failures, with candidates restricted to regions of teacher/student disagreement. Trained with nested dropout over this selection order, the final bottleneck predicts accurately from any concept prefix, so inference spends fewer concepts on inputs it is confident about early and more on hard ones. Since no stage is modality-specific, a new domain and task requires swapping only the backbone and concept pool. Across six vision and two text datasets and two teacher paradigms, AnyBottle yields bottlenecks with fewer concepts and higher concept consistency than annotation-free baselines, while staying close to the black-box reference. Overall, AnyBottle shows that going annotation-free need not mean going large: a small, discovered vocabulary can be as expressive as a much larger, fixed one.

AI.tldr: AnyBottle 提出一种通用方法，用冻结骨干网络与无监督概念池构建紧凑、任务特定的概念瓶颈模型，实现无标注且瓶颈更小。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型虽可解释、可干预，但原始版本需要概念标注；无标注变体又依赖大规模、训练与推理时固定的概念词表，导致瓶颈过大、难以检查且超出任务需要。
AI.method: 仅依赖冻结骨干和无监督概念池（如稀疏自编码器）；用同骨干训练的黑盒教师引导选择，每轮加入最能解释当前瓶颈失败的概念，候选限制在师生分歧区域；按选择顺序使用嵌套 dropout 训练，使瓶颈在任意概念前缀下都能准确预测，从而对简单输入用更少概念、对困难输入用更多概念。
AI.result: 在六个视觉和两个文本数据集、两种教师范式下，相比无标注基线，AnyBottle 用更少概念获得更高概念一致性，同时性能接近黑盒参考。
AI.conclusion: 无需标注并不意味着必须使用大规模概念词表；通过发现得到的小型词表可以像更大的固定词表一样具有表达力。

title: Adaptive Power Sampling for LLM Reasoning
summary: Sequence-level power sampling has recently emerged as a training-free approach to reasoning by sampling from a sharpened output distribution of a base large language model (LLM). Nevertheless, existing methods typically sharpen the base model distribution uniformly across queries, overlooking variations in query difficulty and in how well the base model already handles each query. The goal of this work is to equip power sampling with query adaptivity. Theoretically, we show that the benefits of further sharpening are determined by the self-reward gap between correct and incorrect responses. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Adaptive Power Sampling} (APS), which adjusts the sharpening exponent on a per-query basis at test time using the relationship between answer agreement and the model's self-reward. Experiments across diverse reasoning tasks, including MATH500, HumanEval, and GPQA, show that APS consistently outperforms power sampling with a fixed sharpening exponent, without additional training.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应幂采样(APS)，按查询难度动态调整锐化指数，无需训练即提升LLM推理表现。
AI.motivation: 现有序列级幂采样方法在所有查询上统一锐化基座模型分布，忽略了查询难度差异以及基座模型对不同查询的已有处理能力。
AI.method: 从理论上证明进一步锐化的收益由正确答案与错误答案之间的自奖励差距决定；据此提出APS，在测试时利用答案一致性与模型自奖励之间的关系，对每个查询单独调整锐化指数。
AI.result: 在MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA等多种推理任务上，APS一致优于固定锐化指数的幂采样，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应锐化能有效提升免训练幂采样推理方法的性能。

title: MINDSET: Energy-based Schema Evolution for Long Conversational Agent Memory
summary: Long conversational agents have become essential in our daily lives. They must remember what was said long back in order to help us efficiently complete a task without needing the user to repeat instructions and context repeatedly. However, the main issue is that instructions and context change over time and so the agents must be able to adapt accordingly. A useful memory system should preserve both current and historical states, distinguish stale information from active knowledge, retrieve evidence appropriate to the query and avoid repeatedly invoking a large language model to rewrite prior interactions. We introduce MINDSET, a memory controller that stores a conversation as immutable episodes and organizes them into versioned schemas through minimum-energy state transitions. Each incoming episode may reinforce, supersede, split or create a schema. The transition decision balances representation distortion, contradiction, historical damage, fragmentation and internal inconsistency, while hysteresis prevents isolated contradictions from prematurely rewriting stable memory. We evaluate MINDSET against 5 memory systems on a reproducible sample of 850 questions (700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench). MINDSET obtains the highest observed LoCoMo answer F1 while significantly improving retrieval ranking (Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8) over the second best method LightMem (p<0.01 after Holm correction). It obtains the highest observed scores on MemoryAgentBench although the relative difference is low. Ablations identify controlled fragmentation and schema-aware assignment as the largest contributors to answer quality. Additionally, a 700-question cross-model evaluation with GLM-4.7 and Gemma-4-31B supported model independence. These results show that long-term memory can be better handled as constrained state management rather than continual summarization.

AI.tldr: MINDSET 将长期对话记忆建模为受约束的状态管理：把对话存为不可变的情节，并通过最小能量状态转移组织成带版本的 schema，从而在 LoCoMo 与 MemoryAgentBench 上取得最优问答与检索表现。
AI.motivation: 长对话智能体需记住久远信息以高效完成任务，但指令与上下文随时间变化，智能体必须随之适应。理想的记忆系统应同时保留当前与历史状态、区分过时信息与活跃知识、按查询检索相关证据，并避免反复调用大模型重写历史交互。
AI.method: 提出 MINDSET 记忆控制器：以不可变情节（immutable episodes）存储对话，通过最小能量状态转移将其组织为带版本的 schema。每个新情节可强化、取代、拆分或新建 schema；转移决策综合权衡表示失真、矛盾、历史损害、碎片化与内部不一致，并以迟滞（hysteresis）机制防止孤立矛盾过早改写稳定记忆。
AI.result: 在 850 题可复现样本（700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench）上与 5 个记忆系统对比：MINDSET 取得最高的 LoCoMo 答案 F1，并在检索排序（Recall@8、MRR、nDCG@8）上显著优于次优方法 LightMem（Holm 校正后 p<0.01）；在 MemoryAgentBench 上得分最高但差距较小。消融显示受控碎片化与 schema 感知分配是答案质量的最大贡献因素。700 题跨模型评估（GLM-4.7 与 Gemma-4-31B）支持模型无关性。
AI.conclusion: 长期记忆更适合作为受约束的状态管理来处理，而非持续总结式重写。

title: Parallel Predictive World Models for Accurate and Efficient Long-Horizon Planning
summary: Long-horizon world-model planning typically relies on autoregressive rollouts, where predicted states are repeatedly fed back into the model. This preserves temporal structure but creates a horizon-length sequential path and exposes later predictions to recursive decoded-state feedback. We introduce Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict a finite-horizon trajectory in parallel while retaining causal interaction among future representations. Each horizon is conditioned on its causal action prefix, and future representations interact before decoding, separating temporal causality from state-by-state output recursion. We formalize this distinction by viewing autoregressive rollout as a causal trajectory map and identifying the decoded-state feedback pathway removed by PPWM. Across four visual-control tasks, PPWM achieves the lowest long-horizon prediction error and the highest Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) simulator success among the evaluated predictive interfaces. Meanwhile, PPWM achieves more than a 3$\times$ average CEM planning speedup over the autoregressive LeWM baseline. These results suggest that accurate and efficient long-horizon world-model planning does not require state-by-state autoregression, but can instead be achieved through parallel causal trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出并行预测世界模型(PPWM),通过并行预测有限时域轨迹并保留未来表征间的因果交互,避免了逐步自回归展开中的序列路径与解码状态反馈问题,在多个视觉控制任务上取得更低长时域预测误差和更高CEM规划成功率,并带来3倍以上规划加速。
AI.motivation: 长时域世界模型规划通常依赖自回归展开,将预测状态反复回馈给模型。这虽然保留了时间结构,却造成与时域长度成正比的顺序路径,并使后期预测暴露于递归解码状态反馈之下。作者希望探索:准确高效的长时域规划是否真的需要逐状态自回归。
AI.method: 提出PPWM,并行预测有限时域轨迹,同时保持未来表征之间的因果交互。每个时域以其因果动作前缀为条件,未来表征在解码前先相互交互,从而将时间因果性与逐状态输出递归分离。作者将自回归展开形式化为因果轨迹映射,并识别出PPWM所移除的解码状态反馈路径。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制任务上,PPWM在所评估的预测接口中取得最低的长时域预测误差和最高的CEM模拟器成功率;相比自回归LeWM基线,平均CEM规划速度提升3倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 准确且高效的长时域世界模型规划并不需要逐状态自回归,可以通过并行因果轨迹预测实现。

title: Coupled but Late: Turn-Taking Between Full-Duplex Speech Models in Unscripted Dialogue
summary: Full-duplex speech models are trained to converse with a person, but they are increasingly made to converse with each other, in self-play data generation, agent societies, and model-based evaluation. In that loop no human absorbs a timing error: each model's turn-taking is the other's input. We ask what timing the loop settles into. Two PersonaPlex-7B instances exchange audio tokens on a shared clock in unscripted conversation, and one floor-transfer rule is applied to them and to Switchboard. Their timing is coupled: re-pairing speakers across conversations destroys it. But the floor changes hands late, at a median of 400-560 ms against 137 ms for humans, and the last 120 ms of the partner's turn, where human projection places a tenth of its transfers, holds 1% of theirs. Delaying one direction of the channel shifts the response one-for-one and leaves the run-up to it empty, consistent with a reactive wait after the perceived end rather than the turn-end projection human timing requires.

AI.tldr: 两个 PersonaPlex-7B 实例在共享时钟上以音频 token 进行无脚本对话，其话轮交接时机是相互耦合的，但交接显著晚于人类（中位数 400–560 ms vs 137 ms），末 120 ms 的预测性交接几乎缺失。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型如今越来越多地与同类模型对话（自博弈数据生成、智能体社会、基于模型的评测），在这种回路中没有人类吸收时机误差，每个模型的轮流发言就是对方的输入，因此需要追问该回路最终稳定在怎样的时机模式，以及这种机器间时机是否与人类对话一致。
AI.method: 让两个 PersonaPlex-7B 实例在共享时钟上交换音频 token 进行无脚本对话，并对它们与 Switchboard（人类通话语料）施加同一套话轮转移（floor-transfer）规则；通过重新配对跨对话的说话人来检验时机的耦合性，并人为延迟某一方向的信道来观察响应时机的变化。
AI.result: 时机是耦合的：跨对话重新配对说话人会破坏这种耦合。但话轮交接发生得很晚，中位数为 400–560 ms，而人类为 137 ms；在伙伴话轮最后 120 ms 内（人类投射性交接有十分之一落在此窗口），这些模型的交接仅占 1%。将信道某一方向延迟后，响应随之等量平移，且响应之前的铺垫区为空，说明它们是感知到结束之后的被动等待，而非人类时机所需的末尾投射。
AI.conclusion: 全双工语音模型之间的对话自组织出稳定但"反应式"的时机模式，缺少人类的预测性话轮末投射，其交接系统性偏晚；这种机器回路中的时机偏差无法被人类参与者吸收，对自博弈数据生成与多智能体语音评测的可靠性构成隐忧。

title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
summary: Large language model agents are accelerating scientific automation, yet verified executions rarely become persistent program-level improvements, and existing evaluations do not examine this process across sequential tasks in both the natural and social sciences. We formalize ScienceClaw as fixed-parameter program self-evolution that unifies task solving, scientific verification, and program updates. ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation. Our framework repairs executable workflows through multi-turn interaction, converts re-execution-verified failure--success trajectories into linked Skill and Operator candidates, and retains an update only when source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScienceClaw，将科学任务中的程序自我演化形式化为固定参数的程序自演化过程，并构建 ScienceClaw-Eval 跨23个学科评估科学正确性、演化增益、保持性、跨数据集迁移和演化成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体正加速科学自动化，但经过验证的执行很少能转化为持久的程序级改进，且现有评估未在自然科学与社会科学中跨顺序任务考察这一过程。
AI.method: 形式化 ScienceClaw 为固定参数程序自演化，统一任务求解、科学验证与程序更新；通过多轮交互修复可执行工作流，将经重执行验证的失败—成功轨迹转化为关联的 Skill 与 Operator 候选，仅当源任务重放复现修复且独立科学任务得到改进时才保留更新。ScienceClaw-Eval 覆盖23个学科，通过顺序流与独立重置评估进行测量。
AI.result: ScienceClaw-Eval 在多学科序列任务上测量了科学正确性、演化增益、保持性、跨数据集迁移及演化成本，实现了对程序自演化过程的系统评估。
AI.conclusion: ScienceClaw 为科学智能体程序自我演化提供了形式化框架与跨学科评估基准，强调经验证的程序级持久改进与严格保留准则。

title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://nanomuse.cn ; Code: https://github.com/nano-muse/nanoMuse
summary: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"个人智能体"（具备账户、设备、长期记忆与持续对话能力的软件），以Meta的Muse为参照分析其构建方式，并提出开源对应物nanoMuse及其路线图。
AI.motivation: 2011年的助手是被动应答，2023年的智能体完成单一任务即停止；而2026年Meta的Muse展示了面向个人、跨账户与设备、长期记忆、主动发起对话且封闭于单一厂商云和国家的智能体。此类个人智能体在能力上具有新意，却在开放生态中缺乏对应实现。
AI.method: 报告用五个问题和三个视界来定义个人智能体；依据Meta的公开记录及一份其生产提示词的副本来解析Muse的构建方式，并对每条陈述标注来源；随后提出nanoMuse——基于GPL-3.0的开源对应物，覆盖用户所有设备，共享经由可自托管中继的同一段对话，所有动作经过Sentinel，记忆为可读文件，模型可自选，并以估算形式给出其规模与成本。
AI.result: 给出了个人智能体的定义框架、对Muse构建方式的有源解析，以及nanoMuse的开放设计与规模、成本估算，并将开放性、带溯源的记忆、面向"操作手"的评测套件与开放模型列为路线图。
AI.conclusion: 个人智能体应被理解为一种软件而非模型，其开放实现是可行的；nanoMuse提供了在开源许可下、由用户掌握记忆、模型选择与操作控制权的替代方案，后续工作聚焦开放记忆溯源、操作能力评测与开放模型。

title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver, a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver.

AI.tldr: WorldSolver 是一个包含 168 个仿真任务的基准，源自 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文中的物理现象，覆盖 7 个物理领域，用于评测 LLM 智能体生成物理求解器的能力，从可执行性、视觉保真度和物理合理性三个维度评估。前沿智能体表现不佳，最优者总分仅约 48.7%。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真是具身智能、游戏和影视的重要应用场景，而求解器是仿真的核心。构建求解器需要物理理解、数学推理和软件工程三方面能力，但 LLM 智能体在这方面的能力尚缺乏系统性评测，因此需要一个专门的基准来推动研究。
AI.method: 提出 WorldSolver 基准，包含 168 个仿真任务，取自 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文的物理现象，覆盖 7 个物理领域。每个任务提供固定仿真环境的代码脚手架，求解器实现由智能体补全。从三个维度评测：执行检查（能否成功运行）、视觉保真度（是否复现预期动态行为）、物理合理性（基于物理的动力学验证）。
AI.result: 前沿智能体实验显示，生成可执行求解器本身就很困难，满足视觉与物理正确性更难。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 相对其他智能体表现更好，但总体得分仅为 48.7% 和 46.7%。
AI.conclusion: WorldSolver 是迈向智能体求解器生成的第一步，希望推动智能体向能够忠实模拟动态物理世界的方向发展。代码已开源。

title: Does an Agent's History Tell You When Compaction Will Hurt? A Modest, Bounded Effect on the TRACE Paired-Replay Corpus
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 20 pages
summary: Many long-horizon agents compact their context on a global rule, usually a token budget, blind to what the agent was doing. We ask whether the agent's recent behaviour predicts when a compaction will hurt. TRACE's public corpus of 590 harness-triggered AppWorld compaction boundaries replays each boundary from a re-executed prefix state under the pre-compaction context and under the summary, and records the burden of the next actions: calls that error or repeat a call already made. We find that pre-boundary history predicts post-compaction harm only weakly. An internally prespecified contrast by prefix placement is a wide null, and the naive "has-written" label behind it turns out to measure trajectory phase. The best extension-protocol trigger reaches held-out AUROC 0.66 (0.64 on the replicate's own label) against a same-boundary replicate of 0.72; the best frozen, interpretable trigger avoids 21% of harmful (positive-burden) boundaries while keeping 84% of compaction opportunities, and exceeds the random-rule expectation on count but not on burden mass (a post hoc comparison). Whether the best trigger beats a token-budget rule at matched retention cannot be evaluated on the release. We state what corpora should ship to answer it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时间跨度智能体的上下文压缩时机：判断压缩前行为能否预测压缩后的有害性。基于TRACE公开语料（590个压缩边界），发现压缩前历史对压缩后损害的预测能力很弱；最佳可解释触发器能避开21%的有害边界并保留84%的压缩机会，但尚无法判定其是否优于固定token预算规则。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程智能体通常按全局规则（如token预算）压缩上下文，完全不考虑智能体当前正在做什么。作者希望检验智能体的近期行为能否预测哪些压缩会带来损害，从而推动更"行为感知"的压缩触发策略。
AI.method: 利用TRACE公开语料中590个由测试框架触发的AppWorld压缩边界，将每个边界从重执行的前缀状态出发，分别在压缩前上下文与摘要两种条件下回放，并记录后续动作的"负担"（出错或重复已做过的调用）。开展预注册对比（按前缀位置），并比较扩展协议触发器、冻结的可解释触发器与随机规则、token预算规则的表现。
AI.result: 压缩前历史对压缩后损害仅有弱预测力；按前缀位置的预注册对比为宽零结果，"是否已写入"标签实际度量的是轨迹阶段。最佳扩展协议触发器held-out AUROC为0.66（复现标签上0.64），而同一边界复现为0.72；最佳冻结可解释触发器避开21%有害边界，同时保留84%压缩机会，在计数上超过随机规则期望，但在负担质量上没有。是否优于token预算规则无法在现有发布数据上评估。
AI.conclusion: 压缩前行为对压缩后损害的预测能力有限，现有语料不足以判定行为感知触发器是否优于token预算规则，作者据此提出未来语料应包含哪些内容以便回答该问题。

title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriFine框架，通过策略、课程与评判器的共同进化来扩展验证能力，实现具身推理中的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 自我改进策略不断暴露新的失败模式，改变了评判器需要验证的内容；而现有固定评判器同时限制了优化反馈和有用训练样本的发现，阻碍了进一步自我改进。这一问题在具身推理中尤为突出，因为可靠评估需要兼顾空间定位、因果推理与安全决策。
AI.method: VeriFine包含两个循环：策略改进循环使用评分标准评判器诊断反复出现的失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；当进度停滞、验证成为瓶颈时，评判器改进循环选择性地对信息量大的失败案例查询人类指导，并通过共同校准（人类与智能体解决分歧、趋近物理推理的客观评分标准）来精炼评判器。修订后的评判器随后指导下一阶段的数据选择与策略优化。
AI.result: 在驾驶和机器人导航任务上的实验表明，无论强化学习还是监督微调，策略与评判器能力都实现了持续自我改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，扩展验证能力能够随着策略失败模式的演化，支撑持续的自我改进。

title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability "bottling": the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. We introduce BOTTLED, a benchmark in which agents receive an entire unlabelled workload and must complete it under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. Agents choose their own approach, such as training a small model or writing a reusable program. Across ten models and three tasks, we find that strong zero-shot task performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models with similar zero-shot scores can differ substantially after bottling, and 48 of 60 bottling runs score below the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of their model's zero-shot performance. Moreover, 31 of 60 runs underperform the stronger of two small-model distillation baselines with the same token budget. Nevertheless, bottling can yield substantial savings: on query-product relevance classification, Opus 5 retains about 82% of its zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. Bottling is also competitive with Jev, a "system one" model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5 on the same task recovers about 94% of Jev's macro-F1 at a quarter of Jev's projected full-workload cost. BOTTLED provides a basis for evaluating and improving agents' ability to invest limited resources in reusable solutions for large, repetitive workloads.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"bottling"能力和BOTTLED基准，考察LLM智能体能否将通用能力转化为低成本、可复用的任务专用方案；结果显示强零样本性能并不必然带来强bottling能力，但可带来显著成本节省。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能解决许多细分任务，但对数百万相关实例逐一查询成本过高，因此需要评估智能体能否自主为大规模重复性工作负载创建更廉价的解决方案，即在答案质量与摊销成本之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出BOTTLED基准：智能体接收完整的无标签工作负载，并在固定的时间、计算和LLM API预算下完成；智能体可自行选择方法，如训练小模型或编写可复用程序。实验覆盖十种模型和三类任务。
AI.result: 强零样本性能并不能可靠转化为强bottling能力：零样本分数相近的模型在bottling后差异明显；60次bottling运行中有48次低于其模型零样本性能95%置信区间下界；31次低于同token预算下两种小模型蒸馏基线中较强者的表现。但bottling可带来显著节省：在查询-商品相关性分类上，Opus 5保留约82%的零样本macro-F1，报告成本约低657倍；同任务上恢复Jev约94%的macro-F1，成本仅为Jev预计全负载成本的四分之一。
AI.conclusion: BOTTLED为评估和改进智能体在大型重复性工作负载中投入有限资源以构建可复用解决方案的能力提供了基础。
